introduction_zh: 腾讯视频是中国领先的在线视频平台，涵盖影视、综艺、动漫、纪录片等多元内容，拥有《庆余年2》《繁花》《三体》等爆款剧集，以及《脱口秀大会》《五十公里桃花坞》等热门综艺。平台在国漫领域表现突出，推出《斗罗大陆》《完美世界》等优质作品，并与HBO、BBC等国际厂牌合作，截至2025年3月，付费会员达1.17亿。腾讯视频以“不负好时光”为品牌理念，持续提供高品质内容，满足用户多端娱乐需求。
introduction_en: Tencent Video is China's leading online video platform, offering a diverse range of content including films, TV series, variety shows, animations, and documentaries. It boasts hit dramas such as Joy of Life 2, Blossoms Shanghai, and The Three-Body Problem, as well as popular variety programs like Rock & Roast and Fifty Kilometers Peach Blossom. The platform excels in domestic animation, producing high-quality works like Douluo Continent and Perfect World, while also collaborating with international brands such as HBO and BBC. As of March 2025, it has 117 million paying members. Guided by the brand philosophy of "Make Every Moment Shine," Tencent Video continues to deliver premium content to meet users' multi-screen entertainment needs.

introduction_zh: 创始于1848年的珠宝品牌老凤祥将再次亮相 2026 China Joy，近年来，老凤祥持续推进品牌年轻化转型，先后与迪士尼、圣斗士星矢、高达、蛋仔派对、铁臂阿童木等众多经典IP跨界合作，今年即将携手国民仙侠IP《仙剑奇侠传》达成全线联名合作，依托老凤祥深厚的研发生产能力，将非遗工艺与仙侠文化融合，倾力呈现多品类的联名系列产品。CJ展台将会展现出老凤祥多个联名IP产品，期待各位莅临！
introduction_en: Founded in 1848, the jewelry brand LaoFengXiang will make a grand return to ChinaJoy 2026. In recent years, LaoFengXiang has been actively pursuing a youth-oriented brand transformation, collaborating across multiple iconic IPs such as Disney, Saint Seiya, Gundam, Egg Party, and Astro Boy. This year, the brand is set to launch a full-line collaboration with the beloved Chinese xianxia IP "Chinese Paladin: Sword and Fairy" integrating its profound craftsmanship and intangible cultural heritage techniques with xianxia culture to present a diverse range of co-branded products. The CJ booth of LaoFengXiang will showcase various co-branded items. Looking forward to your visit!

introduction_zh: 腾讯视频是中国领先的在线视频平台，涵盖影视、综艺、动漫、纪录片等多元内容，拥有《庆余年2》《繁花》《三体》等爆款剧集，《脱口秀大会》《五十公里桃花坞》等热门综艺，以及《斗罗大陆》《完美世界》等优质动漫作品。截至2025年3月，付费会员达1.17亿。腾讯视频以“不负好时光”为品牌理念，持续提供高品质内容，满足用户多端娱乐需求。爱玩游戏为腾讯视频旗下专业的游戏平台，为玩家提供丰富的游戏内容海量游戏道具
introduction_en:
Tencent Video is China's leading online video streaming platform. It covers a diverse array of content including films, TV dramas, variety shows, animations and documentaries. Its blockbuster dramas include Joy of Life Season 2, Blossoms Shanghai and The Three-Body Problem; hit variety shows feature Rock & Roast and 50km Taohuawu; it also boasts premium animations such as Douluo Continent and Perfect World. As of March 2025, its number of paying members hit 117 million. Guided by its brand slogan "Treasure Every Moment", Tencent Video consistently delivers high-quality content to satisfy users’ entertainment needs across all devices.
Aiwan Games is a professional gaming platform affiliated with Tencent Video, offering players rich gaming content and massive in-game props.

name_zh: 默沙东（中国）投资有限公司
introduction_zh: 在默沙东（默沙东是美国新泽西州罗威市默克公司的公司商号），我们齐心协力追求共同的目标：我们发挥前沿科学的力量，在全球范围内拯救生命、改善生活。130多年来，我们通过研发重要药物和疫苗，为全人类带来希望。我们致力成为顶尖的研究密集型生物制药公司——当下，我们正处于研发前线，推出创新解决方案，以推进人类和动物疾病的预防和治疗。我们建立了一个多元、包容的全球员工体系，以负责的态度经营每一天，确保所有人、
introduction_en: At MSD, known as Merck & Co., Inc., Rahway, N.J., USA in the United States and Canada, we are unified around our purpose: We use the power of leading-edge science to save and improve lives around the world. For more than 130 years, we have brought hope to humanity through the development of important medicines and vaccines. We aspire to be the premier research-intensive biopharmaceutical company in the world - and today, we are at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions that advance the prevention and treatment of diseases in people and animals. We foster a diverse and inclusive global workforce and operate responsibly every day to enable a safe, sustainable and healthy future for all people and communities.

name_zh: 厦门真景科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 「像素蛋糕」是行业领先的AI修图软件，依托多项独家AI技术（行业首个自研应用级图像大模型“方糖大模型”、“16bit·AI Raw引擎”等），帮助创作者们高效完成图像处理工作。产品能力覆盖联机拍摄、AI追色、专业调色、人像精修、图像美化、AI生成式应用等图像处理全流程，现已累计帮助数万家商业摄影机构提效增收。
introduction_en:
“PixCake” is an industry-leading AI photo editing software powered by multiple proprietary AI technologies, including the industry’s first self-developed application-level image foundation model, the “Fondant Model,” and the “16bit AI Raw Engine.”
PixCake helps creators complete image processing workflows with greater efficiency. Its capabilities cover the full image editing process, including tethered shooting, AI color matching, professional color grading, portrait retouching, image enhancement, and AI generative applications. To date, it has helped tens of thousands of commercial photography studios improve efficiency and increase revenue.

name_zh: 厦门汉印股份有限公司
introduction_zh: 厦门汉印股份有限公司是一家专业从事打印设备的研发、生产、销售及服务的国家级高新技术企业，致力成为全球打印行业的领导者。凭借自主研发的核心精密技术，先后荣“国家级专精特新小巨人企业”、以及“德国红点最佳设计奖”、“中国专利奖”等重要奖项，并积极响应国家碳中和与绿色制造的号召，获评“福建省绿色工厂”。目前已与多家科研院所成立产学研究院，成为行业先锋。
introduction_en: Founded in 2012, Xiamen Hanin Co., Ltd. is a national high-tech enterprise and a global leader in printing equipment, offering professional, end-to-end printing solutions across diverse industries. With self-developed core technologies and a strong presence in over 80 countries and regions, Hanin empowers businesses with IoT-enabled connectivity and intelligent automation.

name_zh: 深圳市领德创科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
深圳市领德创科技深耕固态存储二十余年，是国内少有的产销研一体化出海存储品牌，总部设于深圳，主营消费、企业级存储全链条业务，致力打造全球优质固态存储服务商。
公司手握固件算法、芯片测试、加密存储、封装设计等核心技术，产品覆盖 AI、云计算、车储、大数据领域，为金融、医疗、互联网企业提供可靠存储方案。提供 OEM/ODM 代工，自有梵想等三大品牌，海内外铺货，欧美中东设子公司，市场口碑销量双优。
introduction_en: Lingdechuang Technology Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as “LDC") is one of the few Chinese overseas brands with comprehensive strength integrating production, sales, and R&D. The founder and founding team have been engaged in the solid-state storage industry for over 20 years. Headquartered in Shenzhen, the company boasts an integrated manufacturing、R&D and sales office of over 13,000 square meters. LDC specializes in the research, development, production, sales, and service of consumer and enterprise-grade storage products, striving to become a globally outstanding solid-state storage service provider.

name_zh: 成都威正数码科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 成都威正数码科技是集研发、生产、销售于一体的技术企业，拥有专业研发、生产及管理团队，可独立完成光学、结构、软硬件、模具等全流程开发制造，主营镜头、闪光灯等摄影器材。公司建有万级无尘车间与标准化产线，搭配高精度检测设备，镜头年产能 50 万只。旗下美科（MEKE）品牌拥有多项国际认证，产品远销全球多地，口碑优良。企业深耕技术创新，竭诚为全球客户提供高品质产品与服务。
introduction_en: Chengdu Weizheng Digital Technology Co.,Ltd is a technology-driven enterprise integrating R&D, manufacturing, and sales. Supported by a professional team dedicated to R&D, production, and management, the company is capable of independently executing the entire development and manufacturing process—encompassing optics, structural design, hardware and software, and mold fabrication. The company specializes in photography equipment, with a primary focus on lenses and flash units. Committed to deep-rooted technological innovation, the enterprise is dedicated to providing high-quality products and services to customers worldwide.

introduction_zh: 自1924年以来，德国拜雅（beyerdynamic）推出了无数一流的专业音频产品，备受世界各地用户的推崇。大多数产品都是在德国海尔布隆工厂手工制造。在“音乐创作”、“电竞游戏”、“录音混音”、“HIFI”和“会议办公”等领域，拜雅提供了各类专业耳机、麦克风、游戏耳机、家庭娱乐和办公产品。它们都有一个共同点：纯净自然的声音。百年匠心，跨越世界的舞台，进入人们的耳朵和心灵。
introduction_en:
Since 1924, beyerdynamic of Germany has launched countless premium professional audio products acclaimed by users worldwide. Most items are handcrafted at the brand’s manufacturing facility in Heilbronn, Germany.
Spanning music production, esports gaming, recording & mixing, Hi-Fi, as well as conference and office scenarios, beyerdynamic supplies a full lineup of professional headphones, microphones, gaming headsets, home entertainment and office audio gear. All share one core trait: pristine, natural sound.
A century of meticulous craftsmanship crosses global stages, reaching listeners’ ears and touching their hearts.

introduction_zh: 日本乐敦制药（ROHTO）创立于1899年，坚持制药级品质，业务覆盖眼部健康、护肤等领域。本次ChinaJoy将展示乐敦高端V钻系列眼药水，针对干涩、眼疲劳及红血丝问题，深受电竞人群喜爱；劲Z!清凉眼药水，联名《火影忍者》《勇者斗恶龙》等IP，将护眼与二次元文化结合；以及乐敦小花Lycee系列和Melano CC护肤系列等明星产品，传递品牌“Moving the Heart”理念。
introduction_en: Founded in 1899, ROHTO Pharmaceutical Japan adheres to pharmaceutical-grade quality with businesses spanning eye health and skincare. At this ChinaJoy, we will showcase our premium V Rohto eye drops, which effectively relieve dryness, eye strain and bloodshot eyes and are hugely popular among esports enthusiasts. The ultra-cool Z! eye drops combine eye care with anime culture through collaborations with iconic IPs such as Naruto and Dragon Quest. Also on display are star products including the Lycee series and Melano CC skincare line, embodying the brand philosophy "Moving the Heart".

name_zh: 广东恒兴集团有限公司
introduction_zh: 广东恒兴（恒兴集团、恒兴股份）创立于1991年，是农业产业化国家重点龙头企业。恒兴以“恒农兴邦”为使命，“提高人类生活品质”为愿景，已发展出一条完整的水产食品产业链，业务板块包括种苗繁育、饲料产销、动物保健、水产养殖、食品加工、智慧渔业、水产交易平台等。恒兴食品依托恒兴水产食品全产业链资源，以水产食品研发、加工、销售为一体，致力于为广大消费者提供“从塘头到餐桌”真正可溯源的安全、营养、美味的食品。
introduction_en: Guangdong Evergreen Conglomerate, founded in 1991, is a national-level leading enterprise in China’s agricultural industrialization.For over three decades, Evergreen has upheld its mission of “Strengthening Agriculture to Revitalize the Nation” and its vision of “Enhancing the Quality of Human Life.”Today, Evergreen has built a fully integrated aquatic food industry chain “from pond to dining table,” covering the entire value chain, including: broodstock and seed breeding, feed production and sales, animal health, aquaculture farming, food processing, and smart fisheries. This integrated ecosystem enables Evergreen to deliver safe, traceable, and high-quality aquatic products to consumers worldwide.

name_zh: 爱数伴（上海）人工智能科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
爱数伴（上海）人工智能科技有限公司，成立于2022年，是一家深耕人工智能情感交互与数字生命领域的科技创新企业。公司聚焦AI大模型、3D实时渲染与智能硬件的前沿融合，致力于定义并打造新一代具身智能交互产品。
旗下旗舰产品“Dipal D1”，是一款实现裸眼3D视觉跟随与深度情感化交互的AI陪伴设备。其搭载自研人格化AI引擎，支持用户自主导入并长期培育专属数字伙伴，在虚实交融中构建持续进化的情感链接。
introduction_en:
Dipal (Shanghai) AI Technology Co., Ltd., founded in 2022, is an innovative technology company specializing in AI-powered emotional interaction and digital life. The company focuses on the integration of large AI models, real-time 3D rendering, and intelligent hardware technologies, with the mission of defining and creating the next generation of embodied AI interaction products.

Its flagship product, Dipal D1, is an AI companion device that combines glasses-free 3D visual tracking with deep emotional interaction. Powered by Dipal's proprietary Personality AI Engine, it enables users to import and nurture their own digital companions, fostering continuously evolving emotional connections that bridge the virtual and physical worlds.

name_zh: 上海宸漫科技股份有限公司
introduction_zh:
CHANTECLAIR是DESA集团旗下品牌， 也是意大利百年国宝级家庭清洁品牌，由于品类众多，适用范围广，因此受到国人的喜爱。
CHANTECLAIR大公鸡管家秉承着注重专业技术、传统和品质的品牌价值观；凭借天然、纯粹、亲肤的马赛皂产品，成为意大利家喻户晓的品牌。其中，多能油污净更是凭借适用范围广，去污性强而成为生活必备的日常清洁用品
introduction_en:
CHANTECLAIR is a distinguished brand under the DESA Group and a centuryold, national treasure of Italy in the household cleaning sector. Due to its extensive product range and versatile applications, it has garnered significant popularity among Chinese consumers.
Adhering core brand values that emphasize professional expertise, tradition, and superior quality, CHANTECLAIR has established itself as a household name in Italy through its natural, pure, and skin- Marseille soap products. Notably, its Multi-Purpose Degreaser has become an essential daily cleaning staple, highly regarded for its broad applicability and exceptional cleaning efficacy

name_zh: 深圳市神牛摄影器材有限公司
introduction_zh: 深圳市神牛摄影器材有限公司成立于1993年，位于深圳市宝安区耀川工业园，是一家集研发、设计、制造、销售于一体的高新技术企业。主要为摄影摄像行业从业者提供优质的灯光和影音设备。我们始终秉持创新、诚信、严谨、务实、包容的企业信念，旨在提供卓越的影像、影视灯光和音频解决方案，在技术上不断突破，成为行业领先者。
introduction_en: Founded in 1993 as a high-tech manufacturing facility specializing in lighting and audio equipment, Godox has now become a lighting equipment expert and innovator of gears for photographers, videographers, filmmakers and more. Driven by the mission of offering great lighting and audio solutions, Godox has been always pushing the boundaries of technology, and constantly bringing professional products to the industries.

name_zh: 深圳市卡瑞颂科技有限责任公司
introduction_zh: 卡瑞颂科技是专注于AI陪伴机器人研发与软硬一体化交互体验创新的科技企业，以「爱是最伟大的算法」为核心理念，创造了全球首个“AI陪伴机器人 ⅹ 养成APP”的软硬一体人机交互范式，将情感计算、人格养成大模型与多模态交互技术深度融合，打造可触摸、可对话、可成长的专属原生情感载体；产品拥有沉浸式剧情体验、商业级视听品质与高水准内容制作，从情感算法到内容生态，实现极致呈现。
introduction_en: KAROSON is a tech enterprise dedicated to the R&D of AI companion robots and the innovation of integrated hardware‑software interactive experiences. Guided by the core belief that “love is the greatest algorithm,” it has created the world’s first integrated human‑machine interaction paradigm that combines “AI companion robots” with “nurturing apps.” By deeply integrating affective computing, personality‑development large language models, and multimodal interaction technologies, it builds a tangible, conversational, and growable exclusive native emotional companion. Its products offer immersive narrative experiences, commercial‑grade audiovisual quality, and high‑caliber content production, delivering a pinnacle presentation from emotional algorithms to the content ecosystem.

introduction_zh: 美图以美为内核、AI 为驱动，打造轻量化全能影像创作工具。旗下产品美图秀秀——全球AI人像氛围&创意工具，提供视频/图片/Live人像精修，专注全球AI人像氛围与创意玩法；Wink——AI视频超清工具，动态美颜&网感出片必备。
introduction_en: Combining AI and beauty, Meitu develops intuitive and all-in-one imaging tools.Its flagship products include the Meitu app—a world-renowned portrait & creative tool offering advanced retouching for photos, videos, and Live Photos, with a focus on AI portrait aesthetics and creative effects—and Wink, an AI video enhancement suite that enables dynamic beauty enhancement and effortless social-ready content.

name_zh: 北京神州数码有限公司
introduction_zh: 从2000年成立伊始，神州数码以“数字中国”为使命，锐意变革，砥砺前行，始终坚持以全球领先科技和自主创新核心技术赋能产业数字化转型和数字经济发展。神州数码2024年全年营业收入实现1281.66亿元，位列《财富》中国500强榜单（2025）第182位，并连续三年上榜《财富》最受赞赏中国公司（2023-2025），连续两年获评最具投资价值上市公司（2024-2025）。
introduction_en: Since its establishment in 2000, Digital China has embraced the mission of "Digital China," continuously driving transformation with determination and perseverance. The company has consistently leveraged globally leading technologies and self-developed core technologies to empower industrial digital transformation and the development of the digital economy. In 2024, Digital China achieved an annual operating revenue of 128.166 billion yuan, ranking 182nd on the Fortune China 500 list (2025). It has also been listed among the Fortune Most Admired Chinese Companies for three consecutive years (2023–2025) and recognized as one of the Most Valuable Listed Companies for two consecutive years (2024–2025).

name_zh: 杭州米果智能机器人有限公司
name_en: Hangzhou Migo Intelligent Robot Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh:
杭州米果智能机器人有限公司(也称米果智能)位于中国浙江省杭州市，其主要研发方向为智能情感系统搭建开发、情感陪伴型机器人等。米果智能目前已与浙江大学达成技术研发合作并成立联合实验室。
米果智能致力于研究人类情感需求，并由此研发出能够给予人类陪伴与回应人类情感的科技产品，以最前沿的技术与人文结合，创建人与机器人相互陪伴的美好未来。
introduction_en:
Hangzhou Migo Intelligent Robot Co., Ltd. is located in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province, China. Its main research and development directions include the development of intelligent emotion systems and emotionally companionable robots. Miguo Intelligent has established a technical R&D collaboration with Zhejiang University and set up a joint laboratory.
The company is dedicated to studying human emotional needs, and on this basis, develops technological products capable of providing companionship and responding to human emotions. By combining cutting-edge technology with the humanities, Miguo Intelligent strives to create a future where humans and robots coexist and accompany each other.

name_zh: 深圳宝石角科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
深圳宝石角科技有限公司。不止是科技产品的创造者，更是年轻情绪的共情者与守护者。
在这里，科技与心跳同频。我们以可穿戴的智能产品为画布，将潮流与灵动交互融入设计，让每一次佩戴、每一次点亮屏幕，都成为情绪的温柔出口与个性的诗意表达。
我们开创了“电子吧唧”的崭新世界，并在这片星空下，成长为最明亮的引领者。从灵感到实物，从精密制造到触达全球，我们构建了完整的创造闭环；超过20项专利，是笃定诗行。
introduction_en:
Shenzhen Monokaro Technology Co., Ltd. is more than a creator of tech products — we are empathizers and guardians of young people’s emotions.
Here, technology beats in rhythm with the heart. Taking wearable smart devices as our canvas, we weave trendiness and dynamic interactions into every design. Every wear, every screen light-up becomes a gentle outlet for emotions and a poetic expression of individuality.
We pioneered the brand-new realm of digital badge pins, emerging as the brightest trailblazer within this space. From creative inspiration to tangible finished goods, from precision manufacturing to global market reach, we have built a complete end-to-end innovation ecosystem. Our portfolio of over 20 patents stands as resolute verses we write for the future.

introduction_zh: 2002年成立于中国香港，由中国香港亚洲塔罗学院导师创建。2006年亚塔在新加坡举办首次亚洲塔罗师研讨会。2010年亚洲塔罗协会在日本横滨建立分支机构。2015年3月亚洲塔罗协会机构分支RAS塔罗学社正式创建。2019年北京瑞阿斯神秘文化有限公司收购中国香港亚洲塔罗学院，2021年6月亚洲塔罗协会总部正式迁至北京。亚洲塔罗协会是一个综合性的文化团体，致力于科学的运用塔罗智慧带给人们更好的生活。
introduction_en:
Established in Hong Kong in 2002, the Asian Tarot Association (ATA) was founded by senior academic instructors. It held the first Asian Tarot Practitioners Symposium in Singapore in 2006 and set up an overseas branch in Yokohama, Japan in 2010. RAS Tarot Studio, ATA’s official mainland branch, was founded in 2015 to promote standardized tarot culture in China.
In 2019, Beijing RAS Mystic Culture Co., Ltd. acquired the Asian Tarot College of Hong Kong. ATA headquarters officially moved to Beijing in 2021. As a professional cultural organization, ATA popularizes rational tarot symbolic culture, integrates Western archetypes with Eastern wisdom, standardizes industry ethics, and promotes tarot as a practical tool for self-reflection, emotional adjustment and rational decision-making.

introduction_zh: 新华网是新华社主办的中央重点新闻网站，全球权威中文资讯平台，拥有多语种频道，覆盖200多国。聚焦主流舆论，创新全媒体传播矩阵，日均触达超5亿用户。技术赋能XR、数字人等前沿应用，累计获中国新闻奖44次，承建包含“中国政府网”在内的数十家政务网站。新华网同时作为上市互联网文化企业，融合AI、大数据等重塑生产体系，推进数智化转型，引领媒体融合发展。
introduction_en: Xinhua.net, operated by the Xinhua News Agency, is a key central news website and a globally influential Chinese-language platform, offering multilingual channels and reaching over 200 countries. It focuses on mainstream public opinion and boasts a comprehensive media matrix, engaging more than 500 million users daily. Leveraging cutting-edge technologies like XR and digital avatars, Xinhua.net has won the China News Award 44 times and hosts numerous government websites, including the State Council's official portal. As a listed internet culture enterprise, it integrates AI and big data to drive digital transformation and lead the industry's (integration and development).

introduction_zh: 上海注财管理咨询有限公司（2006年成立）是专业理财师认证授权机构，2010年原创《理财人生》系列财商桌游，并推出《养老人生》、《股神》、《理财麻将》等系列财商桌游产品。《理财人生》涵盖6大理财目标、10大理财规划、34种金融工具，玩家通过资产配置实现财富目标。产品含磁性棋盘、卡牌及游戏币，寓教于乐，广泛用于家庭财商教育、金融机构客户沙龙、企业内训及团队建设。
introduction_en: Shanghai Zhucai Management Consulting Co., Ltd. (established in 2006) is an authorized institution for professional financial planner certification. In 2010, it originally created the financial intelligence board game RICHLIFE and has since launched a series of products including Retirement Life Planning, Stock Guru, and Financial Mahjong. Life Financial Planning covers 6 major financial goals, 10 financial planning categories, and 34 financial instruments, where players achieve wealth objectives through asset allocation. The product includes a magnetic board, cards, and game currency. Combining education with entertainment, it is widely used in family financial literacy programs, client salons for financial institutions, corporate training, and team-building.

introduction_zh:
黄飞红将传统功夫精神融入现代食品工艺，以其专注花生品类
零食而闻名，拳头产品麻辣花生享誉全球。20多年来畅销全球40多个国家和地区。坚持使用真材实料，潜心研发，对工本、物力不惜余力，严苛选料，
下功夫打造高品质的花生美味零食。

黄飞红将传统功夫精神融入现代食品工艺，以其专注花生品类
零食而闻名，拳头产品麻辣花生享誉全球。20多年来畅销全球40多个国家和地区。坚持使用真材实料，潜心研发，对工本、物力不惜余力，严苛选料，
下功夫打造高品质的花生美味零食。

name_zh: 上海卡哥商贸有限公司
introduction_zh:
1. 上海卡哥商贸，深耕欧美中古首饰小众美学。主理人游历全球多国，深耕中古藏品甄选多年。我们聚焦高端高审美女性客群，甄选各年代孤品中古首饰，复刻欧美黄金年代设计美学，以复古孤品首饰，诠释高阶独特的穿搭品味。
2.“漪澜连绵，纵横经纬。织绡绮丽，点素皎皎。”“遗拾安澜”是以非遗宋锦和非遗皮影为创作，将传统工艺和现代美学相结合，展现出古典与时尚交融的魅力，具有独特的艺术文化韵味。
introduction_en: 1.Shanghai Kage Trading focuses on the niche aesthetics of European and American vintage jewelry. The founder has traveled around the world and specialized in selecting high-quality vintage collections. We serve high-aesthetic elite women. Every vintage piece is a unique treasure that inherits the classic design aesthetics of Europe and America and interprets exclusive elegant taste.2."Rippling waves stretch far, warp and weft crisscross as one. Silk brocade glows gorgeous, pale white hues shine pure."Relic of Peaceful Tides integrates two intangible cultural heritages: Song Brocade and shadow puppetry. Blending time-honored craftsmanship with modern aesthetics, it embodies the harmonious fusion of classical charm and contemporary style, bearing distinctive artistic and cultural appeal

introduction_zh: 京东美妆是京东集团旗下的核心美妆业务板块，依托平台正品生态、极速物流和高效服务能力，为消费者汇聚全球美妆大牌、优质国货与新锐品牌，覆盖面部护肤、香水彩妆、美妆工具、男士护肤等全品类，是国内美妆领域的主流电商平台。凭借长期建立的正品保障心智，超九成用户将其作为购买高端美妆的首选渠道，如今已成为兰蔻、雅诗兰黛、SK-II、赫莲娜等超200个国际知名品牌的线上最大销售渠道.
introduction_en: JD Beauty is the core beauty business division under JD Group. Leveraging the platform’s ecosystem of genuine products, ultra-fast logistics and high-quality service capabilities, it brings together world-famous beauty brands, premium domestic labels and emerging indie brands for consumers. Covering all categories including facial skincare, fragrances & makeup, beauty tools and men’s skincare, it stands as a leading e-commerce platform for beauty products in China.Backed by its long-standing reputation for authentic goods, over 90% of consumers regard it as their top destination for purchasing high-end beauty products. To date, it has become the largest online sales channel for more than 200 internationally renowned brands such as Lancôme, Estée Lauder, SK-II and HR Helena Rubinstein.

name_zh: 得力办公科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 得力极致匠心，创意不止。得力通过联合国内外知名IP，打造个性化潮流文具、文创等生活用品，赋予得力文具年轻、潮流、时尚的品牌调性。
introduction_en: Deli embodies supreme craftsmanship, with boundless creativity. By collaborating with renowned domestic and international IPs, Deli develops personalized trendy stationery, cultural and creative products and other daily necessities, endowing its stationery line with a youthful, fashionable and stylish brand identity.

introduction_zh: 招商银行1987年成立于深圳蛇口，是国内首家企业创办的股份制商业银行。以零售银行业务为特色，秉持“因您而变”理念，业务遍布海内外，是国内综合实力领先的上市银行。
introduction_en: Founded in Shekou, Shenzhen in 1987, China Merchants Bank is China's first corporate-initiated joint-stock commercial bank. Famous for retail finance, it operates globally as a leading listed bank adhering to the philosophy of "Change with Your Needs".

introduction_zh: 优酷动漫是优酷视频旗下内容板块，2020 年率先提出 “新国风” 概念，以年轻化表达弘扬中华传统文化。2025 年发布 “新原创” 战略，升级品牌 slogan “看原创国漫上优酷”，打造众多口碑佳作：《沧元图》刷新多项国漫纪录，《光阴之外》《师兄啊师兄》热度出众；另有《云深不知梦》《东大高武学院》《一斩苍穹》等原创新作。平台持续深耕原创赛道，以多元新颖题材拓宽国漫市场，持续壮大原创国漫新兴力量。

name_zh: 首旅如家酒店集团｜璞隐酒店
introduction_zh: 璞隐酒店作为首旅如家酒店集团旗下中高端人文酒店品牌，以“东方写意美学”为特色，融合东方美学空间、在地人文体验与现代旅居服务，打造兼具文化底蕴与品质体验的旅居空间，正逐步成为向世界展现东方美学与民族自信的旅宿窗口。此次，璞隐酒店携手国漫头部IP《一人之下》，以“决战璞隐”为主题亮相ChinaJoy，将东方美学旅居体验与国漫文化深度融合，打造沉浸式东方文化体验场景，以年轻化表达传递东方文化魅力。
introduction_en: As a high-end cultural hotel brand under the BTG Homeinn Hotel Group, Puyin Hotel features "Oriental Freehand Aesthetics" and integrates Oriental aesthetic spaces, local cultural experiences, and modern accommodation services to create a travel space that combines cultural heritage and quality experience. It is gradually becoming a window for showcasing Oriental aesthetics and national confidence to the world. This time, HIDDEN HOTEL Hotel collaborates with the top Chinese animation IP "One Man Under Heaven" to debut at ChinaJoy with the theme of "The Battle at HIDDEN HOTEL", deeply integrating Oriental aesthetic travel experiences with Chinese animation culture to create an immersive Oriental cultural experience scene, conveying the charm of Oriental culture through a youthful expression

name_zh: 新加坡零境途奈有限公司
introduction_zh:
EnergyMo 创立于一个简单的信念：可靠的健康洞察来自舒适、精准且注重隐私的设备。我们将前沿传感技术与精美设计结合，打造你舍不得摘下的健康伙伴。

随着 EnergyMo 的发展，我们始终根植于健康理念——健康的生活不是极端的生活，而是平衡的生活。在压力和忙碌日益增多的时代，EnergyMo 帮助你关注真正重要的事。
introduction_en:
EnergyMo was founded on a simple belief: reliable health insights come from devices that are comfortable, accurate, and privacy-focused. We combine advanced sensor technology with elegant design to create a health companion you’ll never want to take off.

As EnergyMo continues to grow, we remain rooted in our wellness philosophy: a healthy life is not an extreme life, but a balanced one. In an age of increasing stress and busyness, EnergyMo helps you focus on what truly matters.

name_zh: 上海零陆零贰数字科技有限公司
name_en: Shanghai Zero Six Zero Two Digital Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh:
上海零陆零贰数字科技有限公司秉持"以生命感动生命"的核心理念，致力于将AI技术、艺术设计与具身智能家庭陪伴场景深度融合，用原创IP重新定义新一代情感陪伴体验。我们让产品不再只是产品，而是由AI驱动、被艺术唤醒、能够感知你、理解你、回应你、陪伴你的"家庭成员"。
我们相信，科技应该有温度，艺术应该有灵魂，而陪伴更应该是可以被触摸的。
introduction_en:
Shanghai Zero Six Zero Two Digital Technology Co., Ltd. upholds the core philosophy of "touching lives with life," dedicated to deeply integrating AI technology, artistic design, and embodied intelligent home companionship into a redefined new generation of emotional companionship experience through original IP. We're transforming our products from mere objects into "family members" — AI-driven, awakened by art, capable of sensing you, understanding you, responding to you, and accompanying you.
We believe that technology should have warmth, art should have soul, and companionship should be something you can truly touch.

name_zh: 上海都市旅游卡支付有限公司
name_en: Shanghai City Tourism Card Payment Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 上海交通卡作为公共出行核心载体，适用范围覆盖全国330+城市地铁、公交、轮渡等公共交通场景，持续助力绿色低碳通勤。依托庞大用户基础与过往成熟联名案例，持续推出 IP 联名产品，传递绿色出行理念，实现沉浸式出行，打造兼具实用、收藏、传播价值的城市名片。
introduction_en: As a core tool for public transportation, the Shanghai Public Transport Card is accepted in over 330 cities nationwide—including subways, buses, and ferries—and continues to promote green, low-carbon commuting.Leveraging its vast user base and a track record of successful co-branded initiatives, the card continues to launch IP-themed products that promote the concept of green travel, deliver an immersive travel experience, and serve as a city calling card that combines practicality, collectibility, and promotional value.

introduction_zh:
暄暄珍珠室主打原创巴洛克珍珠珠宝设计，秉持自然本真、小众独特的品牌理念，保留珍珠原生随性肌理，拒绝流水线量产模板。
品牌调性温柔兼具先锋艺术感，以不规则珍珠勾勒独一份的美学质感。
面向追求个性穿搭、偏爱小众轻奢配饰，注重穿搭辨识度与首饰故事感的年轻女性、小众穿搭爱好者与饰品收藏者，手工雕琢每一件孤品首饰，让天然珍珠承载专属温柔气质。
introduction_en:
Xuanxuan Pearl Studio focuses on original Baroque pearl jewelry design. Adhering to the brand philosophy of authenticity and uniqueness, it preserves the natural texture of pearls and avoids mass-produced styles.
Blending gentleness with avant-garde artistic temperament, the brand creates distinctive aesthetics with irregular pearls.
It targets young ladies, niche fashion lovers and jewelry collectors who pursue personalized styling and light luxury accessories. Each handmade exclusive piece endows natural pearls with exclusive charm.

name_zh: 天津脆升升贸易有限公司
introduction_zh: 脆升升，全球销量第一的香脆薯条品牌，以23.6%市占率领跑行业。坚持原薯鲜切，采用低温真空锁鲜技术，非膨化、零反式脂肪酸，口感香脆且保留营养。品牌深耕20年，出口全球20多个国家和地区，致力于为年轻人提供美味又健康的薯脆零食。
introduction_en: Crisup, the world's No.1 best-selling crispy fries brand with a 23.6% market share. Made from fresh-cut potatoes using vacuum low-temperature lock-fresh technology, non-puffed, zero trans fat, delivering crunchy texture while retaining nutrients. With 20 years of expertise, it exports to over 20 countries, committed to providing young consumers with tasty and healthy crispy snacks.

name_zh: 绎蔻珐芯（上海）生物科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 源于探索精神的启迪，iLab倡导“探索极限 敢寻真我 i= Dare To Quest”，支持极限运动与户外探索，专研飞行、航行、潜水、冲浪、滑雪、攀登等“极限运动护肤 Extreme Sport Skincare”，防护烈日、疾风、狂沙、巨浪、暴雪等极限环境下的肌肤伤害，并追寻“海洋环保”理念，致力于成为全球户外运动护肤第一品牌。
introduction_en: Inspired by the spirit of exploration, iLab advocates "Explore Extreme · Dare To Quest", supports extreme sports and outdoor exploration; specializes in "Extreme Sport Skin Care" such as flying, sailing, diving, surfing, skiing, and climbing; protects skin from extreme environments such as scorching sun, strong winds, raging sand, huge waves and blizzards; advocates "Ocean Protection", and dedicates to become the world's No.1 outdoor sport skin care.

introduction_zh: 索尼集团公司是一家建立在坚实技术基础上的创意娱乐公司，现运营游戏与网络服务业务；音乐业务；影视业务；娱乐、技术及服务业务；影像与传感解决方案业务等多个业务板块。索尼的企业宗旨是“用创意和科技的力量感动世界”。
introduction_en: Sony Group Corporation is a creative entertainment company built on a solid technological foundation. It currently runs several business segments, including gaming and network services; music; movies and TV; entertainment, technology, and services; as well as imaging and sensing solutions. Sony’s mission is 'to inspire the world with the power of creativity and technology.

introduction_zh: SmallRig斯莫格品牌创立于 2013 年，致力于为全球影像工作者、创作者、记录者提供摄影摄像辅助设备全品类产品，形成了全场景、全兼容的产品生态矩阵。目前在售 SKU 超过 1000 个，涵盖包含相机支撑与稳定、手机支撑与稳定、灯光与控制、影像电源，麦克风等多个品类，市场分布于全球 160 多个国家和地区。
introduction_en: Founded in 2013, SmallRig develops accessory solutions for cameras, gimbals, and mobile phones, empowering millions of creators worldwide. Through its User Co-Design (UCD) and DreamRig programs, SmallRig collaborates directly with creators to turn visionary ideas into reality.

introduction_zh:
醒图是一个Z世代首选的美学创作平台。
从修图工具到全场景的视觉表达方式平台，醒图逐渐延展了创作终端——从移动端到桌面端，也加入了更多与“美”相关的日常应用场景——醒图相机、AI 造型室、灵感编创。
未来，醒图希望跟随AI 技术的发展，更好地理解每一位用户关于美的理解和表达诉求，成为一个更智能、更全面、更懂美的醒图。
introduction_en:
Xingtu is the aesthetic platform of choice for Gen Z. Evolving from a photo editing app into a comprehensive visual expression platform, Xingtu has expanded both the way and the places people create—from mobile to desktop, and from editing to a broader ecosystem of beauty-driven experiences, including Xingtu Camera, AI Styling Studio, and Creative Inspiration.
Looking ahead, as AI continues to advance, Xingtu aims to better understand every user's unique perception and expression of beauty, growing into an all-in-one aesthetic platform that is smarter, more comprehensive, and more deeply attuned to beauty.

name_zh: 深圳市卓尔摄影器材有限公司
introduction_zh: K&F CONCEPT 成立于2012年，是一家面向全球摄影师与影像创作者的摄影配件品牌，总部位于中国深圳。K&F CONCEPT 的产品已覆盖滤镜、脚架、转接环、摄影包、清洁用品、相机电池等多个摄影配件品类，2025年，K&F CONCEPT 获得欧睿国际认证，成为中国摄影配件品牌中，全球镜头滤镜销量第一。
introduction_en: K&F CONCEPT was founded in 2012 as a photography accessory brand catering to global photographers and visual creators, with its headquarters located in Shenzhen, China. The brand's product line spans various photography accessories, including filters, tripods, adapters, camera bags, cleaning supplies, and camera batteries. By 2025, K&F CONCEPT achieved recognition from Euromonitor International, becoming the top global brand in lens filters among photography accessory manufacturers in China.

name_zh: 深圳市七工匠光电科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 深圳市七工匠光电科技有限公司成立于2016年3月，是一家集设计生产销售于一体的全能型企业，总部位于广东省深圳市。我们秉承国人的工匠精神，聚焦产品创新，聚力打造了“七工匠”镜头品牌。镜头作为数码相机成像系统的关键部件，有着重要的研发价值。镜头的好坏一直是影像成像质量的关键因素，品牌秉持工匠精神深耕创新，针对性研发国产无反镜头，依托精细化成本管控与严苛品控收获市场认可。
introduction_en:
ounded in 2016 and headquartered in Shenzhen, China, 7Artisans is an innovative tech company specializing in the design, R&D, and manufacturing of optical imaging products.


Since its founding, 7Artisans has embraced the spirit of craftsmanship—focusing on every detail, pursuing innovation, and creating original lenses that blend professional performance, aesthetic design, and creative enjoyment. Through quality, reliability, and a distinctive character, we have earned the trust of photographers and visual creators worldwide.


Looking forward, we remain committed to originality and technological innovation, evolving our products through thoughtful design and research. Our aim is to be the most trusted, coolest, and most creative optical brand in the global photography community.

name_zh: 广东南光影视器材有限公司
introduction_zh: 广东南光影视器材有限公司创建于1992年，公司位于汕头市澄海区东里镇，占地44000平方米，员工总人数1000多人，是集研发、生产、销售和服务一体化的技术型公司，公司专业生产影视摄影类LED灯具，产品广泛用于影视拍摄、电视台演播室及新闻采访、宣传视频及平面摄影等，是中国影像灯光引领者，南光致力于成为全球领先的智能设备制造商和创新者，打造成为受世界尊重的中国品牌。
introduction_en: Guangdong Nanguang Film and Television Equipment Co., Ltd., founded in 1992, is located in Dongli Town, Chenghai District, Shantou City. Covering an area of 44,000 square meters, the company employs over 1,000 people and is a technology-driven enterprise integrating research and development, production, sales, and service. Specializing in the production of LED lighting fixtures for film and television photography, our products are widely used in film and television shooting, television studio and news interviews, promotional videos, and print photography. As a leader in Chinese imaging lighting, Nanguang is committed to becoming a globally leading manufacturer and innovator of intelligent equipment, striving to establish itself as a respected Chinese brand worldwide.

name_zh: 广东百诺影像科技工业有限公司
name_en: 广东百诺影像科技工业有限公司
introduction_zh: 广东百诺影像科技工业有限公司，成立于 1995 年，是一家集专业研发和生产摄影摄像三脚架、云台、摄影包、旅行拉杆箱、光学滤镜、滑轨的企业，现厂房面积约 55000 平方米。“100% 专业、100% 承诺”是百诺的品牌文化，也是公司的信念!公司将坚持追求轻量、高强度、操作性优良和完善的售后服务理念，为满足专业摄影的需求而不断努力。
introduction_en: BENRO Image Technology Industrial Co., Ltd. was founded in 1995, mainly dedicated to developing and manufacturing the professional photographic tripods, heads, camera bags, optical filters etc., existing plant area of 55,000 square meters, is a large scale manufacturer in producing professional photographic tripods.The BENRO mission statement is simple: 100% professional products guaranteed to professional photographers around the world. BENRO will adhere to the pursuit of light weight, high strength, excellent operability and perfect after-sales concept, in order to meet the needs of professional photographers and continuous efforts.

introduction_zh: 美图云修是美图公司推出的专业级AI人像精修软件，应用全球领先的AI影像技术，为商业摄影后期提供全方位智能修图服务，打造真实、自然、干净、通透的人像精修效果，又快又好地完成照片批量处理工作。支持PC端和iPad端使用。
introduction_en: Kumoo, launched by Meitu, is a professional AI-powered portrait retouching software. Leveraging globally leading AI imaging technology, it provides comprehensive intelligent photo editing services for commercial photography post-production. The software delivers realistic, natural, clean, and clear portrait enhancements, enabling fast and high-quality batch processing, helping business reduce costs, improve efficiency, and increase revenue.

introduction_zh:
洋葱工厂YC Onion旗下所有的产品都以食物命名，创立至今，现有产品涵盖摄影滑轨等智能运动控制产品和三脚架、独脚架等辅助摄影类配件产品。
YC Onion的初衷，就是以食物般亲切的设计，友善和平等的沟通，将跨越地域、文化与信仰的产品，以专业的研发态度，分享给全球影像创作。
introduction_en:
All products under YC Onion are named after food. Since its establishment, 
The brand has developed a range of products, including intelligent motion control devices like camera sliders; smart lighting equipment such as LED lights; and auxiliary photography accessories like monopods, microphones, and teleprompters. 
YC Onion's mission is to deliver products that transcend geography, culture, and beliefs through approachable,

introduction_zh: 微博是人们在线创作、分享和发现内容的领先社交媒体平台，也是当代中国大众获取资讯、表达观点、线上社交的核心阵地。
introduction_en: Weibo is a leading social media platform for people to create, share and discover content online. Weibo combines the means of public real-time self-expression with a robust infrastructure for social interaction, content aggregation and cross-platform distribution.

introduction_zh: 快手是国内头部短视频直播平台，以 “拥抱每一种生活” 为理念。平台去中心化流量，普通人也能获得曝光，形成高粘性的老铁社交生态。内容覆盖三农、生活、才艺、二次元等，集拍摄剪辑、直播、电商、本地生活于一体。依托产业带发展直播带货，兼顾线上购物与线下团购。用户覆盖广，下沉市场优势突出，借助 AI 优化推荐，为创作者提供多元变现渠道，打造内容社交消费综合社区。
introduction_en: Kuaishou is a premier Chinese short-video and live-streaming platform adhering to the slogan "Embrace Every Kind of Life". Its decentralized traffic mechanism empowers ordinary creators with exposure and fosters a highly interactive community. It hosts diverse content such as rural life, daily vlogs and talent shows, integrating editing, live streaming, e-commerce and local services. It develops live commerce via industrial supply chains for online shopping and offline group buys. With wide user coverage and solid lower-tier market advantages, Kuaishou leverages AI for optimized content recommendations and multiple creator monetization options, forming an all-in-one social and consumption platform.

introduction_zh:
Kase卡色——国内知名的相机光学滤镜品牌，自2011年起立足于中国市场，为国内众多专业风光摄影师及摄影爱好者带来高品质的滤镜拍摄体验。 

Kase卡色以其雄厚的自主研发实力以及高水平的制造工艺，并已在中国、德国、英国、美国等世界多个主要国家获得多项注册专利，受到各国知识产权严格保护，成为业内屈指可数的优质滤镜生产商之一。
introduction_en:
Kase is a well-known global filter brand, has been based in the Chinese market since 2011, bringing high-quality filter shooting experience to many global professional landscape photographers and photography enthusiasts.

With our strong independent research and development and our high-level manufacturing process, Kase has obtained multiple registered patents in many major countries in the world, such as Germany, Britain, China, and the United States. We are one of best-quality filter manufacturers in the world.

name_zh: 上海肯高商贸有限公司
introduction_zh:
上海肯高商贸有限公司是日本肯高图丽集团投资的独资贸易公司，日本肯高图集团是一家专业生产照相器材的公司。商品有1万5千多品种。其中肯高(KENKO)滤镜、图丽（TOKINA）镜头、竖力（SLIK）三脚架等品牌最为有名。
而肯高光学制造企业成立于1957年9月。致力于摄影滤镜、工业产品以及双筒望远镜、天文望远镜等光学产品的研发和销售。
公司理念：创建和谐相处、健康向上的社会，并担负起应尽的职责。
introduction_en:
Shanghai Kenko Trading Co., Ltd. is a wholly-owned trading enterprise invested by Japan’s Kenko Tokina Group, a professional manufacturer of photographic equipment. The company offers over 15,000 product varieties. Its best-known brands include KENKO filters, TOKINA lenses and SLIK tripods.
Founded in September 1957, Kenko Optical specializes in the R&D and sales of optical products such as photographic filters, industrial optical components, binoculars and astronomical telescopes.
Guided by its corporate philosophy, the company strives to foster harmony between people, society and nature, and fulfills its due responsibilities to build a sound and progressive society.

name_zh: 尼康映像仪器销售（中国）有限公司
introduction_zh: 创立于1917年的尼康，是全球领先的光学品牌。百余年来，尼康始终秉承“信赖和创造”的企业理念，依托深厚的光学技术积淀，持续推动影像创新，为影像创作者提供专业产品与服务，以可靠的技术满足不断变化的用户与市场需求。
introduction_en: Founded in 1917, Nikon is a leading global optics brand. For over a century, Nikon has upheld its corporate philosophy of "Trustworthiness and Creativity," leveraging its deep expertise in optical technology to continuously drive imaging innovation, providing professional products and services to image creators, and meeting the ever-changing needs of users and the market with reliable technology.

introduction_zh: LUMIX是松下相机品牌，2001年诞生，创立之初便与徕卡合作奠定光学基础。2008年推出全球首款微单G1，开创无反时代。2018年联合徕卡、适马成立L卡口联盟，并推出全画幅S系列。如今，LUMIX拥有M4/3与全画幅产品线，以视频性能和前沿技术成为影像重要力量。Technics是松下高端音响品牌，1965年创立，其黑胶唱盘机为业界标杆，更有TWS耳机、HiFi等产品，为用户带来高保真音乐。
introduction_en:
LUMIX is Panasonic's camera brand, founded in 2001. From its inception, it collaborated with Leica to lay its optical foundation. In 2008, it launched the world's first mirrorless camera, the G1, pioneering the mirrorless era. In 2018, it co-founded the L-Mount Alliance with Leica and Sigma, and introduced the full-frame S series. Today, LUMIX boasts M4/3 and full-frame product lines, and has become a major force in imaging with its video performance and cutting-edge technology.
Technics is Panasonic's high-end audio brand, established in 1965. Its turntables are industry benchmarks, and it also offers TWS earphones, HiFi systems and other products, delivering high-fidelity music to users

introduction_zh: 自 1961 年创立于日本，SIGMA 适马始终以影像为起点，专注光学与影像技术的探索。每一次按下快门，无论情感涌动或理性凝视，都是创作者对时间与世界的回应。秉持成为忠实伙伴的信念，SIGMA 陪伴创作者体会影像艺术的价值，并通过 SIGMA GLOBAL VISION系列镜头、BF、fp 及 fp L 系列相机，以及独一无二的 Foveon X3 传感器，为多样化创作提供可能。
introduction_en: Founded in Japan in 1961, SIGMA has always focused on imaging, dedicating itself to the exploration of optical and imaging technologies. Every time the shutter is pressed, whether out of emotional expression or a deliberate, rational gaze, it represents the creator’s response to time and the world around them. With the commitment to being a faithful partner, SIGMA helps creators appreciate the value of visual art, and it offers various possibilities for creative expression through its SIGMA GLOBAL VISION series of lenses, BF, fp, and fp L series of cameras, as well as its unique Foveon X3 sensor.

name_zh: 闪迪贸易（上海）有限公司
introduction_zh: 闪迪(NASDAQ:SNDK)专注于提供创新的闪存解决方案及先进的存储技术，在现实与理想的交汇之处，满足个人与企业的多样化需求，全力助推其不断前行，创造更多可能。
introduction_en: At Sandisk, we keep people and businesses moving forward with inspired innovations to actualize their potential.

name_zh: 雅迪科技集团有限公司
introduction_zh: 雅迪科技集团有限公司创立于2001年,经过20多年的高速发展,现已成为集电动两轮车、电动三轮车、电踏车、滑板车、折叠车、石墨烯铅酸电池、钠离子电池等多品类产品及其零配件研发、生产、销售、服务于一体的中短途出行服务商。“让亿万人享受美好出行”是雅迪的使命和任务。雅迪持续提供有幸福感的产品和服务，让亿万人的出行更加便捷自由、生活更加幸福快乐。让世界更加绿色环保，让全球用户享受出行的美好。
introduction_en: Founded in 2001. Yadea Technology Group Co., Ltd. has experienced over 20 years of rapid growth and has evolved into a short-and medium-distance travel service provider integrating R&D, production, sales and service of a diverse range of vehicles categories.These include electric motorcycles, electric scooters, electric bicycles, electric kick scooters, graphene batteries, sodium-ion batteries, and associated spare parts and accessories.Guided by its mission to deliver “A Wonderful Journey for Global Users,” YADEA  continuously provides products and services that make everyday travel more convenient, flexible, and enjoyable.YADEA strives to improve quality of life, contribute to a greener world, and help global users to enjoy every journey.

introduction_zh: 宝丽来公司由艾德温·兰德于 1937 年创立。1947年公司推出的宝丽来兰德相机，标志着即时摄影的诞生。如今，宝丽来致力于通过即时摄影工具来发掘日常生活中的美，让全球的创作者能够捕捉有意义的瞬间。历经 80 多年，宝丽来公司始终秉持即时成像技术创新理念，不断在现代社会中焕发生机。
introduction_en: Polaroid was founded in 1937 by Edwin Land as an icon of innovation and engineering. The company’s launch of the Polaroid Land camera in 1947, which marked the genesis of instant photography.Today, Polaroid is in pursuit of unlocking the beauty in everyday life with instant photography tools that empower creators across the globe to capture meaningful moments. The company that we have come to know and love for over 80 years is rooted back in the spirit of analog innovation for the modern age.

name_zh: 昆山蒲公英智能科技有限公司
introduction_zh: PGYTECH蒲公英智能科技，是与全球创作者同行的摄影生活方式品牌。专注影像创作场景下体系化产品研发，打造更畅快、更舒心的拍摄体验，传递让创作更轻松的生活摄影方式理念。至今已获得220多项专利，服务超过100多个国家和地区的用户，全球用户规模达300万，其中摄影箱包和摄影肩腕带在中国及亚太市场份额 TOP1，品牌60%消费者来⾃于国际市场。经过多年积累，已成为摄影器材行业内有深度影响力的领军企业。
introduction_en: PGYTECH is a pioneering global brand dedicated to crafting high-performance, intuitive gear for the creative community. True to our Chinese name, “dandelion,” we embody a spirit of lightness and freedom. Guided by our mission to Make Creation Easier, we remove technical barriers so creators can focus on their vision. Over the past decade, PGYTECH has secured more than 220 patents and served over three million creators across more than 100 countries and regions. Its camera bags, shoulder straps, and wrist straps rank No. 1 in market share in China and the Asia-Pacific region, while 60% of its consumers come from international markets. Through sustained innovation and growth, PGYTECH has become a highly influential leader in the photography equipment industry.

introduction_zh:
LUMIPIA｜摄影配件品牌
手机/相机支架｜磁吸拍摄解决方案
轻量便携 × 多场景拍摄
introduction_en:
We deeply appreciate the artist's desire to record and express the passion of the photograph. We understand the need to capture the moment that gives rise to a unique work of art. Our endless passion for photography in all of its art forms moves us on to the kind of technical innovation that helps the artist raise quality and performance of the art they create.  This is what keeps us looking for new ways to facilitate artistic expression, and creating the tools necessary. 

We are photographers, designers, visual artists, and engineers. A group of misfits, nerds and geeks with one goal, to create quality products with the artist in mind. We offer a long list of items, each designed with one purpose…To let you be creative! Take control, it’s your vision we are here to help you achieve it.

introduction_zh: 内啥（NEISHA.CC）成立于2015年，是国内专业的摄影器材租赁平台，隶属于盛世墨典（北京）信息技术有限公司。平台提供相机、镜头、稳定器、运动相机、无人机、影视灯光等设备租赁服务，覆盖个人创作、商业拍摄、直播、自媒体及影视制作等场景。依托信用免押、全国配送、专业检测及售后保障，内啥为摄影爱好者、内容创作者及专业机构提供安全、便捷的一站式摄影器材租赁服务。
introduction_en: Founded in 2015, NEISHA.CC is a professional photography equipment rental platform operated by Shengshi Modian (Beijing) Information Technology Co., Ltd. We provide rental services for cameras, lenses, gimbals, action cameras, drones, and lighting equipment, supporting photography, live streaming, content creation, and film production. With deposit-free rental, nationwide delivery, professional inspection, and reliable after-sales service, NEISHA.CC delivers a convenient and trusted one-stop rental experience.

name_zh: 深圳市永诺电器有限公司
name_en: Shenzhen YONGNUO Electronic Equipment Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 深圳市永诺电器有限公司是深圳市永诺摄影器材股份有限公司全资子公司，成立于2013年4月，是一家集摄影器材研发，生产、销售于一体的民营企业。公司已获得国家高新技术企业、深圳市专精特新中小企业、深圳市创新型中小企业等称号。公司拥有一支专业的研发团队。现设有相机、镜头、闪光灯、LED摄影灯等多个研发项目。公司现已成为能自主研发、生产自动对焦镜头和安卓系统直播相机的主流国产厂商之一。
introduction_en: Shenzhen YONGNUO Electronic Equipment Co.,Ltd.is the wholly-owned subsidiary of Shenzhen YONGNUO Photographic Equipment CO.,Ltd.,founded in April 2013 as a private enterprise specializing in the R&D,manufacturing,and sales of photographic   equipment.Recognized as a National HIgh-Tech Enterprise,a"Specialized,Refined,Distinctive,and lnnovative"SME in Shengzhen,and an lnnovatIve SME.With a Professional R&D team,we focus on developing cameras,lenses.speedlites,LED lighting,and other photographic equipments,Today,we have emerged as one of China's lenses and Android-based live-streaming cameras.We continuously stengthen our core competitiveness in photographic equipment development,prioritizing user  experience while enhancing product quality without compromising affordability.

name_zh: 广东电小二科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
电小二是全球领先户外电源品牌，深耕行业 14 年，专注为用户提供安全可靠的绿色储能产品，牵头参与制定便携储能行业标准，产品覆盖户外出行、作业、应急供电场景，全球销量超 700 万台。
母公司华宝新能 2022 年创业板上市（SZ301327），为便携储能第一股。品牌秉持 “让绿色能源无处不在” 使命，致力打造全球值得信赖的绿色能源品牌。
introduction_en:
Jackery is a world-leading brand of outdoor power stations. With 14 years of industry experience, we deliver safe, reliable green energy products and helped formulate portable energy storage industry standards. Our products suit outdoor recreation, work and emergency power supply, with over 7 million units sold worldwide.
Our parent company Huabao New Energy listed on ChiNext in September 2022 (SZ301327), the first portable energy storage listed firm. Upholding the mission "Make green energy accessible everywhere", we strive to become the world’s most trusted green energy brand.

name_zh: 深圳市深光影像科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 深光影像是新锐国产镜头品牌，研发制造团队拥有十余年镜头行业经验，率先打破日系企业的市场垄断，依靠创新设计与过硬品质获得市场认可。品牌镜头适配全部主流微单卡口，兼容全画幅、APS-C、中画幅机型，产品既有经典手动对焦镜头，也有对焦迅速精准的自动对焦镜头。其电影镜头凭借出色性能和超高性价比，收获大量好评。深光影像将持续以创新方案、稳定品质和实惠价格，深耕光学领域，助力国产镜头品牌走向全球。
introduction_en:
SG-image is a fast-rising Chinese lens brand built on over a decade of proven experience in camera  lens R&D and manufacturing.We pioneered China's interchangeable-lens area with innovative lens designs, outstanding performance, and exceptional quality, gaining market success.
Our product lineup covers all major mirrorless camera mounts and supports full-frame,APS-C,MFT,and medium-format systems.We offer both classic manual-focus lenses and  fast, precise autofocus lenses.
Our cinema lenses have earned wide industry acclaim for their superb performance and exceptional value for money.
With nearly 20 years of technical accumulation,SG-image ranks among leading global camera lens manufacturers.Driven by innovation,quality,and competitive pricing, we move toward the forefront of the industry.

name_zh: 长沙马上有照数码科技有限公司
name_en: Changsha Mashang Youzhao Digital Technology Co., Ltd
introduction_zh:
马上有照是日本DNP热升华打印机中国授权经销商，专注人像拍照硬件销售与租赁，提供高速高清输出方案。核心设备8.4秒极速出片，色彩优异，广泛用于商场快拍、婚礼、会议签到等场景。同时面向商业体、企事业单位及备婚人群，提供灵活租赁服务。
现正拓展IP运营业务，融合热门IP与AI即时成像技术，打造沉浸式合影体验，面向全国开展项目化运营，为IP方、场地方和用户创造互动价值与商业新可能。
introduction_en: Mashang Youzhao sells and rents portrait photography hardware. As DNP printer distributor in China, we provide fast, high-quality prints. Our 8.4sec output suits malls, weddings, conferences, winning trust. We also rent short/longterm to commercial complexes, enterprises, and couples for events or daily use. Now we expand IP operations: integrate IP with AI imaging for immersive experiences nationwide. This benefits IP owners, venues, and users.

name_zh: 上海悠尼伏斯文化艺术有限公司
name_en: Shanghai Universe Cultural & Art Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 上海悠尼伏斯文化艺术有限公司专注于数字文旅、IP创意及文化创意产品开发，致力于以数字科技打造兼具文化传播与互动体验的创新内容。公司自主研发“上海文旅卡牌”项目，融合实体卡牌、AR、3D数字展示及互动玩法，探索城市文化数字化传播新模式。未来，公司将持续拓展数字文旅、原创IP及文创产品生态，为文化传播和各地政府文旅的发展提供更多创新解决方案。
introduction_en: Shanghai Universe Cultural & Art Co., Ltd. focuses on digital cultural tourism, IP creativity, and cultural and creative product development. The company is committed to leveraging digital technology to create innovative content that combines cultural communication with interactive experiences. It has independently developed the "Shanghai Cultural Tourism Card" project, which integrates physical cards, AR, 3D digital displays, and interactive gameplay to explore new models for the digital dissemination of urban culture.  In the future, the company will continue to expand its ecosystem in digital cultural tourism, original IP, and cultural and creative products, providing more innovative solutions for cultural communication.

introduction_zh: MOSHOWTOYS是千臣文化旗下的第一个品牌，创立之初，我们就定下了“用中国人的思维讲好中国故事”的大方针，通过容易被海外用户接受的故事形式，将伟大祖国五千年历史沉淀的世界观、人文观和价值观以全新的、流行的形式讲述给用户，同时，通过优质的产品，进一步完善和提升品牌价值和IP含金量，真正做到:“走出去”的目标
introduction_en: MOSHOWTOYS is the first brand under Qianchen Culture. At the beginning of its establishment, we set the major principle of "telling Chinese stories with Chinese thinking". Through story forms that are easily accepted by overseas users, we aim to convey the worldview, humanistic view, and values accumulated over 5,000 years of our great motherland's history in a new and popular way. At the same time, through high-quality products, we further improve and enhance brand value and IP value, truly achieving the goal of "going global".

name_zh: 淘宝天猫潮玩行业（潮玩模玩/动漫娱乐周边/三坑娃圈）
introduction_zh: 淘天集团（Taobao and Tmall Group）是阿里巴巴集团旗下核心业务集团。是一家主营线上零售、线上批发、二手闲置交易、数字营销等的有限责任公司， 主要由淘宝和天猫组成。其中，淘天潮玩稳居行业领跑者地位，连续多年保持增长，赢在基建、行业理解与消费者洞察，平台有销售的 IP 过万，并涌现出多个过亿品牌或 IP。
introduction_en: Taobao and Tmall Group is a core business group of Alibaba Group. It is a limited liability company mainly engaged in online retail, online wholesale, second-hand idle trading, digital marketing, and other businesses, and is mainly composed of Taobao and Tmall. Among them, Taotian's toys and collectibles business firmly holds a leading position in the industry, maintaining growth for many consecutive years. Its success lies in infrastructure, industry understanding, and consumer insights. The platform has tens of thousands of IPs on sale, and has produced multiple brands or IPs with sales exceeding RMB 100 million.

name_zh: 永发玩具（Hot Toys中国总代理）
introduction_zh: 永发玩具成立于2000年，次年起成为知名人偶品牌Hot Toys中国区总代理，销售Hot Toys 珍藏级别系列人偶、COSBABY迷你珍藏人偶，以及其相关周边系列的产品等，全力拓展中国大陆珍藏人偶及电影模型市场，在未来的发展中，永发玩具将在专业化与多元化并行的轨道上稳健、持续地前行，在文化市场、主题概念店、自营品牌等多领域里扩展业务，并保持一贯的高品质追求，将最好的产品带给消费者。
introduction_en:
YF-models was founded in 2000. Since the following year, it has served as the exclusive distributor in China for the renowned collectible figure brand Hot Toys, offering Hot Toys premium collectible figure series, COSBABY mini collectible figures, and related merchandise, while fully committed to expanding the collectible figure and movie model market in mainland China.
Looking ahead, Yongfa Toys will continue to move forward steadily and sustainably along the path of parallel specialization and diversification. The company will expand its business across cultural markets, themed concept stores, proprietary brands, and other sectors, while upholding its consistent pursuit of premium quality to deliver the finest products to consumers.

name_zh: 上海骑形网络科技有限公司
introduction_zh: Hitcard成立于2021年，主营业务覆盖卡牌、谷子、轻软周等潮玩产品的全产线生产。我们致力于让每一张卡都能以消费级的价格，成为链接成年收藏玩家生活与记忆的“消费级收藏品”。秉持着“用工艺承载内容，用品质激发心动”的价值观，我们希望通过“内容+工艺+质量”的三重引擎，“万物可卡，珍藏一生”的核心理念，让卡牌成为文化的载体，带文化走向世界。
introduction_en: Hitcard, founded in 2021, mainly focuses on the production and creation of collectible cards, goods, toys and hobbies. We strive to create a new category of affordable, yet high-quality collectibles, bridging lives and memories of adult collectors. We firmly belive that "when culture lives in every card, it travels further". Thus, driven by our triple-engine strategy of "content + craftsmanship + quality", and the core belief of "card anything into a lifetime treasure", we seek to ultimately bring every card from hearts to the world stage.

name_en: Future Cultural and Creative Co.. Ltd.
introduction_zh: 未来文创公司成立于2020年，旗下品牌COME4FREE自由心屿，原创打造「米甜」「邦倪」「儞洛」三大IP。公司坚持中国制造与中国智造，构建了覆盖IP设计、研发、生产、营销的全链路体系，融合当代潮流与东方美学，为年轻一代打造专属可动人偶及周边衍生品。从素体技术到服饰打版，从DIY配件到周边开发，我们形成「可动人偶×服装×DIY配件×周边」的全矩阵布局。从一只娃娃，到一座心屿，让创造与陪伴触手可及。
introduction_en:
Owns the brand COME4FREE, also named Isle of Free Heart, and has independently launched three original IPs: Mitian, Bonni and Nilo
Sticking to Made in China and smart manufacturing, we’ve built a complete industrial chain covering IP design, R&D, production and marketing. We merge modern fashion trends with oriental aesthetics to design customized articulated figures and supporting derivative goods for young people
Our business covers figure body development, garment pattern making, DIY accessory design and peripheral merchandise creation, forming an all-round product matrix featuring articulated figures, matching outfits, DIY parts and assorted peripherals
Starting from delicate dolls, we build a warm creative island for fans, making creation and gentle companionship always within reach

introduction_zh: 入魂一番，是一家汇聚全球正版雕像、手办、3C、拼装模型、潮玩、玩偶、毛绒、盲盒、扭蛋、轻周边等IP产品或IP联名类产品的互动乐趣抽赏平台。玩法涵盖了万代一番赏、B站磁力赏、入魂赏、魂之蛋、团体竞赛等各类抽赏模式，概率透明安全又好玩，将常规购买升级为用户心情消费，让玩家在抽赏的过程中能够获得额外的类游戏的乐趣。
introduction_en: NYUKON ICHIBAN is an interactive and new consumption modes application featuring Animation & Comic IP products or IP co-branded products from around the world. NYUKON ICHIBAN offers a variety of fun sales modes, including Kuji and Gacha. The probability of winning in the Kuji and Gacha is transparent, ensuring a safe and enjoyable experience. Making a purchase becomes a more engaging and emotional activity. Players can have a lot of fun during the process of consumption.

name_zh: 上海以猫己科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 上海以猫己科技有限公司成立于 2025 年 7 月，旗下“以猫己 APP”定位为二次元生活方式与商业融合平台，面向 ACGN用户，打造集资讯、社区、购物与后宅养成于一体的一站式兴趣空间。平台提供给用户看内容、找同好、安心交易、展示热爱的综合体，并为品牌、IP 与创作者提供曝光、互动、销售和长期价值沉淀能力，让“以猫己YIMAOJI”成为二次元与三次元之间的 2.5 次元桥梁。
introduction_en: Shanghai Yimaoji Technology Co., Ltd. was established in July 2025. Its flagship product, the “Yimaoji APP,” is positioned as an integrated platform that blends anime lifestyle and commerce, targeting ACGN users and creating a one-stop interest space that combines news, community, shopping, and virtual “home cultivation” features. The platform provides users with a comprehensive environment to consume content, find like-minded friends, trade with confidence, and showcase their passions, while also offering brands, IPs, and creators capabilities for exposure, interaction, sales, and long-term value accumulation, making “Yimaoji” a 2.5-dimensional bridge between the anime world and the real world.

name_zh: 三零文化产业（北京）有限公司
introduction_zh: threezero，由王剑锋先生创办。作为1990年代中国香港原创品牌玩具制作人之一，王剑锋先生对玩具市场有着深厚的认知和深度的洞察力，多年来致力推动中国香港玩具业发展，迈向国际。而threezero一直致力推动收藏级玩具成为普及潮流，将「玩具」重新定义，为所有人带来前所未有的玩味和乐趣。
introduction_en: threezero, founded by Kim Fung Wong, is one of the original producers of the 1990s Hong Kong designer figure style. With an in-depth understanding and enduring insight into the toy market, Mr. Wong is appointed as a consultant of the toy industry by the Hong Kong Trade Development Council.

introduction_zh:
《大漫匠AniMester》深耕手办模型赛道，与角川、漫威、网易、腾讯等顶级IP方达成深度合作，在业内积累了良好口碑。旗下子品牌《核金重构》专注可动与拼装模型领域，近期推出的《轰天》模型上线后便迅速登顶各大电商热销榜首，收获海量模玩爱好者的喜爱。
品牌同步布局文娱板块，自制的国产特摄短剧《超限斗神》第一季已登陆爱奇艺、B站等主流视频平台，凭借精良制作收获亮眼播放成绩，目前剧集第二季已进入筹备阶段。
introduction_en:
AniMester is deeply engaged in the figure and model industry. It has established in-depth partnerships with top IP owners including Kadokawa, Marvel, NetEase and Tencent, earning an excellent reputation across the sector. Its sub-brand 【Nuclear Gold Reconstruction】 focuses on action figure and plastic model Kit. The newly launched  SKY BLAZE Plastic Model Kit quickly topped bestseller lists on major e-commerce platforms and won wide popularity among hobbyists.
Expanding into the cultural and entertainment field, the brand independently produced the domestic tokusatsu short drama XTREME VANGUARD Season 1, which is available on iQiyi, Bilibili and other mainstream video platforms. Boasting exquisite production, it achieved impressive viewership. The preparation for Season 2 is now underway.

name_zh: 上海衣步信息科技有限公司
name_en: Shanghai Yibu Information Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 上海衣步信息科技有限公司 2023 年成立，依托江苏衣步集团产业资源，深耕艺科融合领域，打造数字化时尚展销综合平台。公司以数字技术打通品牌、设计师与消费者链路，为企业提供全渠道营销运营方案，为独立设计师提供内容策划、新品发售、品牌孵化一站式扶持。线下布局城市分站、设计师生活馆、快闪展厅、直播空间等多元场景，联动线上搭建全域时尚生态，为消费者提供个性化高品质穿搭体验，助力时尚产业数字化转型升级。
introduction_en: Yibu Information Technology, established in 2023 and backed by Jiangsu Yibu Group, is a fashion technology company integrating art and digital innovation. It develops industry software, service integration frameworks, and application platforms for independent designer brands. By leveraging big data, artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and virtual reality, Yibu provides digital infrastructure, data services, and process optimization for fashion enterprises. The company builds an intelligent ecosystem connecting designers, brands, and consumers through full-channel digital solutions, supporting content innovation, brand promotion, collaborative product launches, and personalized fashion experiences while driving the sustainable growth of the fashion industry.

introduction_zh:
巴藤派（BUTTONPIE）创立于2021年，是一个融合原创设计孵化与生活方式于一体的创意品牌。
我们倡导“生活即冒险”，用“BUTTON”连接世界，用“PIE”传递温度，主张自由、好奇、无标准答案的成长方式。
introduction_en: BUTTONPIE was founded in 2021 as a creative brand that integrates original design incubation with lifestyle. We advocate "life as an adventure," using "BUTTON" to connect the world and "PIE" to convey warmth, promoting a growth approach characterized by freedom, curiosity, and non-standardized answers.

introduction_zh: GEEKGALA是一个具备国际视野，聚集时尚创意的先锋、新锐时尚媒体IP，我们深耕在地文化、内容传播、创意活动策划领域，通过数字化科技及可持续发展理念贯穿Z 世代潮流文化，形成多维商业化共创。
introduction_en: GEEKGALA is a cutting-edge fashion media IP with an international vision that brings together innovative fashion creators. We specialize in local cultural exploration, content communication and creative event planning. Integrating digital technology and sustainable development concepts into Gen Z trend culture, we build a multi-dimensional commercial co-creation ecosystem.

introduction_zh: QI Collective 专注时尚品牌孵化，整合全链条资源赋能创作者，依托产销营零垂直体系，为成长品牌提供一站式落地方案。团队深耕制造、面料、物流、金融三十余年，拥有成熟盈利品牌资产，可提供 3D 研发、面料印染生产，依托中美两地仓储打通全球跨境物流，配套批发咨询、公关营销全链路服务，完善供应链助力品牌剥离繁杂运营，专注创意、设计与品牌规划，释放时尚创作潜力。
introduction_en: QI Collective focuses on fashion brand incubation and empowers creators with full-chain resources. With an integrated vertical system covering production, sales and marketing, we deliver one-stop solutions for growing brands. Our team boasts over 30 years of experience in manufacturing, fabric R&D, logistics and finance, with a portfolio of profitable brands. We offer 3D development, fabric printing and production, global cross-border logistics supported by warehouses in China and the US, alongside wholesale consultation and PR marketing. Our comprehensive supply chain frees brands from trivial operations to focus on creativity, design and brand planning.

introduction_zh:
洛杉矶时装品牌 Maison Amory 副线 Rin Label，承袭主线美学内核，以全新视角重构风格，塑造兼具现代锋芒的浪漫复古女性气质。层叠蕾丝、波浪裙摆、鱼骨束身衣等标志性设计，柔感与利落结构相融，平衡浪漫与飒爽，勾勒松弛有氛围感的女性身形。
品牌主张复古美学日常化，陪伴女性人生重要时刻。成人礼、毕业、旅行、生辰约会等珍贵瞬间，皆能为 Rin’s girl 适配得体出彩的造型表达。
introduction_en:
Rin Label, the diffusion line of Los Angeles fashion brand Maison Amory, inherits the core aesthetic of its main line and reinvents its style with a fresh vision, crafting a romantic vintage feminine vibe edged with modern boldness. Signature details including layered lace, ruffled hems and boned corsetry blend softness with sharp silhouettes, balancing romance and poise to shape effortless, atmospheric feminine figures.

Advocating wearable vintage aesthetics, the brand accompanies women through life’s milestones. For coming-of-age ceremonies, graduations, travels, birthdays and dates, it delivers elegant, standout looks tailored for every precious moment of the Rin’s girl.

introduction_zh:
AWAYLEE 创立于 2012 年，融合民间艺术与温柔沉静女性力量，形成独树一帜设计风格，坚守文化传承、可持续理念与精工艺术追求。
主理人苏安出身澳籍华裔家庭，21 岁创业，深耕时尚行业二十余年，业务覆盖多国，兼具企业家、创意总监等多重身份，深谙多国人文艺术。她携手设计总监 Katherine Kin，挖掘传统工艺材质，转化为当代女性设计语言。以匠心材质与匠人工艺，持续探寻文化、艺术与自然之美。
introduction_en:
Founded in 2012, AWAYLEE integrates folk art with gentle and tranquil feminine charm to forge a distinctive design aesthetic, upholding cultural heritage, sustainability and exquisite craftsmanship.
Sue-Ann, the brand’s creative director, was born into an Australian Chinese family. She launched her business at 21, with over two decades in fashion spanning entrepreneurship and creative direction across global markets. Proficient in cross-cultural arts, she collaborates closely with Design Director Katherine Kin to reimagine traditional crafts and materials into contemporary feminist design language. The brand persistently explores culture, art and natural beauty through premium materials and artisanal craftsmanship.

introduction_zh: Selkie 由 Wildfox 前联合创始人 Kimberley Gordon 于洛杉矶创立。品牌崇尚幻想、复古与浪漫，主张打破女性束缚，以尺码、种族多元为核心。当代女性独立通透、敢于展现自我，Selkie 守护女性爱美自由，坚信每个人都有权身着心仪服饰。品牌致力打造理想裙装，赋予她们表达自我的底气。品牌满溢色彩、活力与力量，期许每位女性自在舒展，活出独属于自己的模样。
introduction_en:
Founded in Los Angeles by Kimberley Gordon, co-founder of Wildfox, Selkie embodies fantasy, vintage romance and liberation for women, centering size and racial inclusivity.
Today’s women are independent and unapologetically authentic. Selkie safeguards their freedom to embrace beauty, believing everyone deserves to wear what they love. The brand crafts dreamy dresses empowering girls to voice themselves.
Vibrant, energetic and bold, Selkie wishes every woman to live freely and embrace her true self.

name_zh: 广东杰森娱乐发展有限公司
introduction_zh: 杰森是一家集IP版权运营、内容投资、IP衍生品产研销于一体的综合型文化娱乐集团。业务涵盖IP版权运营、影视及动漫内容投资、IP衍生品设计开发生产销售等。旗下品牌Card.Fun集卡社、GOODS.FUN森罗万象、XA造极工作室等，共同构建起强大的品牌矩阵，分别专注于卡牌、潮玩、动漫IP精品雕像及手办等领域。
introduction_en: 杰森是一家集IP版权运营、内容投资、IP衍生品产研销于一体的综合型文化娱乐集团。业务涵盖IP版权运营、影视及动漫内容投资、IP衍生品设计开发生产销售等。旗下品牌Card.Fun集卡社、GOODS.FUN森罗万象、XA造极工作室等，共同构建起强大的品牌矩阵，分别专注于卡牌、潮玩、动漫IP精品雕像及手办等领域。目前，杰森娱乐国内外版权已超过100个版权方合作，合作IP矩阵已有500以上，商品分布全球，是“中国衍生品头部品牌”。

introduction_zh:
集奇怪﹣﹣世界昆虫标本
我们致力于收集全世界61个国家和地区的昆虫标本，10余年收藏了超过5000种品种，通过我们的制作让自然的美丽永远的保留下去……本着对大自然的热爱，及生态保育的重视，也希望藉我们所学与社会大众分享。更希望让成长于都市的大小朋友们能有真正接触了解大自然的机会，认识和我们一同生活在地球的其它生物、了解生命的奥秘、进而能珍惜、爱护我们的自然环境。
introduction_en:
Strange Collection – Insect Specimens
 
For over a decade, we have collected insect specimens sourced from 61 countries and regions worldwide, boasting a collection of more than 5,000 species. Our professional specimen preservation locks in nature’s timeless beauty.
 
Driven by our passion for nature and commitment to ecological conservation, we share our expertise and collections with the public. We aim to offer urban children and adults a precious chance to connect with the natural world in person, learn about creatures sharing our planet, uncover the mysteries of life, and ultimately cherish and protect our natural environment.

name_zh: 广聚博汇（广州）文化传播有限公司
introduction_zh: FANTHFUL致力于服务热爱游戏、电影、动漫等流行文化的粉丝，提供高品质的官方授权正版周边衍生产品，“Everyone is a fan, 带给粉丝更多好玩、有趣的周边”是我们的宗旨。
introduction_en:
Motivated by entertainment pop culture, Fanthful was found in 2016 as a division of Shuoya,focus on pop culture merchandises business in China . 
Our products range from apparels, bags,fashion accessories, decors,toys,figures and plush, including many different kinds of categories .All of products are officially licensed.Some are designed by ourselves and others are sourced from famous licensees in North America, Europe and Japan . 
Product’s theme focus on video game, film, TV and comic. All from worldwide-known entertainment brands.

name_zh: 宁波市千伏文化有限责任公司
introduction_zh: 千伏工作室诞生于2015年，一直在历史与战争类桌游领域，特别是兵棋类目中，深耕不辍。经过多年发展，千伏已成长为国内首屈一指的桌面兵棋品牌，拥有丰富的原创与开发经验，不但引进了多款国外经典游戏，还原创设计了许多广受好评的爆款游戏，到目前已推出过60多款（套）桌面游戏产品。我们致力于用更棒的游戏、更好的体验，让玩家朋友们以一种独特的方式，感受历史以及我们所处的这个世界。
introduction_en: KV-DESIGN was founded in 2015 and has been continuously dedicated to the field of historical and war-themed board games, particularly in the wargame category. After years of development, KV has grown into the leading domestic tabletop wargame brand, accumlated extensive experiences in game design and development. We have not only published new version for numerous classic games, but also designed many highly acclaimed original games. To date, we have launched a total of over 60 tabletop game products. As a publisher and design team, we are committed to delivering exceptional games and experiences, allowing players to explore history and the world around them in a unique way.

name_zh: 上海悠尼伏斯文化艺术有限公司
name_en: Shanghai Universe Cultural & Art Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 上海悠尼伏斯文化艺术有限公司专注于数字文旅、IP创意及文化创意产品开发，致力于以数字科技打造兼具文化传播与互动体验的创新内容。公司自主研发“上海文旅卡牌”项目，融合实体卡牌、AR、3D数字展示及互动玩法，探索城市文化数字化传播新模式。未来，公司将持续拓展数字文旅、原创IP及文创产品生态，为文化传播和各地政府文旅的发展提供更多创新解决方案。
introduction_en: Shanghai Universe Cultural & Art Co., Ltd. focuses on digital cultural tourism, IP creativity, and cultural and creative product development. The company is committed to leveraging digital technology to create innovative content that combines cultural communication with interactive experiences. It has independently developed the "Shanghai Cultural Tourism Card" project, which integrates physical cards, AR, 3D digital displays, and interactive gameplay to explore new models for the digital dissemination of urban culture.  In the future, the company will continue to expand its ecosystem in digital cultural tourism, original IP, and cultural and creative products, providing more innovative solutions for cultural communication.

name_zh: 上海晨邺实业有限公司
introduction_zh:
上海晨邺实业有限公司专注品牌造物与产品开发，致力于为品牌提供从产品策略、创意设计到打样生产的一站式解决方案。业务涵盖品牌衍生品开发、IP产品设计、文创礼赠、活动定制及全案交付等领域。

我们注重创意表达，更关注产品落地与制造实现，擅长将品牌理念、视觉语言与用户需求转化为兼具美感与实用性的产品，帮助品牌建立更丰富的场景触点与价值表达。
introduction_en:
Shanghai Chenye Industrial Co., Ltd. specializes in brand merchandise development and product creation, providing brands with a one-stop solution from product strategy and creative design to prototyping and production.

Our services cover brand merchandise development, IP product design, cultural and creative gifts, event customization, and full-project delivery. We combine creative thinking with manufacturing expertise, transforming brand concepts, visual identities, and user insights into products that balance aesthetics, functionality, and market relevance.

By focusing on both creativity and execution, we help brands create meaningful touchpoints and deliver stronger brand experiences through well-crafted products.

name_zh: 誉腾文化传播（广州）有限公司
introduction_zh: YOLOPARK 成立于 2009 年，是一间专注于官方授权收藏玩具的创新品牌。同时秉承“用心创造”的理念，YOLOPARK 不断扩展产品线，并与《变形金刚》、《新世纪福音战士》、《鸦 -KARAS-》、《合金弹头》、《天空战记》、《超电磁侠》、《小黄人》和《小猪佩奇》等热门系列合作，为全球玩家提供优质的模型玩具和新颖的玩乐体验。
introduction_en: Established in 2009, YOLOPARK is a pioneering brand dedicated to the design and manufacture of high-end, officially licensed collectible toys. Adhering to the corporate philosophy of "Creating with Heart," the company has consistently diversified its product portfolio. By collaborating with world-class franchises,such as 《Transformers》《EVA》《Karas》《Metal Slug》《Shurato》《Voltes V Legacy 》《Minions》and《Peppa Pig》,YOLOPARK is committed to providing global consumers with superior-quality model toys and innovative entertainment experiences.

name_zh: 广州天闻角川动漫有限公司
introduction_zh: 广州天闻角川动漫有限公司，成立于2010年，专注于ACGN领域的内容开发及整合运营，持续创造和运营优质IP是企业的核心经营理念。从内容开发、运营、培育、海内外发行到销售体系的搭建，逐渐构筑以纸书出版、数字阅读、衍生品开发、原创漫画、动画制作和游戏开发等为主线的业务版图。
introduction_en: Guangzhou Tianwen Kadokawa Animation and Comics Co.,Ltd (short for GZTWJC), focusing on producing high quality animation products. As a leading provider of animation content, GZTWJC developed in original comics, integration anime journals, books edit planning issued, type card brand game, copyright trade, anime television development, anime new media development and anime derivative products since 2010. On the ten anniversary, we propose a new brand concept “have fun,be kawaii ”. 2025 will be our 15th anniversary, we intend to create and operate more wonderful merchandise that respond to the voice of the times, and to move forward steadily.

introduction_zh:
光年工作室 2018 年成立，是涵盖知名 IP 联名、原创 IP 设计、生产、运营销售、市场推广的全产业链收藏品牌。
工作室打通产品定位、研发、生产、推广、销售一体化体系，多年来与海内外多家动漫企业、工作室达成长期合作。
品牌心怀艺术敬畏，敢于突破行业固有模式，坚守匠心工艺。业务覆盖潮玩、手办等多元衍生藏品，一件件作品如同丝线交织，构筑独属于光年的收藏艺术版图。
introduction_en:
Founded in 2018, Lightyear Studio is a full-industry-chain collectibles brand encompassing licensed IP collaborations, original IP design, manufacturing, operation & sales, and marketing.
The studio has established an integrated system covering product positioning, R&D, production, promotion and sales, and has forged long-term partnerships with numerous animation companies and studios at home and abroad.
Rooted in reverence for art, the brand dares to break established industry conventions while upholding fine craftsmanship. Its portfolio spans diverse derivative collectibles including designer toys and collectible figures. Each creation interweaves like threads to form Lightyear’s one-of-a-kind artistic collection landscape.

name_zh: 东莞市微石文化科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
Piececool拼酷成立于2009年，作为全球3D金属拼图的创导者，是集创意设计研发、衍生品开发与授权、精密加工生产、商品销售、玩家共创社区于一体的金属DIY潮玩品牌。

拼酷全新的DIY玩法给行业打开了崭新大门，在国内外掀起金属拼装的热潮，产品被翻译成7种不同语言版本，在100多个国家和地区销售，为全球超1亿玩家提供快乐。
introduction_en:
PIECECOOL was founded in 2009, the world’s leading 3D-metal puzzle brand, which integrating creative design and development, derivative development and authorization, precision processing and production, and commodity sales.

The creative DIY play from PIECECOOL has opened a new door to the toy industry, set off a boom in metal assembly all over the world, and our products have been translated into 7 different languages versions and sold in over 100 countries and regions, providing happiness for over 100 million players worldwide.

introduction_zh: 京畿内容振兴院（Gyeonggi Content Agency，简称 GCA）是韩国京畿道专门负责推动文化内容产业发展的公共机构。GCA致力于支持游戏、网络漫画、动画、AI、XR、角色IP及数字内容等多个创意产业领域的发展，并通过企业培育、国际市场推广、投资对接及国际合作等多元化支持，助力韩国内容企业拓展海外市场，提升全球竞争力
introduction_en: The Gyeonggi Content Agency (GCA) is a public organization dedicated to fostering the growth of the content industry in Gyeonggi Province, Korea. GCA supports companies across a wide range of creative sectors, including games, webtoons, animation, AI, XR, character IP, and digital content. Through business development, global marketing, investment support, and international partnerships, GCA helps Korean content companies expand into overseas markets and strengthen their global competitiveness.

introduction_zh: Eunhoo Holdings是一家专注于原创IP动画、角色授权及衍生商品开发的韩国内容企业。旗下以“影云”世界中的蘑菇部族冒险故事为核心的奇幻IP，具备动画、漫画、游戏、出版、周边商品及元宇宙等多元化拓展潜力。公司希望通过ChinaJoy与发行商、授权商、投资机构及内容平台建立合作，拓展中国及全球市场。
introduction_en:
Eunhoo Holdings is a Korean content company specializing in original IP-based animation, character licensing, and merchandise. The company develops and expands its proprietary IPs through content distribution, licensing, and strategic partnerships in global markets.

Its flagship IP follows the adventures of the Mushroom Tribe living in the mysterious “Shadow Cloud.” Built as a universe-based fantasy IP, it offers strong scalability across animation, webtoons, publishing, games, merchandise, and metaverse experiences.

Through ChinaJoy, Eunhoo Holdings seeks partnerships with publishers, licensors, investors, and content platforms to explore co-production, licensing, and distribution opportunities in China and beyond.

introduction_zh: Haniverse是一家韩国AI内容工作室，原创IP“Mini Republic（迷你共和国）”以生活在人类日常中的1厘米小居民世界为核心，凭借独特的微观世界观打造差异化内容。该IP已推出80余集内容，拥有约23万Instagram粉丝，并拓展至钥匙扣、明信片、贴纸等周边商品，展现出强大的全球角色IP商业潜力。
introduction_en:
Haniverse is an AI content studio and creator of the original IP, Mini Republic, a unique world of 1cm citizens living within everyday human life. The contrast between tiny characters and ordinary objects creates its distinctive identity and makes it a scalable universe-based IP.

The studio has produced over 80 episodes, built an audience of around 230,000 Instagram followers, and won the Red Dot Design Award. It has collaborated with global brands and AI companies and expanded into merchandise, including keycaps, keyrings, postcards, and stickers, demonstrating strong commercial potential as a global character IP.

introduction_zh: Team Tetrapod是一家韩国游戏工作室，旗下原创IP《Staffer》系列以超能力存在的世界观为背景，已推出三款作品并积累了忠实粉丝群体。新作《Staffer Retro》将于7月23日全球上线，拥有20余名角色、17位日本声优约30小时配音、100余条线索及40份档案，目前已获得超过4.2万愿望单关注。
introduction_en:
Team Tetrapod is a Korean game studio behind the Staffer series, a mystery game franchise set in a world where supernatural powers exist. Through its original IP universe, the studio has released three titles and built a loyal global fan base by consistently delivering high-quality story-driven experiences.

Its latest title, Staffer Retro, launching globally on July 23, is the fourth installment in the series. The game features over 20 characters, high-quality animated illustrations, approximately 30 hours of Japanese voice acting by 17 professional voice actors, and a rich mystery experience with more than 100 clues and 40 documents. With over 42,000 wishlists, the Staffer series continues to grow through its strategy of releasing at least one new title every year.

introduction_zh: MYOHANLYANG是以“向往悠闲生活的猫咪”为核心概念的韩国角色IP品牌，业务涵盖漫画、周边商品、展览、品牌联名及沉浸式快闪活动。品牌已与POSCO、教保文库、乐天百货等知名企业合作，并通过与日本乐天、巴西INFINITOON和泰国Mocca Group的合作，积极拓展全球IP授权市场
introduction_en:
MYOHANLYANG is a character IP brand centered around the concept of a carefree cat dreaming of escaping everyday life. Through its unique character universe, the brand has expanded into webtoons, merchandise, exhibitions, corporate collaborations, and immersive pop-up experiences.

The brand has demonstrated strong market competitiveness through partnerships with major Korean companies, including webtoon projects with POSCO and large-scale retail collaborations with Kyobo Book Centre and Lotte Department Store.

Beyond Korea, MYOHANLYANG is rapidly expanding its global presence through IP licensing and strategic partnerships with international companies, including Rakuten in Japan, INFINITOON in Brazil, and Mocca Group in Thailand, establishing itself as a growing global character IP brand.

introduction_zh:
关于麦当劳中国
麦当劳是全球知名的餐饮服务品牌，超过44,000家餐厅遍及全球100多个国家和地区，为顾客提供高品质的餐食、便捷友善的服务、舒适整洁的环境以及物超所值的体验，用美味与热爱凝聚社区邻里。截至2026年3月，中国内地麦当劳餐厅超过7,900家，员工人数超过20万，2025年服务顾客超过14亿人次。现在，麦当劳中国正以更强大、更美好、更智慧的业务策略，实现10,000家餐厅的目标。
introduction_en:
About McDonald's China
McDonald’s is the world’s leading global foodservice retailer with over 44,000 locations in over 100 countries. As of March 2026, there are over 7,900 McDonald's restaurants in mainland China, with more than 200,000 employees, serving over 1.4 billion customer transactions in 2025. Since 2017, McDonald’s China has been accelerating its growth in the new chapter of “Jin Gong Men” (Golden Arch) as a developmental licensee, fully leveraging the strengths of both local ownership and a global brand. Today, McDonald’s China is driving the business strategy of “Bigger, Better, Smarter” to achieve the ambition of 10,000 restaurants.

name_zh: 上海萃叮咔品牌管理有限公司
name_en: Shanghai Cuidingka Brand Management Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: HIT.Collection收卡吧卡牌买取专营店，致力于打造中国卡牌买取领域首席连锁品牌，成为行业生态构建者与价值领航者。我们以成为中国卡牌产业链核心基础设施为己任，推动行业高质量发展。
introduction_en: HIT.Collection (Card Trading Hub) strives to build China's premier chain brand for offline collectible card resale, acting as the industry's ecosystem builder and value trendsetter. We take developing core infrastructure for China's collectible card industrial chain as our mission to drive high-quality industrial growth.

name_zh: 深圳市翊臻科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 机械入侵潮玩品牌主要致力于原创机甲设计与开发，特别是变形类的机甲设计赢得众多模玩爱好者的喜欢与收藏。我们继续在擅长领域深度专研同时也发展其他品类的产品设计与开发，如授权合作，潮玩3C等，丰富不同的产品类型。
introduction_en: The Mecha Invasion collectible brand mainly focuses on original robot toy design and development, especially the transformational robot designs, which have won the favor of many toy collectors. We continue to delve deeply into our areas of expertise while also design and development in other categories, such as licensing cooperation and trendy 3C toys, to enrich our diverse product types.

name_zh: 北京锐腾海林文化发展有限公司
name_en: Beijing Ruiteng Hailin Culture Development Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 公司深耕游戏玩家综合服务领域，面向广大游戏爱好者提供一站式配套服务，涵盖官方游戏资产交易资讯咨询、玩家社群交流运营、玩家原创同人内容分享交流、游戏文创周边定制，全方位满足玩家多元文娱需求。
introduction_en: Focusing on comprehensive services for gaming enthusiasts, our company provides one-stop supporting solutions for all game lovers. Our services include consultation on official in-game asset trading channels, operation of player communities for communication, sharing and exchange of original fan-made works, and customization of gaming cultural peripherals, fully catering to the diverse cultural and entertainment demands of players.

name_zh: 广州泓科文化传播有限公司
name_en: Guangzhou HONGKE Culture Communication Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 广州泓科文化传播有限公司成立于2020年，初创团队始于2009年，已积累了10多年的行业经验，目前已发展成一家专注于动漫、影视、游戏IP等衍生品的开发、设计、生产、零售、数字媒体开发及IP正版授权合作等模块为一体的综合运营服务公司，涵盖合金机甲、可动人偶、变形玩具、拼装模型、手办、潮玩等产品类型。目前旗下拥有完全自主知识产权的模玩品牌HEATBOYS火仔动漫，以及全球模集店BE小蜜蜂小王子。
introduction_en:
Guangzhou HONGKE Culture Communication Co., Ltd.  was established in 2020. The founding team began in 2009 and has accumulated over 10 years of experience in the global model toy industry. It has now grown into a comprehensive operating service company specializing in the development, design, production, retail, digital media development, and IP licensing of derivative products from animation, film, and gaming IPs. These products include Alloy Mechas, Action Figures, Transformable Toys, Assembly Models, Figurines, Trendy Toys, and other product types. Currently, HONGKE owns the model toy brand 
HEATBOYS, with completely independent intellectual property rights, and the global model toy channel brand BEEPRINCE.

name_zh: 上海润忆贸易有限公司
introduction_zh: Mouxuyy漫序隶属于上海润忆贸易有限公司旗下 ， 是正版  动漫IP衍生品开发的综合服务型品牌 ， 专注于 正版 动漫IP衍生品 开发 、 设计 生产 销售 ， 致力于打破传统企业单向开发的设计思路 ,  提供多品类衍生品开发 、 设计的解决方案。
introduction_en: Mouxuyy Manxu is a subsidiary of Shanghai Runyi Trading Co., Ltd., a comprehensive service brand specializing in the development of authentic anime IP merchandise. Focused on the creation, design, production, and sales of official anime IP derivatives, it aims to break away from traditional one-way corporate design models by offering multi-category solutions for derivative product development and design.

introduction_zh: 有色，创立于 2019 年，是中国领先的个护美学先锋品牌。我们主张「让生活更有色」，将科技与潮流文化相结合。有色与宝可梦、机动战士高达、空山基等全球知名IP及艺术家深度合作，赋予产品情绪价值与多元化的使用场景。拒绝平庸，让科技以更 “ 酷 ” 的方式融入生活，让更多人享受设计的价值。
introduction_en:
「yoose」, founded in 2019, is a leading Chinese pioneer brand in personal care design & aesthetics. Guided by the belief of “Making life more diverse,” we combine technology with pop culture.
