yoose has collaborated in depth with globally renowned IPs and artists such as Pokémon, Mobile Suit Gundam, and Hajime Sorayama, bringing emotional value to our products and creating more diverse usage scenarios.
We reject the ordinary, bringing technology into everyday life in a cooler way, and enabling more people to enjoy the value of design.

name_zh: 欢乐模玩(北京)科技发展有限公司
introduction_zh: 自2015年成立以来，JOYTOY专注于成人向动漫、影视及游戏类模型玩具的开发，逐步建立起“原创IP+国际授权”双线并行的产品体系。原创层面，公司先后推出“战星辰”“暗源”“暗源江湖”“纷争”等自有IP模玩系列，每个系列均构建了独立的世界观与机械美学体系，形成了具有延续性的产品线布局。授权层面，JOYTOY先后获得《战锤40K》《荷鲁斯之乱》《忍者龟》《拳皇98'UM》等国际知名IP的模玩开发授权
introduction_en: Since its founding in 2015, JOYTOY has been developing adult-oriented action figures based on its own original IPs (Battle for the Stars, Dark Source, Dark Source Jianghu, Strife) and licensed IPs (Warhammer 40,000, The Horus Heresy, Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles, The King of Fighters '98 UM), building a stable global fanbase through deep multi-IP adaptation.

name_zh: 机甲宇宙(上海)智能科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
MECHTRON机甲宇宙公司是一家专注于创新型品牌公司的先驱企业，致力于为客户提供城市家居生活、汽配、户外等一系列男士家居周边潮流装备产品。
凭借独特的创意及对产品力了解的优势、杰出的团队协作和前瞻性的市场洞察，公司有望在行业中迅速崛起,打破传统，实现可持续增长并为投资者带来丰厚的回报。
introduction_en:
MECHTRON is a pioneering company focused on innovative brand development, dedicated to providing customers with a range of trendy male-oriented lifestyle products for urban living, automotive accessories, and outdoor activities.
Leveraging its unique creativity, deep understanding of product potential, outstanding team collaboration, and forward-looking market insight, the company is poised to rapidly rise within the industry, disrupt traditional norms, achieve sustainable growth, and deliver substantial returns to investors.

introduction_zh: PureArts Studio是享誉全球的收藏品制作商，由知名动画导演Hugues Martel创立，是一个主营美系手办雕像的模玩品牌。品牌成立至今，先后与刺客信条、黑暗之魂、英雄联盟、赛博朋克2077、星球大战、终结者等AAA级游戏和影视IP合作，推出了一系列集收藏性、艺术性和可玩性于一身的手办雕像作品。亦在探索艺术玩具在潮流文化中的可能性和多样性，与国内外多位艺术家合作，推出品牌潮流玩具系列。
introduction_en: PureArts Studio is a world-renowned collector's item manufacturer founded by acclaimed animation director Hugues Martel. The brand specializes in American-style figures and statues. Since its inception, PureArts has collaborated with AAA game and film IPs such as Assassin's Creed, Dark Souls, League of Legends, Cyberpunk 2077, Star Wars, and Terminator, producing a series of figure and statue works that combine collectibility, artistry, and interactivity. The brand also explores the possibilities and diversity of art toys within pop culture, collaborating with numerous artists both domestically and internationally to launch its own line of pop culture toys.

introduction_zh: 本公司为万代（BANDAI）公司国内二级核心合作经销商，深耕日系模玩行业多年，主营高达拼装、TAMASHII魂成品、英雄天地变身玩具、眼镜厂等潮玩玩具。公司拥有完善全国批发分销体系，长期服务线上电商、线下实体店、潮玩集合店等各类渠道，在国内模玩圈具备良好口碑。本次参展诚邀各地实体线上商家客户莅临洽谈合作，共谋长期发展。
introduction_en:
Our company serves as a core secondary authorized distributor of Bandai in China. Having long engaged in the Japanese hobby merchandise industry, we specialize in Gundam model kits, Tamashii Nations finished products, Kamen Rider transformation toys and Banpresto collectibles.

We operate a sound nationwide wholesale and distribution system, providing long-term services for e-commerce platforms, physical stores and hobby boutiques, and enjoy a reputable standing in China’s hobby industry.

We sincerely invite domestic online and offline merchants to visit our booth for business negotiations and long-term cooperation.

name_zh: 深圳市好兄弟电子有限公司
introduction_zh: 巴布森，源自好兄弟声学技术创新平台，是BBS二十余年技术积累的集大成体现，传承经典，天生不凡,自带创新颠覆基因。好兄弟声学创立之初，组建内郎技术创新平台命名为巴布森，旨在探索先进技术，将超前性，概念化，未来感的新产品，新技术，新设计进行全方位的验证，提出新的功能和创意，推动自主创新发展。
introduction_en: Babson, originating from the Haoxiongdi Acoustic Technology Innovation Plaform, represents the culmination of BBS's over 20 yearsof technological expertise. It caries forward a legacy of excellence, born wth distinction and inherently driven by a spirit of innovation anddisruption.At the inception of Haoxiongdi Acoustics, the internal technology innovation platform was established and named Babson,with the aim of exploring advanced technologies. Its mision is to comprehensively validate forward-looking. conceptual, and futuristionew products, new technologies, and new designs, while proposing new functions and creative ideas to drive independent innovation and development.

name_zh: 上海星闪照物科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
你的任何创意，都能在 10 分钟内获得可预览的工艺方案。
全品类定制，支持拼团协作。面向中小创意者的一站式全兜底柔性定制平台 。
你提供创意,我们来落地。不需要懂工艺，不需要找工厂。
上传草图或描述想法，星闪帮你从创意到成品，全程托管
introduction_en: Any of your ideas can receive a previewed craft plan within 10 minutes. Full-category customization is available, supporting group collaboration. This is a one-stop, fully supported flexible customization platform for small and medium-sized creators. You provide the idea, and we bring it to life. No need to understand the craft, no need to find a factory. Upload sketches or describe your ideas, and Popzao.com will help you from concept to finished product, with full process management.

name_zh: 上海暴蒙文化传播有限公司
name_en: Shanghai Baomeng Cultural Communication Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 上海暴蒙文化传播有限公司 成立于2013年，一直从事设计开发 生产动漫周边业务。我司和国内外数十个版权方等保持良好的合作关系，先后合作的ip数量100+。我司自2023年起大力开拓暴蒙专卖店渠道，已有24+专卖店。我们目标一直是做好ip与粉丝的桥梁。目前也成为了IP版权代理，手中有多个日漫ip可对外授权，欢迎各大合作方前来合作。
introduction_en: Shanghai Baomeng Cultural Communication Co., Ltd. was established in 2013. Our company has been engaged in the design, development, and production of anime merchandise.Our company has maintained solid cooperative relationships with dozens of copyright owners.Currently, we have collaborated with over 100 IPs. Since 2023, our company has vigorously expanded the Baomeng specialty store channel. Currently, we have over 24 specialty stores. At present, our company has also become an IP copyright agent. We have multiple Japanese anime IPs available for external licensing. We warmly welcome all potential partners to collaborate with us.

name_zh: 上海禀赋文化传播集团有限公司
name_en: Shanghai Endowment Culture Communication Group Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 遇意品牌2017年创立于上海，深耕IP文创与潮玩领域，已成长为行业内颇具影响力的全链路运营品牌。其独创的“飞花令”等经典产品线，一经推出便迅速售罄，凭借成熟的玩法设计和强劲的自研能力，赢得了版权方与消费者的广泛认可。目前，遇意经营品类已全面覆盖文创周边、谷子潮玩、日用杂项三大板块，数十类产品，并持续与各大博物馆、景区深度联动，探索文创边界。
introduction_en: Founded in Shanghai in 2017, YUYI has deeply cultivated the IP cultural creative and trendy toy sectors, evolving into a full‑chain operation brand with significant influence in the industry. Its signature product line, such as the original “Feihualing” (a poetry‑inspired game series), sold out immediately upon release, earning widespread recognition from both licensors and consumers thanks to its mature gameplay design and robust in‑house R&D capabilities.

introduction_zh: 康师傅控股有限公司及其附属公司主要在中国从事生产和销售方便面、饮品及方便食品。2026ChinaJoy康师傅将携手人气治愈IP小熊虫，主打联名款番茄鸡蛋牛肉面。浓郁醇厚番茄汤底搭配劲道面条，酸甜鲜香，完全是逛展补给的好搭子。全场以软萌小熊虫形象打造沉浸式空间，设置趣味打卡、互动小游戏，参与即可解锁小熊虫限定周边。现场可选购联名泡面，一站式体验泡面美食与治愈萌 IP 双向结合。
introduction_en: Masterkong and its affiliated companies mainly engage in the production and sales  of instant noodles,beverages,and convenience foods in china.Little Bear Bug,and  focus on the joint product -tomato，egg，beef noodles. The rich and thick tomato soup base is paired with firm noodles,with a tangy ,sweet,and fresh flavor.It is definitely a great companion for replenishing supplies during the exhibition.The entire venue is created with an immersive space featuring and cute image of Little Bear Bug,and sets up interesting photography device and interactive games.Participants can gain peripheral products by joining or purchasing our products.On-site,you can purchase the joint noodles, and enjoy a one-stop experience combining the deliciousness of noodles and the cute IP of Little Bear Bug.

introduction_zh: 上好佳于1946在菲律宾起步，集团于1966年创立于马尼拉，从事生产及经营贸易业务。从1974年起，进入食品生产领域，创立了“ Oishi ”品牌。1993年开始拓展海外市场，目前在全球10个国家建立了30生产基地。上好佳食品丰富多样，包括休闲食品、薯片、糖果、饼干、饮料和巧克力制品等，“Oishi 上好佳”已经成为代表“品质和美味”知名品牌。
introduction_en: Liwayway is a leading food manufacturing group with 30 manufacturing bases spread across 10 different countries, offering a diverse range of snacks, beverages, and confectioneries, known for its quality and deliciousness.

introduction_zh: 达米恩光剑深耕高端光剑研发制造，集设计、生产、跨境销售于一体，自研声光控制系统专利。产品采用航空铝手柄、抗打光刃，搭载平滑挥剑感应、多音效光谱切换，兼顾收藏展示与实战对战需求。品牌布局线上跨境平台，面向全球光剑爱好者，坚持精工品质，收获海内外玩家口碑，致力打造国产高端光剑标杆品牌。
introduction_en:
Damiensaber specializes in the R&D and manufacturing of premium lightsabers, integrating design, production and cross-border sales. It holds proprietary patents for self-developed sound and light control systems.
Its products feature aerospace-grade aluminum hilts and impact-resistant blades, equipped with smooth swing sensors and multi-sound & multi-spectrum switching functions, suitable for collection, display and dueling.
The brand operates cross-border online platforms to serve lightsaber enthusiasts worldwide. Adhering to exquisite craftsmanship, it has earned wide recognition from global fans, striving to build a benchmark brand for domestic high-end lightsabers.

name_zh: 深圳市灵童文创有限公司
name_en: Shenzhen Lingtong Cultural and Creative Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh:
智能集换式卡牌游戏（STCG）并非普通的棋盘游戏，而是一个充满活力的平台。它将实体卡牌收集的乐趣与智能棋盘沉浸式体验完美融合。
其核心使命：消除您通往纯粹策略大师之路上的所有障碍。 告别骰子、指示物和手动计分。我们拥有专利的智能棋盘。当您打出卡牌时，棋盘会立即识别，分数自动更新，主题灯光脉冲扫过棋盘表面，触发独特的音效提示。繁琐的数学运算被无缝处理，让您可以专注于真正重要的事：策略较量。
introduction_en:
Smart Trading Card Games (STCG) is a dynamic platform that perfectly blends the joy of collecting physical cards with the immersive experience of a smart digital board.
Our mission is to remove all barriers on your path to becoming a true master of pure strategy. Our patented smart board instantly recognizes the cards you play, automatically updates scores, pulses with thematic lighting that sweeps across the board’s surface, and triggers unique audio cues. Tedious calculations are seamlessly handled, allowing you to focus on what truly matters: the battle of strategies.

name_zh: 中山爱迪讯科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 中山爱迪讯科技有限公司聚焦二次元、动漫、明星应援、展会谷圈核心需求，主打差异化创新产品 ——智能电子吧唧（电子徽章），区别于传统马口铁徽章，搭载蓝牙智能显示模组，支持手机一键上传动态原画、多图切换、柔光发光效果，适配痛包佩戴、展会展示、收藏送礼全场景。
introduction_en: Zhongshan IDIXEE Technology Co., Ltd. focuses on the core needs of the secondary world, anime, star support, and exhibition circle, and focuses on differentiated innovative products.— Intelligent electronic beep (electronic badge), different from traditional tin badge, equipped with Bluetooth intelligent display module, supports mobile phone one-click upload dynamic original painting, multi-picture switching, soft light emitting effect, suitable for pain package wearing, exhibition display, collection gift giving all scenarios.

name_zh: 东莞衍创文化发展有限公司
introduction_zh: 衍创文化于2017年在广东成立，始终坚持中国原创与中国制造。旗下拥有LUCKYEMMA、露露灵、米希娅等知名IP，在潮玩、盲盒、BJD等领域表现亮眼。其中，LUCKYEMMA已成功出海38个国家，覆盖全球超2万家实体门店。公司以“创造快乐，传递幸运”为使命，以“艺术+科技+生活”为创新模式，持续构建全球化潮玩生态。
introduction_en: Yanchuang Culture was founded in Guangdong in 2017. Its IPs including LUCKY EMMA and Luluelf have achieved remarkable performance in trendy toys, blind boxes, BJD and other fields. LUCKY EMMA has been exported to 38 countries and covered more than 20,000 physical stores.With the mission of "Creating Happiness, Delivering Luck", the company is continuously building a global trendy toy ecosystem through an innovative model of "Art + Technology + Lifestyle".

name_zh: 杭州守川文化创意有限公司
introduction_zh: INART成立于2021年，隶属于Queen Studios，专注于可动人偶研发生产。我们希望通过严谨的角色还原与写实工艺，让模玩不再只是普通的陈列品，而是可以被细细品味、被玩家珍藏的艺术创作。无论是INART高端收藏系列、适配多元把玩的INART Action系列，还是聚焦原创的MORFIG系列，我们都想用更细腻的设计语言，探索人偶的更多可能。
introduction_en:
Founded in 2021, INART is a subsidiary of Queen Studios that specializes in the research, development, and manufacturing of articulated collectible figures. We strive to elevate these figures beyond ordinary display pieces into exquisite, collectible works of art worth celebrating  through hyperrealistic craftsmanship and an unmatched attention to detail.
Spanning three core lines — the premium INART Sixth Scale Collectible Series, the versatile INART Action Series engineered for playability and poseability, as well as MORFIG, featuring a lineup of our original designs — we leverage our expertise and refined design techniques to continuously push the boundaries what is possible in the realm of collectible figures.

introduction_zh: Hello Kitty乐园是中国首座正版授权的Hello Kitty主题乐园，国家4A级景区。园区精心规划六大主题区域，游玩形式丰富且受游客青睐。园内拥有亚洲第一台滑道式摩天轮等多项游乐设施，以及缤纷花车巡游和三丽鸥明星零距离互动等主题表演，还有特色餐饮和数千款限定商品供挑选，整个园区将创意、温馨、快乐、梦幻与环保贯穿一体。
introduction_en: Hello Kitty Paradise is China's first officially licensed Hello Kitty theme park, designated as a national 4A scenic spot. The park is meticulously planned with six themed areas, offering a diverse range of attractions that are highly favored by visitors. The park boasts Asia's first slide-style Ferris wheel and other amusement facilities, as well as themed performances such as colorful float parades and up-close interactions with Sanrio characters. Additionally, there are specialty dining options and thousands of limited-edition merchandise for guests to choose from. The entire park seamlessly integrates creativity, warmth, happiness, fantasy, and environmental protection.

introduction_zh: Toyntoys是新加坡D&L集团旗下公司，深耕中国市场多年，拥有丰富的国际品牌合作经验不仅是NECA、Super7等知名潮玩品牌的中国官方授权总代理，还引入了Youtooz等深受年轻消费者喜爱的潮流IP。凭借其强大的分销网络和对本土市场的深刻理解，Toyntoys致力于为中国收藏爱好者带来全球顶尖的玩具与雕像产品。
introduction_en: Toyntoys, a subsidiary of Singapore-based D&L Group, has deep roots in the Chinese market and extensive experience collaborating with international brands. It is the official authorized master distributor in China for renowned collectible brands such as NECA and Super7, and has also introduced popular IPs like Youtooz, which resonates strongly with young consumers.

introduction_zh: Prime 1 Studio是一家总部位于日本的公司，主要从事高端雕像的企划、开发、制作以及销售。我们取得来自全球知名娱乐IP的授权，包括DC Comics、变形金刚、侏罗纪公园、剑风传奇以及新世纪福音战士等，涵盖电影、动画、游戏与漫画等多个领域。自2012年成立以来，始终坚持以“高端、高细节、高品质”为核心，通过精湛的匠人精神不断追求毫不妥协的创作，通过这些坚持致力于为全球收藏家带来惊喜与感动。
introduction_en:
Prime 1 Studio is a Japan-based company that plans, develops, manufactures, and sells high-end statues.
The company holds licenses for a wide range of characters from global entertainment properties, including DC Comics, Transformers, Jurassic Park, Berserk, and Evangelion, spanning films, anime, games, and comics.
Since its founding in 2012, Prime 1 Studio has continuously pursued uncompromising creativity rooted in craftsmanship, with a focus on high-end, high-detail, and high-quality standards.
Through this dedication, the company strives to deliver surprise and excitement to collectors around the world.

name_zh: 东莞未界人形文化创意有限公司
name_en: Dongguan Miraidolls Cultural & Creative Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 东莞未界人形文化创意有限公司坐落于 “中国潮玩之都” 东莞石排镇。当地是全国潮玩产业核心，拥有设计、开模、生产、包装物流完整产业链，15 分钟车程覆盖全生产环节，产业配套优势突出。公司秉持 “艺术情感、收藏价值、情感陪伴” 核心理念，主营 BJD 球形关节人偶全链路业务，自有高端收藏人偶品牌 MiraiDolls。品牌专注打造兼具艺术审美与情感温度的潮玩藏品
introduction_en: Dongguan Weijie Figure Culture & Creative Co., Ltd. is based in Shipai, Dongguan, the "Capital of Designer Toys in China." Benefiting from a complete industrial supply chain covering design, mold development, manufacturing, packaging, and logistics, the company delivers efficient, high-quality production.Guided by the philosophy of "Artistic Expression, Collectible Value, and Emotional Companionship," the company specializes in the development and production of BJD (Ball-Jointed Dolls). Its premium brand, MiraiDolls, is dedicated to creating collectible art dolls that combine exceptional craftsmanship with emotional storytelling.

name_zh: 深圳市天工醒物动漫科技有限公司
name_en: Shenzhen Awake Toys Animation Technology Co.,Ltd
introduction_zh: 深圳市天工醒物动漫科技有限公司，旗下有自营原创IP——卡布兔。我司致力于品牌动漫文化形象的探索与研究，内容包括但不限于盲盒公仔、手办、模型等业务。目前IP相关衍生品有卡牌、漫画书、周边等。盲盒带来的是最初始的感动，最纯粹的快乐，如同孩童得到玩具的喜悦。延续这种感动，就是我们最热切的希望。
introduction_en: Shenzhen Awake Toys Animation Technology Co.,Ltd operates its proprietary original IP—Cup Rabbits. Our company is dedicated to exploring and researching brand animation cultural imagery, encompassing but not limited to blind box collectibles, figurines, models, and related businesses. Current IP-related merchandise includes trading cards, comic books, and accessories. Blind boxes deliver that initial thrill and purest joy—much like a child receiving a toy. Sustaining this excitement is our most fervent aspiration. By bringing IP characters to life, we offer fresh interpretations of brand concepts, allowing consumers to perceive brand identities from new perspectives. This approach maximizes both the commercial and cultural value of our IP.

introduction_zh: Funko作为全球流行文化品牌，聚焦快速增长的"成人童心经济"（Kidult economy）与不断变化的粉丝文化潮流。凭借旗下多元化的品牌矩阵——Funko、Loungefly以及Mondo打造了一系列行业标杆产品，包含搪胶人偶、微型收藏品、时尚配饰、毛绒玩具、动作玩具。公司成立于1998年，总部位于美国华盛顿州，在全球主要消费市场设有办事处、零售门店、运营中心及授权合作伙伴。
introduction_en: Funko is a leading global pop culture brand that focuses on the fast-growing "Kidult economy" and evolving fan culture trends. With a diverse brand portfolio including Funko, Loungefly, and Mondo, the company designs and manufactures industry-benchmarking products, including vinyl figures, micro-collectibles, fashion accessories, apparel, plush toys, action figures, high-end art, and music releases. Through products such as the classic Pop! series, Pop! Yourself, Bitty Pop!, and Digital Pop!™, Funko empowers global fans to express their passion, build communities, and share enjoyment. Founded in 1998 and headquartered in Washington State, USA, the company maintains offices, retail locations, operational hubs, and licensing partners in major consumer markets worldwide.

name_zh: 深圳光胜人工智能科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 深圳光胜人工智能科技有限公司（Avatronics）旗下品牌 Beambox，专注于 AI 智能硬件与可穿戴显示产品研发。核心产品 e-BADGE 智能动态电子徽章支持图片、GIF、视频展示及 App 内容管理，适用于展会、潮玩、品牌活动、二次元周边和商务社交等场景。
introduction_en: Shenzhen Guangsheng Artificial Intelligence Technology Co., Ltd. (Avatronics) is the company behind Beambox, focusing on AI-powered smart hardware and wearable display products. Its flagship Beambox e-BADGE supports photos, GIFs and videos via app control, bringing dynamic digital expression to events, branding, pop culture, cosplay, merchandise and social networking scenarios.

name_zh: 上海弦弓信息科技有限公司
name_en: Shanghai Xiangong Information Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 迷因动力是一家从产品出身的全链路IP版权运营平台，我们专注萌系治愈/搞怪类IP的孵化、签约与商业化落地，从内容创作、社媒运营到产品开发、品牌授权，提供一站式定制化解决方案。只做能长期陪伴用户、有商业生命力的IP，让每个有趣的灵魂被看见。
introduction_en: Meme Power is a full-chain IP copyright operation platform that originated from product development. We specialize in the incubation, signing, and commercialization of cute and healing/humorous IPs. From content creation, social media operation to product development and brand licensing, we provide one-stop customized solutions. We only create IPs that can accompany users for a long time and have commercial viability, allowing every interesting soul to be seen.

name_zh: 维信诺科技股份有限公司
introduction_zh:
全球每3块AMOLED智能手表屏幕，就有1块来自我们！没错，维信诺就是那个你天天看、却不知道名字的屏幕大佬。
我们的故事始于1996年清华大学OLED项目组，后一路拿下“国家技术发明奖一等奖”、“中国专利金奖”，为国内外众多一线品牌客户供货，是全球OLED产业领军者。从手表、手机到车载、医疗，维信诺屏幕早已走出掌心，悄悄遍布你生活的每个角落。
来E6馆001，带你玩转屏幕，探索未来显示的无限可能！
introduction_en:
1 in 3 AMOLED smartwatch screens in the world comes from us. Yes, we're Visionox — the display brand you interact with every day but probably never knew.
Our story began in 1996 as an OLED research team at Tsinghua University. Since then, we've won the State Technological Invention Award (First Prize) and the China Patent Gold Award, supplied screens to leading global brands, and grown into a global leader in the OLED industry. Our products span smartwatches, smartphones, automotive, medical displays and other sectors. Far beyond handheld devices, Visionox display panels permeate every part of your daily life.
This year at ChinaJoy, we welcome you at Booth 001 in Hall E6. Come experience cutting-edge display technologies and explore the boundless potential of next-generation displays!

introduction_zh: 索尼集团公司是一家建立在坚实技术基础上的创意娱乐公司，现运营游戏与网络服务业务；音乐业务；影视业务；娱乐、技术及服务业务；影像与传感解决方案业务等多个业务板块。索尼的企业宗旨是“用创意和科技的力量感动世界”。
introduction_en: Sony Group Corporation is a creative entertainment company built on a solid technological foundation. It currently operates multiple business segments, including Game & Network Services, Music, Pictures, Entertainment, Technology & Services, and Imaging & Sensing Solutions. Sony's corporate purpose is: "To fill the world with emotion, through the power of creativity and technology."

name_zh: 宁波傲风科技有限公司
introduction_zh: AutoFull傲风，专业电竞外设装备品牌，成立于2014年，拥有电竞椅、电竞桌、电竞舱等产品体系； 为LPL/VCT CN/三角洲烽火杯/IEM等顶级联赛战略长期合作伙伴，坚持职业电竞装备的标准研发产品，让电竞职业选手、头部主播和核心玩家参与产品设计，打造集专业电竞、技术领先、潮酷时尚于一体的行业标杆装备； 致力于将健康电竞与极致游戏体验，传递给全球每一位玩家。
introduction_en: AutoFull, a professional esports peripherals brand, was founded in 2014 and offers a product lineup including gaming chairs, gaming desks, and gaming pods. As a long-term strategic partner of top-tier leagues such as the LPL, VCT CN, Delta Force Fire Cup, and IEM, AutoFull adheres to professional esports equipment standards in R&D and product development. Esports professionals, top streamers, and core gamers are invited to participate in product design, creating industry‑benchmark gear that combines professional esports performance, technological leadership, and cutting‑edge style. Committed to delivering healthy gaming and the ultimate play experience to every gamer around the world.

name_zh: 江苏云幕智造科技有限公司
name_en: Jiangsu Yunmu Intelligent Manufacturing Technology Co., Ltd
introduction_zh: 云幕智造成立于2021年，是国家高新技术企业、江苏省专精特新企业，专注L4级具身智能人形机器人研发与产业化。核心创始人贺亮为国家级人才，兼具西工大、航天八院、哈工大等顶尖院校及科研机构背景，核心研发团队积淀近20年技术经验。技术端依托航天技术转化构建全栈自研体系，获近百项人形机器人发明专利。
introduction_en: Founded in 2021, Yunmu Intelligent Manufacturing is a national high-tech enterprise and a national-level "Little Giant" specialized and sophisticated enterprise in Jiangsu Province. The company focuses on the R&D and industrialization of L4-level embodied intelligent humanoid robots. Its founder, He Liang, is a national-level talent with academic and research experience from top universities and institutions including Northwestern Polytechnical University, Shanghai Academy of Space flight Technology, and Harbin Institute of Technology.  The core R&D team has nearly 20 years of accumulated technical expertise.On the technology side, the company has built a full-stack independent R&D system based on the transformation of aerospace technologies，holding nearly 100 invention patents.

name_zh: 深圳爱图仕创新科技股份有限公司
name_en: Shenzhen Aputure Imaging Industries Co., Ltd
introduction_zh: 深圳爱图仕创新科技股份有限公司于2005年成立，专注于影像器材研发、制造和销售，是全球发展速度最快的影像器材企业之一。旗下Aputure爱图仕、amaran艾蒙拉、Deity谛听、Sidus Link四个品牌。爱图仕专注于电影工业，艾蒙拉专注于消费级影视用户。
introduction_en: Shenzhen Aputure Imaging Industries Co., Ltd was established in 2005, specializing in the research and development, manufacturing, and sales of imaging equipment. It is one of the fastest-growing imaging equipment companies globally. The company owns four brands: Aputure, amaran, Deity, and Sidus Link. Aputure focuses on the film industry, while amaran targets consumer-level video users.

introduction_zh: 英信科技有限公司为中国香港科技品牌运营公司，专注于内存模组、SSD、Flash 及电脑周边产品的开发整合与市场推广。旗下拥有两大品牌为AVEXIR 晗之翼面向中高端玩家市场，承袭光效内存基因，强调稳定性能、RGB 美学与装机文化及AUREXIS 曜尚霆聚焦高端科技美学，以雷电 DDR5 为核心代表，打造兼具性能、工艺、光效与品牌精神的电脑装备。
introduction_en: Alson Technology Co., Ltd. is a Hong Kong technology brand operating company, focusing on the development integration and market promotion of memory modules, SSDs, Flash, and computer peripheral products. The company owns two major brands, AVEXIR 晗之翼 and AUREXIS 曜尚霆, with products covering the mid to high-end gamer market and the high-end technology equipment field. AVEXIR 晗之翼 inherits the DNA of lighting-effect memory, emphasizing stable performance, RGB aesthetics, and PC building culture; AUREXIS 曜尚霆 uses Raiden DDR5 as its core representative product, integrating performance, craftsmanship, lighting effects, and brand spirit to create computer hardware products with strong recognition and high-end value.

name_zh: 东莞市敏动电子科技有限公司
introduction_zh: HiBy Music（海贝音乐）成立于2011年，专注于便携（穿戴式）领域高音质产品的研发与销售，拥有50多名专业音频研发销售人员，近20年的行业经验，曾与多个品牌联合开发过数十款专业音频播放器和耳机等产品，同时手机App也拥有200万专业用户，遍布全球100多个国家和地区，音质深受用户的好评。
introduction_en: HiBy Music was founded in 2011. We focus on the R&D and sales of high-fidelity audio products for portable and wearable devices. Our team consists of over 50 professionals in audio R&D and sales, with nearly 20 years of industry experience. We have co-developed dozens of professional audio players, headphones and other audio products with various brands. Meanwhile, our mobile app has attracted 2 million professional users across more than 100 countries and regions worldwide, earning wide acclaim for its outstanding sound quality.

name_zh: 福州极客严选科技有限公司
name_en: Fuzhou Geek Yanxuan Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: VGN于2022 年创立，隶属福州极客严选科技有限公司，是面向全球青年的桌面数码潮牌。我们打造融合精工美学与未来设计的数码产品，服务游戏玩家、数码极客，兼顾高效办公与沉浸式游戏体验。桌面不止是工作娱乐场地，更是释放个性、孕育灵感的多维空间。秉持 “POWER ON GAME ON” 理念，VGN 以专业设备与先锋设计，为 Z 世代搭建可持续迭代的电竞生活生态，提供多元且独具风格的新潮桌面生活方式。
introduction_en: Founded in 2022, VGN is a trendy desktop digital brand under Fuzhou Geek Yanxuan Technology Co., Ltd., catering to young audiences across the globe. We develop digital gear that merges refined engineering aesthetics with futuristic design for gamers and tech enthusiasts, enabling both efficient productivity and immersive gaming sessions. A desktop setup is more than merely a zone for work and play—it serves as a multi-dimensional platform to showcase individuality and fuel creativity. Upholding the brand mantra "POWER ON GAME ON", VGN builds an endlessly upgradable esports lifestyle ecosystem via professional hardware and cutting-edge design, bringing diverse, unique and stylish desktop lifestyles to Gen Z.

introduction_zh:
由刃（Oyrein）成立于2024年，是以东方造物精神理解电竞外设的中国品牌。

品牌取自《梦溪笔谈》“得心应手，意到便成”——工具成为身体延伸，人与物只剩心手默契，便是“游刃有余”。

由刃产品是千百次打磨后的锋芒，是每一次点击的干脆利落。

器物承载态度。鼠标与弓、砚、扇无异，皆因琢磨而成器，让掌中之物成为值得郑重对待的利器。

得心应手，游刃有余。
introduction_en:
Founded in 2024, Oyrein is a Chinese brand that reimagines gaming peripherals through the lens of Eastern craftsmanship.

The brand draws from an ancient saying in Dream Pool Essays: "The hand follows the heart, the intention becomes action." When the tool becomes an extension of the body, all that remains is the harmony between hand and mind—this is what Oyrein calls "moving with effortless precision."

Oyrein believes that a mouse is no different from the timeless objects of ancient China—a bow, an inkstone, a folding fan. Each is shaped through the artisan's repeated touch and becomes something more than mere function. Oyrein approaches this everyday object with the spirit of Eastern craftsmanship, turning every mouse into a tool worthy of being held with care and respect.

introduction_zh: KiWear Inc.是一家聚焦轻量化智能穿戴与新一代人机手势交互的创新科技企业，深耕穿戴硬件、高精度动作感知、AI实时算法与跨终端互联技术。我们依托自研行业首创的无触碰自然手势交互系统，以无感操控打通全品类智能设备，搭建全域覆盖的全场景互联体系，打造独具革新性的智能戒指交互生态。目前已实现手机、电脑、车载、AR、影音、游戏终端全生态跨设备联动、轻量化游戏交互等多元化应用场景。
introduction_en:
KiWear Inc. is an innovative technology company focused on lightweight smart wearables and next-generation gesture-based human-device interaction. We specialize in wearable hardware, high-precision motion sensing, real-time AI algorithms, and cross-device connectivity technologies.

Powered by our proprietary, industry-first touchless and intuitive gesture interaction system, we enable seamless control across smart devices, building a comprehensive all-scenario interconnected system and a groundbreaking smart ring interaction ecosystem.

Our solutions already enable a wide array of use cases, such as seamless cross-device interaction across smartphones, PCs, automotive systems, AR devices, audio-visual systems and gaming terminals, as well as lightweight gesture-based gaming experiences.

name_zh: 南宁重锤科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 天使吉米（TANCHJIM） 是2015年创立的专业声学品牌，由南宁重锤科技有限公司创立，总部位于广西南宁，集产品研发、设计、生产、销售、服务为一体，自创立以来坚持将优秀的设计与出色工艺相结合，视产品为艺术品，力求传达音乐和美学的动人之处
introduction_en: TANCHJIM is a professional audio brand founded in 2015 by Nanning Zhongchui Technology Co., Ltd., with its headquarters in Nanning, Guangxi, China. Integrating product research and development, design, manufacturing, sales, and customer service, TANCHJIM is always committed to combining outstanding design with exceptional craftsmanship since its founding. Viewing every product as a work of art, TANCHJIM strives to capture and convey the emotional beauty of music and aesthetics through every listening experience.

name_zh: 东莞市七个音符科技有限公司
name_en: Dongguan Seven Notes Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh:
KNA，诞生于全球电竞玩家对游戏体验的极致追求，在KNA的基因序列里，每一块电路板都流淌着炽热纯粹的电竞血液，每一条导线都复刻着攻防轨迹的原生频率，每一个焊点都承载着百万对局的凯旋记忆。
我们坚信，电竞外设绝非简单的参数堆砌，而是对精密元件的暴力解析。那些曾被廉价硬件阉割的快感、被超高延迟篡改的战绩、被电流杂音模糊的胜负，终将在KNA的澎湃性能里涅槃重生，让胜利的欢呼与呐喊，成为战场的永恒旋律。
introduction_en: KNA was born from global esports players’ relentless pursuit of the ultimate gaming experience. Within KNA’s genetic code, every circuit board pulses with fervent, pure esports energy; every wire replicates the native frequency of attack-and-defense movements; and every solder joint bears the triumphant memories of millions of matches.

name_zh: 深圳市兴戈科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 兴戈科技，自2015年成立以来，已发展成为一家集产品开发、工业设计、技术研发、生产制造、多渠道营销和销售为一体的综合性科技企业。秉承“致敬艺术与科学”的理念，打造出一系列集卓越音质、精湛工艺和时尚外观于一身的音频“艺术品”。旗下拥有国内知名Hi-Fi音频品牌:兴戈SIMGOT。产品曾多次获日本音频权威VGP金赏，也曾多次被美国本土报纸Dallasnews和福布斯杂志Forbes等世界知名媒体报道。
introduction_en: Founded in 2015, SIMGOT has grown into a fully integrated technology company spanning product development, industrial design, R&D, manufacturing, and multi-channel marketing and sales.Guided by the philosophy of "Salute to Art and Science," the company seamlessly combines cutting-edge acoustic engineering with timeless design to create a portfolio of audio "artworks"—each delivering exceptional sound quality, meticulous craftsmanship, and contemporary aesthetics.SIMGOT is also home to its namesake Hi-Fi audio brand, a well-established name in the Chinese market. The brand has repeatedly earned the VGP Gold Award, one of Japan's most prestigious audio accolades, and has been featured in major international media outlets, including the U.S. newspaper Dallas News and Forbes magazine.

name_zh: 深圳市壹号本科技有限公司
name_en: Shenzhen One- Netbook Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 深圳市壹号本科技有限公司成立于2017年，是一家集研发、制造与销售为一体的国家高新技术企业。旗下核心品牌OneXPlayer，是壹号本面向硬核玩家推出的高性能数码游戏设备品牌。自2021年发布全球首款Windows PC游戏掌机以来，OneXPlayer持续深耕这一领域，先后开创了“三合一PC”新品类，并推出ONEXGPU外置显卡扩展坞，为游戏设备深度赋能，持续引领行业发展。
introduction_en:
Shenzhen One Netbook Technology Co., Ltd. was founded in 2017. It is a national high-tech enterprise integrating R&D, manufacturing, and sales.

Its core brand, OneXPlayer, is a high-performance digital gaming device brand launched by One Netbook for hardcore gamers.

Since releasing the world‘s first Windows PC gaming handheld in 2021, OneXPlayer has continued to deepen its presence in this field. It has pioneered the “3-in-1 PC” new product category and launched the ONEXGPU external graphics dock, deeply empowering gaming devices and continuously leading the development of the industry.

name_zh: 东莞市觅之声科技有限公司
name_en: Dongguan Misheng Voice Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 觅声（Misiom）创立于2018年，是东莞市觅之声科技有限公司旗下专注于HiFi专业音频领域的声学品牌。通过将前沿的声学和音频技术应用于觅声产品之中，不断推动产品创新与技术革新，品牌主营产品覆盖游戏头戴式耳机、入耳式耳机、蓝牙耳机、外置声卡及音箱等，觅声坚持“技术至上，用户至上”的研发理念，为用户提供更专业出众、扣人心弦的聆听体验。
introduction_en: Founded in 2018, Misiom（觅声） is a professional Hi-Fi audio brand under Dongguan Misheng Voice Technology Co., Ltd., dedicated to the high-fidelity audio field.Committed to applying cutting-edge acoustics and audio technologies to its products, Misiom（觅声） continuously drives product innovation and technological advancement. Its main product lineup includes gaming over-ear headphones, in-ear monitors, wireless earbuds, external sound cards, and speakers.Adhering to the R&D philosophy of "Technology First, User Centric", Misiom delivers professional, outstanding, and soul-stirring listening experiences for users.

name_zh: 东莞伍联电子科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 双飞燕A4Tech始于1987年，深耕外设领域近40年，是家喻户晓的国民键鼠品牌。坚守“好用、实用、耐用”理念，自研磁轴、光轴等核心技术，产品覆盖全品类外设，兼顾办公与电竞。凭借扎实做工，双飞燕成为几代人的国民外设记忆。旗下潮玩电竞系列“野蛮部落”Savage Impact专为年轻玩家打造，全系拉满硬核性能，精准契合电竞需求，以潮酷外观与全能配置，解锁沉浸式热血体验。#极限操作就用野蛮部落
introduction_en:
Founded in 1987, A4Tech is globally recognized as a leader in the computer peripheral industry. With a robust R&D team and proprietary core technologies, A4Tech continuously develops cutting-edge products, transforming yesterday's fiction into today's reality. Our innovations in computer peripherals drive new ideas and advancements in technology.
A4Tech SHINES by consistently Sustaining innovation and excellence. By Nurturing talent and creativity, we Excel in providing top-tier quality and exceptional user experiences.
Savage Impact is its trendy gaming line built for young players. Every device packs powerful gaming performance to fully meet gamers’ demands. Combining stylish looks and all-round functions, it delivers fully immersive gaming fun.

name_zh: 深圳市优篮子科技有限公司
introduction_zh: Ulanzi成立于2015年，是全球摄影配件知名品牌，专注于提供全场景摄影配件产品及解决方案。凭借敏捷的创新研发模式，Ulanzi致力于构建摄影配件产品生态，已推出超过3400款产品，覆盖了支撑与稳定、灯光与控制、音视频以及箱包等核心领域，并荣获国内外600余项专利认证。目前，公司产品遍及全球190多个国家和地区，服务了全球超过1000万影像创作者，斩获iF、红点、IDEA等多项国际知名设计奖项。
introduction_en: Founded in 2015, Ulanzi specializes in video accessories, including tripods, stabilizers, lights, audio gear, smartphone photography accessories, and bags. We are dedicated to empowering creators, providing the tools to bring your vision to life. So far, we've designed 3400+ products that have won over 600 patents. Our products have been sold to over 10 million users in more than 190 countries and regions all over the world. Among our users, there are vloggers, filmmakers, and professionals who give us high praise. All of these encourage us to keep going on the journey of helping creators to make video content beyond imagination.

name_zh: 泰坦触觉技术（深圳）有限公司
introduction_zh: TITAN Haptics 是一家专注于先进触觉解决方案的提供商。其专利线性磁悬浮马达（LMR）技术基于磁悬浮结构设计，实现宽频、高位移的触觉反馈能力。依托模块化开发工具与全球工程支持体系，TITAN Haptics 帮助消费电子厂商简化高保真触觉的集成流程，加速触觉功能在产品中的落地应用，提升人机交互体验。
introduction_en: TITAN Haptics is a leader in advanced tactile solutions. Its patented Linear Magnetic Ram (LMR) technology utilizes magnetic suspension to deliver wideband, high-displacement feedback. Through modular development tools and global engineering support, TITAN Haptics simplifies the integration of high-fidelity touch to enhance human-machine interaction.

name_zh: 冠捷视听科技（深圳）有限公司
name_en: TPV Audio and Visual Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh:
冠捷科技集团是全球领先的智能显示终端产品研发、制造、销售与服务商。在全球布局方面，公司拥有多个制造基地及创新研发中心，多个销售及服务网点，覆盖中国、欧洲、北美、南美、东南亚等主要市场。
冠捷科技采用“自有品牌+智能制造服务”双轨并行的商业模式，公司旗下拥有多个知名品牌，覆盖不同定位和细分市场：AOC、AGON、PHILIPS等。
introduction_en:
TPV Technology Group is a globally leading provider of R&D, manufacturing, sales, and services for smart display terminal products. In terms of global presence, the company operates multiple manufacturing bases and innovation R&D centers, along with a vast network of sales and service outlets covering key markets including China, Europe, North America, South America, and Southeast Asia.

TPV adopts a dual-track business model combining "own-brand products" and "manufacturing services." The company owns a portfolio of well-known brands across different market segments and positioning, including AOC, AGON, and PHILIPS.

introduction_zh: 梵音帝国（Harmonic Empire）是唐族音频（TangZu Audio）旗下年轻、引领潮流的子品牌。作为一项旨在弥合小众专业HiFi与大众市场之间鸿沟的战略举措，梵音帝国致力于打破传统行业壁垒，将专业级音质与多元化的音频生态带给更广泛的用户群体。
introduction_en: Harmonic Empire is a youthful, trend-forward sub-brand under the TangZu Audio umbrella. Established as a strategic initiative to bridge the gap between niche professional HiFi and the mass market, Harmonic Empire is committed to breaking traditional industry barriers by delivering professional-grade audio quality and a diverse audio ecosystem to a broader audience.

name_zh: 深圳市和沐电子有限公司
introduction_zh: HMLAB 是一家专注于电竞外设生态的创新品牌，致力于打造兼具性能、稳定性与个性化体验的电竞周边产品。品牌围绕电竞 HUB、电竞线材及桌面扩展设备等领域持续创新，以原创设计、高品质制造和玩家共创理念为基础，为电竞玩家提供更专业的设备连接方案。未来，HMLAB 将继续深耕电竞外设以及相关周边领域，与玩家共同探索更自由、更高效的电竞体验。
introduction_en:
HMLAB is an innovative brand focusing on the esports peripheral ecosystem. It strives to develop esports accessories that deliver outstanding performance, reliable stability and personalized user experiences.
The brand keeps innovating in esports hubs, gaming cables and desktop expansion devices. Rooted in original design, premium craftsmanship and player co-creation philosophy, it provides professional device connection solutions for esports enthusiasts.
Going forward, HMLAB will continue to delve into the esports peripheral sector, and work with gamers to explore a more flexible and efficient esports experience.

name_zh: 泰深轨道工程有限公司
introduction_zh: Orbitalworks（轨道工程） 是一家以“朋友”为核心定位的创新外设品牌。我们的理念是每一位用户都不是冷冰冰的消费者，而是可以分享游戏时刻、生活感悟与艺术热忱的伙伴。正是这种人文关怀，驱动着我们不止于追求硬核性能，更致力于打造能与用户理想和文化气息产生共鸣的产品。例如Pathfinder模块化游戏鼠标，便是这一理念的极致体现。
introduction_en: Orbitalworks is an innovative peripherals brand built around the core value of "friendship." Our philosophy is that every user is not just a cold consumer, but a companion with whom we share gaming moments, life insights, and artistic passion. It is this human-centered care that drives us not only to pursue hardcore performance but also to craft products that resonate with our users' aspirations and cultural vibes. The Pathfinder modular gaming mouse, for example, is the ultimate embodiment of this philosophy.

name_zh: 深圳远虑科技有限公司 弗西音频
name_en: Shenzhen Foresight Technology Co., Ltd. Fosi Audio
introduction_zh: 远虑科技创立于2017年，是一家以用户需求为核心，集自主研发、制造和全球销售为一体的科技公司。国家高新技术企业和专精特新“小巨人”企业。FosiAudio(弗西音频)是远虑科技旗下专注于高保真(HiFi)音频产品的品牌。秉持“以无与伦比的价值重新定义HiFi"的品牌使命，致力于通过创新设计、尖端技术和卓越品质，推动HiFi行业的发展，让更多人享受高保真音频的魅力。
introduction_en: Founded in 2017, Foresight Technology is a technology company that places user needs at the core of its operations and integrates independent R&D, manufacturing, and global sales.National High-Tech Enterprises and “Specialized, Refined, Distinctive, and Innovative” (“Little Giant”) Enterprises. FosiAudio is a brand under Foresight Technology that specializes in high-fidelity (Hi-Fi) audio products. Upholding its brand mission to “redefine Hi-Fi with unparalleled value,” FosiAudio is committed to advancing the Hi-Fi industry through innovative design, cutting-edge technology, and exceptional quality, enabling more people to enjoy the charm of high-fidelity audio.

name_zh: 深圳市其力音频应用有限公司
introduction_zh: 深圳市其力音频应用有限公司依托十年来的军工通讯设备研发技术，在专业音频应用领域的丰富经验开发qdc高端音乐耳机，致力于成为世界一流的音频设备品牌。qdc耳机，明星之选，一次倾听，终生难忘，80%以上国内一线音乐人专业舞台耳机占有率，qdc耳机每一款产品均采用定制声学元器件、科学的音腔设计，通过自身团队与专业音乐人士联合调教，为音乐人和hifi发烧友、电竞人群提供真实、还原现场的声音，品质卓越的耳机
introduction_en: Known as the "Choice of Stars", qdc IEMs leave a lasting impressionwith just one listen. We hold over 80% market share in professionalstage IEMs among top domestic musicians. Each gdc product adoptscustomized acoustic components and scientific sound chamberdesign, jointly tuned by our in-house team and professional musicians.It delivers authentic, live-like sound and premium-quality professionalIEMs for musicians, Hi-Fi enthusiasts, and E-sports players

introduction_zh: OBSBOT寻影致力于影像自动化赛道，以实现人类影像自由为使命。通过AI算法、运动控制与光学协同，寻影让专业级拍摄变得更加简单。凭借140余项核心专利，寻影已服务全球150多个国家和地区超过百万创作者，广泛应用于电竞赛事、游戏直播、体育赛事及综艺拍摄等场景。从EWC电竞世俱杯到电竞战队，从头部主播到普通玩家，寻影以AI影像技术降低创作门槛，让人人都能成为自己故事的记录者与表达者。
introduction_en: OBSBOT focuses on Autonomous Imaging, driven by the mission to achieve "Imaging Freedom for All." We believe that at its core, imaging is about the pure freedom to capture and communicate.Today, backed by over 140 patents, our technology and user experience are trusted by creators in more than 150 countries and regions worldwide. Our products are widely used in esports tournaments, game streaming, sports broadcasting, and variety show production. From the Esports World Cup to professional esports teams, from top streamers to everyday gamers, OBSBOT will continue to lead the autonomous imaging industry, empowering everyone to create effortlessly, express themselves freely, and achieve true Imaging Freedom for All.

introduction_zh:
EPZ是一家年轻而充满活力的专业音频品牌。2019年创立于深圳，由多名声学、软硬件工程师组成。
凭借业内领先的3D打印技术实现复杂声学结构与个性化定制色彩，产品因卓越的性能指标，超高的声价比于2024年被中国电子音响协会评为“中国十大HiFi耳机品牌”。
未来EPZ将持续专注于将3D打印树脂新材料广泛应用于音频领域，成为新型材料用于耳机的探索者与实践者。
introduction_en:
EPZ is a young and energetic professional audio brand. Founded in Shenzhen in 2019, the team consists of acoustic, software, and hardware engineers.
Leveraging industry-leading 3D printing technology to achieve complex acoustic structures and customized colors, EPZ products have been recognized for their outstanding performance metrics and exceptional price-to-performance ratio. As a result, EPZ was named one of the "Top 10 HiFi Earphone Brands in China" by the China Electronic Audio Association for two consecutive years (2024–2025).
Looking ahead, EPZ will continue to focus on the widespread application of new 3D-printed resin materials in the audio field, striving to become an explorer and practitioner of using advanced materials for earphones.

introduction_zh: 咪帅（MISHUAI）前身为服务全球顶尖音频品牌的深层供应链，拥有资深研发调试与生产团队，掌握音频产品全链路核心技术。2025年我司将中心转向消费级市场并成立独立品牌咪帅。依托自建声学消音实验室，凭借高精DSP调校与瞬态失真控制技术，打破传统降噪耳机的音质瓶颈，拒绝盲从流量化风味调音。我们的愿景是在消费级价位，实现大动态、高解析的高保真表现，这就是咪帅存在的意义。
introduction_en: Departing from mainstream brands that blindly pursue traffic and superficial trendy tuning, MISHUAI insists on rigorous acoustic technology and authentic sound restoration. Adopting high-precision DSP tuning and transient distortion control technology, it effectively breaks through the inherent sound quality bottlenecks of traditional noise-canceling headphones. The brand adheres to its original aspiration, committed to delivering high-dynamic, high-resolution and genuine high-fidelity audio performance at consumer-friendly prices, which defines the core value and original intention of MISHUAI.

introduction_zh: Blackmagic Design致力于为电影、后期制作和电视广播行业提供高品质视频剪辑产品、数字电影摄影机、调色系统、视频转换器、视频监看产品、矩阵、现场制作切换台、硬盘录机、示波器和实时胶片扫描仪。Blackmagic Design的DeckLink采集卡在后期制作领域掀起了一场性价比革命。其获得Emmy™艾美奖的DaVinci调色产品自1984年以来一直占据着影视行业的主导地位。
introduction_en: Blackmagic Design creates the world’s highest quality video editing products, digital film cameras, color correctors, video converters, video monitoring, routers, live production switchers, disk recorders, waveform monitors and real time film scanners for the feature film, post production and television broadcast industries. Blackmagic Design’s DeckLink capture cards launched a revolution in quality and affordability in post production, while the company’s Emmy™ award winning DaVinci color correction products have dominated the television and film industry since 1984. Blackmagic Design continues ground breaking innovations including 6G-SDI and 12G-SDI products and stereoscopic 3D and Ultra HD workflows.

name_zh: 深圳动感指尖网络科技信息有限公司
name_en: Shenzhen Dynamic Fingertip Network Technology Information Co., Ltd
introduction_zh: 深圳动感指尖网络科技信息有限公司扎根深圳，是一家专注游戏手柄研发、设计、生产与销售的专业电竞外设企业。公司深耕游戏外设细分赛道，主营有线、无线、多平台适配等全系列游戏手柄，产品适配手机、电脑、游戏主机等多终端，覆盖大众娱乐、专业电竞等多元场景。依托成熟研发与供应链优势，公司严控产品品质，优化操控体验，搭建全域销售渠道，致力于为全球玩家打造高性价比、高品质的电竞外设产品。
introduction_en: Based in Shenzhen, Shenzhen Dynamic Fingertip Network Technology Information Co., Ltd. is a professional esports peripheral enterprise focusing on the R&D, design, production and sales of game controllers. Specializing in the game peripheral track, it offers a full range of products including wired, wireless and multi-platform compatible game controllers, which adapt to multiple terminals such as mobile phones, computers and game consoles, suitable for daily entertainment and professional esports scenarios. With mature R&D and supply chain advantages, the company strictly controls product quality and optimizes control experience. It has built comprehensive sales channels and commits to providing cost-effective and high-quality esports peripherals for global gamers.

name_zh: 深圳迈可摩根科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
NYXI 霓汐是一家专注于游戏控制装备研发与创新的品牌，面向全球 Switch、Switch 2、PC、手游及多平台玩家，致力于打造兼具舒适手感、精准操控、丰富功能和独特设计的高品质游戏外设。
从玩家真实需求出发，NYXI 持续探索游戏控制体验的更多可能，将人体工学设计、先进控制技术、多平台兼容能力与个性化美学融合，为全球玩家提供更完整、更自由、更沉浸的游戏体验。
introduction_en:
NYXI is a brand focused on the research and innovation of gaming control equipment, targeting global players of Switch, Switch 2, PC, mobile games, and other platforms. NYXI is committed to creating high-quality gaming peripherals that combine comfortable feel, precise control, rich functionality, and unique design. 
Starting from the real needs of players, NYXI continuously explores the possibilities of gaming control, integrating ergonomic design, advanced control technology, multi-platform compatibility, and personalized aesthetics to provide global players with a more complete, freer, and more immersive gaming experience.

name_zh: 铠侠电子（中国）有限公司
introduction_zh: 铠侠是全球存储器解决方案领导者，致力于开发、生产和销售闪存及固态硬盘(SSD)。深耕固态存储领域的铠侠，依托自研BiCS FLASH™三维堆叠闪存核心技术，打造出能覆盖旗舰性能，先锋体验与主流升级需求的EXCERIA系列SSD全系产品，让高速体验真正进入日常使用场景。
introduction_en: KIOXIA, a world leader in memory solutions, is dedicated to the development, production and sales of flash memory and solid state drives (SSDs). With deep expertise in solid state storage, KIOXIA manufactures the EXCERIA SSD lineup leveraging its proprietary 3D Flash Memory BiCS FLASH™ technology, which covers flagship performance, cutting-edge experiences, and mainstream upgrade needs, bringing high-speed performance into everyday usage scenarios.

introduction_zh: 魔法原子是全球领先的具身智能科技公司，专注于具身智能和通用人形机器人的研发、生产与产业化落地应用。公司具备全栈自研软硬件技术，在运动控制、导航、多模态感知与具身操作等算法领域优势突出，核心人形、四足机器人产品均已实现量产及交付。同时，公司拓展全行业1000家合作伙伴，打造1000个人形机器人落地场景，致力于助力机器人赋能千行百业。
introduction_en: MagicLab is a world-leading embodied AI technology company specializing in the R&D, manufacturing and industrial deployment of embodied intelligence and general humanoid robots. We possess fully self-developed full-stack software and hardware technologies, with prominent algorithm advantages in motion control, navigation, multimodal perception and embodied manipulation. Our core humanoid and quadruped robot products have been mass-produced and delivered to customers. We are also partnering with 1,000 enterprises across all industries to build 1,000 real-world application scenarios for humanoid robots, empowering thousands of sectors with robotic solutions.

introduction_zh: 滴滴旗下即时配送服务平台。

name_zh: 深圳市绿联科技股份有限公司
introduction_zh: 深圳市绿联科技股份有限公司（股票代码：301606）成立于 2012 年，2024 年 7 月 26 日于深交所创业板上市，是全球领先的消费电子科技企业。公司业务覆盖全球 180 多个国家和地区，秉持 “以用户为中心、真诚、敬业” 的价值观，布局充电创意、智能办公、智能影音、智能存储四大品类，覆盖家庭、出行、办公、娱乐等日常场景，构建人、设备与数据的高效连接，为全球用户带来从容掌控的数字生活体验。
introduction_en: UGREEN is a global-leading consumer technology company. Built around four product categories: smart charging and creative products, smart office products, smart audio and visual products, and smart storage products. Since 2012, UGREEN has upheld its core values of being user-centric, sincere, and dedicated. Its business covers over 180 countries and regions. serving more than 300 million users.

introduction_zh: 重力星球是2019年诞生的新消费电子品牌，隶属深圳市拙野创意有限公司，由设计师黄勇创立。团队汇聚工程师、设计师、玩家与创作者，以产品、IP与文化搭建中国原创3C机甲宇宙。秉持“怎么酷怎么玩，将酷进行到底”的理念，立志打造全球硬核原创品牌。旗下MARS、VENUS蓝牙音箱首创异形机器人结构，收获海外媒体高度评价。品牌面向年轻群体持续拓展差异化创意好物，产品涵盖音箱、耳机、3C配件与电竞外设。
introduction_en:
Redefining Gaming & Desktop Technology Through Futuristic Design
Founded in 2018, GravaStar is a global premium gaming and technology brand that combines bold industrial design with high-performance engineering. Inspired by science fiction, mecha aesthetics, and futuristic architecture, we create products that transform ordinary desktop setups into extraordinary experiences.
Unlike conventional gaming brands, GravaStar believes technology should be both powerful and expressive. Every product is designed to stand out—not only for its performance but also as a collectible piece of industrial art.
Today, GravaStar products are sold in over 50 countries through leading retailers, distributors, and online marketplaces, serving gamers, creators, technology enthusiasts, and collectors worldwide.

name_zh: 上海中熠佳艺术传媒咨询有限公司
name_en: Shanghai Zone Yiga Art Media Consulting Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh:
我们不仅提供专业的产品设计全案服务，更是多家知名品牌与潮玩品牌背后的孵化推手，擅长从0-1构建品牌旗舰产品并制定核心市场策略。
基于对成年用户情绪价值的深刻理解，我们内部孵化了专注于EDC解压玩具的新兴潮玩品牌--“KADA EDC”。秉承“KEEP ABSOLUTE. DEAR ADULTS.”的品牌理念，致力于为成年人打造设计精致且触手可及的解压潮玩，让每一次指尖的触碰都成为释放压力的出口。
introduction_en:
We provide comprehensive, professional product design services and serve as the driving force behind numerous renowned brands and designer toy labels. We specialize in building complete product lines from the ground up (from 0 to 1) and formulating core market strategies.
Driven by a deep understanding of the emotional needs of adult users, we internally incubated 'KADA EDC,' an emerging designer toy brand focused on EDC (Every Day Carry) fidget toys. Upholding the brand philosophy of 'KEEP ABSOLUTE. DEAR ADULTS.', we are dedicated to creating exquisitely designed and accessible fidget toys for adults—making every touch of the fingertips an outlet for stress relief.

name_zh: 深圳市唛咕科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 2022年AULUMU成立，专注于高能装备设计。品牌源自古希腊语“αὐτόματος”（象征精准高效）与赛博朋克（Cyberpunk）的机能美学，致力于将绝对的实用主义与独特的视觉风格相融合。不满足于制造孤立的配件，而是为追求高效生活的现代都市人群，打造一个系统化、高机能的装备生态，帮助用户在复杂的数字世界中，获得更有掌控感、更从容自信的生活方式。目前产品已触达全球超40个国家与地区的数百万用户。
introduction_en: Founded in 2022, AULUMU creates high-performance gear for the rhythm of contemporary digital life. Inspired by the ancient Greek word “αὐτόματος” associated with precision and efficiency, the brand was built around one belief: the products people use every day should feel as intentional as the devices they rely on. We do not see accessories as passive add-ons. We design them as part of a connected gear ecosystem—built to improve how people carry, protect, charge, and interact with their devices across work, travel, commuting, entertainment, and everyday movement. The result is gear that feels precise in hand, clear in purpose, and distinct in character.

name_zh: 小芒电子商务有限责任公司
introduction_zh: 小芒电子商务有限责任公司依托芒果TV的内容资源，构建了直播、精选内容和商品相结合的娱乐电商生态体系，专注于将中国文化元素融入青年消费领域。平台通过内容驱动的运营模式，将IP资源转化为商业价值，尤其在毛绒玩具、卡牌及智能潮玩产品上形成系统化运营优势，并与泡泡玛特等品牌建立合作关系
introduction_en: Xiaomang E-commerce Co., Ltd. leverages Mango TV's content resources to build an entertainment e-commerce ecosystem that combines live streaming, curated content, and products, focusing on bringing Chinese cultural elements into the youth consumer market. The platform operates with a content-driven model, turning IP resources into commercial value, especially gaining systematic operational advantages in plush toys, trading cards, and smart trendy toys, while also partnering with brands like Pop Mart.

name_zh: 指间跳动(上海)文化创意有限公司
name_en: Finger Dancing (SH) Cultural and Creative Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 专注EDC玩具设计与潮流IP运营，链接创意、指间灵感与情绪表达，让快乐跃然指上!
introduction_en: Focusing on EDC toy design and trendy IP operations, we bridge creativity, fingertip inspiration, and emotional expression—bringing joy to life, right at your fingertips.

introduction_zh: BPMODS是国内先锋的EDC推牌品牌，是一个由IP、创意、趣味和情感构筑的掌上玩趣宇宙。首个提出「IP 内容 + 可玩性 + 实用性」多元化理念，用可更换贴片、IP联名内容设计的形式，打造年轻人的“第一台掌上情绪EDC”，让每一枚推牌都能承载玩家喜爱的IP与情绪。
introduction_en:
BPMODS is a pioneering domestic Chinese brand specializing in EDC fidget sliders. It has built a pocket-sized fun universe constructed around IPs, creativity, playfulness and emotional resonance.
It was the first brand to put forward the diversified development concept of "IP Content + Playability + Practicality". Through interchangeable decorative patches and IP co-branded designs, it creates young people’s "first pocket emotional EDC gear". Every slider is crafted to carry the IP imagery and personal sentiments cherished by its users.

name_zh: 爱国者电子科技有限公司
introduction_zh: aigo国民好物，33年深耕于电子消费领域，始终秉持“为国民，造好物”的理念，聚焦国民生活多元的场景化需求，致力于引领智能数码硬件创新，以科技赋能美好生活。布局安全存储、数码影音、智能穿戴、电脑整机、电子教育、电脑DIY、数码配件、智慧安防、户外生活等多个业务板块，推出40+产品品类。目前，aigo国民好物在北京、深圳、天津、美国等地设立了研发及生产机构，并在全球范围建立销售及服务体系。
introduction_en:
aigo, a leading consumer electronics brand, has been deeply rooted in the industry for 33 years. Guided by the philosophy of “Creating Better Products for Everyone,” aigo focuses on diverse lifestyle scenarios and consumer needs, driving innovation in smart digital hardware to enhance everyday life through technology.
With a portfolio spanning secure storage, digital imaging, smart wearables, PC systems, DIY solutions, digital accessories, smart security, outdoor lifestyle, and more, aigo offers over 40 product categories. Today, aigo has established R&D and manufacturing facilities in Beijing, Shenzhen, Tianjin, the United States, and other regions, while building a global sales and service network to bring innovative products and experiences to users worldwide.

name_zh: 轻度沸腾（杭州）创意科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 轻度沸腾是一家以内容为驱动的创意科技公司，拥有《环形密码》、《Jason Smith》两大IP，核心品牌符号为原创五行寿字纹，在深度探讨人类未来哲学的同时，深度融合中国元素，持续向全世界输出符合品牌文化的原创高端EDC、首饰、微缩模型、服装、魔术道具，以及动漫、游戏、小说。同时拥有核心技术BPC，包含人生管家系统、智能家居产线和虚拟世界项目，全名《2030超级个体计划》。
introduction_en: Light Boiling is a content-driven creative technology company with two major IPs, "Circular Cipher" and "Jason Smith." Its core brand symbol is the original Five Elements Longevity Character. While deeply exploring the philosophy of human future, it integrates Chinese elements to continuously deliver original high-end EDC, jewelry, miniatures, clothing, magic props, as well as anime, games, and novels that align with its brand culture. It also possesses the core technology BPC, encompassing a life butler system, smart home production lines, and virtual world projects, fully named the "2030 Super Individual Plan.".

introduction_zh: 2026ChinaJoy重磅打造  UltGear Arena极致装备展区（ChinaJoyUGA）。高端品质生活方式与潮流格调装备为核心，聚焦EDC解压玩具、品质随身器物、高端运动装备、极客用品、专业骑行装备等全品类硬核好物，面向追求精致品位、注重情绪价值的消费人群，构建集质感、潮流、体验于一体的沉浸式高端装备空间，让每一位玩家与爱好者，沉浸式感受随身装备带来的实用价值与情绪满足。
introduction_en: ChinaJoy 2026 proudly presents the brand-new UltGear Arena (ChinaJoy UGA). Centered on premium lifestyle and trendy gear, this exhibition covers a full spectrum of hardcore products including EDC stress relief toys, high-end daily carry essentials, luxury sports equipment, geek gadgets and professional cycling gear. Targeting consumers with refined taste and a demand for emotional value, we have built an immersive high-end gear space that combines texture, trend and interactive experience. Every player and enthusiast can fully immerse themselves in the practical functions and spiritual satisfaction brought by premium carry gear.

name_zh: 宇树科技股份有限公司
introduction_zh: 宇树科技是一家世界知名的民用机器人公司，专注于消费级、行业级高性能通用足式/人形机器人及灵巧机械臂的自主研发、生产和销售，曾受邀参加2021牛年央视春晚、2022年冬奥会开幕式、2023 Super Bowl赛前表演、2023年杭州亚运会和亚残运会、2025蛇年央视春晚及2026马年央视春晚等，在机器人核心零部件、运动控制、机器人感知决策、机器人AI等综合领域持续深耕，引领行业。
introduction_en: Unitree Robotics is a world-renowned civilian robotics company focusing on the independent research and development, production, and sales of consumer-level and industry-level high-performance general-purpose quadruped/humanoid robots and dexterous robotic arms. It was invited to participate in the 2021 CCTV Spring Festival Gala (Year of the Ox), the 2022 Winter Olympics Opening Ceremony, the 2023 Super Bowl pre-game performance, the 2023 Hangzhou Asian Games and Asian Para Games, the 2025 CCTV Spring Festival Gala (Year of the Snake), and the 2026 CCTV Spring Festival Gala (Year of the Horse). The company continues to deepen its expertise in core robot components, motion control, robot perception and decision-making, and robot AI, leading the industry.

introduction_zh: 金山办公（688111.SH）是国内领先的办公软件产品和服务提供商，于2019年在上海证券交易所上市，是中国“硬科技”的代表性企业。金山办公为来自全球220多个国家和地区的用户提供办公服务。截至2026年3月，WPS Office全球月度活跃设备数为6.72亿，可在Windows、Linux、macOS、Android、iOS、HarmonyOS等众多主流操作平台上应用。
introduction_en:
Kingsoft Office (688111.SH) is a leading provider of office software products and services in China. Listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2019, it is a representative enterprise of China's "hard technology" sector.

Kingsoft Office provides office services to users in more than 220 countries and regions worldwide. As of March 2026, WPS Office has 672 million monthly active devices globally, and can be used on many mainstream operating platforms including Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS, and HarmonyOS. Its main products include WPS Office, WPS 365, WPS AI, and WPS Lingxi.

introduction_zh: 上海格子互动信息技术有限公司于2021 年成立，深耕 AI 实时人声算法赛道，推出大饼 AI 变声、油条 AI 口音滤镜两款产品。全球范围内拥有千万级用户。今年大饼 AI 发布首款一体化移动端实时变声耳机，依托自研算法实现超低延迟，适配游戏开黑、语音连麦、直播等场景。公司面向海内外个人与企业，提供覆盖 PC、移动端、AI耳机设备的多端全场景实时人声转化解决方案。
introduction_en:
Founded in 2021, Gerzz Interactive specializes in real-time AI voice algorithms, with two flagship products: Dubbing AI Voice Changer and Utell AI Accent Filter, boasting tens of millions of users worldwide.
This year, Dubbing AI launched its first all-in-one mobile real-time voice-changing earbuds. Powered by proprietary algorithms with ultra-low latency, it seamlessly supports gaming sessions, voice chat, live streaming and more.The company delivers cross-device, full-scenario real-time voice conversion solutions for individual and enterprise users globally, covering PCs, mobile devices and AI hardwares.

introduction_zh:
逐际动力 LimX Dynamics 是一家 AI 驱动的人形机器人公司，聚焦打造全尺寸通用人形机器人，并衍生了包括多形态机器人 TRON 等多款创新产品。
我们致力于具身智能的颠覆性创新，释放 AGI 在物理世界的泛化能力，围绕三大核心具身智能技术：
本体硬件的设计制造、基于强化学习的小脑全身运动控制、具身大脑模型的训练策略，打造具身化多智能体操作系统，推动具身智能的技术创新、开发和广泛应用。
introduction_en:
LimX Dynamics is an AI-first robotics company, driving frontier innovation in autonomous general-purpose humanoid robots, and other innovative products, such as the multi-modal robotics platform TRON.
We are committed to disruptive technology in physical AI, with the mission to unlock the generalization of Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) in the real world. We focus on three core technologies: hardware design and manufacturing, the integration of high-level cognition with whole-body control, and the embodied agentic OS.
We aim to advance embodied intelligence across research, commercial, and household services, and accelerate its development and adoption in the real world.

name_zh: 上海脸谱心智智能科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 专注AI 弹幕陪伴领域，深耕二次元、游戏场景，打造轻量化实时弹幕互动工具。聚焦陪伴玩家线上娱乐、二次元内容浏览等场景，以趣味弹幕、实时ai弹幕互动、弹幕角色自定义、情绪陪伴为核心，用 AI 赋能沉浸式体验。
introduction_en: Specializing in AI danmaku companionship, we delve deep into anime and gaming scenarios to develop lightweight real‑time danmaku interaction tools. Focusing on players’ online entertainment and anime content browsing, we center on fun danmaku, real‑time AI danmaku interaction, customizable danmaku characters and emotional companionship, empowering immersive experiences with AI technology.

name_zh: 深圳市思萌倍特科技有限公司
introduction_zh: PP GUN（Pad Power Gun）是一款专为射击游戏打造的枪形体感游戏控制器，打破传统手柄的平面操控局限，为FPS、VR射击类游戏玩家带来沉浸式、拟真化的操控体验，兼顾娱乐性与实用性，适配新手玩家与硬核游戏爱好者。
introduction_en: PP GUN (Pad Power Gun) is a gun-shaped motion-sensing game controller specifically designed for shooting games. It breaks the limitations of traditional controllers' flat operation and brings an immersive and realistic control experience to FPS and VR shooting game players. It combines entertainment with practicality, and is suitable for both novice players and hardcore game enthusiasts.

introduction_zh:
观猹：AI 产品的大众点评。
「猹」源自鲁迅《故乡》，一种住在瓜田，爱偷吃瓜的神秘动物。而观猹就是一个轻松愉快可以一起来“吃瓜”的社区。平台聚焦真实用户视角，以“评分 + 讨论”模式，服务 AI 创业者、超级个体、投资人、技术爱好者及普通用户，提供“探索社区-发现产品—试用体验—打分评价—社区共建”完整路径。
观猹，让好产品和用户，彼此相遇。
introduction_en:
Watcha — the review platform for all AI tools.

Named after "Cha", a legendary melon-field creature from Lu Xun’s Hometown known for poking around for news. Here you can casually catch up on the latest trends and share thoughts.
Powered by real user ratings and discussions, we serve AI creators, independents, investors and tech aficionados. Explore, test, rate and build together.

Where great AI products meet their users.

introduction_zh: 猹与猹是观猹平台旗下的品牌管理平台。依托 OMG 方法论（策划统筹、品牌营销、商业增长），为 AI 产品与创业团队提供从冷启动、品牌投放到商业增长的全链路服务，助力好产品被更多用户看见。同时面向内容创作者，提供系统化的成长支持与流量资源，帮助优质内容获得应有的关注与回报。好产品，值得被更多人看见。
introduction_en:
Cha & Cha is the brand management platform of Watcha.

Built on the OMG methodology—Orchestration, Marketing, and Growth—we provide AI products and startup teams with end-to-end support across market entry, brand building, media activation, and commercial growth, helping exceptional products reach and resonate with a wider audience.

For content creators, we offer structured growth support, distribution resources, and commercial opportunities, enabling high-quality content to earn the visibility, influence, and returns it deserves.

Great products deserve greater visibility.

name_zh: 珀乐互动科技（厦门）有限公司
introduction_zh: 珀乐互动科技是一家“AI+TMT+IP”创新企业。依托自研大模型与工业级AIGC管线，公司打造了涵盖自有原创与国民级授权的顶级IP矩阵，将低成本算力投入转化为高溢价的合规数字资产沉淀，实现了商业价值与利润的跨越式增长。
introduction_en: Pole Interactive Technology is an innovative enterprise centered on “AI + TMT + IP”. Leveraging self-developed large-scale models and industrial-grade AIGC pipelines, the company has built a top-tier IP portfolio covering original in-house content and nationally popular licensed IPs. It converts low-cost computing investment into high-value compliant digital assets, achieving transformative growth in both business value and profitability.

introduction_zh:
TokenDance 是观猹平台旗下的一站式大模型 API 聚合平台。一个 API Key 即可直连对话、生图、视频、语音、多模态及搜索等数十款主流模型。新模型 T+0 同步上线；智能路由按稳定性与价格自动择优，并通过容错降级保障服务稳定。面向 Agent 开发、AI 应用等场景，实现统一调用与计费管理。
官网：https://tokendance.space/
introduction_en: TokenDance is an AI gateway incubated by the Watcha AI ecosystem, providing unified access to all major LLMs in the Chinese market.

name_zh: 上海珞亨智能科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
Robopoet，机器诗人，AI养成系潮玩品牌Robopoet珞博智能，创立于2024年1月，作为AI情感陪伴领域前沿探索者，致力于"让每一个人都能拥有自己梦中的那个AI伙伴"
我们的远景：通过技术和艺术的双重魔法，定义一种新的“人机共生”关系，创造出与人类产生情感羁绊的硅基伙伴
introduction_en:
Robopoet
 
Robopoet, also known as Machine Poet, is an AI nurture‑oriented trendy toy brand under Luobo Intelligence. Founded in January 2024, it stands as a pioneering explorer in the field of AI emotional companionship. We are committed to enabling everyone to own their ideal AI companion of their dreams.
 
Our Vision:
Through the dual magic of technology and art, we redefine a new human‑machine symbiotic relationship, and create silicon‑based companions that build emotional bonds with humans.

name_zh: 深圳市乐唯科技开发有限公司
name_en: Shenzhen LOOVEE Technology Development Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 乐唯集团成立于2011年，2017年通过并购于中国香港主板上市(股票代码HK00915)。集团在智能产品、潮玩文创、娱乐新零售等领域形成完整布局，并积累了深厚的知识产权与研发体系。乐唯AI依托集团十余年的技术、供应链、渠道与IP资源，专注人工智能全链路落地的OEM/ODM品牌。依托集团自研AI能力与供应链渠道、IP资源，为客户提供从模型到量产的一站式Al硬件解决方案。
introduction_en:
Founded in 2011, LOOVEE Group listed on the Hong Kong Main Board in 2017 following a merger and acquisition (Stock Code: HK00915).
The Group has established a comprehensive footprint across sectors such as smart products, trendy toys and cultural-creative goods, and new entertainment retail, while building robust capabilities in intellectual property (IP) and R&D. Leveraging the Group’s extensive resources—spanning over a decade of experience in technology, supply chains, distribution channels, and IP—LOOVEE AI operates as an OEM/ODM brand dedicated to the end-to-end implementation of artificial intelligence solutions. 
It provides clients with one-stop AI hardware solutions that cover the entire process from model development to mass production.

name_zh: 杭州觉济科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 杭州觉济科技有限公司主营品牌FlowEight 福禄无穷，是以国际美学解构东方国学符号的科创时尚品牌。企业融合 AI 技术与传统东方智慧，打造个性化国学生活体验，消解外界不确定性，给予用户内心安定，倡导女性自主独立，做自己人生主角。公司致力于年轻化国学复兴，打造全球化科技国学品牌，主动践行社会责任，将品牌部分收益用于传统文化保护与心理健康公益，以科技传承国学，以善意回馈社会。
introduction_en: Hangzhou Jueji Technology Co., Ltd. owns FlowEight, a fashion-tech brand reconstructing ancient Chinese cultural symbols with international aesthetics. Combining AI and Eastern wisdom, it delivers personalized traditional culture experiences to help people gain inner peace amid uncertainties and empowers women to be masters of their own lives. Committed to revitalizing traditional Chinese culture among youth, the brand aims to build a world-leading tech-driven cultural lifestyle brand. Upholding social responsibility, it donates part of its proceeds to traditional heritage conservation and mental welfare programs, inheriting oriental culture via technology and giving back to society.

name_zh: 影眸科技(上海)有限公司
introduction_zh:
影眸科技（Hyper3D.AI）是全球领先的3D生成大模型公司，已完成数千万美元融资，投资方包括字节跳动等。业内唯一连续多年获 SIGGRAPH 最佳论文及提名，与 Google、
 并列为全球唯三获此殊荣的商业公司。Rodin Gen-2.5为全球首个千万面级3D生成模型，4秒生成百万面，适配 Unity、Unreal 引擎。已服务网易、Unity等客户，覆盖游戏、动漫、潮玩与3D打印。
introduction_en: Deemos Technology (Hyper3D.AI) is a global leader in large-scale 3D generative AI models. It is the only company in the industry to have received SIGGRAPH Best Paper awards and nominations for multiple consecutive years, standing alongside Google and Meta as one of only three commercial companies worldwide to earn this distinction. Rodin Gen-2.5, the world's first ten-million-polygon 3D generation model, produces million-polygon models in just 4 seconds and integrates natively with mainstream engines such as Unity and Unreal. Its clients include NetEase, Unity, and others, spanning gaming, animation, designer toys, and 3D printing.

name_zh: 恒之未来(重庆)创新科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 恒之未来（重庆）创新科技有限公司成立于2022年7月26日，专注于消费级机器人产品的研发与创新。公司源自Xbotpark科创体系，是重庆明月湖基地首批孵化的消费电子企业。依托大湾区完备产业链，并与重庆、中国香港多所高校及研究所深度合作，恒之未来兼具前沿研究能力与商业转化实力。目前，公司正积极拓展全球市场，在北美、欧洲等地已建立深入的用户合作并积累了一定的媒体知名度。
introduction_en: Hengbot Innovation, founded in July 2022, is a consumer-grade robotics R&D company born from the Xbotpark ecosystem and incubated at Chongqing Moon Lake Base. Leveraging the Greater Bay Area’s industrial chain and partnerships with top universities in Chongqing and Hong Kong, it excels in both fundamental research and product commercialization. The company is now expanding globally, with strong user partnerships and media recognition in North America and Europe.

name_zh: 杭州辰景光电科技有限公司
name_en: Hangzhou changing photoelectricity technology co., ltd
introduction_zh: 杭州辰景光电科技有限公司是一家专注于裸眼真三维显示和内容智能生成的科技企业，依托跨学科专家团队和自研光学/算法专利，为广告、零售、展览、教育等行业提供智能三维显示解决方案。公司拥有3000㎡生产车间，与中科院、浙大等机构深度合作，实现从内容生成到终端显示全链路闭环。辰景以技术引领体验升维，从B端行业赋能到C端科技美学，打造沉浸式交互新生态，致力于成为全球领先的裸眼真三维AI视觉技术与场景生态服务商
introduction_en: Hangzhou Chenjing Optoelectronics Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in glasses-free true 3D display and AI-driven content generation. Powered by an interdisciplinary expert team and proprietary optical/algorithm patents, it delivers smart 3D solutions for advertising, retail, exhibitions, and education. With a 3,000㎡ facility and partnerships with the Chinese Academy of Sciences and Zhejiang University, Chenjing enables a full-link closed loop from content creation to terminal display. The company elevates experiences through technology—empowering B-end industries while bringing tech aesthetics to C-end users—to build an immersive interactive ecosystem. Its vision is to become a world-leading provider of glasses-free true 3D AI vision technologies and scenario ecosystem services.

name_zh: 掌阅科技股份有限公司
introduction_zh: 掌阅科技（SH.603533）成立于2008年，2017年沪市上市，是一家“内容+AI”上市公司。公司从数字阅读与版权起家，现已发展为AI内容生态企业，短剧业务位居国内前五。本次携两大战略产品亮相ChinaJoy：泡漫PopoMint——面向内容产业的AI内容平台，覆盖版权、生产、分发与全球发行；CreMoMo——掌阅首款人格化AI潮玩，具备长效记忆与情感模型，让AI成为可陪伴、会成长的桌面伙伴。
introduction_en: Founded in 2008 and listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange in 2017, iReader Technology (SSE: 603533) is a publicly traded company focused on digital content and AI.Originally built on digital reading and copyright operations, iReader has evolved into an AI-powered content ecosystem company. Its short-form drama business ranks among China’s top five.At ChinaJoy, iReader is showcasing two flagship products:PopoMint is a full-stack AI content platform that transforms text-based IP into scripts, storyboards, images, and videos, while supporting global distribution.CreMoMo is iReader’s first personality-driven AI companion collectible with persistent memory and a proprietary emotional model. It remembers users, interacts proactively, and grows over time.

name_zh: 北京光跃极枢智能科技有限公司
name_en: Beijing Guangyue Jishu Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 本公司专注 AI 体育科技，打造「小球圈 」软硬件产品体系，面向网球、羽毛球、乒乓球、匹克球等挥拍运动，提供 AI 视频剪辑、动作分析、训练建议及智能装备服务。让每位运动爱好者都能拥有随身 AI 教练，也帮助教练和俱乐部实现数字化升级。
introduction_en: We focus on AI sports technology and build the Spherely product ecosystem across software and smart hardware. Designed for racket sports such as tennis, badminton, table tennis and pickleball, Spherely provides AI video highlights, motion analysis, training feedback, progress tracking and smart equipment services. We help every player train with an AI coach, while enabling coaches and clubs to upgrade digitally.

name_zh: 弈智交互（上海）文化科技有限责任公司
introduction_zh: Neurobo是一家专注于二次元智能硬件的科技公司，致力于让虚拟角色突破次元壁，自然融入日常陪伴。团队成员来自清华、同济、日本筑波大学等知名高校，深耕人机交互领域，兼具二次元创作与极客文化背景。首款产品“Goobo谷语智能娃包”可为棉花娃娃赋予感知与互动能力，持续记录与生成现实生活中的个性化内容。未来将持续围绕智能配件、DIY共创等形态，打造角色“来到现实”的陪伴终端。
introduction_en:
Neurobo is a tech company specializing in anime-inspired smart hardware, dedicated to bringing virtual characters beyond the screen and seamlessly integrating them into everyday companionship. Our team members hail from renowned institutions such as Tsinghua University, Tongji University, and the University of Tsukuba, with deep expertise in human-computer interaction and companion robotics, grounded in both anime creativity and geek culture.
Our debut product, the GOOBO, enhances dolls with perception and interaction capabilities, capturing and recording moments of daily life. Looking ahead, Neurobo will continue to develop smart accessories and DIY co-creation platforms, building immersive companion terminals where characters truly “come to life.”

introduction_zh: 万有引力（GravityXR）成立于2021年，是国内XR（VR/AR/MR）空间计算芯片研发领军企业，专注于下一代空间计算芯片的研发。通过核心芯片、硬件技术与算法的支撑，公司提供包括芯片平台、硬件解决方案，以及配套软件与技术套件等整套技术服务，服务全球多家XR与机器人行业头部客户。
introduction_en: GravityXR focuses on the design of next-generation spatial computing chips. Supported by core chips, hardware technologies, and algorithms, it provides a complete set of technical services, including chip platforms, hardware solutions, and supporting software and technology kits. It serves many leading customers in the global XR and robotics industries.

name_zh: 杭州哇嘶嗒科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
Tripo Studio，全球首个AI驱动的一站式3D 工作站。其诞生旨在解决3D创作中“创意难以落地为完整成果”的痛点，重新定义了 AI驱动的3D内容创作流程。
深度触入专业3D建模全流栏，极简界面融合专业工具，从灵感进发到成果导出全流程无缝衔接，让创意从模糊构想走问完整、可用、有价值的可交互3D内容。
仅需一张图片，2秒即可获得3D模型，可用于游戏、3D 打印、影视、动画渲染、XR等各个领域。
introduction_en: Tripo Al provides real-time 3D generation infrastructure for games and interactive applications, powered by its model lineup from TripoSR and H3.1 to P1 smart mesh and W1 world models, enabling developers to generate engine-ready assets from text or images, integrate scalable 3D pipelines through APls and plugins, and support player-generated content systems that make interactive worlds programmable at scale.

introduction_zh: 中关村在线（ZOL）自首届ChinaJoy起至今已参与超过20届，同时ZOL还是官方奖项“黑金奖BlackGold Award”指定评选机构。今年ZOL继续提供超大展台，携手HKC，AGON，佳能，长江存储，致态，雷柏，KTC，aigo，泰坦军团，影驰，耕升，海盗船，索泰，澳加狮，飞猫，海康存储，瀚铠，鑫谷昆仑，映众，金邦，MS，磐镭，佰维，迈从，OriginCode共25家品牌打造娱乐胜地。
introduction_en: ZOL (Zhongguancun Online) is the leading shopping guide platform and professional vertical media outlet dedicated to tech products for the new consumer generation. It has maintained in-depth participation in ChinaJoy since the very first edition, covering more than 20 shows to date. ZOL is also the officially designated judging body for ChinaJoy’s exclusive BlackGold Award.This year, ZOL will once again operate a massive 1,000-square-meter exhibition booth. Teaming up with a total of 25 brands — HKC, AGON, Canon, YMTC, ZHITAI, Rapoo, KTC, aigo, TITAN ARMY, GALAX, Gainward, Corsair, ZOTAC, AOLION, Feimao, HIKSEMI, VASTARMOR, Segotep Kunlun, Inno3D, GeIL, MS, Peladn, BIWIN, MCHOSE, OriginCode — ZOL will build a premier hub for tech and entertainment.

introduction_zh:
戟创集团是一家面向年轻用户的电竞生活方式品牌公司。公司围绕电竞玩家的真实需求，持续打造更有设计感、更稳定、更专业、更有电竞氛围的产品。
从产品到内容，从品牌到渠道，我们一直在做一件事：把电竞玩家真正需要的东西做好。我们卖的不只是产品，更是电竞空间、电竞体验和热爱本身。
introduction_en:
ichuang Group is a brand company that focuses on e-sports lifestyle for young users. The company continuously develops products that are more stylish, stable, professional, and conducive to an e-sports atmosphere, all while addressing the genuine needs of e-sports players.
From products to content, from brands to channels, we have been focusing on one thing: delivering what e-sports players truly need. What we sell is more than just products; it’s e-sports spaces, experiences, and the passion itself.

name_zh: 无停（上海）贸易有限公司
introduction_zh: Wooting 是一家成立于 2015 年、源自荷兰的磁轴键盘品牌，专注于高性能输入技术创新。通过模拟信号输入与可调节触发点等核心技术，持续推动键盘在精确性与响应表现上的进化，塑造了独特而鲜明的品牌认知，使其成为全球众多外设爱好者与职业电竞选手的共同选择。
introduction_en: Wooting is a hall effect keyboard brand founded in 2015 in the Netherlands, focused on innovation in high-performance input technology. Through core technologies such as analog input and adjustable actuation, it continuously advances the precision and responsiveness of keyboards, shaping a distinct and recognizable brand identity and becoming a preferred choice among enthusiasts and professional esports players worldwide.

name_zh: 上海六联智能科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 六联智能2007年起源于上海，是全球领先的智能终端ODM/OEM与全栈式AI基础设施服务商。产品涵盖笔记本电脑、平板电脑、Mini PC、一体机、PC周边设备、服务器、loT、工控等智能终端产品。
introduction_en: Founded in 2007 in Shanghai, SIXUNITED is a global leader in ODM/OEM intelligent terminals and full-stack AI infrastructure services. Our product portfolio spans laptops, tablets, Mini PCs, all-in-one computers, PC peripherals, servers, IoT devices, industrial control equipment, and other intelligent terminal products.

introduction_zh: "中国香港铠雷有限公司是一家集自主研发，生产与销售为一体的制造型企业。专业生产各类平面鼠标垫、电竞游戏鼠标垫、无线充鼠标垫、RGB发光鼠标垫、办公护腕垫垫垫等"
introduction_en: HONG KONG CAPERE CO. LIMITED is a manutacturing enterprise ntegrating independent research and development, production and sales. Specializing in theproduction of all kinds of flat mouse pad, electronic sports game mouse pad, wireless mouse pad, RGB light mouse pad, office wrist pad

name_zh: 上海樊为信息科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
LeleDesign 是一家深耕高端客制化键盘与桌面周边的独立设计品牌。品牌以“穿透式美学”与“硬核极客感”为核心标签，致力于通过机械解构艺术，打破传统输入设备的沉闷，将其转化为极具未来感的桌面艺术品。
其产品涵盖键盘套件、键帽、轴体及桌搭周边。LeleDesign 希望为桌面爱好者搭建表达个性与极客精神的载体，让每一次敲击都不只是输入，而是一场手指与未来机械的曼妙对话。欢迎现场体验！
introduction_en:
LeleDesign is an independent design brand deeply rooted in high-end customized keyboards and desktop accessories. With "translucent aesthetics" and a "hardcore geek vibe" at its core, the brand is dedicated to breaking the monotony of traditional input devices through the art of mechanical deconstruction, transforming them into futuristic desktop artwork.

Our product lines cover keyboard kits, keycaps, switches, and desktop setups accessories. LeleDesign aims to build a platform for desktop enthusiasts to express their individuality and geek spirit—making every single keystroke more than just an input, but a graceful dialogue between fingertips and futuristic machinery.

introduction_zh: Sandalwood紫檀数据成立于2015年，是全球化的大数据洞察与研究机构，在全球7大城市设有分支机构。Sandalwood紫檀数据拥有亚洲最大的另类数据库及全球电商数据库，数据覆盖全球100,000+品牌、400+细分行业，并长期为全球Top20基金公司及全球各行业头部企业提供大数据洞察与研究分析服务，已成为全球100+顶尖机构与企业的信赖之选。
introduction_en: Sandalwood was founded in 2015 with headquarter in Hong Kong and offices in 7 major cities across the globe aiming to provide data solutions for institutional investors and corporations to maximize their growth potential with data intelligence, insight reports, one-stop SaaS platform covering 100,000+ brands and 400+ sectors. 100+ world-class institutions rely on Sandalwood to make strategic investment and business decisions.

introduction_zh:
KiiBOOM
每一次灵感与创意的碰撞，都能引发一场BOOM。
用设计定义键盘，让美学诠释你的独特语言。
introduction_en:
Design-forward Keyboards
Premium custom aesthetics.

introduction_zh:
每个人都能成为 Maker，创造独属于你的声音。
无论是创作、工作还是游戏，总有一把键盘与你同频。
introduction_en:
Epoch of Maker
Everyone can be a Maker. Unique, novel, diverse — from creative work to gaming, from office to collection, craft your own Maker experience.

name_zh: 深圳市迈从科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 迈从（MCHOSE）成立于2021年，致力于重新定义新一代用户与数字世界互动的方式，通过推出键盘、鼠标、音频等外设产品，迈从将互联网与每一个人的工作生活更紧密地连接在一起，激发灵感，成就创造。成立至今，迈从的产品畅销海内外30多个国家与地区，深受全球众多科技爱好者、职业电竞选手、游戏玩家、职场白领、高校大学生群体等的信赖与喜爱，是年轻一代的选择。
introduction_en: MCHOSE was founded in 2021 with a mission to redefine the way young individuals interact with the digital world. Through its lineup of peripherals—including keyboards, mice, and audio gear—the brand bridges the digital world and everyday life. MCHOSE brings people closer together, sparking inspiration and turning ideas into reality. Since its inception, MCHOSE's products have sold well in more than 30 countries and regions worldwide. Trusted and loved by tech enthusiasts, esports pro players, gamers, office professionals, and college students globally, MCHOSE has become the go-to choice for the younger generation.

name_zh: 常州爱尔威智能科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 常州爱尔威智能科技有限公司（Airwheel）成立于 2013 年，是全球领先的智能出行科技企业，国家高新技术企业。公司以 “智能让生活更自由” 为理念，专注智能电动行李箱、智能平衡车、服务机器人等产品研发、生产与销售。全球布局三大研发中心，拥有 600 余项国际专利，斩获 18 项国际设计大奖。产品远销 168 个国家和地区，智能骑行行李箱市场占有率全球领先，致力于以科技创新重构人类移动方式。
introduction_en: Changzhou Airwheel Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. (Airwheel), founded in 2013 and headquartered in Changzhou, Jiangsu, China, is a national high-tech and gazelle enterprise. Focused on R&D, production and sales of rideable electric suitcases, self-balancing vehicles and service robots, it operates three global R&D centers. With over 600 global patents and 18 international design awards, its products are sold in 168 countries and regions. A global leader in rideable electric suitcases, Airwheel is dedicated to redefining human mobility through innovation .

name_zh: 深圳市八位堂科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 八位堂（8BitDo）成立于2013年，是一家专注游戏外设的创新型科技公司。秉承“游戏是一种艺术，一种表达，一种连接”的理念，致力于为全球玩家打造高品质、高性能、高便携性的游戏外设。旗下产品先后荣获国际设计卓越奖（IDEA）等多个国际奖项。“更专业、更有趣”，八位堂积极布局电竞领域，将品牌理念与电竞精神深度融合，推动电竞产业发展。首届“八位堂杯”街霸同盟赛总决赛将于2026年12月正式打响！
introduction_en:
Founded in 2013, 8BitDo is a global gaming hardware company dedicated to designing products that bridge classic inspiration with modern functionality.
Recognized for its retro-inspired design language and cross-platform compatibility, 8BitDo has developed a complete range of controllers, keyboards, and accessories that serve players across consoles, PC, and mobile devices.
Through close collaboration with partners such as Microsoft Xbox, Apple, Steam, and Analogue, 8BitDo continues to expand the possibilities of play—delivering hardware that is reliable, versatile, and deeply connected to the culture of gaming.
Guided by a belief in thoughtful design and universal play, 8BitDo strives to build gaming hardware that is timeless, enduring, and made for everyone who loves to play.

name_zh: 惠州冠泰电子有限公司/惠州优力纬尔微控电子有限公司
name_en: Huizhou Greetech Electronics Co., Ltd./Huizhou Unionwell Sensing & Control Electronics Co., Ltd
introduction_zh: 惠州冠泰电子有限公司（惠州优力纬尔微控电子有限公司），是专注微动开关研产销一体化的国家级高新技术、专精特新企业，获评省级工程技术中心，拥有 30 余年行业积淀。公司现有员工 600 余人，自建 5.4 万㎡产业园，生产自动化率达 90%，年产能超 4 亿只。手握 200 余项专利，通过 IATF16949 等多项体系认证，深耕数字化智能制造，可提供一站式 ODM/OEM 定制服务。
introduction_en:
Huizhou Greentech Electronics Co., Ltd. (Huizhou Unionwell Sensing & Control Electronics Co., Ltd.) is a national high-tech and "Specialized, Refined, Differential, Innovative" enterprise specializing in the integrated R&D, production and sales of micro switches.
Accredited as a Provincial Engineering Technology Center, it has over 30 years of industry heritage. With 600+ employees and a 54,000㎡ self-built industrial park, the company achieves 90% production automation with an annual output of over 400 million units.
Holding 200+ patents and certified by multiple management systems including IATF16949, we are committed to digital intelligent manufacturing and provide one-stop ODM/OEM customized services.

name_zh: 深圳市爱克斯瑞科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 艾可斯锐（X-raypad）2003年成立于深圳，专注游戏鼠标垫及外设配件。早期以T8、T9树脂垫获NOA战队推荐，并成为2005年ESWC官方指定产品，深耕海外市场。近年凭AC系列布垫重获玩家青睐，再度获得全球玩家与职业选手的青睐，并通过国内电商平台进入大众视野。
introduction_en: Founded in Shenzhen in 2003, X-raypad specializes in gaming mouse pads and accessories.
