Early success came with T8/T9 resin pads, endorsed by NOA and used as official gear at ESWC 2005. Recently, the AC series cloth pads have regained global popularity for their innovation and cost-performance ratio.

name_zh: 上海艮奇科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
Genki 是一个享誉全球的游戏配件品牌，以创新、玩家社区和大胆创意为核心。自 2018 年通过众筹平台推出以来，Genki 已获得全球超过 150,000 名支持者的认可，将充满创意的产品概念转化为屡获殊荣、并深受玩家、内容创作者和科技爱好者信赖的产品。

从便携式底座、采集设备，到保护壳与独特硬件产品，Genki 始终以智能设计和实用工程为基础，不断突破掌机与主机游戏体验的边界。
introduction_en:
Genki is a globally recognized gaming accessories brand built on innovation, community, and bold ideas. Since launching in 2018 through crowdfunding, Genki has earned the support of over 150,000 backers worldwide, turning creative concepts into award-winning products trusted by gamers, creators, and tech enthusiasts.

From portable docks and capture solutions to protective cases and unique hardware, Genki continues to push the boundaries of handheld and console gaming with smart design and practical engineering.

introduction_zh: TALONGAMES（飓鸦）于2020年创立于日本，是一家专注于电竞与游戏周边配件研发、生产与销售的品牌。“TALON”意为猛禽利爪，象征稳定、精准与掌控力。自创立以来，品牌始终以玩家体验为核心，致力于为玩家提供专业、多样且品质稳定的游戏配件产品。产品涵盖游戏鼠标垫、玻璃垫、鼠标脚贴、防滑贴、游戏冰袖及手柄/掌机配件等电竞周边，并支持个性化定制服务。持续为玩家带来更稳定、更精准的操控体验。
introduction_en:
Established in Tokyo, Japan in 2020, TALONGAMES is an esports and gaming accessories brand specializing in R&D, manufacturing, and sales.

“TALON” refers to the claw of a bird of prey, representing stability, precision, and control. With a player-centered approach, TALONGAMES develops reliable gaming accessories, including mousepads, mouse skates, anti-slip grip tapes, esports arm sleeves, and accessories for controllers and handheld gaming devices.

The brand also provides customization services, delivering stable, precise, and dependable control experiences to players worldwide.

name_zh: 深圳意义之塔科技有限公司
introduction_zh: ATK GEAR是全球领先的游戏外设品牌，拥有键盘、鼠标、耳机与驱动系统，构建了软硬件一体的完整电竞生态。团队深耕游戏行业多年，打造粉丝超八千万的游戏动力，2022年进军外设行业，2023年夺得国产磁轴销冠。自研驱动ATK HUB月活超800万，自研烈风磁轴方案与绝鲨鼠标方案经过职业赛场与消费市场验证，已成行业公认的顶尖方案，相关产品累计出货超千万台，ATK正持续引领电竞外设的专业化与高性能浪潮。
introduction_en: ATK GEAR is a leading global esports peripheral brand, offering keyboards, mice, headsets, and driver software in a fully integrated hardware-software ecosystem. With extensive gaming industry experience, the brand has engaged over 80 million players worldwide. Since entering the peripheral market in 2022, ATK GEAR became the top-selling domestic magnetic switch brand in 2023. The self-developed ATK HUB driver has over 8 million monthly active users, while the proprietary Blazing Wind magnetic switch and ApexShark Max mouse solutions have been validated in both professional esports and consumer markets, earning recognition as industry-leading technologies. Related products have sold over 10 million units. ATK GEAR continues to advance professional, high-performance esports peripherals.

name_zh: 东莞市凯华电子有限公司
name_en: Dongguan City Kaihua Electronics Co., Ltd
introduction_zh: 东莞市凯华电子有限公司多年来专注于自主创新与研发，始终将创新视为核心驱动力。作为中国领先的电子开关制造商，东莞市凯华电子有限公司持续投入大量人力、物力与财力，不断拓展技术边界。其产品线涵盖机械轴体、磁轴、光轴、滚轮模组及微动开关，服务于全球键盘及外设行业品牌。凯华电子致力于精密工程与持续突破，力争成为电子开关领域创新的世界领军者。
introduction_en: Kailh has focused on independent innovation and R&D for years, consistently regarding innovation as its core driving force. As a leading manufacturer of electronic switches based in China, Kailh invests heavily in human, material, and financial resources to broaden technological boundaries. Its product portfolio spans mechanical switches, magnetic switches, optical switches, scroll wheel modules, and micro switches, serving global brands across the keyboard and peripherals industry. With a commitment to precision engineering and continuous breakthroughs, Kailh strives to become a global leader in the innovation of electronic switches.

name_zh: 京恒腾伟(惠州)电子科技有限公司
introduction_zh: RK、kzzi、ilovbe是京恒腾伟旗下的品牌，目前在全球拥有广泛的市场和忠实的追随者群体。我们拥有自主研发的全套自动化生产线，专注于游戏装备外设的研发和生产，配备国内资深电子研发团队，精心多年潜心设计，是一家集研发、生产及销售一体的大型企业。我们的产品在全球大多数市场的品牌销售排名中常年位列前五，作为电子外设领域的领军企业之一，我们将继续致力于提升产品质量和用户体验，满足客户不断变化的需求
introduction_en: RK, kzzi,and lovbee are brands under Jingheng Tengwei. Currently, they have a wide market and a loyal following around the world a complete set of self-developed automated production lines focusing on the research and development and productiorWe have aof gaming equipment peripherals. Equipped with a senior domestic electronic research and development team, we have beermeticulously designing for manyy years We are a large enterprise integrating research and development, production, and salesOur products consistently rank among the top five in brand sales in most global markets As one of the leading enterprises in theelectronic peripheral field, we will continue to be committed to improving product quality and user experience to meet the constantlychanging needs of customers,

name_zh: 东莞市真品科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
东莞市真品科技有限公司于2007年成立，是深耕散热领域、集研产销一体的高新技术企业。
公司拥有专业营销团队，主营 CPU 散热器、风扇、机箱、电竞键鼠等产品，覆盖 PC、服务器、工控、车载、LED 照明等多领域。
旗下自主品牌 VALKYRIE 突破传统配件厂商定位，布局潮流一体化桌搭赛道，融合二次元 IP 打造高颜值个性化产品，为玩家提供沉浸式电竞桌面全套解决方案。
introduction_en:
Dongguan Zhenpin Technology Co., Ltd., established in 2007, is a high-tech enterprise deeply rooted in the thermal management industry, integrating research, development, production, and sales.  
The company boasts a professional marketing team and primarily offers products such as CPU coolers, fans, computer cases, and gaming keyboards and mice, serving diverse fields including PCs, servers, industrial control, automotive electronics, and LED lighting.  
Its flagship brand, VALKYRIE, breaks away from the traditional positioning of component manufacturers by entering the trend-driven all-in-one desktop customization market. By integrating anime-inspired IPs, it creates highly stylish, personalized products that deliver immersive, full-package gaming desk solutions for enthusiasts.

name_zh: 深圳市卓立久科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 卓立久是一家集研发、设计、生产、销售为一体的综合型科技企业，产品线覆盖了多种闪光灯、相机配件、麦克风、手机配件、包袋、照明等影像核心领域。卓立久拥有多项自主知识产权和国内外专利，产品远销全球190多个国家地区，近百万万用户深度体验，数千位多领域知名达人好评推荐。
introduction_en:
Zeniko is a full-scenario creation brand for creators worldwide, offering camera accessories, phone grips, bags, lighting, and microphones—designed to support every step from idea to final piece.

Guided by "Boundless Inspiration", we focus on precision, simplicity, and intuitive design—striking the perfect balance between function and form, so every tool feels like a natural extension of your creativity.

With tens of millions of users already, we believe every shutter click starts a story, and every frame speaks from the heart. We're here to explore light and shadow with you—keeping creation pure and inspiration within reach.

Create freely. Savor the moment.

name_zh: 深圳市中软赢科技术有限公司
introduction_zh: GPD 是深圳市中软赢科技术有限公司旗下的品牌，全称 GamePad Digital，专注于高性能‌掌上游戏机‌、‌迷你笔记本电脑‌及‌迷你主机‌。其产品线涵盖 GPD WIN 系列掌机、Pocket 系列掌上电脑以及 2026 年新发布的 GPD BOX 迷你主机等
introduction_en: GPD, short for GamePad Digital, is a brand owned by Shenzhen GPD Technology Co., Ltd.[1][2] It specializes in high-performance handheld gaming consoles, mini laptops, and mini PCs[3]. Its product lineup encompasses the GPD WIN series of gaming handhelds, the Pocket series of pocket computers, and the GPD BOX mini PC newly released in 2026

name_zh: 深圳市拾景科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
深圳市拾景科技有限公司是一家专业研究裸眼3D显示技术，并集光学设计、研发、生产及销售服务于一体的高科技企业，是全球裸眼3D显示平板行业领先企业。
       公司研发团队汇聚了海外归国精英、985高校才子及行业资深人员，已构建起超30项专利及软件著作权的自主知识产权体系。产品广泛应用于消费电子、医疗教育、数字文旅、高端商显等领域，立志打造全球裸眼3D显示平板行业领先企业。
introduction_en:
Shenzhen Shijing Technology Co., Ltd.,is a global leader in the glasses-free 3D tablet industry.We focus on glasses-free 3D display technology, bringing together optical design, research and development, production, and customer service. Our goal is to create high-quality 3D display tablets that deliver a more natural and immersive viewing experience.
   Our R&D team includes overseas-educated specialists, graduates from leading Chinese universities, and experienced industry professionals. With years of technical development, we have built an independent intellectual property system that includes more than 30 patents and software copyrights.
    Our products are used in consumer electronics, medical education, digital culture and tourism, commercial displays, and many other fields.

name_zh: 芯景铄（上海）科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
芯景铄（上海）科技有限公司EASMT专注于半导体存储领域，致力于为客户提供高性能、高可靠性的半导体存储解决方案。
公司的产品广泛应用于移动智能终端、汽车电子、工业控制、个人计算及各类行业终端设备，满足不同应用场景对数据存储与处理的严苛需求。通过不断技术创新与灵活的市场响应机制，持续为行业数字化进程提供稳定、高效的存储产品，助力产业升级与技术进步。
introduction_en: EA SEMI（SHANGHAI）TECH LIMITED specializes in the semiconductor memory field, dedicated to providing customers with high-performance, high-reliability semiconductor memory solutions.Our company's products are widely used in mobile intelligent terminals, automotive electronics, industrial control, personal computing, and various industry terminal equipment, meeting the stringent demands of different application scenarios for data storage and processing. Through continuous technological innovation and an agile market response mechanism, EASMT consistently delivers stable and efficient storage products to support the digital transformation of industries, contributing to industrial upgrading and technological advancement.

name_zh: 东莞市索艾电子科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 东莞市索艾电子科技有限公司地处珠三角的核心地带东莞市，于2002年正式成立，专注从事计算机周边产品的研发和生产，是行业知名、技术领先的电脑外设供应商。我司从产品研发到生产制造，从多元化销售到完善的售后技术支持，全链条运作，品牌化运营。我司深耕游戏电竞外设产品领域多年，产品已覆盖鼠标、键盘、耳机、音箱、手柄等多个类别，致力于为全球用户提供个性化、高品质、高性价比的外设产品。
introduction_en:
Located in Dongguan, the core hub of the Pearl River Delta, DONGGUANSUOAI ELECTRONICS CO., LTD. was founded in 2002. It specializes in the R&D and production of computer peripheral products, and is a well-known industry supplier of computer peripherals with leading technological strength.
The company operates a full industrial chain and implements brand-oriented operations, covering product R&D and manufacturing, diversified sales, as well as comprehensive after-sales technical support. With years of in-depth dedication to the gaming and esports peripheral sector, our product portfolio includes mice, keyboards, headsets, speakers, game controllers and more. We are committed to providing global users with personalized, high-quality and cost-effective peripheral products.

name_zh: 深圳市纽斐科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 我们是一支致力于极致创新和简约美学的设计团队，专注于打造令人惊艳的前瞻性产品。我们的使命是通过简洁直观的设计，提升每位用户的生活体验。NuPhy 从用户的视角出发，持续探索最新技术与潮流，并将这些创新巧妙融入我们的产品中。与此同时，我们也肩负环保责任，采用可持续材料，尽力减少对环境的影响。NuPhy，与你共创更有趣、更可持续的未来。
introduction_en: We are a design team dedicated to cutting-edge innovation and minimalist aesthetics, focusing on creating stunning and forward-thinking products. Our mission is to enhance the life experience of every user through simple and intuitive design. NuPhy starts from the user's perspective, continuously exploring the latest technologies and trends, and subtly integrating these innovations into our products. At the same time, we are committed to environmental responsibility, using sustainable materials and striving to minimize our environmental impact. NuPhy, creating a more fun and sustainable future with you.

introduction_zh: LAMZU兰族创立于2022年，自诞生之初便深耕电竞职业赛场，始终以玩家真实体验为出发点，坚持自研模具、原创外观与精细化调校，致力于为全球电竞玩家、FPS爱好者与外设发烧友带来兼具性能、手感与审美的高端外设新选择。
introduction_en:
LAMZU was founded in 2022 and has rooted itself deep within the professional esports arena from the very beginning.
Centered on genuine gaming experience,we specialize in self-developed ergonomic molds,original industrial design and precise performance calibration.
We strive to deliver premium gaming gear integrating outstanding performance,exceptional hand feel and refined aesthetics for pro esports athletes,FPS gamers and peripheral enthusiasts across the globe.

name_zh: 上海爷叔电竞信息科技有限公司
name_en: Shanghai Ye Shu Esports Information Technology Co.,  Ltd.
introduction_zh: Uncle Panda熊猫大叔创立于2023年，由一群热爱电竞与热爱游戏的资深玩家联合打造。品牌以潮流时尚、使实用耐用为内核，传递踏实可靠、潮流有趣的品牌气质。我们秉持精工造好物，乐趣伴电竞的理念，专注游戏外设研发生产。从选材、调校到外观设计，每一处细节都反复打磨，兼顾硬核性能与舒适手感。摒弃浮夸噱头，坚持性价比与扎实品质，用心打造适配不同玩家的外设产品。成就玩家超越极限达到极致。
introduction_en:
Founded in 2023, Uncle Panda was created by a group of veteran gamers who are passionate about esports and gaming. Centered on trendiness, practicality and durability, the brand embodies a down-to-earth, reliable, stylish and fun spirit.
Upholding the philosophy of Craft Quality Gear, Enjoy Esports Fun, we focus on the R&D and production of gaming peripherals. Every detail from material selection, performance tuning to appearance design is meticulously refined, delivering robust performance and comfortable hand feel.
We reject flashy gimmicks, and insist on cost-effectiveness and solid quality to craft peripherals for all types of gamers. We strive to help every player break limits and pursue excellence.

name_zh: 深圳市翰德昌电子科技有限公司
name_en: Shenzhen handechang electronic technology co., ltd
introduction_zh: FEKER品牌，是国内专注于电竞客制化机械键盘研发、设计、生产与销售的新锐实力品牌，深耕电竞外设领域多年，精准聚焦游戏玩家、数码发烧友、桌面美学爱好者的核心需求，是兼具硬核性能、原创设计与高性价比的国民电竞外设品牌。
introduction_en: The FEKER brand is a cutting-edge brand focusing on the R&D, design, production and sales of customized mechanical keyboards for e-sports. It has been deeply involved in the field of e-sports peripherals for many years, focusing precisely on the core needs of gamers, digital enthusiasts and desktop aesthetic enthusiasts. It is a national e-sports peripheral brand with hard-core performance, original design and high cost performance.

introduction_zh:
桑帛Sohaku是聚焦个性化桌面外设领域的原创品牌产业，主营高性能鼠标垫，客制化键盘两大核心产品线，同步布局桌面周边配件开发，IP联名定制等多元化业务，面向电竞发烧友，内容创作者，高端办公用户，潮流桌面玩家提供一站式个性化硬件解决方案。
企业组建自有产品研发和工业设计团队，深耕鼠标垫面料，环保底胶，键盘轴体搭配，外壳等核心技术自研，摒弃行业手感分级定制，尺寸规格定制性能，美学设计。
introduction_en: Sohaku is an original bran enterprise focusing on high-end personalized desktop peripheral devices. Its core product lines cover high-performance esports mousepads and custom machanical keyboards. The brand also develops diversifiel businesses including desktop accessory R&D, IP co-brand cusstmization and private bespoke services, delivering one-stop customized hardware solutions for esports enthusiasts, content creators, high-end office users and trendy desktop enthusiats

name_zh: 深圳市金源声电子有限公司
introduction_zh: 深圳市金源声电子有限公司（品牌：JYS）成立于2016年，集研发、生产和销售于一体 ，致力于为全球玩家提供高品质、创新性的产品。产品兼容Nintendo Switch、Sony PlayStation、Microsoft Xbox等主流平台，涵盖游戏手柄、充电座、转换器、方向盘等全品类配件 作为深耕行业多年的创新制造商，我们不仅是配件的生产者，更是游戏乐趣的搬运工。欢迎现场试玩体验！
introduction_en: Shenzhen Jinyuansheng Electronics Co., Ltd. (JYS) – Since 2016, integrating R&D, production & sales. We deliver high-quality, innovative gaming accessories for global players.Compatible with Switch, PlayStation, Xbox: controllers, charging docks, converters, wheels & more.We're not just makers — we bring gaming joy. Come try us on site!

introduction_zh:
DeviceArmoury品牌于2023年在海外成立，2025年末在中国成立子公司
主营外设产品代理和生产，目前主营产品为电脑游戏外设产品，包括鼠标垫（布垫，玻璃垫），键盘等各类产品。
我们站在玩家的角度，希望推出更多能进一步提升游戏操作表现、优化日常使用体验的专业电竞外设。
 Device Armoury全体团队成员，将始终全力以赴，为各位顾客提供值得信赖的高品质产品与服务。
introduction_en:
Founded overseas in 2023, Device Armoury set up its subsidiary in China at the end of 2025.
 Our core businesses cover the agency sales and manufacturing of gaming peripherals. Currently, fabric mouse pads and coated glass mouse pads are our flagship products.
 We put gamers at the heart of everything we do, and are dedicated to developing a wider range of professional esports peripherals that sharpen in-game maneuverability and elevate daily usage experience.
 Every member of the Device Armoury team will go all out to provide all customers with trustworthy, premium-grade products and services.

name_zh: 深圳银宸科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 深圳银宸技有限公司主营电脑外设产品为主的3C类消费电子产品，是集研产销于一体的企业。Akko与众多知名ACGN IP合作， 包括《海贼王》、《龙珠Z》、《 火影忍者》、《Hello Kitty》、《美少女战士：水晶》、《哆啦A梦》和《崩坏3》等推出了相关外设。Akko将继续与受欢迎的动漫、电影、电竞以及重视时尚和生活方式的品牌合作，推出专为计算机外设而设计的独特产品，丰富用户的生活。
introduction_en: Shenzhen Yinchen Technology Co., Ltd. specializes in 3C consumer electronic products, primarily computer peripherals, and operates as an integrated enterprise encompassing research, development, production, and sales. Akko has collaborated with numerous renowned ACGN IPs, including “One Piece”, “Dragon Ball Z”, “Naruto”, “Hello Kitty”, “Sailor Moon Crystal”, “Doraemon”, and “Honkai Impact 3rd”, to launch related peripherals. Akko will continue to partner with popular anime, film, gaming, and brands that value fashion and lifestyle, to create unique products designed specifically for computer peripherals, enriching users' lives.

name_zh: 江西前行者电子科技有限公司
name_en: Jiangxi Qianxingzhe Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 江西前行者电子科技有限公司自2013年成立以来，一直致力于电脑外设领域的深耕与创新。目前，公司主要经营键盘、鼠标、耳机等产品并计划未来重点开发电脑周边、游戏电玩、影音电器、手机配件、车载周边等五大品类。作为全球数码解决方案的提供商，公司秉承"高颜值+实用性"的核心理念，致力于为消费者打造既具美学设计又具备功能价值的科技产品。
introduction_en: Jiangxi Qianxingzhe Electronic Technology Co., Ltd., founded in 2013, has dedicated itself to innovation and technological progress in the computer peripherals industry. The company’s core products include keyboards, mice and headsets, while it is actively expanding its product portfolio to five key sectors: computer peripherals, gaming equipment, audiovisual electronics, mobile phone accessories and automotive electronics. As a global supplier of consumer electronics, the company upholds the brand concept of "premium aesthetics and practical functionality", creating exquisitely designed tech products integrating outstanding performance and attractive looks for consumers worldwide.

introduction_zh: 创造，不止游戏，黑鲨是年轻人喜爱的科技品牌。从诞生到今天，我们一直在创造。从无到有，创造更强大的游戏外设；从好到更好，创造更极致的游戏体验；从今天到未来，创造一个凝聚你我的更大更好的世界。黑鲨始终秉持“用户第一、拥抱变化、正直担当、团结分享”的品牌核心价值观，担负"致力以科技创新提供无可匹敌的游戏外设，与全球玩家共同成长，共创最佳游戏世界”的品牌使命，愿景是成为全球顶尖游戏外设科技公司。
introduction_en:
Black Shark is a tech brand beloved by young people. Since its founding, we have never stopped innovating. Starting from scratch, we craft a more powerful gaming peripherals; constantly pushing boundaries. we deliver an unparalleled gaming experience; and looking ahead to the future, we strive to build a broader, better world that unites every gamer.

BlackShark consistently upholds its core brand values: "Users First, Embrace Change, Integrity & Accountability, Unity & Sharing". Our brand mission is: "Dedicated to delivering unrivaled gaming peripherals through technological innovation, growing alongside gamers worldwide and co-creating the ultimate gaming universe." Our corporate vision is to become the world’s leading technology enterprise specializing in gaming peripherals.

name_zh: 深圳市战歌智控科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 墨将（MOJHON）创建于2020年是深圳市战歌智控科技有限公司旗下的专业游戏外设品牌。墨将主营游戏手柄、耳机、街机游戏控制器，依托20年代代工沉淀，现集设计、研发、制造、销售于一体，销售覆盖亚洲、欧洲、北美洲多国。墨将凭借深度定制和自主研发先后推出迅龙系列、彩虹系列、烈风系列多款热销产品。在未来墨将将持续深耕产品，让每一毫秒的进化，都成为玩家不断探索竞技乐趣的底气—墨将，为极致操控而生。
introduction_en: MOJHON, founded in 2020, is a professional gaming peripheral brand under Shenzhen Warsong Technology Co., Ltd. MOJHON primarily offers game controllers, headsets, and arcade gaming controllers. Backed by over 20 years of OEM experience, the company has integrated design, R&D, manufacturing, and sales, covering multiple countries across Asia, Europe, and North America. Through deep customization and independent R&D, MOJHON has successively launched several bestselling products, including the Xunlong series, Rainbow series, and Liefeng series. Going forward, MOJHON will continue to refine its products, ensuring that every millisecond of evolution empowers players to explore the thrill of competition. — MOJHON，Built for ultimate control.

name_zh: 上海科乐派健康科技有限公司
name_en: Shanghai Geramix Health Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 上海科乐派健康科技有限公司成立于2022年，专注人体工学健康产品的研发、销售与品牌运营。以“让健康姿态融入日常”为使命，服务久坐办公、移动办公及家庭健康场景用户。旗下品牌“捷锐米”聚焦年轻一代，推出智能显示器支架、笔记本散热支架等桌面健康产品，将专业级支撑与日常痛点解决方案相融合，带来敏捷顺滑的舒适体验。用智慧设计，助力奋斗青年重获对身体、空间与生活的掌控感。
introduction_en:
Shanghai Geramix Health Technology Co., Ltd., founded in 2022, is a tech company dedicated to the R&D, sales, and brand operation of ergonomic health products. With the mission of “integrating healthy postures into daily life,” it serves users in sedentary office work, mobile work, and home health scenarios.

Its core brand, Geramix, focuses on young generations, offering innovative ergonomic products such as smart monitor stands, laptop cooling stands, and desktop health accessories. It combines professional-grade support with practical solutions to daily pain points, delivering an agile and smooth comfort experience. Through smart design, Jieruimi helps young strivers regain a sense of control over their body, space, and life.

introduction_zh: 深圳市云联科电子有限公司是一家专注于电竞外设研发、生产、销售于一体的高新技术企业。深耕行业十余载，我们以”技术驱动体验，品质定义口碑"为发展理念，聚焦电竞玩家核心需求与工业生产场景痛点，构建了"电竞外设品牌+OEM/ODM加工"双业务矩阵。从初始的鼠标垫代工，到如今拥有自主研发团队、无尘生产车间及多项专利技术，云联科始终以”贴近市场、快速响应、极致创新"为准则成为电竞外设品类的信赖之选
introduction_en: Shenzhen Yunlianke Electronics Co., Ltd. is a high-tech company that focuses on the research, development, production, and sales of gaming peripherals. Having been deeply involved in the industry for over a decade, we operate under the philosophy of 'technology drives experience, quality defines reputation,' focusing on the core needs of gamers and pain points in industrial production scenarios. We've built a dual business model of 'gaming peripheral brand and OEM/ODM processing.' From initially outsourcing mouse pads to now having our own R&D team, dust-free production workshops, and multiple patents, Yunlianke always follows the principles of 'closely following the market, responding quickly, and innovating to the extreme.'

name_zh: 骅讯电子企业股份有限公司
introduction_zh: 骅讯电子成立于1991年，始终坚持产品与技术创新。公司从专注PC音效芯片的IC设计业者，逐步引进杜比与DTS技术引领高阶音效风潮。近年更跨足手机、游戏周边、VR及IoT语音处理等领域，成功扩张版图。2026年，骅讯电子推出无线电竞芯片与XearONE AI音效软件平台，首度实现跨平台实时音场控制，宣告正式迈入AI电竞音效新纪元。
introduction_en:
Founded in 1991, C-Media Electronics has consistently adhered to product and technological innovation. Evolving from an IC design company focused on PC audio chips, it led the high-end audio trend by introducing Dolby and DTS technologies to the PC platform. In recent years, the company has successfully expanded its business footprint into mobile phones, gaming peripherals, VR, and IoT voice processing.

In 2026, C-Media launched its wireless gaming chip and the XearONE AI Audio Software Platform, achieving cross-platform, real-time sound field control for the first time and officially ushering in a new era of AI gaming audio.

introduction_zh: 我们是专业做电竞线的品牌,为电竞玩家服务.
introduction_en: As a professional brand, we focus on manufacturing esports cables to serve gaming enthusiasts.

name_zh: 惠州市正牌科电有限公司
introduction_zh:
惠州市正牌科电有限公司成立于1998年，注册资金5280万，公司专业设计生产键盘轴体（开关）、数字编码器、电子开关及连接器等产品，广泛用于电脑、汽车、智能机器、鼠标、键盘、数码音响、家用电器、办公设备、测量仪器、工业控制设备等；
公司的合作伙伴包括美国霍尼韦尔Honeywell，戴尔Dell、雷蛇Razer、惠普HP、金士顿Kingston、瑞士罗技Logitech、中国联想Lenovo
introduction_en:
Huizhou Trantek Electronics Co., Ltd. was founded in 1998 with a registered capital of 8.8 million USD (52.8 million RMB). The company specializes in the design and manufacturing of keyboard switches, digital encoders, electronic switches, connectors, and other related products. Our products are widely used in computers, automobiles, smart devices, mice, keyboards, digital audio equipment, home appliances, office equipment, measuring instruments, industrial control equipment, and more.

Our partners include Honeywell (USA), Dell, Razer, HP, Kingston, Logitech (Switzerland), Lenovo (China), Xiaomi, and others.

name_zh: 深圳市零点零一科技有限公司
name_en: Shenzhen Zero Point Zero One Tech Co., Ltd
introduction_zh:
MelGeek蜜氪是深圳市零点零一科技有限公司旗下的桌面生态品牌，自2014年诞生以来，MelGeek蜜氪始终坚持用美学表达热爱，以创新传递极客精神，为全球玩家和创作者打造有趣且专业的外设产品。
如今MelGeek拥有全新中文名，其中的初心始终未变，「蜜，Mel」代表感性美学，诠释品牌对颜值与质感的极致追求，「氪，Geek」代表理性钻研，承载着品牌专业、极致的技术态度。
introduction_en:
MelGeek is a desktop ecosystem brand owned by Shenzhen Zero Zero One Technology Co., Ltd. Founded in 2014, MelGeek has always embodied passion through aesthetic design and delivered the geek spirit via continuous innovation, crafting fun, professional peripheral products for gamers and creators worldwide.
The character “Mi (Mel)” stands for emotional aesthetics, representing the brand’s relentless pursuit of exquisite appearance and premium texture. The character “Ke (Geek)” embodies rational exploration, carrying the brand’s rigorous, pursuit-of-perfection technical ethos.

introduction_zh: IQUNIX品牌成立于2014年，是一个专注于美学与科技的先锋品牌，旨在打造为用户带来审美愉悦，具备长期美学主义的桌面科技产品。当前， 品牌致力于将高品质、高观赏性的客制化键盘、桌面产品带到市场，满足每一位用户对质感与设计的高要求。
introduction_en: Established in 2014, inspired by a deep passion for aesthetics and functionality. Our mission is to deliver high-quality computer peripherals that enhance the digital lifestyle of our users. We see beauty in simplicity and strive for excellence in the details — where design meets innovation. With every product, we aim to inspire, empower, and become a brand our users trust and love in their everyday moments.

introduction_zh:
【ASH WINDER PRODUCTION】
日本顶级电竞娱乐公司 ASH WINDER 旗下的核心赛事内容制作与技术执行团队。我们以“高田马场 Esports ARENA”为基地，专注于电子竞技赛事的直转播、舞台舞美设计、视觉包装及衍生娱乐内容的开发。用最顶尖的幕后技术，连接选手激情，传递电竞震撼。
introduction_en:
【ASH WINDER PRODUCTION】
The core tournament production and broadcast engineering team under ASH WINDER, Japan's premier esports entertainment company. Based at the "Esports ARENA Takadanobaba," we specialize in live esports broadcasting, stage design, motion graphics, and entertainment content creation. Harnessing cutting-edge behind-the-scenes technology, we connect player passion and deliver the ultimate esports thrill.

name_zh: 深圳极创智合科技有限公司
name_en: Shenzhen Jichuang Zhihe Technology Co., Ltd
introduction_zh: LunaFury专注电竞外设领域，产品专注于电竞鼠标品类。品牌秉持技术创新核心，致力为电竞玩家和外设核心玩家提供高性能外设解决方案。
introduction_en: LunaFury focuses on gaming peripherals, specializing in gaming mice. Driven by technological innovation, we deliver high-performance solutions for esports and gaming enthusiasts.

name_zh: 斯凯派游戏（上海）有限公司
introduction_zh: WALLHACK是一家源自丹麦哥本哈根的全球化潮流品牌，深度融合游戏、动漫、亚文化领域。打破品类边界，通过高性能游戏装备、时尚潮流服饰和原创IP，重新定义游戏文化、时尚与互联网美学的融合体验。
introduction_en: Wallhack is a Copenhagen-based brand  operating globally with a deep love for culture, anime, and the gaming underground.

name_zh: 清闲智能创新（深圳）有限公司
introduction_zh:
清闲 LiberNovo，一个致力于将动态人机工学与健康办公舒适体验相融合的品牌。

2025年6月清闲智能推出「全球首款动态人机工学椅」，专注解决久坐办公下的舒适和健康需求。抛弃过去孤立地针对腰部、颈部、背部、坐骨等问题的单点式解决方式，清闲智能打造了全新的动态人机工学系统，为每一位创作者的体态健康与工作环境，提供更加科学健康的系统性久坐解决方案，引领传统人体工学椅行业进入动态人机新时代。
introduction_en:
LiberNovo is a brand dedicated to integrating dynamic human-machine ergonomics with healthy and comfortable office experiences.
In June 2025, LiberNovo  unveiled the world’s first dynamic human-machine ergonomic chair, designed to meet comfort and health demands amid long-hour sedentary work.
Moving beyond conventional fragmented solutions that merely target separate parts including the waist, neck, back and ischium, the brand has developed an all-new dynamic human-machine ergonomic system. It provides a scientific and systematic solution for prolonged sitting, protecting posture health and optimizing working conditions for all creators, steering the traditional ergonomic chair industry into a brand-new dynamic ergonomics era.

name_zh: 苏州亿思贝斯科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 苏州亿思贝斯科技有限公司是由资深电竞行业领军人王伟，联合英雄联盟名人堂解说闫紫境(wAwa)等于2022年在苏州共同成立。2026年5月，智能升降桌龙头乐歌股份完成对苏州亿思贝斯科技有限公司32%股权的收购，正式控股。公司创始人团队拥有丰富的行业资源，公司旗下拥有"Morphling变体精灵"和"YESBASE"两大品牌，涉及电竞桌椅、显示器支架、外设等8大品类。
introduction_en: Suzhou Espace Technology Co. Ltd. is founded by experienced leader of esport industry - Wang Wei and the top caster of League of Legends - Yan Zijing (aka wAwa) in 2022.  In May 2026, Loctek, a leading manufacturer of smart height-adjustable desks, completed the acquisition of a 32% stake in Suzhou Espace Technology Co. Ltd., officially taking a controlling stake in the company. Espace now has two of its brands "Morphling" and "YESBASE" which cover 8 kinds of products, including gaming chairs, gaming standing desks, gaming monitor arms, mouse pads, headsets and mice, gaming keyboards (with magnetic switches).Morphling mainly focuses on gaming chair and desk and we are accompanied by the inspirational slogan "Back Your Dreams."

name_zh: 东莞市达尔优电子音频有限公司
name_en: Dongguan Dareu  Electronics Audio Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh:
达尔优是深耕行业20载的电竞外设领军品牌，产品矩阵覆盖磁轴键盘、机械键盘、电竞鼠标、游戏耳机等多品类，销量长期霸榜各大平台。
从最初成立到如今引领，达尔优不只制造硬件，更致力于探索玩家操作的无限可能；凭借深厚研发底蕴，为全球玩家提供全场景的专业外设解决方案，让胜利触手可及。
introduction_en:
DAREU is a leading gaming peripheral brand with over 20 years of industry expertise. Its product portfolio spans magnetic-switch keyboards, mechanical keyboards, gaming mice, gaming headsets, and other gaming accessories, consistently ranking among the top sellers across major platforms.

From its founding to becoming an industry leader, DAREU has remained committed not only to manufacturing high-performance hardware but also to unlocking the limitless potential of player performance. Backed by strong R&D capabilities and continuous innovation, DAREU delivers professional gaming peripheral solutions for every scenario, empowering gamers worldwide to stay ahead and keep victory within reach.

name_zh: 诗社（深圳）科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
NINJUTSO成立于2020年，品牌自成立以来一直专注于无孔轻量化电竞鼠标技术研发。现已掌握传感器技术、结构和模具研发、软硬件和方案协同等全链条研发实力。2024年2月推出的仅重39克的Sora V2和网页驱动大幅推动行业技术革新，网页驱动现已成为行业标配。

作为轻量化鼠标技术领跑者，未来品牌将坚持第一性原理为研发理念，持续深入全链条技术研发与创新，为用户带来更好用，更耐用的产品。
introduction_en:
Founded in 2020, NINJUTSO has been dedicated to the R&D of solid-shell, ultra-lightweight gaming mice. Today, the brand possesses full-chain R&D capabilities, spanning sensor technology, structural and mold engineering, as well as hardware-software integration. In February 2024, NINJUTSO launched the Sora V2, weighing a mere 39 grams. Alongside its web-based driver, this release catalyzed a major technological shift in the industry, making web drivers the new industry standard.

As a pioneer in lightweight mouse technology, NINJUTSO will continue to embrace First Principles as its core philosophy. By consistently pushing the boundaries of full-chain R&D and innovation, the brand is committed to delivering more reliable, high-performance products to users worldwide.

introduction_zh: Waizowl唯卓，作为游戏文化的深度参与者和创新者，我们持续倾听全球玩家社区的的反馈，精准把握前沿游戏体验需求。凭借高效的研发与供应链整合能力，我们能快速响应市场变化，结合玩家对产品的真实需求与技术创新加速转化为卓越产品。源于对游戏的无限热忱，我们坚信卓越的游戏体验源于顶尖硬件支特，让每一款外设都诞生于玩家的真实需求，实现"玩家共创"的美好愿景。
introduction_en:
At Waizowl, we work alongside gaming communities worldwide, turning genuine player feedback into the driving force behind every product we create.

With rapid development cycles and fully integrated manufacturing, we’re able to bring innovative ideas to life quickly, delivering performance-focused products that evolve as fast as the games they’re built for.

introduction_zh: 松能X（HUMANEX）创立于2022年，是一家以显示器支架、电竞桌椅及桌搭周边三大产品体系为核心的高端电竞外设品牌。作为专业电子游戏空间探索者，松能X以人体工学为基石，构建专业、灵活、可持续进化的游戏环境，打破平台与空间界限。松能X致力于为PC电竞、主机游戏、影音娱乐等多元场景构建专业化、可进化的空间解决方案，为玩家提供兼具高性能与健康支撑的沉浸式体验。
introduction_en: HUMANEX, founded in 2022, is a premium esports peripherals brand built around three product categories: monitor arms, gaming desks & chairs, and desktop accessories. Positioned as a pioneer in professional gaming spaces, HUMANEX utilizes ergonomics as the foundation to create specialized, flexible, and sustainable gaming environments that transcend the boundaries of platform and space. We are dedicated to delivering advanced and future-ready spatial solutions for PC gaming, console gaming, audio-visual entertainment and other diverse scenarios – empowering players with immersive experiences that combine high performance with long-term ergonomic support and well-being.

introduction_zh:
万灵竞记以“万物皆有灵，有灵以为生”为理念，聚焦外观设计、创新技术及新材料应用，专注为电竞爱好者与职业玩家打造高端电竞外设。
万灵竞记作为全球锻碳、微晶复合材料外设应用的开发者和应用者，也是中国镁合金外设开发和应用的首个高端品牌，公司建立并通过 ISO 9001 质量管理体系认证，实现研发、生产、销售全流程规范化管理。拥有各类发明，实用，商标等专利约40余项，被多次评为A级纳税企业及爱心企业。
introduction_en:
WLMouse embraces the philosophy of “All things have spirit, and spirit gives life.” Focusing on innovative design, cutting-edge technology, and advanced materials, the brand is dedicated to creating high-end gaming peripherals for esports enthusiasts and professional players.

As a global pioneer in forged carbon and microcrystalline composite materials, WLMouse is also China’s first high-end brand specializing in magnesium alloy gaming peripherals. The company has passed ISO 9001 quality management system certification, achieving standardized management across R&D, production, and sales. WLMouse holds over 40 patents, including invention patents, utility models, and trademarks, and has been repeatedly recognized as an A-level taxpayer and a socially responsible enterprise.

name_zh: 厦门青凤鸾智能科技有限公司
name_en: Xiamen Phoenix Intelligent Tech Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 玩特（WONDER FITTER）品牌创立于2022年，作为一个创新型AI虚拟运动平台，玩特的使命是推动下一代人在身体和心智的健康发展，穿越时空的约束，打造出以虚拟射箭、虚拟射击，虚拟挥杆为代表的下一代虚拟运动体感硬件外设产品，为全球射击运动爱好者创造出全新、高效的虚拟电子运动体验。
introduction_en: Founded in 2022, WONDER FITTER is an innovative AI virtual fitness platform. Its mission is to foster the physical and mental well-being of the next generation. Breaking free from the limits of time and space, the brand develops next-gen virtual motion-sensing hardware peripherals represented by virtual archery, virtual shooting and virtual swing equipment. It delivers brand-new, high-efficiency virtual e-sports fitness experiences for shooting enthusiasts worldwide.

name_zh: 达利音响制造（宁波）有限公司
introduction_zh: 达尼1983年创立于丹麦，全称为Danish Audiophile Loudspeaker Industries，秉承还原自然原声的理念，凭借30余年的经验和全球顾客的认可，达尼已经在音箱领域占有一席之地，并且提升了目前的行业工艺水平。产品远销七十余国，多次斩获欧洲 EISA 影音大奖。Argon Audio品牌主营高性价比北欧音频设备，坚持丹麦自研，与丹麦达尼同宗同源。
introduction_en:
DALI founded in Denmark in 1983, DALI stands for Danish Audiophile Loudspeaker Industries. Adhering to the philosophy of reproducing natural, authentic sound, DALI has secured a solid foothold in the loudspeaker industry with over 30 years of expertise and worldwide customer recognition, while elevating prevailing industry craftsmanship standards. Its products are sold in more than 70 countries and have won multiple EISA European Audio Awards.
Argon Audio specializes in cost-effective Nordic audio equipment with all R&D conducted in Denmark, sharing the same Danish corporate origin as DALI.

introduction_zh: 艾巴索成立于2006年，专注于便携HiFi领域二十余年，产品涵盖数字音频播放器、解码耳放、耳机等专业音频设备。凭借自主研发能力、领先的音频架构设计及卓越的声音表现，iBasso产品畅销全球多个国家和地区，深受发烧友与专业用户认可。iBasso Jr.是艾巴索旗下年轻化子品牌，延续iBasso追求极致HiFi的基因，更兼具出色的外观设计。致力于迎向新生代的音乐与文化，为新一代用户带来专业级音频体验。
introduction_en: iBasso, founded in 2006, has specialized in portable HiFi for over two decades. Its product line includes digital audio players, DAC headphone amplifiers, headphones, and other pro audio gear. With in-house R&D, advanced audio architecture, and superior sound quality, iBasso products are sold worldwide and well received by audiophiles and professionals. iBasso Jr., the youth-oriented sub-brand, continues the brand's pursuit of ultimate HiFi while featuring distinctive design. It embraces new-generation music and culture, delivering professional-grade audio experiences to the next generation of users.

name_zh: 厦门游射科技有限公司
introduction_zh: AIM游射科技是厦门游射科技有限公司旗下的电竞外设品牌。作为电竞外设领域的创新引领者，以"客制化电竞外设"为核心，构建了集高端外设研发、电竞IP运营、客制化键盘产业化推广三位一体的创意科技品牌矩阵。成功运营多个海外战队品牌落地中国，打爆多款现象级电竞外设产品。我司始终坚持以提升FPS电竞玩家的游戏体验为目标，凭借强大的设计团队以及对电竞玩家群体的深度认知，成功打造一系列深受玩家喜爱的外设产品。
introduction_en:
AIM Youshe Tech is an innovative pioneer in the esports peripherals industry, built on one belief: elite gear shouldn't come off a cold, mass-production lines — it should be a customized extension of a player's tactical instinct.
We've built an ecosystem anchored in three pillars: high-end peripheral R&D, esports IP operation, and industrialized advancement of custom mechanical keyboards — bringing overseas esports brands to China and launching breakout  products along the way.
Founded and driven by gamers who live for the clutch moments and perfect flicks, AIM combines robust supply chain capabilities with real esports community insights to design peripherals loved by players worldwide

name_zh: 深圳奥斯艾科技有限公司
logo: https://appobs.chinajoy.net/user/admin/exhibitionMaterials/1784101237602_vr6vnb_深圳奥斯艾科技有限公司LOGO渐变.jpg
introduction_zh: 深圳奥斯艾科技有限公司是一家科技创新，引领创意设计的产品品牌企业，致力于塑造一个“冷静的效能艺术家”与“可靠的创新伙伴”的双重形象。我们亦是“科技美学的探索者”。品牌风格兼具工业设计的理性与艺术感，追求极简、精致的外观，并通过创新的材质运用，让每一款产品都成为用户桌面上彰显品味的科技艺术品。
introduction_en: SHEN ZHEN ALSEYE TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD is a product brand enterprise that leads in technological innovation and creative design. It is committed to shaping a dual image of a "calm and efficient artist" and a "reliable innovation partner". We are also explorers of technological aesthetics. The brand style combines the rationality and artistic sense of industrial design, pursuing a minimalist and exquisite appearance, and through innovative material application, making each product a technological artwork that showcases taste on the user's desktop.

introduction_zh: 17173为游戏玩家提供导购、资讯、攻略、论坛等全游戏生命周期内的一站式服务，为游戏发行商提供综合营销解决方案，是面向游戏玩家、运营商、发行商的矩阵化、多平台、综合性游戏媒体群。
introduction_en: 17173 provides gamers with one-stop services across the entire game lifecycle—including purchase recommendations, news, strategy guides, and forums—while offering comprehensive marketing solutions to game publishers. It is an integrated, multi-platform, comprehensive gaming media group serving gamers, operators, and publishers.

name_zh: HARRISONWORLD 发行作品 《元素的祈望》
name_en: Published by HARRISONWORLD — Hope of Elements
introduction_zh:
HARRISONWORLD发行作品 《元素的祈望》
《元素的祈望》是一款以元素反应和高风险高收益“搜打撤”为核心的回合制Roguelike游戏。身负神秘力量的银发女巫伊莉丝，与小龙皮皮一同踏上冒险，在随机生成的地图中探索未知，运用元素之力击败强敌，收集各类宝物材料，自由构筑战斗流派，揭开云层之后的真相！
现场Demo试玩  展位N1-CJE41
introduction_en:
Published by HARRISONWORLD — Hope of Elements
Hope of Elements is a turn-based roguelike centered around elemental reactions and high-risk exploration. The witch Elise and the young dragon Pipi embark together on an unknown adventure. Defeat enemies with elemental combos, collect loots, craft unique builds, and uncover the hidden secrets.
Booth: N1-CJE41

introduction_zh: 公司成立于2023年，主要从事2D游戏开发。目前已完成作品《异幻之梦》，正在开发《猎异者》。上线平台steam
introduction_en: The company was established in 2023 and primarily engages in 2D game development. It has completed the game "Dream of the Otherworld" and is currently developing "The Hunter." The games are available on the Steam platform

introduction_zh: 翼熵网络(ENTROWING)成立于2024年，为了制作出有趣且拥有艺术价值的游戏而诞生。拥有完整3D游戏工作流和独立游戏发行能力。游戏项目：《领航员计划》《宇宙魔弹godrop》
introduction_en: ENTROWING Network was founded in 2024 to create fun and artistically valuable games. Complete 3D game production workflow and independent game publishing capabilities. Game “Navigator Project” ，“Godrop”

introduction_zh: SapStaR成立于2023年夏季，由四位来自中国的主机和移动游戏发行资深人士创立。基于GaaS（长线运营）理念，我们致力于为全球中小型开发团队提供全生命周期的发行服务，并协助他们在亚洲市场开展实时运营服务。
introduction_en: SapStaR is established in 2023 summer, founded by four console and mobile publishing vaterans from China. Based on the concept of GaaS (Game as a Service), we are committed to provide full lifecycle publishing services for small to medium-sized development teams worldwide, and assist them with live operation service in the Asian market.

name_zh: 苏州乐志软件科技有限公司
introduction_zh: EasyTech Games 专注于历史军事策略游戏开发与发行，融合历史与策略，为全球玩家提供深度的游戏体验和丰富的历史知识。产品涵盖古罗马、中世纪、拿破仑、一战等，广受赞誉。我们严谨还原历史，注重策略性，并拥有活跃的全球玩家社区。公司致力于健康积极的游戏内容，通过积极互动和反馈来不断改进游戏，提升玩家满意度，营造友好和谐的游戏环境。
introduction_en: EasyTech Games specializes in the development and publishing of historical military strategy games, blending history and strategy to provide global players with deep gaming experiences and rich historical knowledge. Our products cover periods such as Ancient Rome, the Middle Ages, the Napoleonic era, and World War I, all widely acclaimed. We rigorously recreate historical events, emphasize strategic gameplay, and maintain an active global player community. The company is committed to produce healthy and positive game content, continuously improving through active interaction and feedback to enhance player satisfaction and build a friendly and harmonious gaming environment.

name_zh: 上海任深果科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
我们是一家把“快乐”装进代码里的魔法工坊！作为跨次元的造梦师，我们用像素和算法编织跨平台的奇幻世界，让游戏成为治愈心情的笑声动力。我们相信游戏不该只是任务清单，而是随时点亮好心情的魔法按钮。我们希望作品没有“通关”二字，只有“再来一局”的魔力。
公司核心成员来自行业大厂，拥有十余年丰富经验。作为新兴的游戏公司，我们持续创新，逐梦前行。未来，我们将用更多创意和热情，为玩家打造难忘的数字娱乐体验。
introduction_en:
We are a magic workshop that codes happiness into every pixel! As dreamweavers across dimensions, we craft cross-platform fantastical worlds with pixels and algorithms, turning every gaming session into a laughter-powered mood booster. We believe games shouldn’t be a checklist of duties but a magic button that lights up your mood anytime. Our goal? To create experiences where there’s no “game over,” only the urge to play “one more round.”
Our core team brings over a decade of experience from industry giants. As a young game company, we innovate relentlessly. Looking ahead, we’ll keep creating unforgettable digital entertainment to bring joy to players worldwide.

name_zh: 北京猫爪星云科技有限公司
name_en: Beijing Cat's Paw Nebula Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 猫爪星云是一家All in AI的内容提供商，主研项目为UGC游戏平台巴别图书馆。我们将泛同人爱好者群体作为核心用户，不仅为非专业创作者提供一条功能强大且富有乐趣的「从设定到游戏」的创作流程，允许她们以为爱发电的方式将脑海中碎片化的灵感或审美偏好转化为真实可触的虚拟世界；并为更加广大的玩家带来「以任何身份穿越至任何世界，在任何可能的交互形式中，开始任何一段沉浸感十足的历程」的个性化消费体验。
introduction_en:
Cat Paw Nebula is an All-in-AI content provider, with its core project being the UGC game platform Library of Babel. We serve OC and worldbuilding communities as our core audience, providing non-professional creators with a powerful and enjoyable "From Lore to Game" creation pipeline. This enables them to transform fragmented ideas, original settings, and aesthetic inspirations into fully realized, interactive virtual worlds—all driven by their passion for the stories and characters they love.

At the same time, we aim to deliver a deeply personalized gaming experience to players everywhere: the freedom to enter any universe as any character, engage through any form of interaction, and embark on uniquely immersive adventures limited only by imagination.

introduction_zh:
喵吉托工作室是2023年9月创立的AI独立游戏工作室，核心团队成员均曾供职头部大厂，有丰富的人工智能及游戏领域从业经验。
工作室已经拿到了国内一线美元VC的天使投资，目标是利用AI实现全新的游戏体验，共创人与AI共生的游戏世界。
introduction_en:
Meowjito Game is an independent AI game studio founded in September 2023. Its core team members previously worked at top-tier, major tech companies, bringing extensive experience in both the artificial intelligence and gaming industries.
The studio has secured angel investment from a first-tier, US dollar-denominated venture capital firm in China. Its goal is to leverage AI to deliver entirely new gaming experiences and co-create a gaming world where humans and AI coexist.

introduction_zh: 安奇钛科工作室是一家由三人组成的独立游戏团队。我们专注于打造兼具深度与乐趣的原创游戏，希望通过富有创意的设计与扎实的玩法，为更多玩家带来值得反复品味的游戏体验。本次参展作品《爪爪谋略》是一款以猫咪为主题的回合制策略游戏，将轻松可爱的风格与富有思考空间的策略玩法相结合。目前游戏已上线 Steam 愿望单。未来，我们也将继续坚持独立创作，不断打磨作品，为玩家带来更多精彩体验。
introduction_en:
theArkitect Studio is a three-person independent game development team dedicated to creating original games that combine depth, creativity, and fun. Through thoughtful design and engaging gameplay, we aim to deliver experiences that players can enjoy and revisit time and time again.
Our featured title at ChinaJoy is Paw and Plot, a cat-themed turn-based strategy game that blends charming visuals with meaningful tactical gameplay. You can now add the game to your Wishlist on Steam.
As an independent studio, we remain committed to refining our craft, pushing our ideas further, and creating memorable experiences for players around the world.

introduction_zh:
薄荷猫工作室（Nipcat Studio）成立于2020年，由几个热爱游戏的年轻人组建。
我们的核心成员曾参与过多款国内知名动作游戏的研发，大家因为对单机游戏的热爱而聚集于此。
作为一支年轻的团队，我们将会尽全力为玩家打造富有沉浸感与独特氛围的动作体验。
期待在这场异世界幻想的旅途中，与你相遇。
introduction_en:
Nipcat Studio was founded in 2020 by a group of passionate young game developers.
Our core members have contributed to the development of several well-known domestic action titles, brought together by a shared love for standalone (single-player) games.
As a young team, we are dedicated to crafting an immersive action experience with a truly unique atmosphere.
We look forward to meeting you on this journey through a fantasy world.

introduction_zh:
IGA STUDIO致力于发掘并培育下一代创新驱动的、革命性的独立游戏项目。
我们关注游戏的玩法、商业化、社会效用、文化符号等多个维度，旨在为开发者提供全方位的支持，助力他们将创意转化为具有影响力的游戏作品。
打造独特且富有意义的游戏体验，共同塑造游戏的未来！
introduction_en:
IGA STUDIO is dedicated to discovering and nurturing the next generation of innovation-driven, revolutionary indie game projects.
We focus on multiple dimensions—gameplay, commercialization, social impact, and cultural significance—providing comprehensive support to help developers turn their creative visions into influential games.
We craft unique, meaningful gaming experiences. Together, we shape the future of games!

name_zh: 上海巧艺思企业发展有限公司
name_en: Shanghai Joystick Enterprise Development Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 巧思（Joystick）致力于在中国与全球头部游戏IP和品牌进行战略及深层次合作，在发行业务领域专注于复古经典名作的最新呈现，以及主打格斗元素和竞赛元素的游戏。公司协同Dotemu在合作区域发行了《怒之铁拳4》和《野外飞盘2》，于2023年在亚洲区域成功发行《双截龙外传 – 双龙出海》，并于2025年在亚洲区域再度成功发行《NINJA GAIDEN Ragebound（忍者外传：怒之羁绊）》。
introduction_en: Joystick is committed to strategic and in-depth cooperation with top global game IPs and brands in China. In its publishing business, it focuses on the latest presentations of retro classic masterpieces, as well as games featuring fighting and competitive elements. The company, in collaboration with Dotemu, has published Streets of Rage 4 and Windjammers 2 in the cooperative regions. In 2023, it successfully published Double Dragon Gaiden: Rise of the Dragons in the Asian region, and in 2025, it once again successfully published NINJA GAIDEN: Ragebound in the Asian region.

introduction_zh: 我们的游戏玩法创新有特点，美术风格有70年代美式漫画，40年代儿童读物，90年代赛璐璐动画电影，目标是成为中国的任天堂。
introduction_en: Gameplay of our game are unique, art style including 70s western comics, 40s child's book, 90s animation styles. Our goal is becoming Chinese Nintendo.

name_zh: 上海炼境网络科技有限公司
introduction_zh: Hobo Studio/上海炼境网络科技有限公司。从2025年初成立至今，是由来自多家游戏企业的资深策划与美术人才组成，其中不乏来自高校的人才。最初，这只是一个偶然兴起写的小故事，然而正是通过每位成员的齐心协力与独特才能，我们才得以将这个最初存在于幻想中的故事以游戏的形式演绎出来。我们在摸索中不断学习和前进，希望有机会让《無明Avidy》在电子游戏新时代中大放异彩。
introduction_en: We are the team behind the game project Avidy. Hailing from Hobo Studio/Shanghai Lianjing Network Technology Co., Ltd., we consist of seasoned planners and artists recruited from multiple game enterprises, including outstanding talents from universities. What began as a casual short story has evolved into a full-fledged game, brought to life through the concerted efforts and unique talents of every team member. Since our establishment in early 2025, we have been learning and progressing through continuous exploration, aspiring to make Avidy shine brightly in the new era of video games.

introduction_zh: INT游戏工作室，名字源于成员的MBTI——某种自我指认，也是一种略带自嘲的标签。我们2024年成立于上海，出身于游戏大厂，一个做文案，一个做美术。我们想用游戏作为媒介，去触碰一些真正的问题：生活在钢筋水泥丛林里的个体，如何重新找回存在的实感？工作之余我们，除了用来养活自己，还能意味着别的什么吗？我们希望通过游戏叙事，去触碰那些没有标准答案的边界，也正是那些边界，才值得我们不断徘徊。
introduction_en: INT Game Studio — the name comes from its members’ MBTI types: a kind of self-reference, laced with a touch of self-mockery. We were founded in Shanghai in 2024, both coming from major game companies — one in writing, one in art. Today, we want to use games as a medium to touch on some real questions: How do individuals living in this concrete jungle reclaim a genuine sense of existence? Beyond just making a living, could work mean something more to us? Through game storytelling, we hope to reach for those boundaries that have no easy answers — and it is precisely those boundaries that are worth questioning over and over, worth lingering on.

name_zh: HARRISONWORLD发行作品 《夜血W:割喉之狼》
name_en: Published by HARRISONWORLD — Night Blood W : Cutthroat Wolf
introduction_zh:
HARRISONWORLD发行作品 《夜血W:割喉之狼》
《夜血W:割喉之狼》是一款赛博朋克风2D像素动作游戏。在这个充满未来科技与黑暗势力的世界中，你将扮演割喉之狼“洛雷托”，孤身杀入黑帮腹地，彻底清算叛徒“弗雷帮”，在一次次厮杀与算计中，成为都市的“地下统治者”。
现场Demo试玩  展位N1-CJE19
introduction_en:
Published by HARRISONWORLD — Night Blood W : Cutthroat Wolf
Nightblood W: Cutthroat Wolf is a cyberpunk 2D pixel action game. In a world of futuristic tech and dark underworld forces, you become Loreto – the Slaughter Wolf. Alone, you infiltrate the gang's heart to wipe out the traitorous Fre Gang. Through brutal fights and cunning schemes, rise as the city's underground ruler.
Booth: N1-CJE19

introduction_zh: Kunpan Games（昆磐游戏）是一家全球游戏发行公司，专注于精品手游与独立游戏。游戏品质是我们的核心关注点，创造力和创意性是我们的核心追求。我们尊重每一位开发者，希望让坚持做好游戏的团队专心创作，我们负责让游戏抵达玩家。
introduction_en: Kunpan Games is a global game publisher focused on premium mobile games and indie titles. Game quality is our core focus, and creativity and originality are what we strive for. We respect every developer, and our goal is to let teams dedicated to making great games focus on creation, while we take care of bringing those games to players.

introduction_zh:
Mecrew Games位于中国上海，是一家深耕游戏行业多年的资深发行与营销服务商。成立于2017年，早期核心业务聚焦于游戏市场营销，凭借卓越的创意解决方案，曾先后为多款全球3A级大作提供市场助力。
深耕东亚市场9载，我司已与多家国际顶尖游戏开发商、发行商及国内主流平台建立了长期稳定的战略合作关系。2024年，基于深厚的市场积淀，我们正式开启了独立游戏发行业务，致力于发掘并推广全球优质的独立游戏。
introduction_en:
Mecrew Games is a Shanghai-based game publisher with 9 years of deep roots in the East Asian market.
We partner with world-class developers and platforms to deliver end-to-end publishing services across domestic and overseas markets, including marketing, localization, LQA and distribution. Our team combines industry expertise with hands-on experience across multiple AAA and indie titles.

introduction_zh: Astral Clocktower Studios 是屡获殊荣的黑暗奇幻动作角色扮演游戏《月影杀》（Kristala）的开发团队。工作室致力于打造充满沉浸感的奇幻世界，让玩家踏入猫族战士、远古魔法与史诗冒险交织的壮丽旅程。凭借流畅爽快的动作战斗、自由跑酷探索、潜行玩法与丰富的角色成长系统，《月影杀》为动作 RPG 玩家带来了耳目一新的体验。
introduction_en: Creator of the award-winning dark fantasy RPG Kristala, Astral Clocktower Studios is an independent developer bringing players into a richly imagined world of feline warriors, ancient magic, and epic adventure. Combining fluid action combat, parkour traversal, stealth, and RPG progression, Kristala offers a fresh take on the action RPG genre. Following its successful global launch on PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, and Steam, the studio is expanding its presence in Asia with enhanced Chinese localization and exclusive content celebrating Chinese culture.

introduction_zh: 仙谣Fairytale工作室是一支专注于奇幻题材独立游戏开发的双人团队。我们致力于用奇幻风格游戏，创造独特的玩家体验。每一款作品都承载着我们对幻想世界的热爱——从角色、故事到战斗，力求在有限规模中打磨出经得起回味的细节。目前正致力于奇幻风格战棋RPG《阿卡兰幻域迷城》的开发，该作品融合了经典 RPG 地牢探索与回合制策略战斗，期待与更多玩家在冒险中相遇。
introduction_en:
Fairytale Studio is a two-person indie team dedicated to fantasy game development. We strive to create unique player experiences through fantasy-style games. Every title we make reflects our passion for imagined worlds — from characters and storytelling to combat, we aim to polish every detail to the fullest within our means.

We are currently working on *Aldradah: Tome of Mist Realm*, a fantasy tactical RPG that blends classic dungeon exploration with turn-based strategic combat. We look forward to meeting more adventurers on this journey.

We believe great stories and gameplay don't require a hundred-person team — small, refined creations can deliver unforgettable adventures too.

introduction_zh: Gamirror Games是一家独立游戏发行商，由来自中国，美国，瑞典，墨西哥和日本等国的成员组成，这些成员来自不同的背景，如游戏设计师、游戏开发人员、3A级游戏发行商等。但最重要的是， 我们都是游戏玩家。
introduction_en: Gamirror Games is an indie game publisher conformed by a diverse team of members from many places like China, America, Sweden, Mexico and Japan and they come from many backgrounds like game designers, game developers, AAA game publishers among other areas. But most of all we are all gamers.

name_zh: HARRISONWORLD 发行作品《骰途酒馆》&《复兴吧温泉镇！》
name_en: Published by HARRISONWORLD —  Dice Tavern: Farkle Roguelike & Revive! Onsen Town!
introduction_zh:
HARRISONWORLD 发行作品《骰途酒馆》&《复兴吧温泉镇！》
《骰途酒馆》是一款Farkle Roguelike骰子构筑游戏。由你来亲手改造概率、叠加收益，挑战越来越夸张的分数纪录。面对稳妥与暴富的抉择，你会见好就收，还是再骰一次？
《复兴吧！温泉镇》是一款以日系乡村为舞台的模拟经营游戏。玩家将以少女与年轻镇长双视角，体验捕虫、钓鱼、打工与小镇建设。
展位：N1-CJE31-32
introduction_en:
Published by HARRISONWORLD —  Dice Tavern: Farkle Roguelike & Revive! Onsen Town!

Dice Tavern: Farkle Roguelike is a Farkle Roguelike dice-building game where you can bend the odds, stack rewards, and push your score to absurd heights. When fortune beckons, will you play it safe—or take one more roll for glory?
Revive! Onsen Town! is a cozy life and town-building simulation set in a charming Japanese countryside. Play from the perspectives of a young girl and a young mayor as you enjoy bug catching, fishing, part-time jobs, and the revival of a beloved hot spring town.

Both titles will feature playable demos on-site. We look forward to seeing you there!
Booth: N1-CJE31-32

name_zh: 北京星空智盛科技发展有限公司
name_en: Beijing ThinkingStars Technology And Development Co., Ltd
introduction_zh: 北京星空智盛科技发展有限公司（ThinkingStars）是一家专注于原创游戏研发的中国公司，致力于为全球玩家打造兼具创新玩法、优秀叙事与独特艺术风格的高品质作品。公司代表作《纪元变异（ANNO: Mutationem）》已登陆 PlayStation、Xbox、Nintendo Switch 及 PC 等全球主流游戏平台，获得国际媒体与玩家的广泛认可，并继续开发面向全球的主机游戏产品
introduction_en: Beijing ThinkingStars Technology Development Co., Ltd. is an independent game development studio based in Beijing, China, focused on creating original IPs for global players. The company is best known for ANNO: Mutationem, a cyberpunk action-adventure RPG released on PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, and PC. Recognized for its distinctive blend of 2D pixel art and 3D environments, the title has earned praise from players and media worldwide. Building on this success, ThinkingStars continues to develop new original projects, combining immersive storytelling, unique artistic direction, and engaging gameplay experiences while expanding its presence through global platform and publishing partnerships.

introduction_zh: 热脉游戏一家专注于精品游戏发行的年轻厂牌，成立于2020年，团队成员是来自各大游戏厂商的行业精英。我们为世界各地的独立游戏开发者提供发行解决方案，协助开发者专注于研发优质游戏。为每一款独立游戏提供定制的、有创意的策略与内容。短短几年时间，我们已成功发行了多款不同类型的精品游戏，从全平台口碑佳作《迷雾侦探》、到创新先锋《孤星猎人》、再到国风家族经营《吾今有世家》，每一款游戏皆倾注热情！
introduction_en: We are Thermite Games, a Beijing-based publisher comprised of industry veterans. Founded in 2020, Thermite Games specializes in bringing indie games and premium content to players across the globe. We provide customized publishing solutions and unique strategies for indie devs throughout the world, helping them focus on developing high-quality games. Innovation and creativity runs through our blood! We are proud to be the publisher behind a diverse lineup of acclaimed titles across multiple genres — from the sandbox management House of Legacy, to the atmospheric puzzle adventure Tales of the Neon Sea, the strategy deckbuilder LONESTAR. We pour passion into every game we publish, and look forward to working with like-minded partners to create fun games and achieve success together!

introduction_zh:
我们是 Gnirut Games（Gnirut 游戏），一家专注游戏研发的独立工作室，致力于打造兼具深度与温度的互动体验咕。我们相信游戏不只是娱乐，更是一种能传递情感、激发思考、连接人心的艺术形式咕嘎。
我们相信游戏不只是娱乐，更是一种能传递情感、激发思考、连接人心的艺术形式咕嘎，而连接的另一头，正是玩家老爷您。您的每一个心跳和精彩的瞬间，都是我们想守护的东西咕。
咕，我们会一直嘎嘎向前的咕！
introduction_en: Gnirut Games is an independent studio dedicated to the craft of game development, committed to creating interactive experiences defined by both depth and warmth. We believe that games are more than entertainment — they are an art form capable of conveying emotion, inspiring thought, and bringing people together. At the heart of everything we create is you, the player. Every moment of wonder, every spark of delight, and every experience you find difficult to leave behind is something we strive wholeheartedly to honor. The name "Gnirut" is "Turing" reversed — a reflection of our commitment to questioning convention, challenging boundaries, and continually expanding what games, as a medium, can be — always with our players at the center.

name_zh: Dear Villagers / Owlcat Games / Top Hat Studios / Bohemia Interactive
name_en: Dear Villagers / Owlcat Games / Top Hat Studios / Bohemia Interactive
introduction_zh:
Dear Villagers是一家法国发行商，致力于通过令人难忘的游戏讲述令人难忘的故事；
Owlcat Games是一家游戏开发工作室，致力于打造叙事丰富、注重玩家选择的角色扮演游戏；
Top Hat Studios是一家亚洲风格复古游戏发行商，以SILLY POLLY BEAST最为知名；
Bohemia Interactive手握Arma、DayZ等多条产品线，以及自研的Enfusion引擎
introduction_en:
Dear Villagers is a boutique publishing label based in the South of France. Their mission: to tell memorable stories through memorable games.
Owlcat Games is an international game development studio dedicated to creating rich narrative RPG experiences where player choice matters. 
Top Hat Studios is a publisher and curator of Asian-inspired and retro games globally, best known for MOTORSLICE and SILLY POLLY BEAST.
Bohemia Interactive spans Arma, DayZ, Ylands, Vigor, and their proprietary Enfusion engine. Their bet? Games aren't just products — they're platforms for people to explore, create, and connect.

name_zh: 杭州半自觉游戏科技有限公司（船游戏工作室）
name_en: Hangzhou Semi Consciousness Game Technology Co.,Ltd（Chuán Game Studio）
introduction_zh: 我们目前是一个位于杭州的三人全职的游戏制作工作室 ，很早之前内心就蠢蠢欲动想讲一个故事 ，用游戏讲一个关于人性的光亮与罪恶的故事 ，作为游戏从业者 ，也同样作为一个游戏爱好者 ，始终认为这种最棒的艺术载体可以更好的肩负表达故事的责任 ，下笔开始撰写剧本同时呼朋引伴 ，经过一段时间的筹备 ，我和其他两位伙伴们一起成立了公司 ，开始踏上了制作之路。
introduction_en: We are currently a three-person, full-time game development studio based in Hangzhou. For years, we've nurtured a compelling desire to tell a story – a narrative exploring humanity's light and darkness through the medium of games. As both game developers and passionate gamers, we firmly believe this exceptional artistic form holds unparalleled power for storytelling. Putting pen to paper, I began crafting the script while gathering like-minded collaborators. After months of preparation, I co-founded this company with two partners, embarking on our journey to bring this vision to life.

introduction_zh:
HARRISONWORLD发行作品 《黑夜轮回》
《黑夜轮回》是一款融合战棋与 Roguelike 卡牌构筑的策略游戏。自由搭配三人阵容，利用站位、元素暴击与卡组联动创造无限可能，在一次次轮回中突破极限，终结永夜诅咒。
现场Demo试玩 2026.8.12正式上线  展位N1-CJE43
introduction_en:
Published by HARRISONWORLD — Re：Night
Re:Night is a strategy game that blends tactical grid-based combat with Roguelike deckbuilding. Assemble a team of three heroes, leverage positioning, elemental critical hits, and powerful card synergies to create endless strategic possibilities. Push beyond your limits through each cycle and break the curse of the eternal night.
 Official Release Date: August 12, 2026
Booth: N1-CJE43

introduction_zh: 集英社游戏是一家横跨出版和游戏两个行业而诞生的新公司，旨在为全球玩家创造全新的游戏体验。
introduction_en: Shueisha Games is the game publishing label of Shueisha Inc., one of Japan’s leading media companies and the publisher of Weekly Shonen Jump. Shueisha Games publishes and co-develops original titles in partnership with independent studios around the world.

introduction_zh: AI原生游戏工作室。我们从机器的低语中编织故事。作品《千夜之书1001》获腾讯创作大赛，IndiePlay提名。
introduction_en: An AI-native game studio weaving stories from the whispers of machines. Our game, Book of Infinity: 1001 Nights, won an award at the Tencent Game Creation Competition and was nominated for IndiePlay.

introduction_zh: 阿狗社Astrolabe Games是诞生自中国上海的全球全平台电子游戏发行商，曾发行过《暗影火炬城》、《苍翼：混沌效应X》等游戏，发行游戏作品横跨全平台，签约创作者和游戏产品来自世界各地。
introduction_en: Astrolabe Games is a global video game publisher that proudly strives to "align the stars" for talented developers worldwide, assisting them in realizing their creative visions and delivering fun, unique, and diverse gaming experiences across all platforms.

name_zh: 北京瑕趣科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
Imperfect Games是一家专注于帮游戏开发者打开中国PC游戏市场的公司。我们在2025年5月成立，我们依托深厚的行业积累和优质资源，为Steam游戏开发者提供在中国市场的发行与营销运营支持。
核心成员均来自中国最大游戏平台资深团队。
拥有业内顶尖口碑、广泛人脉及独到信息网络。
善用数据驱动策略，提供专业直观的定制化解决方案。
深度聆听一线玩家声音，为游戏优化提供全方位建议。
introduction_en:
Imperfect Games is a company dedicated to helping game developers expand their presence in China's PC gaming market. Founded in May 2025, we leverage our extensive industry expertise and premium resources to assist Steam game developers with their domestic distribution and marketing operations in China.
Our core team consists of veterans from China's largest gaming platform.
We possess exceptional industry reputation, extensive networks, and unparalleled market intelligence.
Leveraging data-driven strategies, we deliver professional, intuitive, and effective customized solutions.
We actively engage with grassroots player communities, offering comprehensive game optimization recommendations informed by frontline player insights.

introduction_zh: 《铁巢重炮》是一款残酷的柴油朋克重型火炮游戏，你将驾驶一台巨型战争机器，统治整个战场。 依照接收到的座标进行地图测距，将液压系统推到极限，校准火炮并发起毁灭性的打击 ⟹ 操作员，你会服从最高统帅部的命令吗？
introduction_en: IRON NEST is a brutal dieselpunk heavy-artillery game where you dominate the battlefield through a colossal war machine. Take map measurements based on the received coordinates, strain the hydraulics, and gunlay the cannons to unleash devastating blows.

name_zh: 广州白日梦境网络技术有限公司
introduction_zh: 白日梦境工作室成立于 2024 年，由一群热爱游戏、拥有成熟项目经验的开发者组成。团队成员曾参与多个业内知名商业项目，也经历过头部厂商的研发与发行环境。在长期行业实践后，团队重新回到创作初心，希望打造真正能够承载情感表达与个人记忆的作品。
introduction_en:
Founded in 2024, Daydream Studio is made up of a group of developers who share a deep passion for games and bring with them extensive experience in delivering established projects.
 Its team members have contributed to a number of well-known commercial titles and have worked within the development and publishing environments of leading game companies.
After years of working across the industry, the team chose to return to the original intention of creation — to make games that can truly carry emotional expression and personal memories.

introduction_zh:
曾席卷中国跑跑卡丁车赛场的“oRASENo”，时隔20年作为独立游戏制作人回归。
RasEn Inc. 是一家由海外大厂资深专家创立的个人独立工作室。曾让无数中国核心玩家为之疯狂的他，如今纯粹从玩家视角出发，独自倾注全部心血，竭力打造世上独一无二的独创性游戏体验。凭借纯粹的投入与匠人精神，他将为硬核玩家们带来极具诚意与冲击力的品质之作。
introduction_en:
'oRASENo', who once dominated the Chinese Crazyracing Kartrider pro scene, returns after 20 years as an independent game developer.
RasEn Inc. is a solo indie studio founded by a veteran developer who honed top-tier core technical expertise at major overseas gaming corporations. Having once captivated countless hardcore Chinese players under the alias 'oRASENo', he is now pouring all his efforts and expertise into crafting a truly one-of-a-kind, original gaming experience entirely from a player's perspective. Guided by pure dedication and a craftsman's spirit, this authentic solo developer is set to deliver a high-quality build that will deeply resonate with and impact hardcore gamers.

name_zh: 上海任深果科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
我们是一家把“快乐”装进代码里的魔法工坊！作为跨次元的造梦师，我们用像素和算法编织跨平台的奇幻世界，让游戏成为治愈心情的笑声动力。我们相信游戏不该只是任务清单，而是随时点亮好心情的魔法按钮。我们希望作品没有“通关”二字，只有“再来一局”的魔力。
公司核心成员来自行业大厂，拥有十余年丰富经验。作为新兴的游戏公司，我们持续创新，逐梦前行。未来，我们将用更多创意和热情，为玩家打造难忘的数字娱乐体验。
introduction_en:
We are a magic workshop that codes happiness into every pixel! As dreamweavers across dimensions, we craft cross-platform fantastical worlds with pixels and algorithms, turning every gaming session into a laughter-powered mood booster. We believe games shouldn’t be a checklist of duties but a magic button that lights up your mood anytime. Our goal? To create experiences where there’s no “game over,” only the urge to play “one more round.”
Our core team brings over a decade of experience from industry giants. As a young game company, we innovate relentlessly. Looking ahead, we’ll keep creating unforgettable digital entertainment to bring joy to players worldwide.

introduction_zh: 无定律工作室是由一群有着丰富开发经验的游戏爱好者们组成的独立工作室。专注于将“美术”，“设计”与“程序”三大游戏基本内容打造成工作室的三大核心。制作者们也是游戏玩家，我们清楚玩家对游戏团队的诉求。所以我们希望在任何方面不辜负玩家们的期待。
introduction_en: Uncertain Studio is an independent game studio founded by a group of passionate developers with extensive experience in game development. We are currently focused on building our three core strengths around the fundamentals of game creation: art, design, and programming. As creators, we are also players. We understand what players expect from a game development team, and we hope to meet those expectations in every aspect of our work.

introduction_zh: 集英社游戏是一家横跨出版和游戏两个行业而诞生的新公司，旨在为全球玩家创造全新的游戏体验。
introduction_en: Shueisha Games is the game publishing label of Shueisha Inc., one of Japan’s leading media companies and the publisher of Weekly Shonen Jump. Shueisha Games publishes and co-develops original titles in partnership with independent studios around the world.

name_zh: 杭州松鼠系猪网络科技有限公司
name_en: Hangzhou SongShuXiZhu Network Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 上四休三，牛马之家
introduction_en: Work 4 days, rest 3 days – Home of the Workhorses.

name_zh: 上海泼泼猫文化传媒有限公司
name_en: Shanghai Popocat Culture Media Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 上海泼泼猫文化传媒（泼泼猫工作室）是一家深耕原创叙事游戏与角色IP孵化的独立开发商。主打产品《履云录》是一款融合战术战斗与视觉小说叙事的3D战棋RPG，现已登陆Steam抢先体验。我们正持续深化内容更新、多语言本地化及跨平台移植，并拓展番外漫画等泛娱乐生态，致力于打造具有全球影响力的长线IP。
introduction_en: Popocat Studio is a Shanghai-based indie studio focused on original narrative games and character IP. Our flagship project, Elysium Above, is a story-rich 3D SRPG/TRPG combining tactical battles, visual-novel-style storytelling, and anthropomorphic characters. It is available on Steam Early Access with Chinese and English support. We have delivered regular updates, expanded localization, and developed side comics and community content, creating a foundation for global publishing, platform expansion, and long-term IP growth.

name_zh: 武汉奇力造物网络科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 武汉奇力造物网络科技有限责任公司是一家成立于2024年的游戏研发公司。首个项目《酷鼠宝快跑》集角色抽卡养成，团队战斗，融合搜打撤为一体，混合了多种玩法。以及还有《鼠宝冲冲冲》，《鼠宝消消怪》，《鼠宝找找乐》等多款”酷鼠宝“系列小游戏。我们希望打造 “酷鼠宝” IP，其中包括“酷鼠宝”IP游戏，“酷鼠宝”IP潮玩，及其短片动画等衍生内容，把可爱的酷鼠宝推向世界。
introduction_en: Wuhan Qili Creation Network Studio is a game development company established in 2024. Its first project, Coobao Run, combines character gacha and cultivation, team-based combat, and an integrated "search, collect, and extract" mechanic into a hybrid gameplay experience. In addition, the company has also developed a series of "Coobao" mini-games, including Coobao Go, Coobao Obliterate, and Coobao Find. Our vision is to build the "Coobao" IP ecosystem, which will encompass Coobao IP games, Coobao IP trendy toys, animated shorts, and other derivative content, bringing the adorable Coobao to the world.

introduction_zh: ManaWanderer 是一个由 8 名成员组成的小型独立游戏团队，在业余时间搭伴创作。本次端上了两款作品，第一款是穿着恐龙睡衣到处闯祸的双人欢乐游戏；另一款是发生在火星上的满是黑色幽默的刁民模拟器游戏DEMO。我们的理念是（没有蛀牙）创作出能让朋友之间一起欢笑、吐槽、创造回忆的瞬间，希望我们的作品能带来这样的效果~
introduction_en: ManaWanderer is a small indie game team of 8 members who create games together in their spare time. They've released two titles: the first is a hilarious two-player game where players wear dinosaur pajamas and cause chaos; the other is a darkly humorous demo of a troublemaker simulator set on Mars. Our philosophy is (without cavities) to create moments that allow friends to laugh, joke, and create memories together—we hope our work achieves that!

introduction_zh: "做有趣的体验，做好玩的叙事！"无限狗工作室是一支专注于高能动性叙事游戏的独立开发团队。我们相信玩家的每一次选择都应当真实地改变世界，每一段关系都值得被认真对待，每一场冒险都能够留下属于自己的痕迹。团队的第一款梦核怪谈风格的悬疑游戏《它色：第零类接触》火热开发中！
introduction_en: Infigo Games is an independent studio built around one belief: great stories are written by the players who live them. We make high-agency narrative games where choices have real weight, relationships carry real risk, and no two play-through are quite the same. Our debut title, a cosmic horror mystery adventure, is currently in development.

introduction_zh:
一支专注于独立游戏创作的工作室，诞生于对游戏最纯粹的热爱与创意追求。团队核心成员曾参与过轻度小游戏开发、主机平台移植开发，并在 UGC 内容生态搭建方面积累了丰富经验。在不同平台与类型的项目中积累了灵活务实的技术能力和对玩家体验的敏锐直觉。
我们相信，好游戏源于对“玩”的本质探索，也来自与玩家之间真诚的对话。我们愿以沉淀的经验为基石，持续尝试新颖的表达方式，在独立游戏中注入更多温度与惊喜。
introduction_en:
A studio dedicated to independent game development, born from pure passion for gaming and creative pursuit. Our core team members have been involved in the development of casual mini-games, porting projects to console platforms, and have accumulated extensive experience in building user-generated content (UGC) ecosystems. Through diverse projects across different platforms and genres, we have honed agile, practical technical skills and a keen intuition for player experience.

We believe that great games stem from exploring the essence of "play" and emerge through genuine dialogue with players. Building on our accumulated experience, we continue to experiment with novel forms of expression, striving to inject more heartfelt moments and delightful surprises into independent games.

introduction_zh: 单人业余开发，作品展示在B站、小红书【半桶水战士】
introduction_en: Individual amateur development. The works are showcased on Bilibili and Xiaohongshu [半桶水战士]

name_zh: 杭州黑岩网络科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 黑岩科技成立于2013年，是一家具备高水准技术实力，集游戏、动画、影视、虚拟制作等数字内容研发及运营的互动娱乐公司。拥有从内容、服务、技术、人力到资源端的完整产业链：经过十年在引擎技术、AIGC等领域的发展与沉淀，已实现游戏开发、原创动画制作出品、AIGC全品类内容等完整自主的产业模块，致力于IP全版权开发、 AI短剧制作、AI短剧投资发行、影游联动等多种业务形态，建设全球化的AIGC内容生态。
introduction_en: Founded in 2013, D.ROCK is a high-caliber interactive entertainment company specializing in the development and operation of digital content, including games, animation, film and television, and virtual production. It possesses a complete industrial chain from content, services, technology, human resources to the resource side. After ten years of development and accumulation in engine technology, AIGC and other fields, the company has achieved fully independent industrial modules including game development, original animation production and distribution, and full-category AIGC content. It is committed to various business forms such as full IP copyright development, AI short drama production, AI short drama investment and distribution, and film-game synergy.

introduction_zh:
SoloGame 是一家专注全球游戏本地化发行与整合营销的专业服务商。
历经 12 年市场积累，SoloGame 已在上海、北京、天津、苏州、深圳、广州、西安、成都、中国香港、东京、阿布扎比、雅加达建立全球分支网络，构建起 “中国深度运营 + 全球定制化发行” 的双轨驱动模式，120 人专业团队累计参与全球游戏市场项目超 11,000 个。
introduction_en:
SoloGame is a professional game publishing and integrated marketing company, focus on localized global game publishing.
With 12 years of industry experience, SoloGame has established branches in Shanghai, Beijing, Tianjin, Suzhou, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Xi'an, Chengdu, Hong Kong, Tokyo, Abu Dhabi, and Jakarta. Our dual-engine model — deep China operations combined with globally customized publishing — is supported by a 120-person professional team that has participated in over 11,000 game projects worldwide.
We champion the indie spirit — dedicated to serving independent developers and niche quality games, believing that individual creativity can reshape the industry. We pursue breakthrough focus: cultivating each title with precision to drive global impact.

introduction_zh: Blingame可口游戏于2015年在深圳成立，代表作有《勇敢的哈克》（HAAK）、《猫旅馆物语》、《我一点都不可口》，专注于独立游戏开发，有10多年的研发经验，主要开发动作游戏和益智休闲类游戏，同时开发了自研的AI本地化工具，为许多国内外的独立游戏提供64种语种的本地化服务支持。
introduction_en: Blingame was founded in Shenzhen in 2015, known for titles such as HAAK, Cat Hotel, and I'm Not Yummy At All. Specializing in indie game development with over 10 years of experience, the studio focuses primarily on action games and casual puzzle games. Blingame has also developed a proprietary AI localization tool, providing localization support across 64 languages for numerous indie games both domestically and internationally.

name_zh: 龙与麻雀与地下城（成都）科技有限公司
name_en: Dragon and Sparrow and Dungeon Chengdu Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh:
龙与麻雀制作组是由六位在国内游戏行业饱经“地精”风霜的社畜组建的团队。
尽管经历了种种磨难，但出于对策略游戏的热爱（地精的厌恶），他们决定制作这款麻将游戏（揭露这一切）。
目前团队的第一款游戏《龙与麻雀》锐意制作中，预计7月上线steam 试玩，敬请期待！
introduction_en:
Dragon & MahjongStudio is a ragtag band of six corporate drones who've been thoroughly weathered by the "goblins" of China's game industry rat race.
Despite all the trials and tribulations (read: trauma), their burning love for strategy games — and equally burning hatred for goblins — drove them to create this mahjong game (and expose the whole shady business while they're at it).
The studio's debut title, Dragon & Mahjong, is currently being forged with passion (and caffeine). A Steam demo is slated to drop this July — stay tuned, and may the tiles be ever in your favor!

introduction_zh: Pariah Interactive 是一家总部位于美国纽约布鲁克林和印度新德里的独立游戏与 XR 开发工作室。我们完全依靠自主创业发展，作品屡获国际奖项，并亮相纽约现代艺术博物馆、翠贝卡电影节、IGN Live 和 MAGFest Indie Video Game Showcase，2025 年推出首款自研游戏《1000 Deaths：千重命陨》。
introduction_en: Pariah Interactive is a seasoned independent game and XR development studio based in Brooklyn, New York, and New Delhi, India. We have a history of creating award-winning projects showcased at the Museum of Modern Art NY, Tribeca Film Festival, IGN Live, and MAGFest Indie Video Game Showcase. We have bootstrapped our entire company from the ground up and released our first in-house title, 1000 Deaths, in 2025.

name_zh: 索尼互动娱乐有限公司
introduction_zh: 自1994年索尼互动娱乐在日本推出第一代PlayStation以来，公司不断突破娱乐和创新的边界。时至今日，我们持续通过PlayStation系列产品与服务为全球玩家带来精彩纷呈的创新体验，包括具有代表性的硬件、引领行业的网络服务和屡获殊荣的游戏阵容。我们相信游戏的影响力不分国界。索尼互动娱乐是索尼集团公司的全资子公司。
introduction_en:
Sony Interactive Entertainment pushes the boundaries of entertainment and innovation, starting from the launch of the original PlayStation in Japan in 1994. Today, we continue to deliver innovative and thrilling experiences to a global audience through our PlayStation line of products and services that include generation-defining hardware, pioneering network services, and award-winning games.
Headquartered in San Mateo, California, with global functions in California, London, and Tokyo, and game development studios around the world as part of PlayStation Studios, we believe that the power of play is borderless. Sony Interactive Entertainment is a wholly owned subsidiary of Sony Group Corporation.

name_zh: 完美世界股份有限公司
introduction_zh: 完美世界涵盖影视、游戏和电竞三大业务。自2011年至2026年，公司14次被认定为全国文化企业30强，并多次获评国家文化出口重点企业，入选国家文化和科技融合示范基地、国家文化产业示范基地名单。完美世界游戏是中国最早自主研发3D游戏引擎的游戏企业，旗下产品出口100多个国家和地区；完美世界电竞为知名电竞产品《刀塔》、《反恐精英:全球攻势》在中国大陆的独家运营商。
introduction_en: Perfect World Co, Ltd encompasses three core business segments: Perfect World Pictures, Perfect World Games, and Perfect World E-sports. From 2011 to 2026, the company has been recognized as China’s Top 30 Cultural Enterprises for 14 times. Perfect World Games is the first Chinese gaming company to independently develop 3D game engines. Its game titles are now distributed to more than 100 countries and regions worldwide. Perfect World Esports serves as the exclusive operator of well-known e-sports titles such as Defense of the Ancients 2 (Dota 2) and Counter-Strike: Global Offensive (CS) in the Chinese mainland.

introduction_zh: 中国游戏创新大赛是在中国音像与数字出版协会指导下举办的全球性游戏赛事，由中国音像与数字出版协会游戏产业研究专家委员会主办，易玩（上海）网络科技有限公司（TapTap）与上海市网络游戏行业协会承办，上海市新闻出版局、静安区人民政府支持。赛事旨在落实中宣部出版局关于推动游戏产业守正创新与健康发展的要求，发掘具有鲜明辨识度与独特创造力的优秀原创作品，引导游戏行业致力创新创造，实现产业高质量发展。
introduction_en: The China Game Innovation Awards is a global game competition held under the guidance of the China Audio-Video and Digital Publishing Association. It is hosted by the Game Industry Research Expert Committee of the China Audio-Video and Digital Publishing Association, co-organized by Yiwan (Shanghai) Network Technology Co., Ltd. (TapTap) and the Shanghai Online Game Association, with support from the Shanghai Municipal Press and Publication Bureau and the Jing’an District People’s Government.

name_zh: 杭州顺网科技股份有限公司
introduction_zh: 杭州顺网科技股份有限公司创立于2005年，于2010年在深交所上市，历经二十年发展，已成为国内颇具影响力的科技产业集团。公司围绕"科技连接快乐"的核心使命，已构建起涵盖电竞科技、互动娱乐、算力服务、人工智能四大核心业务的数智服务生态，并与全球领先的游戏厂商、硬件厂商、运营商等合作伙伴保持持续、深入的技术、产品和生态合作，致力于成为数智服务引领者，让快乐随手可得。
introduction_en: Hangzhou Shunwang Technology Co., Ltd. ("Shunwang Technology"), founded in 2005 and listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in 2010, has evolved into one of China’s most influential technology enterprises over two decades. Anchored by the mission "Technology Bridges Joy", the company has forged a digital-intelligence ecosystem spanning four core pillars: eSports，interactive entertainment，computing power and AI. We maintain sustained and in-depth technological, product, and ecosystem collaborations with global industry leaders including top-tier game developers, hardware manufacturers, and telecom operators. Committed to establishing ourselves as a pioneer in intelligent digital services, we strive to make joyful experiences effortlessly accessible.

introduction_zh: 星辰铸造是重庆密尔克维模型有限公司旗下品牌，成立于2015年，从事饰品设计与生产近十年，拥有专业的设计团队，以及经验丰富的生产线。熟悉银饰传统工艺，同时掌握鎏金、雕刻等工艺以及独特的黑灰配方。既能驾驭传统的中国风，同时善于融合中西方特色呈现独具特色的饰品风格。从2020年起从事IP授权周边生产，与众多知名公司和IP合作，产品广受客户喜爱与认可。
introduction_en: Starforged is a subsidiary brand of Milkyway Works. We have been engaged in the design and production of fashion accessories for over a decade. Our idea is to bring the goodies from fantasy artwork to reality. We love them, and now we are making them, simple as. From our foundries in Chongqing, China, the Starforged made high-quality and finely detailed metalworks. All of our products are metallic – or mainly metallic in case of some – as the word ‘forged’ in our name suggested. We offer a large categories of merchandise, include but not limited to Pins, Badges, Pendant, Keychain, Ring and Collectible Coins. Whether you wish to make your brand’s properties materialised from virtual concept, or wish to join us as a retailer, just mail us, and the talk can then begin.

name_zh: 上海字符无限教育科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
「上海字符无限科技」深耕动漫游戏数字可视化十九载，杰普软件官方战略合作伙伴，专注打造产学研一体化人才培育体系。
公司核心业务覆盖UE虚幻引擎、Unity全流程开发设计、游戏研发、动漫番剧、AI 短剧、VR/AR/MR 交互、数字孪生、智慧城市、数据可视化等元宇宙全赛道，面向大学生及院校，向政企及行业企业提供高端技术人才培训、项目落地与商业深度合作一站式解决方案，技术积淀深厚，综合专业实力行业领先。
introduction_en:
「CHARACTER INFINITE」Nineteen years of deep cultivation in the IT industry and an official strategic partner of JEP Software, we focus on building an integrated industry-university-research talent cultivation system.
Our core businesses span the full metaverse spectrum, including Unreal Engine (UE), full-cycle Unity development & design, game R&D, anime series, AI short dramas, VR/AR/MR interaction, digital twins, smart cities and data visualization. We provide one-stop solutions for government institutions, enterprises and universities covering high-end technical talent incubation, project implementation and in-depth commercial cooperation. Boasting profound technical accumulation, we hold leading comprehensive professional strength in the industry.

name_zh: 杭州禹诺互动数字技术有限公司
name_en: Hangzhou Yunuo Interactive Digital Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 禹诺互动成立于2024年8月，位于杭州市西湖区，是一家独立游戏工作室。本公司自成立以来，先后发布了武侠动作冒险游戏《墨者：邓陵之丘》和叙事向科幻题材冒险游戏《回声 E.C.H.O.S》，均收获大量玩家的好评与期待。
introduction_en: Yunuo Interactive was established in August 2024 and is an independent game studio located in Xihu District, Hangzhou. Since its founding, the company has released the wuxia action-adventure game *Mo Zhe: Dengling Hill* and the narrative-driven science fiction adventure game *E.C.H.O.S*, both of which have received strong praise and anticipation from players.

introduction_zh:
以那是一家专注于互动叙事内容与创作者生态工具的科技公司。公司核心项目「来路门 Narloom」是新一代精品AVG互动阅读平台，连接用户、作品、与创作者。我们通过自研编辑器工具、创作者生态机制和内容发行能力，源源不断地为用户提供丰富多元的平台原创作品，同时也帮助创作者把故事发展成可长期运营的内容IP。
我们的愿景是为用户打开通往鲜活故事新世界的发光之门，也为创作者和作品打开走向更远处的大路。
introduction_en:
Yina is a creative technology company building platforms and tools for interactive storytelling. 
Our flagship project, Narloom, is a next-generation platform for discovering, experiencing, creating, and publishing interactive story games and creator-led story worlds. Built for narrative-driven games, and the creator ecosystem around them, Narloom provides creation tools, publishing support, and a curated library of original works to help creators grow their stories into lasting digital IP  — while giving players story worlds they can explore, follow, and return to.

introduction_zh: The Arcade Crew是一家独立游戏发行商，2018年成立于巴黎，其作品有风格化动作玩法、强烈的吸引力，以及令人难忘的游戏体验。发行阵容包括《深渊之潮》、《方块公国》、《卡战奇谋》、《复仇守护者：月亮骑士》等作品。The Arcade Crew与Dotemu也有渊源。在ChinaJoy上，它带来的作品能够与那些重视风格、挑战性以及独特世界观的玩家产生共鸣。
introduction_en:
The Arcade Crew is an indie game publisher founded in Paris in 2018, with a catalog shaped by stylish action, strong hooks, and a clear love for memorable games. On Steam, the publisher describes itself as a team of passionate studios working on indie games with a strong retro feeling, while its official site simply says what it is in the most direct way possible: an indie publisher of awesome indie games.
Its lineup includes titles such as Abyssus, Drop Duchy, Shuffle Tactics, MainFrames, Vengeful Guardian: Moonrider, Infernax, Young Souls, KUNAI, and Blazing Chrome.  The Arcade Crew also notes its connection to Dotemu, and at ChinaJoy it arrives with a portfolio that already speaks fluently to players who care about style, challenge, and standout worlds.

introduction_zh:
Butterscotch Shenanigans 是一家小型独立工作室，以充满搞怪风格、动作性强且极具个性的游戏而闻名。其代表作品包括《崩溃大陆》《崩溃大陆2》，以及《多少兄弟？》。
