在 ChinaJoy 上，Butterscotch Shenanigans 所展示的是一种典型的独立开发力量——通过鲜明的风格与扎实的玩法，构建能够跨越地区传播的玩家社区。
introduction_en:
Butterscotch Shenanigans is an independent studio known for games that are playful, energetic, and full of personality. Its work blends humor, creativity, and systems-driven design in a way that feels light on the surface, but carefully built underneath.
Its best-known titles include Crashlands, Crashlands 2, and Levelhead, alongside other projects such as How Many Dudes?, Quadropus Rampage, Flop Rocket, Towelfight 2, and Roid Rage. Huqiao’s own site also features a testimonial from founder and CEO Adam Coster, reflecting the studio’s experience in the Chinese market. At ChinaJoy, Butterscotch Shenanigans represents the kind of indie team that turns strong gameplay and a clear identity into communities that can travel well across borders.

introduction_zh: Game Smithing成立于2022年，是一家新锐游戏工作室，他们的创立初衷十分纯粹：打造能让团队引以为傲的游戏，并把游戏趣味性放在首位。这一理念看似简单，却清晰诠释了工作室想要带给玩家的游玩体验。本届ChinaJoy展会，Game Smithing将作为新生代游戏创作团队参展。尽管团队规模不大，但他们始终用心打磨作品，精准把握玩家喜好，用心打造每一款游戏。
introduction_en: Founded in 2022, Game Smithing is a young studio built around a simple idea: make games the team is proud of, and make sure fun comes first. It is a straightforward philosophy, but one that says a lot about the kind of player experience the studio wants to create. Huqiao’s website features a testimonial from founder Allan Smith, and the studio’s public presence reflects a focused team that is still early in its story, but already clear about its direction. At ChinaJoy, Game Smithing joins the event as part of a new generation of game creators who may be small in size, but are already building with intention, care, and a strong sense of what players enjoy.

name_zh: 上海想象引擎科技有限公司
name_en: Shanghai Imagination Engine Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 上海无尽梦科技有限公司成立于2025年，专注于AI驱动的数字内容创作与互动娱乐。旗下核心产品「演我」是一款AI互动剧情平台，以"用AI体验无限流人生"为理念，为用户打造沉浸式故事体验。平台融合AI叙事引擎与互动影游玩法，用户可代入不同角色、穿梭无尽故事时空，每一次选择都将演化出独特的剧情分支，公司致力于以人工智能技术重新定义数字叙事，为玩家创造无限可能的互动娱乐体验。
introduction_en: Shanghai Endless Dream Technology Co., Ltd., founded in 2025, specializes in AI-driven digital content creation and interactive entertainment. Our flagship product "Belike"  is an AI interactive narrative platform built around the concept of "Experience infinite lives through AI." The platform combines an AI storytelling engine with interactive drama gameplay, allowing users to immerse themselves in different roles, traverse endless story universes, and shape unique narrative branches with every choice they make. We are committed to redefining digital storytelling through artificial intelligence, delivering boundless interactive entertainment experiences.

name_zh: 杭州浩汤科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
杭州浩汤科技有限公司成立于 2023 年 8 月，团队规模约70人，浩汤科技以 “用数字作品传承民族历史、打造有文化重量的国产单机游戏” 为核心理念，聚焦小众但具备文化价值的严肃题材，拒绝流量化快餐制作，坚持高完成度、强沉浸感的单机内容研发。

浩汤科技目前在研项目《抵抗者》以沉浸式电影化叙事为核心，填补全球市场亚洲抗战题材单机游戏市场空白。
introduction_en:
Hangzhou Hoothanes Entertainment Co., Ltd. was founded in August 2023 and currently has a team of approximately 70 developers. Guided by the vision of preserving national history through interactive digital experiences and creating culturally meaningful premium games from China, Hoothanes is dedicated to developing high-quality, immersive single-player games that explore culturally significant and historically grounded themes, rather than following short-lived market trends.

Hoothanes is currently developing The Defiant.

name_zh: 爱国者电子科技有限公司
introduction_zh: aigo国民好物，33年深耕于电子消费领域，始终秉持“为国民，造好物”的理念，聚焦国民生活多元的场景化需求，致力于引领智能数码硬件创新，以科技赋能美好生活。布局安全存储、数码影音、智能穿戴、电脑整机、电子教育、电脑DIY、数码配件、智慧安防、户外生活等多个业务板块，推出40+产品品类。目前，aigo国民好物在北京、深圳、天津、美国等地设立了研发及生产机构，并在全球范围建立销售及服务体系。
introduction_en:
aigo, a leading consumer electronics brand, has been deeply rooted in the industry for 33 years. Guided by the philosophy of “Creating Better Products for Everyone,” aigo focuses on diverse lifestyle scenarios and consumer needs, driving innovation in smart digital hardware to enhance everyday life through technology.
With a portfolio spanning secure storage, digital imaging, smart wearables, PC systems, DIY solutions, digital accessories, smart security, outdoor lifestyle, and more, aigo offers over 40 product categories. Today, aigo has established R&D and manufacturing facilities in Beijing, Shenzhen, Tianjin, the United States, and other regions, while building a global sales and service network to bring innovative products and experiences to users worldwide.

name_zh: 上海霓诺网络科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 上海霓诺网络有限公司是一家注重创新精神的游戏研发公司，成立于2018年3月。公司从创立初期就秉持着“创造玩家第二梦”的理念，以模拟经营和AVG为主研方向，项目涵盖了手游和独立游戏，旗下拥有两个工作室： 零点物语物语工作室，主研AVG独立游戏——《不/存在的你，和我》、《不/存在的逐梦者：银葱之森》等；第二梦工作室，主研模拟经营游戏——《天空岛传说》、《魔女旅店》、《饮料小镇》。
introduction_en: Shanghai Nino Network Co., Ltd. is a game development company driven by a spirit of innovation, founded in March 2018. Since its inception, the company has adhered to the philosophy of "creating players' second dreams," focusing on simulation management and AVG as its main research directions. Its projects cover mobile games and indie games, and it operates two studios: the 0x0Real Studio, which specializes in AVG indie games such as The NOnexistenceN of you AND me and The NOnexistenceN of Morphean Paradox: The Forest of Silver Shallots; and the Second Dream Studio, which focuses on simulation management games including Tale of Skyland , Witches Tavern, and Beverage Town.

name_zh: 亚洲游戏娱乐有限公司
introduction_zh:
位于中国香港的游戏发行商及代理商，亦是任天堂株式会社及索尼互动娱乐的授权发行商。
目前已于PlayStation® / Nintendo Switch™/ Xbox 等主机平台上推出超过100款中文化游戏。
introduction_en: Game Source Entertainment (GSE) is one of the leading console game distributors in Asia which also an authorized publisher of Sony Interactive Entertainment and Nintendo Co., LTD. Gift Card partner of Google Inc. and Apple Inc.

name_zh: 杭州游卡网络技术有限公司
name_en: Hangzhou Yoka Network Technology Co., Ltd
introduction_zh:
致力于打造中国领先的多场景文化创意平台。
游卡坚持以“创造和分享快乐”为使命，围绕以桌游为代表的线下社交场景、以线上游戏为代表的数字文化场景、音娱体验场景、电子竞技场景等，不同的业务彼此交互，集设计、开发、发行、运营于一体，构建全场景的全新文化社交方式，打造出一个以内容力、IP化、全场景为驱动的文化创意平台
introduction_en: Yoka Games is the first company based in mainland China that lives and breathes table top games. The company is focused on the design, development, marketing and operations. Yoka Games offer a wide range of products, mid to hard core board games, educational, puzzles, casual, etc. Our distribution channels span across the world, covering both domestic and international.

name_zh: 砺算科技（上海）有限公司
introduction_zh: 砺算科技是一家专注高性能GPU研发的中国科技企业，由全球GPU行业领军人物创立，具备大芯片研发、架构设计、软件开发和量产的全链条能力。公司自研TrueGPU天图架构及AI Powered GPU技术，打造国产"渲推一体GPU"芯片及Lisuan eXtreme系列高端显卡，达国际主流、国内领先水平。为数字孪生、云游戏、AIPC、ARVR、智能座舱、具身智能等数字经济核心领域提供底层芯片与算力支撑。
introduction_en: Lisuan Technology is a Chinese high-tech company dedicated to high-performance GPU R&D. Founded by world-renowned GPU industry leaders, it possesses end-to-end capabilities spanning large-scale chip design, architecture development, software engineering, and mass production. The company independently develops its proprietary TrueGPU "Tiāntú" architecture and AI-Powered GPU technology, having successfully created domestic "Rendering-and-Streaming Unified GPU" chips and the Lisuan eXtreme series of high-end graphics cards that meet international mainstream standards and lead the domestic market. Lisuan provides foundational chips and computing power for core digital economy sectors including digital twins, cloud gaming, AI PCs, AR/VR, intelligent cockpits, and embodied intelligence.

name_zh: 北京豪腾创想科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
疯狂游戏集研发、运营与发行一体，一直致力于在不同流量场景下打造爆款游戏。
公司成立于 2010 年，依托多年内容研发与用户运营经验，累计服务超 10 亿玩家，聚焦休闲小游戏赛道，凭借创意玩法与优质内容稳定输出现象级游戏佳作，不断突破休闲游戏创意边界。
秉持坦诚、创新、共赢的价值观，HORTOR 正与热爱游戏、志同道合的人才携手，打造全球领先的游戏公司。
introduction_en:
HORTOR GAMES is an integrated game developer, operator, and publisher, dedicated to delivering blockbuster hits across diverse platforms.
Founded in 2010, HORTOR GAMES leverages deep expertise in content creation and user operations to serve over one billion players. Focused on casual mini-games, it consistently delivers phenomenal titles through creative gameplay and premium content, constantly pushing the boundaries of casual game innovation.
Guided by the core values of Sincerity, Innovation, and Win-Win Collaboration, HORTOR GAMES is committed to building a world-leading gaming enterprise alongside passionate talent who share the vision.

name_zh: 苏州蜗牛数字科技股份有限公司
introduction_zh: 蜗牛数字成立于2000年，是中国最早3D网络游戏研发公司之一，一直秉持“技术为核”的经营理念，自主研发并全球发行百余款不同版本的数字娱乐产品，拥有100多项自主知识产权和《九阴真经》、《航海世纪》、《太极熊猫》等多款经典IP，产品涵盖PC端游戏、移动端游戏、网页游戏、VR游戏、AR游戏、主机游戏、互动影视游戏等，在全球150多个国家和地区，累积注册用户数超过2亿，致力于成为最好的虚拟世界缔造商。
introduction_en: Snail Digital was founded in 2000 and is one of the earliest 3D online game R&D companies in China. Adhering to the business philosophy of "technology as the core," the company has independently developed and globally published over a hundred different versions of digital entertainment products. It holds more than 100 independent intellectual property rights and owns several classic IPs such as Age of Wushu, Voyage Century, Taichi Panda, and others. Its product portfolio includes PC games, mobile games, web games, VR games, AR games, console games, and interactive film games. With over 200 million registered users across more than 150 countries and regions worldwide, Snail Digital is committed to becoming the best creator of virtual worlds.

introduction_zh: 唱舞工作室旗下拥有《唱舞全明星》与《唱舞星计划》两款音舞社交手游。《唱舞全明星》于2019年上线，全球累计用户超6000万，已成为Z世代潮流娱乐的标志性品牌；续作《唱舞星计划》为系列第三代升级之作，采用3D换装与大地图自由探索，2025年公测后迅速引爆全平台热度，影响力辐射泛圈层用户。两款游戏均融合K歌、舞蹈、时尚穿搭与虚拟社交，提供佛系交友、恋爱互动与个性换装等多元体验。
introduction_en: Changwu Studio owns two music‑dance social mobile games: Idol Party and Idol Party II. Idol Party launched in 2019 and has accumulated over 60 million users worldwide, becoming an iconic brand of Gen Z trend entertainment. Its sequel, Idol Party II, is the third‑generation upgrade of the series, featuring 3D dress‑up and free exploration of a large map. After its open beta in 2025, it quickly gained massive popularity across all platforms, with its influence extending to users beyond the core gaming circle. Both games integrate K‑singing, dancing, fashion styling, and virtual socializing, offering diverse experiences such as laid‑back friendship building, romantic interactions, and personalized outfit customization.

introduction_zh: LazyFlock发行作品《Haunted Paws》一款温馨的合作恐怖冒险游戏，玩家扮演小狗探索神秘鬼屋，融合魅力、悬念与合作玩法，体现我们对情感叙事和有趣游戏世界的热爱。该工作室以热情和承诺为驱动，目标是在打造独特、真诚且难忘的游戏中持续成长。
introduction_en:
LazyFlock is a game development studio with over three years of hands-on experience in the gaming industry. 
Today, our focus is on developing our second independent title, *Haunted Paws* - a cozy co-op horror adventure where players take on the role of puppies exploring a mysterious haunted mansion. Blending charm, suspense, and cooperative gameplay, *Haunted Paws* reflects our love for both emotional storytelling and playful, memorable game worlds.
At LazyFlock, we are driven by a passion for game development and a commitment to creating immersive, captivating experiences for players to explore. Our goal is to continue growing as an indie studio while crafting games that feel unique, heartfelt, and unforgettable.

name_zh: 雷神（武汉）网络技术有限公司
introduction_zh: 雷神加速器专注于游戏网络优化领域，致力于为全球游戏用户提供稳定，低时延的网络连接服务，累计服务用户已超过1亿。秉承为用户创造价值的理念，雷神加速器在行业内首创“时长可暂停”模式，用户购买的加速时长长期有效，支持不用随时可暂停，突破了传统包月制束缚。同时，平台支持六端时长互通（Windows端、Mac端、手机端、主机端、路由器端），同一账户无需按端重复购买，让用户每分钱花的具有实际价值不浪费
introduction_en: Thunder VPN Accelerator specializes in game network optimization and is committed to delivering stable, low-latency network connections for gamers worldwide, with over 100 million cumulative users served. Upholding the philosophy of creating value for users, Thunder pioneered the "pausable subscription time" model in the industry. The purchased acceleration duration remains permanently valid and can be paused at any time when not in use, breaking free from the limitations of traditional monthly subscription plans.

introduction_zh: 《科拉诺克岛：恐龙战纪》是一款轻度肉鸽的多人对战DBG游戏。玩家将化身不同的角色，用独特的技能在岛屿上展开“抢龙大战”。每种恐龙都有其专属的食性与技能，与此同时还有随机刷新的自然事件和黑市奇物，如何组建出最强的恐龙战队将是每一位登岛者需要攻克的难题。已上架steam愿望单，现场提供Demo试玩。
introduction_en: Chronicle Island: The War of Dinosaurs is a roguelite, multiplayer deck-building battle game (DBG). Players take on the roles of unique characters, each with their own abilities, and compete in a fierce dinosaur-snatching showdown across the island. Every dinosaur has its own diet type and unique abilities, while randomly occurring natural events and black-market curios add even more unpredictability to each match. Building the ultimate dinosaur squad will be the defining challenge for everyone who sets foot on the island.

introduction_zh: Extremely Normal Studios因WTF.gg及新作Waifu Tactical Force为人熟知。工作室风格辨识度极高：节奏明快、趣味十足，自带浓厚互联网特质，精准拿捏当代多人游戏的鲜活氛围。本次参展 ChinaJoy，该团队展现出游戏行业年轻鲜活的创作力量，专注为偏爱高机动玩法、独特画风，追求快速沉浸式体验的玩家打造优质作品。
introduction_en:
Extremely Normal Studios is a game developer widely known for creating WTF.gg and its upcoming title WTF: Waifu Tactical Force. This laid-back yet high-energy tone defines the game’s overall style, highlighting fast-paced gameplay, distinct character personalities, fluid movement, and community-driven iteration.
As noted on Steam, the team highly values player feedback and uses Early Access as a core method to refine and optimize the game collaboratively with its community.
At ChinaJoy, Extremely Normal Studios will showcase the youthful, dynamic spirit of modern game development. Rooted in online gaming culture and drawn to trendy visual aesthetics, the studio caters to players seeking immersive gameplay experiences and approachable, easy-to-pick-up game worlds.

name_zh: 北京格拉飞可斯科技有限公司
introduction_zh: Meshy 是全球领先的 3D 生成式 AI 平台,总部位于硅谷,致力于重塑游戏开发的内容生产管线。基于自研 3D 基础大模型,Meshy 能将一句文字或一张图片在分钟级转化为具备高精度几何与逼真贴图的 3D 资产,把传统需要数周、上千美元的建模流程提效百倍以上。目前 Meshy 服务全球 1000 万+ 用户,生成模型数突破 1 亿,被 A16Z Games 评为最受欢迎的 3D AI 工具。
introduction_en: Meshy is a leading 3D generative AI platform headquartered in Silicon Valley, on a mission to transform the content creation pipeline for game development. Powered by its in-house 3D foundation models, Meshy turns a single text prompt or image into a 3D asset with high-precision geometry and photorealistic textures in just minutes — delivering 3D assets over 100× faster and cheaper than traditional workflows that used to take weeks and thousands of dollars. Today, Meshy serves 10M+ users worldwide, has generated over 100M models, and was recognized by A16Z Games as the most popular 3D AI tool

name_zh: 北京龙图智库科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 北京龙图智库科技有限公司成立于2002年8月28日，于2002年9月正式开始运营游戏。公司运营的线上游戏均以中国文化故事题材为主题，以华人世界为中心，秉持传承中华文化，打造精品网游的使命，纵使在互联网高速发展的今天，公司仍然坚持以用户的需求为最高宗旨，全面倡导绿色健康游戏为经营理念，伴随着中国网游行业成长历程，凭借若拥抱变化，追求卓越的企业精神，率先在网络游戏行业树立自身特色，抢先占得市场先机。
introduction_en: Beijing Longtuzhiku Technology Co., Ltd. was established on August 28, 2002, and officially began operating games on September 2002. The company's online games are all based on Chinese cultural stories, centered in the Chinese community, and dedicated to inheriting Chinese culture and creating high-quality online games. Even in today's rapidly developing internet era, the company still insists on taking users' needs as its top priority, fully advocating the business philosophy of green and healthy gaming. Accompanied by the growth of China's online game industry, through its spirit of embracing change and pursuing excellence, the company has established its unique features in the online game industry and seized market opportunities first.

introduction_zh: 2P Games 成立于2019年，这是一个拥有十年以上游戏媒体、社区运营经验的游戏发行团队。我们期望通过与开发者的合作以及玩家社群的力量将来自中国、日本、欧美等地的优秀独立游戏作品和知名团队的作品带给大家
introduction_en: 2P Games was founded in China by a small team of experts from the Asian games industry with a decade of professional experience. They are behind the release of successful indie gems like Sultan’s Game, Immortal Life, Dust to the End, Greedland, The Hungry Lamb, and Looper Tactics. For more information on 2P Games and its products, please visit 2pgames.net/links. Or join the 2P Games Discord Server.

name_zh: 成都水月雨科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 水月雨MOONDROP，深耕音频领域的创新型科技品牌，作为国家高新技术企业，品牌搭建以成都总部为核心，联动东莞、深圳分公司的协同创新体系，全方位精进核心声学技术稳固技术优势。品牌在成都温江海峡科技园区拥有4000平方米自有生产基地，以高标准生产工艺保障高端产品研发与量产品质。同时积极拓展文化IP生态，先后与《崩坏:星穹铁道》《鸣潮》《阴阳师》等IP深度联动，市场反响热烈。
introduction_en:
MOONDROP is an innovative audio tech brand accredited as China’s National High-tech  Enterprise. Centered at its Chengdu headquarters with branches in Dongguan and Shenzhen, it upgrades core acoustic technologies persistently.
Boasting a 4,000㎡ self-owned production site in Chengdu Wenjiang Strait Science & Technology Park, it guarantees premium R&D and product quality with strict manufacturing standards. It also develops IP partnerships with Honkai: Star Rail, Wuthering Waves and Onmyoji, achieving remarkable market results.

name_zh: 上海宇逸无界智能科技有限公司
introduction_zh: CCC Games是一家位于上海的游戏开发团队，专注于航空、铁路、公交等真实交通系统模拟游戏。我们以真实数据、真实规则与真实物理为基础，打造兼具沉浸感、策略性与工程趣味的硬核模拟体验。旗下项目包括空中交通管制模拟游戏《迷你空管》、次世代3D空管模拟游戏《机场管制27》以及铁路驾驶模拟游戏《手指口呼：中国铁路模拟》等。
introduction_en: CCC Games is a Shanghai-based game development team specializing in simulation games inspired by real-world transportation systems, including aviation, railway, and public transit. Built on authentic data, operational rules, and physical logic, our titles include Mini Airways, ATC 27, and TrainSim: Point & Call.

name_zh: 深圳市固胜智能科技有限公司
introduction_zh: MOZA魔爪是深圳市固胜智能科技有限公司（2023年入选国家级专精特新重点“小巨人”企业）旗下品牌，专注于传感器融合算法和高精度运动控制技术的研究创新，并应用于汽车智能驾驶、赛车模拟器、飞行模拟器和智能影像等领域。凭借在专业汽车技术及力反馈算法领域的多年积淀与专业积累，MOZA打造的高性能模拟设备能精准细腻、稳定地传递丰富的力反馈细节，带来无限趋近真实世界的沉浸式拟真驾驶体验。
introduction_en: Founded by automotive engineers, MOZA Racing merges advanced automotive engineering with cutting-edge flight and racing simulation technology. Drawing on expertise in vehicle dynamics and camera stabilization, we design high-performance equipment that authentically replicates real-world experiences.

introduction_zh:
Boltray GamesPC/主机发行团队成立于2024年,办公地点深圳。我们专注PC与主机游戏发行,用心甄选全球优质作品,为玩家呈现值得体验的好游戏。团队成员具备丰富的游戏经历、行业工作经验以及国际视野,团队负责人张少毒同时兼任雷霆
游戏战略负责人,从业12年,曾主导代理《摩尔庄园》、《鬼谷八荒》、《失落城堡》、《世界弹射物语》等游戏,投资《羊了个羊》研发商北京简游等游戏公司。
introduction_en:
Boltray Games PC/Console Publishing Team was established in 2024 in Shenzhen and Singapore. Our team members have extensive gaming and industry experience, combined with a global perspective. Team lead Zhang
Shaoqian has 12 years of industry experience and signed key titles such as Tale of Immortal and Lost Castle. We offer end-to-end global publishing capabilities, covering all aspects of the publishing process including brand
building. marketing, community operations, localisation, and China game license (ISBN) applications. Our localisation team is partnered with top universities in China like Peking University School of Foreign Languages to
ensure high translation quality.

name_zh: 恺英网络股份有限公司
introduction_zh:
恺英网络股份有限公司是国内知名互联网游戏上市公司，核心业务涵盖手游与页游的研发、运营及发行，网页游戏平台与移动应用分发平台运营；同时长期布局智能科技领域，积极推进全球化发行以触达更广泛用户。
目前，恺英网络先后开发、运营了《蓝月传奇》《敢达争锋对决》《三国：天下归心》知名平台XY.COM、996传奇盒子、AI全流程开发平台SOON以及治愈系AI潮玩暖心谷梦游记等。
恺英网络将持续提供优质内容体验。
introduction_en:
Kingnet Network Co., Ltd.  is a well-known listed online game company in China. The Company's core business encompasses the R&D, operation, and publishing of mobile games and webgames. It also engages in the operation of webgame platforms and mobile apps distribution platforms. In addition, Kingnet has established a long-term strategic presence in the smart technology sector and is actively developing its overseas business to reach a broader user base.
Currently, Kingnet has developed and operated numerous popular games including Legend of Blue Moon, Gundam Supreme Battle, Three kingdoms,XY.COM,996.BOX, AI full-process development platform SOON and the heartwarming AI designer doll brand Warm Star Valley Dream Journey.

introduction_zh: Pocketpair是日本顶级独立游戏开发与运营公司之一，凭借《幻兽帕鲁》等作品受到全球游戏行业广泛关注，曾多次登顶Steam全球销量榜。公司坚持以玩家为中心，同时重视开发者的创造力，致力于打造面向全球市场的原创游戏。与此同时，Pocketpair通过Pocketpair Publishing开展游戏发行业务，为开发者提供资金、发行及项目支持，帮助更多优秀创意走向全球玩家。
introduction_en: Pocketpair is one of Japan's leading indie game development and operation companies, attracting attention from game companies around the world. The company has reached No. 1 on Steam's worldwide sales ranking multiple times, and develops games for the global market with a customer-centric approach and a strong focus on developers' creativity. Through Pocketpair Publishing, Pocketpair also supports developers with funding, creative consultation, and publishing, helping them bring their dream games to players worldwide.

introduction_zh: 种子实验室（Seed Sparkle Lab）是《星砂岛》的制作工作室，专注于打造温暖、治愈且富有探索感的游戏体验。团队希望通过细腻的美术、轻松的玩法和充满生活感的岛屿世界，为玩家带来一段舒适又充满惊喜的冒险旅程。
introduction_en: Seed Sparkle Lab is the development studio behind *Starsand Island*. The team focuses on creating warm, cozy, and exploration-driven game experiences, bringing players a relaxing island adventure filled with charming visuals, peaceful gameplay, and delightful moments of discovery.

name_zh: 深圳市莱仕达电子科技有限公司
name_en: Shenzhen PXN Electronics Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 深圳市莱仕达电子科技有限公司是一家立足全球视野的创新科技企业，以智能硬件与软件生态的深度创新为核心驱动，致力于打造享誉世界的消费电子品牌。公司精准布局赛车模拟器、游戏手柄、飞行模拟器等产品线，构建了领先的互动娱乐科技生态。凭借卓越的产品力与品牌价值，在中国、中东、北美、欧洲等全球关键市场占据领导地位，业务版图覆盖全球140多个国家和地区，累计触达全球超1亿用户，成为全球消费者信赖的消费电子品牌。
introduction_en: Shenzhen PXN Electronics Technology Co., Ltd. is an innovation-driven technology brand with a global vision, dedicated to advancing intelligent hardware and software ecosystems. Committed to building a world-renowned consumer electronics brand, PXN strives to lead through continuous innovation and excellence. Focusing on racing simulators, gaming controllers, and flight simulators, PXN has built a leading ecosystem in interactive entertainment. Its dedication to outstanding product innovation and a strong brand reputation has secured PXN's leadership across key markets including China, the Middle East, North America, and Europe, reaching over 100 million users in more than 140 countries and regions and reinforcing its position as a trusted name in consumer electronics.

introduction_zh: Ukiyo Studios is an Australian-Japan-based business development company that supports game developers and publishers with their external needs. We support our clients by exhibiting at Events and PR.
introduction_en:
Ukiyo Studios is a business development company that supports game developers and publishers with their external needs. We operate behind the scenes and help our clients with the “business side of things” so they can better focus their time and resources on development.

Here are some of the ways we support our clients:

- Exhibiting at Events on your behalf
- Publisher scouting for developers
- Developer scouting for publishers
- B2B Negotiation
- PR support in Asia and around the world
- Consulting work
- Localisation work
- Japanese Voiceover
- Selling Merchandise

Let us tackle the external challenges so you can focus on what you do best: Making Games!

At ChinaJoy we are showing a mix of indie games from all over the world.

name_zh: 北京水泠喵网络科技有限公司
name_en: Beijing Shuilingmiao Network Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 北京水泠喵网络科技有限公司是一家年轻、创新、充满活力的新兴游戏公司。团队由热爱游戏、具备技术实力与创意表达的成员组成，核心成员拥有大型项目研发经验，并在游戏引擎、AI应用、云游戏等领域持续积累。公司坚持以创新驱动产品研发，积极探索游戏与前沿技术的融合，致力于打造兼具趣味性、技术力与想象力的互动娱乐作品。
introduction_en: Beijing Shuilingmiao Network Technology Co., Ltd. is a young, innovative and energetic game company. Our team is composed of passionate creators and skilled developers with experience in large-scale game projects. With expertise in game engines, AI applications, cloud gaming and other emerging technologies, we are committed to integrating creativity with cutting-edge technology. Driven by innovation, we aim to create interactive entertainment experiences that are imaginative, engaging and technically refined.

introduction_zh: KOOK语音是北京逍遥一下科技有限公司推出的年轻人在线语音社交平台，聚焦游戏开黑、兴趣社区与实时陪伴，为用户提供更稳定、自然、有归属感的在线沟通空间。目前，平台主要面向游戏、音乐、二次元等多类兴趣的年轻用户，秉持"让沟通自然发生，让关系一直在线"的核心理念，支持高质量多人语音频道、高清屏幕共享、多功能文字频道、去中心化服务器架构、40万以上成员规模的超大容量主题服务器，以及开放式机器人生态。
introduction_en: KOOK is an online voice social platform for young people, launched by Beijing Xiaoyao Yixia Technology Co., Ltd. It focuses on gaming team-ups, interest communities, and real-time companionship, offering users a more stable, natural online communication space with a sense of belonging. Currently, the platform primarily targets young users with diverse interests in gaming, music, anime, and more. Adhering to its core philosophy—"Let communication happen naturally, let connections stay online"—it supports high-quality multi-person voice channels, HD screen sharing, multi-functional text channels, a decentralized server architecture, large-capacity topic servers that can accommodate over 400,000 members, and an open bot ecosystem.

introduction_zh: 琥桥游戏是一座连接中西方游戏产业的桥梁。公司总部设于中国香港，助力海外游戏踏上“数字丝绸之路”、开拓中国市场，对接本地玩家、社群、达人、平台，同时深度适配本土文化、挖掘各类市场机遇。过去数年间，琥桥已协助超过百款游戏，其中包含《战锤》、《异星工厂》及Atari旗下系列作品。本届ChinaJoy琥桥将作为连接西方与中国游戏的纽带参与盛会。
introduction_en:
Huqiao Games is a bridge between China and the West in the games industry. Based in Hong Kong, the company helps Western games find their place in the Chinese market - step onto the Digital Silk Road - and connect with local players, communities, influencers, platforms, culture, and market opportunities.
Over the past few years, Huqiao has supported more than 100 games in China, including titles such as Warhammer, Factorio, and Atari. Most of the team is based in China, while people like founder Wojtek Jaworski and managing director John Kavvouras help strengthen the Western side of Huqiao Games. At ChinaJoy, Huqiao joins the event as a link between the Western and Chinese gaming worlds.

introduction_zh:
独游不独行！
Ludere独立游戏互助社区是一个专注于连接独立游戏开发者与玩家的非营利性共创平台。我们致力于为个人开发者以及小型团队提供作品曝光、玩家测试及开发交流的机会，同时为玩家发掘优质小众的独立游戏。通过线下体验会、线上访谈与赛事，打破开发者与玩家间的信息壁垒，让每个独特的创意都能被看见。
introduction_en:
Indie, Never Alone！

Ludere IndieGame Support Group is a non-profit co-creation platform focused on connecting indie game developers and players. We are committed to providing individual developers and small teams with opportunities for their work to gain exposure, be tested by players, and exchange ideas, while also helping players discover high-quality, niche indie games. Through offline events, online interviews, and competitions, we break down information barriers between developers and players, ensuring that every unique idea can be seen.

introduction_zh: 怦然临境科技是一家专注虚拟现实内容体验的独立游戏团队，致力于探索沉浸式交互与创新玩法。当前项目《拼火序列》是一款VR Roguelite射击游戏，融合多角色策略构筑、枪械拼接与快节奏生存战斗。游戏已在Meta Store上线Demo及Early Access版本，后续计划登陆PICO与Steam平台，欢迎持续关注。
introduction_en: Spoyzen is an independent VR game studio focused on immersive and playful virtual reality experiences. We are currently developing SnapWorks: Flip Corp, a VR roguelite shooter where players build unique weapons, choose different characters, and survive fast-paced combat. The game is now available on the Meta Store as both a demo and an Early Access release, with PICO and Steam versions planned.

introduction_zh: 18183游戏网，是国内领先的游戏综合媒体平台。深耕游戏行业十余年，我们覆盖手游、单机、主机、网游等全品类游戏，累计服务玩家超过3000万。作为2025年PUBG鸡斯卡年度合作媒体及多届金翎奖玩家最喜爱游戏媒体得主，18183致力于为玩家提供高质量的新闻资讯、深度攻略、专业评测及独家礼包，同时为游戏厂商提供精准营销与整合传播服务。
introduction_en: 18183.com is a leading comprehensive gaming media platform in China. With over a decade of deep expertise in the gaming industry, we cover mobile, PC, console, and online games across all genres, serving more than 30 million players. As the 2025 PUBG Chicken Award Media Partner of the Year and multiple-time winner of the Golden Plume Award for Players' Favorite Gaming Media, 18183 is dedicated to providing players with high-quality gaming news, in-depth guides, professional reviews, and exclusive gift packs, while offering precise marketing and integrated communication services to game developers.

name_zh: 一点小火（北京）游戏科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 一点小火是一家致力于传递社交快乐的独立游戏工作室，专注创作有趣的多人互动游戏。我们期望可以创造一个游戏机制牵引的无压力社交环境，让所有人都可以在沉浸式的游戏中，自由表现真实的自己，享受到与人社交的快乐！
introduction_en:
Spiritx2 Studio is an indie game studio dedicated to delivering joyful social experiences. We focus on developing fun multiplayer interactive titles.
Our goal is to build a stress-free social ecosystem driven by innovative gameplay mechanics. Within immersive gaming worlds, every player can freely embrace their authentic selves and relish the joy of connecting with others.

name_zh: 广州市星杰网络科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 广州市星杰网络科技有限公司以自研为核心，始终保持对游戏品质的执着追求，致力于与玩家一起探索和创造有趣、深刻的游戏体验
introduction_en: Guangzhou Xingjie Network Technology Co., Ltd. takes self-research as its core, always maintaining a persistent pursuit of game quality, and is committed to exploring and creating interesting and profound gaming experiences together with players

introduction_zh:
《浑天星途》一款创新开放世界游戏，由首像·数字创造（INSIGNE）独立研发，致力于探索传统文化的现代演绎、科学幻想与游戏叙事的融合，希望通过具有创新玩法、内容与审美的作品，与玩家共同创造富有生命力的游戏世界。
系列初代作品里，玩家将从异星乐土的荒野境地开始，重新掌握火、蒸汽、新能源，依靠拼合古老的蓝星知识碎片延续文明，直至点亮方舟母舰的人造恒星引擎，开启回归之旅。
introduction_en:
Huntian: StarTrace is an innovative open-world game independently developed by INSIGNE. The project explores the modern interpretation of traditional culture, the science fiction and fantasy, game narrative, and seeks to create a living, evolving world through innovative gameplay, rich content, and distinctive artistic expression with players.
As the first installment in the series, players will begin their journey on a planet called Lexing, rebuilding civiliazation from the remnants of a lost era. By rediscovering the knowledge of Earth's past, technologies like fire, steam power, advanced energy systems, players will gradually restore the foundations of civiliazation. Their ultimate goal is to reignite the artificial stellar engine of the Arkship and embark on the journey back to Home.

name_zh: 长沙兔窟网络科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
长沙兔窟网络科技有限公司是一家位于长沙的数字文化创意与游戏开发公司，专注于原创角色IP、互动叙事与音乐表达体验的研发。
公司目前正在开发原创游戏《Cocoiro》，以原创角色与世界观为核心、音乐节奏玩法为表达系统，致力于打造兼具内容深度与长期运营潜力的角色IP产品。
introduction_en:
TUKU Network is a digital cultural creativity and game development company based in Changsha, specializing in the development of original character IPs, interactive narratives, and music-driven interactive experiences.
The company is currently developing the original game "Cocoiro". Centered on original characters and worldbuilding, and using music rhythm gameplay as its core expressive system, "Cocoiro" aims to become a character IP product with both narrative depth and long-term operational potential.

introduction_zh: PepperStones是一家来自韩国的独立游戏开发工作室，致力于打造兼具创意、情感叙事与精致玩法的游戏体验。以3D动作Roguelike冒险游戏《Wetory》为起点，我们持续探索独特的视觉风格与创新机制。团队以热情、匠心和对玩家的尊重为核心，目标是成长为面向全球玩家、跨平台提供难忘互动娱乐体验的游戏公司。
introduction_en: PepperStones is an independent game studio based in Korea, creating distinctive games that combine imaginative concepts, emotional storytelling, and polished gameplay. Starting with Wetory, a 3D action roguelike adventure, we have continued to explore original game experiences with strong visual identity and creative mechanics. Our team develops games with passion, craftsmanship, and a deep respect for players. PepperStones aims to grow as a global studio that delivers memorable interactive entertainment across diverse platforms and audiences.

introduction_zh: 金山世游成立于2020年，是金山软件集团旗下的全资子公司，总部位于北京，并在武汉、珠海设有研发中心。作为一家专注于数字娱乐内容的公司，金山世游以网络游戏代理发行起家，经过多年发展，逐步建立起“以精品游戏自主研发为基础，以全球优质IP发行与运营为核心”的业务布局。重点围绕经典IP引进、本地化改造以及IP全产业链运营，推动IP价值深度释放，构建覆盖研发、发行、运营与IP延展的综合能力体系。
introduction_en:
Founded in 2020, Kingame is a wholly owned subsidiary of Kingsoft Group, headquartered in Beijing with R&D centers in Wuhan and Zhuhai.

As a company focused on digital entertainment content, Kingame started with online game publishing and distribution. Over the years, the company has gradually established a business framework centered on premium in-house game development and the publishing and operation of high-quality global IPs.

Kingame focuses on classic IP licensing, localization, and full IP lifecycle operations, aiming to further unlock the value of IPs while building integrated capabilities across game development, publishing, operations, and IP expansion.

introduction_zh:
哔哩哔哩，简称 “B 站”，一个有用有趣的综合性视频社区，被用户们亲切地称为 “百科全书式的网站、没有围墙的图书馆，成长道路上的加油站，创作者的舞台”。
围绕用户、创作者和内容，B 站构建了一个源源不断产生优质内容的生态系统。中国最优秀的专业创作者都聚集在 B 站创作内容，涵盖生活、游戏、时尚、知识、音乐等数千个品类和圈层，引领着流行文化的风潮，成为中文互联网极其独特的存在。
introduction_en:
Bilibili is an iconic video community where knowledge meets entertainment—hailed by users as "a digital encyclopedia, a dynamic open library, a growth companion, and a stage for creators."
Bilibili has cultivated a thriving ecosystem centered around users, content creators, and content, ensuring a continuous stream of high-quality offerings. It is home to China’s top professional content creators, covering thousands of niche topics—from lifestyle and gaming to fashion, knowledge, and music. This vibrant community not only makes Bilibili a Chinese pop culture trendsetter but also positions it as a truly unique player in China's digital space.

introduction_zh: 巨人网络是一家用创新驱动的互联网企业，通过提供有核心价值的产品或服务，让用户享受创新带来的便利。 公司坚持聚焦、用户第一、阳光经营的发展理念，致力于打造百年品牌。
introduction_en: Giant Network is an innovation-driven Internet company. By providing products or services with core values, users can enjoy the convenience brought by innovation. The company adheres to the development concept of focus, users first, and sunshine management, and is committed to building a century-old brand.

name_zh: 北京梧桐宇舟科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
北京梧桐宇舟科技有限公司（SYCA GAMES）是一家面向全球内容、以高品质产品引进与本地化运营为核心的综合型游戏发行企业。公司核心业务聚焦于游戏的本地化发行和本土电竞赛事体系建设，致力于将全球优质游戏内容引入中国市场，并实现长期稳定的商业化与用户口碑。
发行作品《对峙：交锋时刻》为全球热门战术射击手游《Standoff 2》的国服版本。
introduction_en:
Beijing Wutong Yuzhou Technology Co., Ltd. (SYCA GAMES) is an integrated game publishing company with a global content vision, focusing on the introduction of high-quality titles and localized operations. The company’s core business covers localized game publishing and the development of local esports ecosystems. It is committed to bringing premium global game content to the Chinese market while building long-term commercial success and a strong reputation among players.
SYCA GAMES is the official publishing partner of Standoff 2 in Mainland China, bringing the globally popular tactical shooter mobile game to Chinese players through localized publishing, community operations, and esports initiatives.

introduction_zh: 360游戏是集游戏发行、运营、推广为一体，全面覆盖手游、端游、页游全品类的游戏平台。同时，在游戏安全技术、AI大数据和电竞赛事等前沿领域持续发力，挖掘游戏产品的创新活力与发展潜力。由全球顶尖游戏研发商Wargaming研发、360游戏深度联合运营的《坦克世界》、《战舰世界》两款游戏，现已成为载具射击游戏领域的领军之作。未来，360游戏将持续巩固自身优势，为全球游戏开发者和玩家提供双向价值。
introduction_en: 360 Games is a comprehensive gaming platform that integrates game publishing, operations, and promotion, covering all categories including mobile, PC, and web games. At the same time, it continues to invest in cutting-edge fields such as game security, AI, big data, and esports. World of Tanks and World of Warships, developed by world-leading game developer Wargaming and co-operated in depth by 360 Games, have become flagship titles in the vehicle-based shooter genre. Looking ahead, 360 Games will continue to build on its strengths, creating values for game developers and players worldwide.

name_zh: 北京展心展力信息科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 233乐园隶属于MetaApp集团，是国内领先的AIGC游戏平台与创作社区。平台日活跃用户已突破千万，注册用户超过 2 亿，内容生态覆盖UGC二创、休闲小游戏、头部手游、视觉小说、模拟器游戏、MOD、PC单机云游戏等多个品类。凭借丰富的内容供给与活跃的创作氛围，233乐园已成为触达Z世代与Alpha世代用户最具影响力的平台之一。
introduction_en: 233 Leyuan, a subsidiary of MetaApp Group, stands as one of China’s leading AIGC-powered gaming platforms and creator communities. With over 10 million daily active users and more than 200 million registered users, the platform features a diverse content ecosystem spanning UGC derivative works, casual mini-games, popular mobile titles, visual novels, emulator games, MODs, and cloud-based PC single-player games. Built on its extensive content library and vibrant creator community, 233 Leyuan has become one of the most influential platforms for engaging Gen Z and Gen Alpha audiences.

name_zh: 海南元游信息技术有限公司
introduction_zh: 海南元游信息技术有限公司（简称“乐享元游”），2016年成立，专注高端精品手游研发。秉承“向真向善向美向难”使命，聚焦仙侠赛道，已研发《青云诀》《青云诀之伏魔》《仙遇》《源星战域》等作品。公司系国家高新技术企业、国家文化出口重点企业、海南省专精特新中小企业；2025年入选中国互联网百强、海南省民营企业百强及研发投入20强，2026年入选中国成长性文化企业30强。
introduction_en: Hainan YuanYou Information Technology Co., Ltd.("YUANYOU GAMEMETA"), founded in 2016, is dedicated to premium mobile game development. Upholding its mission of "conveying truth, goodness, beauty, and resilience," it focuses on the Xianxia genre and has developed titles including 《KaiTian》、《Eternal Rebirth: Oversouler》、《Destiny M》、《Sky Codex》、《Nhất Kiếm Phục Ma》. The company is a National High-Tech Enterprise, a National Key Cultural Export Enterprise, and a Hainan Specialized and Sophisticated SME. In 2025, it was listed among China's Top 100 Internet Enterprises, Hainan's Top 100 Private Enterprises, and Hainan's Top 20 R&D Investment; in 2026, it was named to China's Top 30 Growth-Oriented Cultural Enterprises.

introduction_zh:
顺丰是亚洲最大、全球第四大综合物流服务提供商*，服务超235万企业客户及8亿个人消费者，提供包括时效快递、经济快递、快运、冷运及医药、同城即时配送、供应链及国际（含国际快递、国际货运及代理、供应链）等物流服务。同时，公司以领先的科技赋能，为客户打造全球端到端一站式安全高效的智慧供应链体系，致力于成为备受尊重全球领先的数智物流解决方案服务商。
*根据弗若斯特沙利文报告，以2024年的收入统计
introduction_en:
SF (SZSE: 002352, HKEX: 6936) was established in Shunde, Guangdong Province in 1993, and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China. Through years of development, SF has become the largest integrated logistics service provider in Asia, and the fourth largest in the world*, ranking 393rd on the Fortune Global 500 list.*
According to Frost & Sullivan Report, in terms of revenue in 2024

introduction_zh: Battlestate Games (BSG) 是一家成立于 2014 年的独立游戏开发工作室，其主要研发总部位于俄罗斯圣彼得堡。团队由在第一人称射击游戏（FPS）和硬核游戏领域拥有丰富经验的资深专业人士组成。该公司致力于打造极具沉浸感、拟真且硬核的游戏体验，以挑战传统的游戏机制。
introduction_en: Battlestate Games (BSG) is an independent game development studio founded in 2014, with its main development headquarters located in St. Petersburg, Russia. The team consists of experienced professionals with extensive backgrounds in first-person shooters (FPS) and hardcore games. The company is dedicated to creating deeply immersive, realistic, and hardcore gaming experiences that challenge conventional mechanics.

name_zh: 四三九九网络股份有限公司
introduction_zh:
四三九九网络股份有限公司（简称：4399）是国内领先的互联网休闲娱乐平台及游戏的发行商、研发商、运营商。公司主营业务为网页游戏（含休闲小游戏）、移动网络游戏的开发、发行以及互联网游戏平台的运营。
4399游戏盒是4399旗下平台，集游戏推荐、资讯、社交于一体，玩家可发表评价与心得，并直连开发者反馈建议，共建优质交流社区；同时提供新游爆料、体验服提醒、实用攻略及有趣视频，助力玩家进阶为游戏发烧友。
introduction_en:
4399 Network Co., Ltd. (abbreviated as "4399") is a leading Internet-based casual entertainment platform and a publisher, developer, and operator of games in China. The company's core business spans the development and publishing of web games (including casual mini-games) and mobile games, as well as the operation of Internet gaming platforms.
4399PlayBox is a platform under 4399 that integrates game recommendations, news, and social features. Players can post reviews, share their gameplay insights, and connect directly with developers to provide feedback, helping to build a quality community. The platform also delivers new game previews, beta test alerts, practical strategy guides, and entertaining videos — all designed to help players level up into true gaming enthusiasts.

introduction_zh:
好游快爆，隶属于厦门纯游互动科技有限公司，是一个以游戏内容驱动的“手游+PC”游戏推荐与交流平台。
我们一起品鉴精品好游，抢先体验内测新游，发现好玩、新奇、魔性、二次元游戏，关注排行榜掌握游戏市场动向。
发表游戏评价，共建高品质游戏交流社区，与千万游戏爱好者交流心得，与开发者直接沟通、反馈游戏建议BUG。
这里还有一手新游爆料信息、体验服提醒、实用攻略、游戏工具、有趣视频，助您走向游戏发烧友之路。
introduction_en:
HaoYouKuaiBao, belonging to Xiamen Chunyou Interactive Technology Co., Ltd., is a content-driven "mobile + PC" game recommendation and communication platform.
Together, we appreciate premium good games, get early access to experience closed beta new games, discover fun, novel, addictive, and ACG games, and follow the leaderboards to grasp game market trends.
Publish game reviews to jointly build a high-quality game exchange community, exchange insights with tens of millions of game lovers, and directly communicate with developers to feedback game suggestions and bugs.
Here are also first-hand new game scoop information, test server reminders, practical guides, game tools, and interesting videos, helping you on your path to becoming a game enthusiast.

introduction_zh: 韩国文化产业振兴院支持广播、游戏、音乐、时尚、动画、卡通形象、漫画、IP及新技术融合内容等领域的企划、制作、流通、海外拓展、企业培育、人才培养、研发、政策金融与研究。通过K-Contents成长及与产业界、相关机构、区域机构合作，推动韩国成为文化强国
introduction_en:
Korea Creative Content Agency (KOCCA) supports production, planning, creation, distribution, overseas expansion, business growth, training, R&D, policy financing, and policy study of many different genres, including broadcasting, video game, music, fashion, animation, character, comics, IP, new technology convergence content.

KOCCA is dedicated to promote the welfare of the people by turning Korea into a major player in the content industry worldwide.

KOCCA plans to systemically and strategically support the industrial infrastructures by closely working with stakeholders, relevant organizations, and local promotion centers.

introduction_zh: ACT Games 致力于通过差异化的游戏体验，连接全球 IP 粉丝群体。
introduction_en: ACT Games creates differentiated gaming experience that connect IP fanbase.

introduction_zh: 这是一家来自韩国的独立游戏工作室，凭借下载量超过 170 万次的《KALPA》，重新定义节奏动作游戏类型。
introduction_en: Korean indie studio behind KALPA (1.7M+), redefining the rhythm-action genre.

introduction_zh: NDEV GAMES 致力于打造不受边界限制、人人都能享受的游戏体验。
introduction_en: NDEV GAMES, striving to create games that anyone can enjoy without boundaries.

introduction_zh: 这是一家拥有丰富 PC 游戏开发经验的全球化游戏公司。
introduction_en: A global game company with extensive experience in PC development.

introduction_zh: 专注于打造轻松治愈系移动游戏的开发商，代表作品包括《Forest Island》和《Tiny Cafe》。
introduction_en: Relaxing mobile game developer. Creators of Forest Island & Tiny Cafe.

introduction_zh: 汇聚韩国顶尖游戏人才，致力于打造世界级游戏开发公司。
introduction_en: Gathering the top talent of Korea to create a world-class game developer.

introduction_zh: 宁可作为原创而失败，也不愿作为模仿者而成功。
introduction_en: Better to fail as an original than succeed as an imitation.

introduction_zh: Hypercent 是一家引领游戏趋势、以成果证明实力，并快速拓展全球市场的游戏工作室。
introduction_en: Hypercent is a game studio leading trends, proving results, and moving fast globally.

introduction_zh: Wayway Inc. 是《Aksun》的开发商，这是一款以韩国巫俗文化为题材的动作 Roguelike 游戏。
introduction_en: Wayway Inc. develops the Korean shamanism action roguelike Aksun.

introduction_zh: 这是一家面向全球市场、屡获殊荣的独立游戏 IP 开发商。
introduction_en: Award-winning indie game IP developer targeting global markets.

introduction_zh: 百度智能云于2015年正式对外开放运营，已成为人工智能、大数据和云计算服务的领先提供商，并连续六年位列AI公有云服务国内市场份额第一名。2020年，百度智能云率先提出“云智一体”战略，为客户提供高效的异构算力基础设施“百度百舸AI计算平台”、强大的文心大模型、易用的一站式大模型平台“百度千帆大模型平台”、以及丰富的AI原生应用样板间和行业解决方案，全力赋能千行百业，加速推进产业智能化。
introduction_en:
Founded in 2015, Baidu AI Cloud has become a leading provider of artificial intelligence, big data, and cloud computing services. For six consecutive years, Baidu AI Cloud has held the largest share of China’s AI public cloud market.
As generative AI gained momentum in 2023, Baidu AI Cloud introduced the AI-Native Stack—a comprehensive suite that combines the high-performance Baidu Baige AI Computing Platform, the powerful ERNIE Foundation Model, and the Qianfan Foundation Model Platform for developing and deploying AI models and agents from prototype to production. Our mission is to empower industries at scale, accelerate the progress of industrial intelligence, and fuel innovation and growth across the economy.

name_zh: 哔哩哔哩游戏/碳酸小队
introduction_zh:
关于哔哩哔哩游戏
根植于哔哩哔哩独特的社群文化，哔哩哔哩游戏已成为游戏界中最具影响力的品牌之一。秉持着推动创意与玩家互动的精神，哔哩哔哩游戏持续推出引人入胜的游戏作品，吸引了全球各地的玩家。不论是充满幻想的游戏世界，还是沉浸式的游玩体验，这个品牌不断为广大且多元的玩家社群带来深刻的游戏体验。
introduction_en:
About BILIBILI GAME
Rooted in the unique community culture of Bilibili, BILIBILI GAME has become one of the most recognized and influential names in gaming. Dedicated to fostering creativity and player engagement, BILIBILI GAME consistently introduces compelling titles that captivate audiences across the globe. From imaginative fantasy realms to immersive gameplay, the brand continues to deliver standout experiences that resonate with a diverse gaming community worldwide.

introduction_zh: 东京电玩展（TOKYO GAME SHOW，简称TGS） 是全球最具影响力的电子游戏盛会之一，既是游戏厂商发布新品与技术的前沿阵地，也是全球玩家一年一度的热切期盼。2026年，TGS将迎来意义非凡的第30届盛会，定于9月17日至21日举办。为庆祝这一里程碑，展期首次由4天扩展至5天，其中9月17–18日为商务洽谈日，19–21日面向公众开放
introduction_en: TOKYO GAME SHOW(TGS) is one of the world's most influential video game events—a premier platform for publishers to unveil new titles and technologies, and a highly anticipated annual occasion for gamers worldwide. In 2026, TGS will mark a significant milestone with its 30th edition, scheduled to take place from September 17 to 21. To celebrate this landmark anniversary, the exhibition period will be extended for the first time from four days to five days, with September 17–18 designated as Business Days and September 19–21 open to the general public.

introduction_zh: 白日梦境工作室成立于 2024 年，由一群热爱游戏、拥有成熟项目经验的开发者组成。团队成员曾参与多个业内知名商业项目，也经历过头部厂商的研发与发行环境。在长期行业实践后，团队重新回到创作初心，希望打造真正能够承载情感表达与个人记忆的作品。
introduction_en:
Founded in 2024, Daydream Studio is made up of a group of developers who share a deep passion for games and bring with them extensive experience in delivering established projects.
 Its team members have contributed to a number of well-known commercial titles and have worked within the development and publishing environments of leading game companies.
After years of working across the industry, the team chose to return to the original intention of creation — to make games that can truly carry emotional expression and personal memories.

name_zh: 汉诺威米兰展览（上海）有限公司
introduction_zh: 汉诺威米兰展览（上海）有限公司作为世界领先会展组织者德国汉诺威展览公司和意大利米兰国际展览公司的合资在华子公司，已深耕中国市场30多年。公司每年在中国境内组织近30场贸易展览会，主题涵盖工业制造、物流、汽车、旅游、地面铺装和应急救援等，同时邀请优质的中国企业前往海外参加总部旗下涉及20余个主题10多个国家的50多场专业展会。
introduction_en:
Adhering to principal of “holding brand fairs, showcasing state-of-the-art technique; emphasizing to promote advanced application-oriented technologies, releasing the latest innovative products”, Hannover Milano Fairs is committed to bringing impressive experiences to each customer motivated by an array of considerate services before, during and after show to yield their best returns.
With years of exploration and development in Chinese market, Hannover Milano Fairs has obtained quite a lot of experience in successfully running top-level international fairs as well as established a good relationship with Chinese associations and institutes, which paves the grounds for its further achievements.

name_zh: 杭州电魂网络科技股份有限公司
name_en: Hangzhou Electronic Soul Network Technology Co.,Ltd
introduction_zh: 杭州电魂网络科技股份有限公司成立于2008年，是一家集游戏研发、游戏发行、赛事运营、投融资及孵化业务于一体的创新型数字文娱企业。目前已在日本、新加坡、澳洲等多个国家和中国香港地区成立子公司，致力于打造一条完整的动漫游戏产业生态链。2016年10月26日，电魂网络在上海证券交易所发行股票并上市（电魂网络，603258）。2021年，电魂网络旗下产品《梦三国2》正式入选杭州亚运会电子竞技比赛项目。
introduction_en:
Hangzhou Electronic Soul Network Technology Co., Ltd. , Founded in 2008,is an innovative digital entertainment company, integrating game R&D and publishing, esports event operations, investment and financing, and
incubation services. The company has now set up subsidiaries in multiple countries and regions, including Hong Kong (China), Japan, Singapore, and Australia, expanding its global market presence and committed to building a complete ecosystem for the animation and gaming industry.On October 26, 2016, Electronic Soul successfully listed on the Shanghai Stock Exchange (Stock Code: 603258). In 2021, "Dream Three Kingdoms 2" was selected as an eSports event for the 2022 Hangzhou Asian Games.

name_zh: 上海织裁者网络科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 因热爱游戏而聚，我们是一家专注创新的女性向游戏工作室。我们迷恋神明题材的神秘浪漫，热衷于将古今美学巧妙碰撞，为你编织跨越时空的绮丽梦境。打破传统框架，只为给你不一样的心动体验。在这里，每一次创新都是对热爱的致敬，期待与你共赴这场浪漫冒险！
introduction_en: Brought together by a shared passion for gaming, we are a studio dedicated to innovating the female-oriented gaming space. Captivated by the mysterious romance of deities, we love blending ancient and modern aesthetics to weave enchanting dreams that transcend time and space. By breaking traditional molds, we strive to bring you a unique, heart-fluttering experience. Here, every innovation is a tribute to our passion. We can't wait to embark on this romantic adventure with you!

name_zh: 北京库兰织梦科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 北京库兰织梦科技有限公司的核心产品是Funloom AI，这是一款面向内容创作者的 AI 内容共创平台，载体包括文字、图片、音乐、视频和游戏，最先选择文游作为切入口，并逐步解决剧情、数值、视觉、交互等原子能力，将模态从文游升级到更多模态的RPG，同时延展出小说、短剧、互动影游等内容。它试图降低内容制作中的技术门槛，让创作者不必依赖专业技术，也能将创意快速转化为可体验的文化作品。
introduction_en: Beijing Kurangames Technology Co., Ltd. launches Funloom AI as its flagship AI collaborative content creation platform tailored for creators. It supports multi-media content production across text, images, music, video and games.The company debuted with text-based narrative games and has gradually built core foundational capabilities in plot writing, numerical tuning, visual design and interactive systems. It now expands its business scope from text games to full multi-modal RPGs, and extends its layout to derivative content such as novels, short dramas and interactive cinematic games.Funloom AI effectively lowers the technical barriers of content creation.

introduction_zh: 华为游戏中心是华为官方游戏社区与下载平台，集结了众多热爱游戏的玩家。
introduction_en: HUAWEI GameCenter is a Huawei official game community and download platform, which brings together many players who love games.

name_zh: 网易（杭州）网络有限公司
introduction_zh: 网易2001年正式成立在线游戏事业部，现已跻身全球七大游戏公司之一。作为中国领先的游戏开发公司，网易一直处于网络游戏自主研发领域的前端。目前正在运营中的游戏有100余款，自主研发了梦幻西游IP、大话西游IP、《燕云十六声》、《蛋仔派对》、《逆水寒》、《永劫无间》等数十款热门游戏。网易游戏近年来在海外市场持续迎来重大突破，包括《漫威争锋》《第五人格》等多款产品均在全球多个地区取得了不俗的口碑和成绩。
introduction_en: NetEase Games, the online games division of NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ: NTES and HKEX: 9999), is a leading global developer and publisher of video game IP across a variety of genres and platforms. NetEase Games' development and publishing slate include titles such as Marvel Rivals, Knives Out, and Naraka: Bladepoint, and partnerships with major entertainment brands such as Warner Bros and Mojang AB (a Microsoft subsidiary). NetEase Games also supports the growth and development of its innovative global studios in Canada, Europe, Japan and the United States.

name_zh: 上海网之易网络科技发展有限公司
introduction_zh:
关于暴雪娱乐
暴雪娱乐有限公司凭借其《魔兽世界®》、《守望先锋®》、《暗黑破坏神®》与《星际争霸®》等多个具有代表性的游戏宇宙而闻名于世。作为被微软收购的动视暴雪旗下子公司，暴雪娱乐是全球娱乐软件的知名开发商和出版商之一，在过去30年曾打造了多款备受业界好评且开创游戏类型的作品，并获得多项“年度游戏大奖”殊荣。
introduction_en:
​About Blizzard Entertainment​
​Best known for iconic video game universes including Warcraft®, Overwatch®, Diablo®, and StarCraft®, Blizzard Entertainment, ​​Inc. a division of Activision Blizzard, which was ​​recently ​​acquired by Microsoft, is a premier developer and publisher of entertainment experiences. Blizzard Entertainment has created some of the industry's most critically acclaimed and genre-defining games over the last 30 years, with a track record that includes multiple Game of the Year awards.​

name_zh: 比亚迪汽车销售有限公司
introduction_zh: 比亚迪掌握电池、电机、电控等新能源汽车全产业链核心技术，从自主创新到全面开放创新，持续引领全球新能源汽车变革。比亚迪新能源汽车运营足迹，已遍及全球100多个国家和地区、400多个城市，持续为全球消费者提供绿色技术和产品。
introduction_en: BYD has mastered the core technologies for the whole industry chain of new energy vehicles in terms of battery, motors, and controllers. Carving a path from independent innovation to all-round and open-minded innovation, BYD keeps leading the accelerated global reform of new energy vehicles. The operating footprints of BYD new energy vehicles have covered more than 400 cities in more than 100 countries and regions around the world, continuously providing green technologies and products to global consume.

introduction_zh: 作为全球知名的显示方案综合服务商，HKC惠科拥有四条技术特点各有侧重的G8.6TFT-LCD高世代产线和一条G5.5OLED时世代线，目前已实现电视、显示器、笔电、平板电脑、手机、车载、工控等多种应用场显示面板的量产出货，并不断拓展电子纸、医疗、户外显示屏等新应用领域。
introduction_en: As a globally renowned integrated service provider of display solutions, HKC boasts four G8.6 TFT-LCD high-generation production lines with distinct technical features and one G5.5 OLED generation line. Currently, it has achieved mass production and shipment of display panels for various applications including TVs, monitors, laptops, tablet computers, mobile phones, automotive displays, and industrial controls, and is continuously expanding into new application areas such as electronic paper, medical, and outdoor displays.

name_zh: 浙江闲趣互娱网络科技有限公司
name_en: Zhejiang Xianqu Interactive Entertainment Network Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh:
996传奇盒子是一款多经典怀旧游戏聚合平台，拥有《热血传奇》《传奇世界》《热血江湖》国内独家正版IP授权。
平台每日稳定开新服，在线千款精品版本，涵盖1.76复古、微变、合击、火龙、超变、沉默等主流玩法。并支持电脑、手机、平板等实时多端互通，集成游戏、社区、直播、电竞、语音、云手机、小说、短剧、周边等多元生态，一站式满足玩家找服、玩服、社交、娱乐等需求。
introduction_en:
996 Legend Box is a game aggregation platform for classic nostalgic MMORPGs. It holds exclusive official licenses in mainland China for Legend of Mir, The Legend of Mir 2, and Hero Online, bringing together iconic IPs including Mir, Mir World, Mir 3, and Hero Online.

The platform features thousands of game servers with new servers launched daily, covering popular gameplay styles such as Classic, Micro-Variant, Combo, Fire Dragon, Super-Variant, and Silent. It supports seamless cross-platform play across PC, mobile phones, and tablets, while integrating games, community, live streaming, esports, voice chat, cloud AFK, novels, short dramas, and merchandise into one ecosystem, offering players a comprehensive gaming and entertainment experience.

introduction_zh: 朝夕光年是字节跳动旗下游戏业务品牌。作为面向用户与开发者的游戏研发与发行公司，朝夕光年致力于服务全球玩家，通过提供优质游戏和打造玩家社群，为每位玩家带来有趣和激励人心的体验。本次2026 ChinaJoy朝夕光年携旗下蓝海工作室、Zero36工作室、绿洲工作室、Glow工作室、江南工作室、Neon、心光工作室共12款游戏强势集结，提供内容多元、玩法丰富的游戏体验。
introduction_en:
Nuverse is ByteDance’s gaming business brand. As a game development and publishing company serving both players and developers, Nuverse is committed to connecting with players around the world by delivering high-quality games and building vibrant player communities, bringing every player fun, engaging, and inspiring experiences.
At ChinaJoy 2026, Nuverse will make a strong appearance with 12 games from its studio matrix, including Bluesea Studio, Zero36 Studio, Oasis Studio, Glow Studio, JNG Studio, Neon, and Inner Spark, offering players a diverse portfolio of games across multiple genres and gameplay experiences.

name_zh: 厦门麟贝互娱科技有限公司
name_en: Xiamen Linbei Interactive Entertainment Technology Co.,LTD
introduction_zh: “麟”取自麒麟，是中国传统文化中的瑞兽，象征仁厚、祥瑞与守护；“贝”则是最早的货币，代表珍贵与价值。两者合为“麟贝”，寓意“麒麟衔贝，赐福娱乐新时代”——就像祥瑞之兽衔来珍宝，我们希望把最珍贵、最美好的游戏体验带给每一位玩家，为大家的娱乐时光送上祝福与惊喜，持续创新的玩法设计、细腻温暖的内容表达,为玩家提供释放压力、治愈心灵的数字空间,让游戏成为点亮日常生活的微光。
introduction_en:
“Lin” is derived from *qilin*, a mythical auspicious creature in traditional Chinese culture that symbolizes benevolence, good fortune, and protection. “Bei” refers to the earliest form of currency in China, representing preciousness and value.
Together, “Linbei” conveys the vision of “a qilin bearing treasures, bringing blessings to a new era of entertainment.” Like this auspicious creature carrying precious gifts, we hope to bring every player the most valuable and joyful gaming experiences, filling their leisure time with warmth, surprise, and delight.
Through continuous innovation in gameplay and thoughtful, heartfelt content, Linbei creates a digital space where players can unwind, find comfort, and heal. We believe games can be a small light that brightens everyday life.

name_zh: 浙江卡游动漫有限公司
introduction_zh: 卡游是中国泛娱乐产品行业中最具影响力的品牌之一，坚守“品质·乐趣”发展理念，以智造为驱动，是深耕动漫、创意文具产业的文化创新公司。
introduction_en: Kayou is one of the most influential brands in China’s pan-entertainment products industry. Guided by its philosophy of “Quality & Fun” and driven by intelligent manufacturing, Kayou is a cultural innovation company dedicated to the anime and creative stationery industries.

introduction_zh: Monster Energy魔爪能量，来自加利福尼亚，风靡全球的能量饮料品牌，以前卫、神秘、打破常规的独特生活方式作为其品牌主张。2016年登陆中国市场。“魔爪能量更带劲”，正如品牌主张一样，Monster Energy魔爪能量一直专注于极限运动（滑雪、冲浪、滑板、BMX，UFC等）、赛车/机车运动（F1、 MotoGP、MX、RX等）、音乐、电子竞技领域的文化发展。
introduction_en:
Sometimes you just need that boost, that push, that focus… that punch of energy to get you going. You need Monster. 
At Monster, we do things differently — because Monster Energy is not just a drink. It’s a lifestyle in a can.  
We support the scene, our bands, our athletes and our fans.  We back athletes so they can make a career out of their passion.  We promote concert tours, so our favorite bands can visit your hometown.  We celebrate with our fans and riders by throwing parties and making the coolest events we can think of a reality.  Monster Energy — Unleash the Beast!

introduction_zh: 世纪华通（002602）成立于2005年，2011年7月在深交所挂牌上市。公司以汽车零配件业务为起点，2014年启动向互联网游戏产业的战略升级与转型，现旗下拥有点点互动、盛趣游戏、天游软件、世纪珑腾等核心子公司，拥有互联网游戏、人工智能云数据、汽车零部件制造三大核心主营业务，同时拓展人工智能应用与开发、创新科技产业投资等多元业务领域。公司稳居A股游戏行业第一，并逐步迈入全球游戏行业第一阵营。
introduction_en: Zhejiang Century Huatong Group Co., Ltd. (stock code: 002602, referred to as "Century Huatong") was established in 2005 and was successfully listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange in July 2011.Starting with the auto parts business, the Company began its transformation to the Internet game industry in 2014, and acquired Shengqu Games (formerly Shengda Games) with 29.8 billion yuan in 2019, and is now a top-ranked A-share listed company in the culture and media sector, with Tencent and OCT as its major shareholders, and online games, auto parts manufacturing, cloud data, , artificial intelligence, meta-universe platform and application development and investment as its main businesses.

name_zh: TCL科技集团股份有限公司
introduction_zh: TCL以“领先科技 和合共生”为使命，致力于为用户带来前瞻性科技体验和智慧健康生活，通过TCL实业与TCL科技两个产业集团，布局智能终端、半导体显示、新能源光伏等核心产业。2025年TCL电视出货量全球第二，Mini LED电视出货量全球第一；TCL华星电竞显示屏及LTPS笔电、LTPS平板产品市占率全球第一；TCL中环光伏硅片市占率全球第一。
introduction_en: TCL is dedicated to "Inspiring and Embracing the Future through Leading Technology," delivering forward-looking tech experiences and intelligent healthy living. Through TCL Industries and TCL Technology, TCL focuses on smart devices, semiconductor displays, and renewable energy photovoltaics. In 2025, TCL ranked second globally in TV shipments and first in Mini LED TV shipments. TCL CSOT ranked first globally in gaming monitors, LTPS laptops, and LTPS tablets. TCL Zhonghuan ranked first globally in photovoltaic wafer market share.

name_zh: 腾讯科技（深圳）有限公司
introduction_zh: 腾讯游戏成立于2003年，是全球领先的游戏研发和运营商。作为“超级数字场景”理念的倡导者和实践者，腾讯游戏高度关注和重视未成年人的健康发展，并致力于通过技术创新、创意激发、产学研结合、全球化布局，以及公益实践等方式，推动游戏成为助推前沿科技发展、优秀文化弘扬、创新人才孵化、社会公益增效的重要驱动力，为产业和社会的发展创造更多突破性与建设性的价值。
introduction_en: Tencent Games, founded in 2003, is the world's leading game developer and operator. As an advocate and practitioner of the concept of "Hyper Digital Reality", Tencent Games pays high attention to and attaches great importance to the healthy development of minors, and is committed to promoting the game as an important driving force to promote the development of cutting-edge technology, promote the promotion of excellent culture, incubate innovative talents, and increase the efficiency of social public welfare through technological innovation, creative stimulation, combination of production, education and research, global layout, and public welfare practice, Create more breakthrough and constructive value for the development of industry and society.

name_zh: 咪咕互动娱乐有限公司
introduction_zh: 咪咕互动娱乐有限公司是中国移动旗下负责全国游戏业务的专业子公司。作为国有数字内容科技创新平台，咪咕互娱坚持以打造高品质益智健康游戏社区为目标，紧密围绕移动游戏、设施游戏、游戏电竞三大业务板块，致力打造高质感手机游戏社区平台、跨屏跨端 PC 游戏分发平台、全场景电竞赛事服务商与全品牌电竞厅店运营商，为用户提供高品质、有趣、有伴的游戏社区，为行业提供专业、可靠、开放的全场景游戏服务平台。
introduction_en: Migu Interactive Entertainment Co., Ltd. a wholly owned subsidiary of China Mobile, serves as the group's national hub for gaming operations. As a state-owned digital content tech innovation platform, Migu Interactive is committed to creating a building a premium gaming community centered on intellectually stimulating entertainment. Our business spans three core pillars: mobile gaming, PC/console gaming, and esports, driving the development of a high-end mobile gaming community platform, a cross-device PC game distribution network, a full-scenario esports event service provider, and a comprehensive esports venue operator. We deliver users a vibrant, social, and high-quality gaming experience, while offering the industry a professional, reliable, and open full-scenario service ecosystem.

introduction_zh: 骁龙（Snapdragon）是高通公司（Qualcomm）打造的业界领先的旗舰SoC平台，为智能手机、平板、笔记本电脑、智能汽车、XR终端、可穿戴等多元设备提供芯片及系统级软件支持，从手机到汽车，骁龙让万物互联更智能、更高效。
introduction_en: Snapdragon, an industry-leading flagship SoC platform developed by Qualcomm, provides chips and system-level software support for a wide range of devices, including smartphones, tablets, laptops, smart vehicles, XR devices, and wearables etc. From mobile phones to automobiles, Snapdragon makes connectivity across everything smarter and more efficient.

introduction_zh:
"小米集团成立于2010年4月，2018年7月9日在中国香港交易所主板挂牌上市(1810.HK)，是一家以智能手机、智能硬件和IoT平台为核心的消费电子及智能制造公司。
胸怀“和用户交朋友，做用户心中最酷的公司”的愿景，小米致力于持续创新，不断追求极致的产品服务体验和公司运营效率，努力践行“始终坚持做感动人心、价格厚道的好产品，让全球每个人都能享受科技带来的美好生活”的公司使命。"
introduction_en:
Xiaomi Corporation was founded in April 2010 and listed on the Main Board of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange on July 9, 2018 (1810.HK). Xiaomi is a consumer electronics and smart manufacturing company with smartphones and smart hardware connected by an IoT platform at its core. 

Embracing our vision of “Make friends with users and be the coolest company in the users’ hearts”, Xiaomi continuously pursues innovations, high-quality user experience and operational efficiency. The company relentlessly builds amazing products with honest prices to let everyone in the world enjoy a better life through innovative technology.

name_zh: 广东欧加通信科技有限公司
name_en: Guangdong Oplus Telecommunications Technology Corp., Ltd.
introduction_zh:
一加手机
OPPO旗下主打性能的先锋品牌。
为用户打造拥有强悍性能、极致游戏体验、无负担设计的产品和诚意服务，让每一个人在生活、游戏和学习中随时激发高能状态，解锁无限可能。
introduction_en:
OnePlus
A pioneering performance-focused brand under OPPO.
We create products that combine powerful performance, an ultimate gaming experience, and a burden-free design with sincere services, empowering everyone to unleash a high-energy state anytime in life, gaming, or learning, and unlock infinite possibilities.

name_zh: 中国联合网络通信集团有限公司
name_en: China United Network Communications Group Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 中国联通在国内31个省（自治区、直辖市）和境外多个国家和地区设有分支机构，拥有覆盖全国、通达世界的现代通信网络和全球客户服务体系，在2025年《财富》世界500强中位列第269位。作为支撑党政军系统、各行各业、广大人民群众的基础通信企业，中国联通在国民经济中具有基础性、支柱性、战略性、先导性的基本功能与地位作用，具有技术密集、全程全网、规模经济、服务经济社会与民生的特征与属性。
introduction_en: China Unicom has established branches in 31 provinces (autonomous regions and municipalities directly under the central government) across China, as well as in multiple countries and regions around the world. It operates a modern communications network that spans the nation and connects the globe, supported by a worldwide customer service system. In 2025, it was ranked 269th on the Fortune Global 500 list. As a foundational communications enterprise serving the Party, government, military systems, various industries, and the general public, China Unicom plays a fundamental, pillar, strategic, and pioneering role in the national economy. It features technology intensity, end-to-end and whole-network operations, economies of scale, and serves the economy, society, and people’s livelihoods.

introduction_zh: 京东集团定位于“以供应链为基础的技术与服务企业”，目前业务已涉及零售、科技、物流、健康、工业、产发和国际等领域。作为同时具备实体企业基因和属性、拥有数字技术和能力的新型实体企业，京东集团所有的业务都围绕供应链展开。依托超级供应链，京东不仅保障自身供应链稳定可靠，也带动产业链上下游合作伙伴数字化转型和降本增效，更好服务实体经济高质量发展。
introduction_en: JD.com is a leading supply chain-based technology and service provider. The company’s cutting-edge retail infrastructure seeks to enable consumers to buy whatever they want, whenever and wherever they want it. The company has opened its technology and infrastructure to partners, brands and other sectors, as part of its Retail as a Service offering to help drive productivity and innovation across a range of industries.

name_zh: 维沃移动通信有限公司
introduction_zh: iQOO作为vivo旗下子品牌，创立于2019年。iQOO品牌聚焦性能与设计赛道，致力于成为在意高性能和电竞游戏体验消费者的首选品牌。目前品牌业务已覆盖主流电商平台，并与vivo共享部分线下渠道。
introduction_en: iQOO is a sub-brand of vivo, founded in 2019. iQOO focuses on performance and design, and is committed to becoming the top choice of consumers who are passionate about performance and gaming. Currently, the brand's business covers all mainstream e-commerce platforms and shares offline channels with vivo.

name_zh: 荣耀终端股份有限公司
introduction_zh: 作为全球领先的 AI 终端生态公司，荣耀致力于变革人机交互方式。在 AI 智能体时代，我们专注于构建 AI 生态系统与广大消费者之间的紧密联系，通过开放、共创、共享不断拓展产业边界，与合作伙伴携手构建 AI 生态。凭借涵盖智能手机、个人电脑、平板电脑、可穿戴设备等多元化的创新产品组合，荣耀旨在赋能每一位用户，让每个人都能轻松踏入并享受崭新的智能世界。
introduction_en: HONOR is a global leading AI device ecosystem company. It is committed to revolutionizing human-to-device interactions to bridge the AI ecosystem with all consumers in the agentic AI era and beyond. The company endeavors to open industrial boundaries through open, seamless collaboration to co-create a value-sharing ecosystem with industry partners. With an innovative product portfolio spanning AI phones, PCs, tablets, wearables and more, HONOR aims to empower every human, enabling everyone to embrace the new intelligent world.

introduction_zh: 红魔专注专业电竞硬件赛道，秉持 “Win More Games” 核心理念，深耕移动电竞领域。品牌自研全域散热系统、高刷电竞触控屏、实体游戏肩键等核心技术，搭配旗舰芯片与专属游戏引擎，高负载场景稳定不降频。产品线涵盖电竞手机、电竞平板、游戏笔记本及配套外设，打造完整移动电竞生态。凭借硬核性能、机甲潮流外观与深度游戏调校，深受硬核玩家、职业电竞选手喜爱，是全球主流专业电竞数码品牌。
introduction_en:
REDMAGIC focuses on professional esports hardware and devotes itself to mobile esports guided by its core philosophy "Win More Games". The brand independently develops core technologies including full-range cooling systems, high-refresh-rate esports touch screens and physical gaming shoulder triggers. Equipped with flagship chips and exclusive gaming engines, its products sustain steady performance without frequency reduction under heavy loads.
Its product lineup covers esports phones, gaming tablets, gaming laptops and supporting peripherals, building a complete mobile esports ecosystem. It stands as one of the world’s mainstream professional esports digital brands.

introduction_zh: 努比亚以“Be Yourself”为理念，着力打造面向年轻人群的个性化智能移动终端品牌。
introduction_en: As a cutting-edge high-end smartphone brand, nubia is focusing on bringing personalized fashion spirits for young people conveying the concept of 'Be Yourself'.

introduction_zh: BidMatrix 深耕国际移动广告领域，助力应用实现规模化、效果化增长，业务涵盖获客、再营销、CTV 投放、反作弊与AI优化等一站式服务，携手共赢业务增长。
introduction_en: BidMatrix is an international mobile ad tech company focused on performance-driven growth for mobile apps. We provide user acquisition, retargeting, CTV, anti-fraud protection, and AI-powered optimization. With advanced in-house technology and a unique traffic mix, BidMatrix helps advertisers reach high-quality users, reduce fraud risks, and improve campaign efficiency. At ChinaJoy 2026, BidMatrix will present its quality-first approach to mobile growth, including traffic verification, scalable acquisition solutions, and performance optimization designed for global app advertisers.

introduction_zh: Bidmachine 是全球领先的广告技术平台，总部位于美国，致力于通过全栈式的广告技术产品，从广告变现到买量投放，助力移动应用于游戏开发者实现可观增长。BidMachine 增长方案以 SDK 为核心，通过提供更优质、透明、信息丰富的应用内信号，让变现与投放更高效。目前，BidMachine 已与全球超 5 万应用合作，月均广告请求高达 1 万亿，美国日均广告展示超 9.6 亿。
introduction_en: Bidmachine is an SDK-first monetization and advertising platform built to increase transparency, efficiency, and performance across the mobile ecosystem. By connecting publishers, advertisers, DSPs, and agencies through clean, direct SDK integrations, Bidmachine removes unnecessary intermediaries, giving publishers greater visibility and control, and giving advertisers transparent access to verified supply.

introduction_zh: Yandex Ads 助力游戏发行商实现俄语用户市场变现，接入超过60万广告主资源、AI 驱动的优化能力，以及可靠的全球支付服务。
introduction_en: Yandex Ads helps game publishers monetize Russian-speaking audiences with access to 600K+ advertisers, AI-powered optimization, and reliable global payouts.

name_zh: 上海世全网络科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 作为行业领先、稳定可靠的一站式广告变现与服务平台，TradPlus 致力于为全球开发者提供公平、透明、高效的流量变现解决方案。TradPlus 凭借其全面的变现产品与精细化的服务，为开发者提供全球优质预算资源，帮助开发者快速实现流量控制和调配，高效而精准地匹配流量和预算，运用数据诊断与分析工具，快速做出更佳变现策略，最大化提升广告变现收益。
introduction_en: TradPlus is a leading, stable, and reliable ad monetization platform that is committed to providing global developers with fair, transparent and efficient monetization solutions. Leveraging its monetization products and services, TradPlus helps developers monetize their traffic efficiently, meanwhile, accurately conducting data analysis, quickly controlling and allocating traffic resources to adjust monetization strategies to maximize their ad revenue.

introduction_zh: Smadex 是一款 AI 驱动的程序化广告平台，致力于通过移动广告和 CTV 广告帮助游戏应用实现高 ROI 规模化增长。通过专有的深度学习模型，Smadex 能精准评估并优化每一次广告曝光的价值，为全球数千广告主带来真实可衡量的增长。
introduction_en: Smadex is a leading AI-Driven Growth Engine for Mobile and CTV, enabling app marketers to scale profitably. By valuing every impression through proprietary deep-learning models, we drive measurable performance for our customers.

name_zh: 映思软件技术（上海）有限公司
introduction_zh: 作为全球合作伙伴经济的核心引擎，impact.com通过Performance（联盟营销）、Creator（红人营销）和Advocate（推荐营销）三大核心产品矩阵，助力全球化品牌打造品效合一的全链路增长生态。平台连接40万+全球媒体，赋能近万家全球化品牌实现增长，深受TikTok Shop, eufy, Shokz, Halara, Joybuy, OpenArt, Plaud等全球化品牌信赖。
introduction_en: impact.com is the world’s leading global infrastructure for partnership-driven commerce, transforming the way businesses grow by enabling them to discover, manage, and scale partnerships across the entire customer journey.  Its award-winning products - Performance (affiliate), Creator (influencer), and Advocate (customer referral) - unify every type of partner into one integrated platform.  Today, Connecting 400,000+ global publishers and continuously empowering nearly 10,000 global brands to drive business growth, impact.com is trusted by leading global brands including TikTok Shop, eufy, Shokz, Halara, Joybuy, OpenArt, and Plaud, among others.

name_zh: 广州有容数据网络有限公司
name_en: Guangzhou Yourong Data Network Co., LTD.
introduction_zh: 广州有容数据网络有限公司，简称有容网络。公司专注APP广告商 业化变现的，可以进行广告场景设计和广告价值提升，品质化的全流程交付，为我们赢得了包括众多比如安防行业，音视频、社交行业等现象级大媒体在内的上百家媒体平台的青睐，助力开发者提高效率、降低成本、增加收益、扩大优势，深受媒体欢迎。
introduction_en: Guangzhou Yourong Data Network Co., Ltd. (shortened as Yourong Network) specializes in the commercial monetization of in-app advertisements. The company provides customized ad scenario design and ad value optimization alongside high-quality end-to-end delivery services. Our offerings have earned recognition from hundreds of media platforms, including leading flagship players across security monitoring, audio & video, social networking and other sectors. We help developers boost operational efficiency, cut operational costs, raise revenue and strengthen competitive edges, winning widespread acclaim from media partners.

introduction_zh: Pixalate专注于数字广告供应链中的隐私合规、广告作弊防护以及数据智能分析。自2012年成立以来，Pixalate平台全天候守护品牌声誉、提升流量质量，有效检测和抵御广告作弊。凭借MRC认证的专业实力，Pixalate精准检测并过滤CTV联网电视、移动应用及网页端的复杂无效流量（SIVT）。
introduction_en:
Pixalate is the market-leading MRC Accredited fraud protection, privacy, and compliance analytics platform for Connected TV (CTV), Mobile Apps, and Websites. Founded in 2012, the company helps brands, advertisers, DSPs, SSPs and publishers improve ad inventory quality across the Programmatic Ecosystem.

Ad Fraud Prevention: Detects and eliminates sophisticated and general invalid traffic (SIVT).

Privacy & Compliance: Offers tools for Children's Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) compliance and General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) standards.

CTV & Mobile Focus: Provides specialized analytics for the fast-growing Connected TV and mobile app ecosystems.
AdTech Digital Marketing company with its DSP platforms and in-house inventory.

introduction_zh: Adforce 是一家面向全球广告主与数字营销团队的数字增长服务商，核心业务涵盖广告账户服务、VCC 支付方案及 AI token调用服务。公司提供 Meta、Google、TikTok、AppLovin 等主流广告平台的账户支持与投放解决方案，并围绕广告投放、SaaS 订阅等场景提供支付能力。同时支持主流 AI 模型 API 接入与统一调用，帮助企业提升运营效率与业务增长。
introduction_en: Adforce is a digital growth solutions provider serving global advertisers and marketing teams. Its core offerings include advertising account services, VCC payment solutions, and AI model token-based consumption services. The company provides account support and campaign solutions for leading advertising platforms such as Meta, Google, TikTok, and AppLovin, while delivering payment capabilities for advertising, SaaS subscriptions, and other digital spending scenarios. Adforce also supports API access and unified integration of mainstream AI models, helping businesses improve operational efficiency and drive growth.

introduction_zh: ClickOnik Digital Media 是一家总部位于印度、并在新加坡设有区域办公室的全球绩效营销公司，专注于联盟营销、移动应用推广、程序化广告及品牌增长。我们服务游戏、金融科技、电商、旅游等行业，提供 CPA、CPI、CPL、CPC、CPM、CPS 等合作模式，依托全球媒体资源和数据优化能力，帮助客户获取高质量用户，提升品牌影响力，实现业务持续增长
introduction_en: ClickOnik Digital Media is a global performance marketing company headquartered in Singapore and India, serving advertisers, agencies, and app developers worldwide. We specialize in Affiliate Marketing, Mobile App User Acquisition, Programmatic Advertising, Lead Generation, and Brand Growth across Gaming, FinTech, E-commerce, Travel, Retail, OTT, and Lifestyle sectors. Leveraging a trusted global publisher network, premium traffic sources, and data-driven optimization, we deliver measurable results through CPA, CPI, CPL, CPC, CPM, and CPS models. With transparent reporting, dedicated account management, and scalable marketing solutions, ClickOnik helps businesses acquire high-quality users, maximize ROI, and achieve sustainable growth in global markets.

introduction_zh: Mobway致力于通过深度数据挖掘，高效匹配优质流量与优质广告主。流量覆盖中国、欧洲、北美、拉美、中东、东南亚等地区，助力广告主实现用户增长与品牌影响力。Mobway的技术团队拥有国际顶尖的数据科学专家和强大的研发能力，开发了一系列专有的优化模型，可实现高效的流量匹配、反欺诈措施，确保数据应用符合营销区域的用户隐私法规。通过大数据和人工智能技术，实现精准受众定位,提高广告转化率，减少广告浪费。
introduction_en: Mobway is committed to efficiently matching high-quality traffic with high-quality advertisers through deep data mining. Its traffic covers China, Europe, North America, Latin America, the Middle East, and Southeast Asia, helping advertisers achieve user growth and brand influence. Mobway's technical team boasts top international data science experts and strong R&D capabilities, having developed a series of proprietary optimization models to achieve efficient traffic matching, anti-fraud measures, and ensure data application complies with user privacy regulations in the marketing region. Through big data and artificial intelligence technologies, Mobway achieves precise audience targeting, improves ad conversion rates, and reduces ad waste.

introduction_zh: PayTrades汇通国际支付，精耕于中小外贸企业、出海企业、跨境电商企业的全球收付款、资金结汇、广告费支付、跨境劳务结算等领域的跨境支付平台。
introduction_en: PayTrades is a cross-border payment platform specializing in global transactions for small and medium-sized foreign trade enterprises, overseas expansion businesses, and cross-border e-commerce companies, covering areas such as international payments, foreign exchange settlement, advertising fee payments, and cross-border labor settlement.

name_zh: 北京点思传媒有限公司
introduction_zh: 北京点思传媒有限公司创立于2017年，专注于全域数字营销，致力于为广告主提供智能化、高转化的效果营销服务。以数据驱动为核心，整合全渠道优质流量资源，主营业务涵盖DSP&ADX程序化广告投放和CPA应用拉新&促活，助力于在主流广告平台实现精准获客与高效转化的同时为广告主提供智能化、高转化的效果广告解决方案。以ROI为导向，涵盖信息流广告、开屏广告、原生广告等多种形式，为广告主实现低成本获客与持续增长
introduction_en: Founded in 2017, Dance Mobi specializes in omnichannel digital marketing and is committed to providing advertisers with intelligent, high-conversion performance marketing services. With a data-driven approach at its core, Dance Mobi integrates high-quality traffic resources across all channels. Its core business includes DSP & ADX programmatic advertising and CPA-based user acquisition and engagement, helping advertisers achieve precise customer acquisition and efficient conversions on mainstream advertising platforms while providing intelligent, high-conversion performance advertising solutions. Dance Mobi offers a variety of ad formats—including feed ads, splash screen ads, and native ads—to help advertisers achieve low-cost customer acquisition and sustained growth.

name_zh: 钛动科技股份有限公司
introduction_zh: 钛动科技是一家领先的AI营销科技公司，成立于2017年，总部位于广州，专注于为全球商业增长提供效果导向的营销解决方案。公司以自研的钛极多模态大模型（MLLMs）为技术底座，通过AI原生、效果驱动的产品组合为出海企业提供从市场洞察、内容生成到广告投放与效果优化的端到端服务。2025年，公司服务超10万家广告主，覆盖电商、游戏、文娱、本地生活等行业。
introduction_en: Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Guangzhou，Tec-Do 2.0 is a leading AI martech company delivering result-centric marketing solutions for global business growth. Powered by our Tec-Chi multi-modal large language models (“MLLMs”), we deliver our end-to-end marketing solutions through a suite of AI-native, performance-driven products that restructure and autonomize mission-critical marketing processes, including market intelligence, content generation, campaign delivery and performance optimization across global media channels. In 2025, we served over 100,000 advertisers and a diversified customer base spanning e-commerce, gaming, entertainment and local commerce.

introduction_zh: 汇量科技（Mobvista，股票代码：01860）是全球领先的 AI 驱动增长平台。公司通过广告技术（Adtech）与营销科技（Martech），为全球开发者与企业客户提供覆盖用户获取、效果归因、创意自动化及流量变现的全链路解决方案，助力客户实现可衡量的增长与商业回报。了解更多，请访问 www.mobvista.cn
introduction_en: Mobvista (HKEX: 1860) is the leading AI-powered growth platform that provides developers and businesses worldwide with end-to-end capabilities spanning user acquisition, attribution, creative automation, and monetization. Through its advertising and marketing technology solutions, Mobvista helps clients achieve measurable growth and maximize business outcomes. For more information, visit: www.mobvista.com

name_zh: 北京美数信息科技有限公司（美数科技）
introduction_zh: 美数科技成立于 2014 年，是国家级高新技术企业、“双软”认证企业和专精特新企业。自主研发了 AI 驱动的全栈平台产品：广告主增长平台产品、开发者变现平台产品，以及智能交易与增长平台产品，为【广告主】与【开发者】提供高效率、高收益、高安全的精准营销与商业化变现解决方案，满足合作伙伴所有业务需求。
introduction_en: Founded in 2014, AdMate is a national high-tech enterprise, double-software certified enterprise and specialized, sophisticated, distinctive and innovative enterprise.AdMate has independently developed AI-driven full-stack platform products, including advertiser growth platforms, developer monetization platforms and intelligent trading & growth platforms. We deliver efficient, high-yield and secure precise marketing and commercial monetization solutions for advertisers and developers, fully meeting all business demands of our partners.

name_zh: 上海拓布拉信息技术服务有限公司
introduction_zh: Taboola成立于2007年，总部位于美国纽约，2021年于纳斯达克上市。旗下效果广告平台Realize凭借独家第一方数据与领先AI技术，帮助广告主精准搜索与社媒之外的增量新客，实现规模化增长。目前全球数万家企业通过Realize投放广告，每日触达超6亿活跃用户，覆盖NBC News、Yahoo、Apple News等全球优质媒体，三星、小米等头部设备厂商亦采用Taboola技术扩大触达与营收。
introduction_en:
Taboola empowers businesses to grow through performance advertising technology that goes beyond search and social and delivers measurable outcomes at scale.

Taboola works with thousands of businesses who advertise directly on Realize, Taboola’s powerful ad platform, reaching approximately 600M daily active users across some of the best publishers in the world. Publishers like NBC News, Yahoo, and OEMs such as Samsung, Xiaomi and others use Taboola’s technology to grow audience and revenue, enabling Realize to offer unique data, specialized algorithms, and unmatched scale.

name_zh: 南瓜科技(香港)有限公司
introduction_zh: Pumpkin Technology提供先进的程序化广告技术平台，可帮助发布商提升效率，增加收入。我们可通过展示广告和视频广告，为网站、应用、移动设备和联网电视提供高级变现解决方案，包括技术支持、界面优化，以及可轻松集成热门移动应用需求来源的一体化 SDK。此外，我们还可利用专有的视频播放器，通过 HTML5 游戏、AdSense 搜索广告和 AI 生成的视频内容为发布商提供新的收入来源。
introduction_en:
Pumpkin Technology offers an advanced programmatic advertising technology platform to help publishers boost efficiency and maximize revenue.
We deliver premium monetization solutions for websites, mobile applications, mobile devices and connected TVs via display and video ads, including technical support, interface optimization, and all-in-one SDKs that enable seamless integration with mainstream mobile app demand sources.
In addition, leveraging our proprietary video player, we help publishers unlock new revenue streams through HTML5 games, AdSense search ads and AI-generated video content.

name_zh: 天津大序初放网络科技有限公司
