introduction_zh: PolyCell是一站式海外广告代投与可试玩广告定制服务商。公司专注于为出海企业提供一站式海外广告代投与可试玩广告定制服务，自主研发轻量化H5可玩广告引擎及智能投放研判模型，打通Facebook、Google、TikTok等主流海外渠道，是业内领先的"先体验、后下载"转化模式先行者。秉承数据驱动、务实长效的投放理念，助力中国企业实现品牌与业绩双增长。
introduction_en: PolyCell is a one-stop overseas advertising placement and playable ad customization service provider. The company focuses on providing one-stop overseas advertising placement and playable ad customization services for companies going abroad, independently developing a lightweight H5 playable ad engine and intelligent delivery evaluation model, connecting mainstream overseas channels such as Facebook, Google, and TikTok, and is an industry-leading pioneer of the "experience first, download later" conversion model. Adhering to a data-driven and pragmatic long-term delivery philosophy, it helps Chinese companies achieve growth in both brand and performance.

introduction_zh: MEGAXUS INFOTECH 是印度尼西亚领先的游戏企业，自2006年成立以来专注于游戏发行、运营及相关服务。公司已成功发行12款PC网游、17款手游及1款主机游戏，累计用户超过2500万。凭借丰富的市场经验与本地化运营能力，MEGAXUS 致力于将优质游戏推广至印度尼西亚、东南亚及全球市场，覆盖手机、PC和主机平台。
introduction_en:
MEGAXUS INFOTECH is a leading game company based in Indonesia, delivering comprehensive gaming solutions since 2006. With a strong track record that includes publishing 12 PC online games, 17 mobile games, and one console game, MEGAXUS has built a loyal user base of over 25 million players.

With a strong market presence, MEGAXUS looks for and publishes promising games for the Indonesian, Southeast Asian, and global markets on mobile, PC, and console platforms.

In addition to publishing, MEGAXUS offers Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) services tailored for the gaming industry. These include game development across categories such as entertainment games, serious games, simulations, as well as game channeling services and other game-related support.

name_zh: 香港超帆科技有限公司
introduction_zh: Supermobi是一家关于出海互联网的企业，拥有成熟的资金、流量和中台能力，以工具、社交、游戏发行为主要赛道的创新项目孵化平台。以技术数据驱动引领广告浪潮，借助多功能策划方案提供客户的参与度和广告收入。同时为不同类型的受众群体和不同的地区开发高质量的游戏、视频等移动增值服务，为众多CPA/CPI/CPL客户提供高质量的facebook、google、In-app等流量。
introduction_en: Supermobi It is an internet company focused on overseas expansion, possessing mature funding, traffic, and middleware capabilities. It is an innovative project incubation platform with tools, social networking, and game publishing as its main tracks. We lead the advertising trend with technology and data, and enhance client engagement and advertising revenue through multifunctional planning solutions. We also develop high-quality mobile value-added services such as games and videos for different audiences and regions, providing high-quality traffic from Facebook,Google, and in-app platforms to numerous CPA/CPI/CPL clients.

introduction_zh: 作为全球化一站式效果营销生态平台，Doro Mobile始终致力于连接全球优质用户资源，为广告主、开发者及媒体伙伴提供覆盖用户获取、流量变现与效果增长的全链路营销解决方案。依托覆盖全球多个国家和地区的优质流量网络，以及丰富的行业合作经验，Doro Mobile持续帮助合作伙伴拓展市场边界，释放增长价值。
introduction_en:
Doro Mobile is a global one-stop performance marketing platform that delivers comprehensive, end-to-end growth solutions for advertisers, developers, and media partners. Covering the entire marketing journey—from user acquisition and traffic monetization to performance optimization—we help businesses achieve scalable and sustainable growth.

Leveraging a premium global traffic network with extensive worldwide coverage, combined with deep industry expertise, Doro Mobile empowers partners to expand into new markets, reach high-value audiences, and unlock sustainable, long-term growth.

introduction_zh: 八度音创Octave music提供各式高品质音乐製作服务，具备跨国音乐製作实力与众多游戏/品牌合作！从配音、配乐、音效、主题曲，全流程定制服务！适用于游戏、动画与品牌项目，支持中/日/韩三语！ACTIVE GAMING MEDIA (AGM)是游戏全球化服务商。为全球游戏提供一站式解决方案，业务涵盖游戏本地化、配音、LQA/FQA测试、全球营销、多语言客服及AUTOMATON媒体推广。
introduction_en:
Octave Music delivers premium audio production, powered by multinational expertise and a proven track record with leading games and brands. We offer end-to-end tailored services: theme songs, scores, sound effects, and voice-overs. Ideal for gaming, animation, and corporate branding, we fully support trilingual localization in Chinese, Japanese, and Korean. Elevate your cross-border project with our bespoke audio solutions!

ACTIVE GAMING MEDIA (AGM) is a leading provider of one-stop globalization solutions for the gaming industry. We help global games expand worldwide through premium services, including game translation & localization, voice acting, LQA/FQA testing, global PR, multilingual support, and promotion via our media platform, AUTOMATON.

logo: https://appobs.chinajoy.net/tools/admin/exhibitionMaterials/1781605616822_沛星互動科技股份有限公司.jpg
introduction_zh: Appier（TSE：4180）是一家 AI 原生的 Agentic AI 即服务（AaaS）公司，透过最先进的广告科技与营销科技解决方案，协助企业制定更明确的商业决策。创立于 2012 年，Appier 秉持「Making AI Easy by Making Software Intelligent」的愿景，帮助企业将 AI 转化为可衡量的投资报酬，目前在全球设有 17 个据点。
introduction_en: Appier (TSE: 4180) is an AI-native Agentic AI as a Service (AaaS) company that empowers business decision-making with cutting-edge AdTech and MarTech solutions. Founded in 2012 with the vision of “Making AI Easy by making software intelligent,” Appier endeavors to help businesses turn AI into ROI with its Ad Cloud, Personalization Cloud, and Data Cloud solutions. Now Appier has 17 offices across APAC, the US and EMEA, and is listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange.

introduction_zh: Bidease是一家由AI技术驱动的程序化广告买量平台（DSP），专注于通过数据驱动的全托管广告解决方案，帮助应用营销人员实现用户获取和应用内再营销目标。依托领先的机器学习和神经网络技术，以及对透明度和广告效果的坚持，我们为客户带来可衡量的营销成果，推动客户业务持续增长。
introduction_en: Bidease is a programmatic demand-side platform powered by advanced AI technology. We specialize in helping app marketers achieve their user acquisition and in-app retargeting goals through data-driven, fully-managed advertising solutions. By combining best-in-class machine learning and neural networks, with a commitment to transparency and performance, we deliver measurable results that drive business growth.

name_zh: 上海倍孜网络技术有限公司
introduction_zh:
倍孜网络专注于移动数字营销的技术服务搭建，为移动开发者提供高品质商业化的一站式变现服务与管理。
自2016年成立以来，倍孜网络SDK DAU覆盖超过3.6亿，MAU覆盖超10亿，合作包括央媒、政府级媒体、头部大中型媒体在内的媒体客户超过1600家，日均请求量超200万次。
倍孜网络凭借品质化的全流程交付，成为国内用户覆盖量领先的第三方广告SDK。
introduction_en:
Beizi Network specializes in building technical services for mobile digital marketing, offering mobile developers high-quality, one-stop monetization solutions and management.
Since its establishment in 2016, Beizi Network's SDK has reached over 360 million daily active users (DAU) and more than 1 billion monthly active users (MAU). It has partnered with over 1,600 media clients, including central state media, government-level media, and leading large- and medium-sized media platforms, handling an average of over 2 million requests per day.  
With high-quality, end-to-end delivery services, Beizi Network has become a leading third-party advertising SDK in China in terms of user reach.

introduction_zh: 全球每20款游戏中，就有1款诞生于莫斯科。Moscow Game Hub 是俄罗斯领先的视频游戏开发中心，汇聚了超过50家入驻工作室和170余个在研项目。该产业群主要聚焦两大方向：一方面助力俄罗斯本土游戏工作室拓展海外市场，另一方面为海外公司进入俄语市场提供一站式入口——包括本地化服务、外包团队筛选及合作伙伴对接.12家莫斯科公司亮相，并期待以多种形式展开合作。ChinaJoy2026见！
introduction_en:
Every 1 in 20 video games worldwide is created in Moscow.
Moscow Game Hub is Russia’s leading video game development center, home to over 50 resident studios and more than 170 projects currently in the pipeline. The cluster operates on two fronts: it helps Russian studios expand into international markets, and serves as the primary gateway for foreign companies looking to enter the Russian-speaking market—offering services from localization and outsourced team selection to partnership sourcing.
This year at ChinaJoy 2026, Moscow is represented by 12 companies, all open to various partnership formats.
See you at ChinaJoy!

name_zh: 电子游戏产业发展组织
introduction_zh:
一个非营利性协会，汇聚了300多位行业专家（包括开发者、发行商和律师）。目标：支持游戏文化，提升投资吸引力，推动俄罗斯游戏在全球市场的开发。
主要产品：
《开发者红皮书》（法律和支持措施数据库）。
Indie GO加速器（独立工作室指导）。
行业名人堂（重要项目和人物评选，例如《俄罗斯方块》和《原子之心》）。
introduction_en:
A non-profit association that brings together more than 300 industry experts (including developers, publishers and lawyers). Objectives: Support gaming culture, increase investment attractiveness, promote the development of Russian games on the global market.
Main products:
The Red Book for Developers (a database of laws and support measures).
Indie GO Accelerator (guidance for independent studios).
Industry Hall of Fame (a selection of important projects and figures, such as Tetris and Atomic Heart).

introduction_zh: 独立游戏工作室，由RTU MIREA游戏产业系高级讲师和拥有超过一百万粉丝的俄罗斯Twitch主播deepins02共同创立。我们开发并发行自己的游戏，同时也支持和指导独立开发团队。结合现代营销策略、学术环境资源和紧密的行业联系，我们帮助实现创新游戏项目。
introduction_en: An indie game studio founded by a senior lecturer at the Department of Game Industry at RTU MIREA and Russian Twitch streamer deepins02, who has an audience of over one million followers. We develop and publish our own games while also supporting and mentoring indie development teams. By combining modern marketing strategies, the resources of an academic environment, and close ties with the game industry, we help bring innovative game projects to life.

ChinaJoy2026 purpose: Establishing communication with Chinese companies and developers, seeking investment in our own products, clients for development infrastructure, and large products wishing to be published in the CIS

introduction_zh:

Nanosemantics is a leading Russian developer of artificial intelligence and neural network solutions, founded by Igor Ashmanov and Natalia Kaspersky. CHINAJOY 2026 Focus: To find localization partners and publishers for the SPLIT project

Business solutions: 1C:Enterprise 8, 1C:Accounting.

Interest in 2026 CHINAJOY:
The company is looking for partners to distribute 1CGS products in Southeast Asia and China.

Leading publisher of MMO games on PC/Mobile in Russia & CIS

introduction_zh: 独立游戏开发工作室。已推出一款游戏，两款正在开发中。已在Steam上发布《MEATGRINDER》——一款混乱、快节奏的复古射击游戏，玩家在卡车、火车和飞机的车顶间跳跃射击，躲避障碍。即将推出《Quack Hunters》——合作冒险游戏，扮演勇敢的鸭子小队狩猎怪物；以及《Blindshot Arena》——所有人都看不见的射击对战游戏。
introduction_en:
Indie game development studio. One game launched, two games in development.
Launched on Steam: MEATGRINDER
Meatgrinder is a chaotic, lightning-fast retro shooter. Leap across the roofs of trucks, trains, and planes — blasting enemies and dodging obstacles. Just don't fall onto the road. 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1968710/MEATGRINDER/
Preparing to launch: Quack Hunters, Blindshot Arena
Quack Hunters is a coop adventure game. Hunt and catch monsters, playing as a member of a brave duck squad.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4252280/Quack_Hunters/
Blindshot Arena has one simple idea - you shoot your enemies, they shoot you. But everyone's blind!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4332910/Blindshot_Arena/

introduction_en:
WATT - a game development and animation studio, currently working on two exciting projects:

TSAREVNA: Age of Tales — the world's first ballet slasher, blending elegant choreography with intense action.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3348640/TSAREVNA_Age_of_Tales/

GRIMPS — a fast-paced, insane action shooter packed with relentless combat and over-the-top mayhem.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3297800/GRIMPS/

HeroCraft - Worldwide publisher with 24 years of experience. We publish games on all available platforms.

我们拥有超过 30 年的电子游戏发行和分销经验。分销范围包括实体和数字产品，例如电子游戏主机、不同平台的游戏、配件和周边商品，以及游戏密钥、订阅和礼品卡。作为发行商，我们的游戏覆盖全球 PC 平台和所有主流主机平台。

introduction_zh: VK是俄罗斯覆盖用户规模最大的科技公司，97%以上俄罗斯网民使用其产品与服务。2026 ChinaJoy将展示RuStore、VK Ads、VK Play和Fandom Fest VKontakte，帮助国际企业、开发者和创作者进入俄罗斯市场并触达本地用户。欢迎前往W3馆C302展位了解VK生态与合作机会。展位设计融合数字科技与俄罗斯文化元素，展现VK创新、开放的国际化理念。
introduction_en: VK is Russia’s largest technology company by audience reach. More than 97% of the Russian internet audience use VK products and services for communication, entertainment, education, content creation, commerce and business solutions. At ChinaJoy 2026, VK will present RuStore, VK Ads, VK Play and Fandom Fest VKontakte. These platforms help international companies, developers and content creators enter the Russian market, reach local audiences and build new business opportunities. Visitors can meet VK representatives and learn more about the company’s ecosystem at booth C302 in Hall W3. The booth design combines modern digital technologies with elements inspired by Russian cultural traditions, reflecting VK’s approach to innovation, openness and international cooperation.

Infobip's technology has the capacity to reach over 7 billion mobile devices in 6 continents connected to 10k+ connections of which 800+ are direct operator connections. Th

introduction_en:
Mobsco delivers high-quality global user growth and a premium performance marketing network. We empower mobile advertisers and partners with scalable, high-return, and closed-loop digital marketing solutions through refined traffic operations, premium media matrices, and strict anti-fraud systems.

Backed by extensive partnerships with leading global clients and immense budget capacities, Mobsco zeroes in on high-value overseas markets. With data-driven optimization and compliant scaling operations, we consistently secure and maximize backend ROI for every marketing dollar.

name_zh: 智信禾（北京）知识产权代理有限公司
introduction_zh: 智信禾知识产权成立于2011年，在十余年间砥砺前行，不断创新发展，目前已成为一家综合性、国际化的知识产权公司，为企业知识产权的申请确权、诉讼维权与管理运营提供一站式全方位服务。智信禾的专业能力和服务水平也得到了业内外的高度认可，目前是国际保护知识产权协会、国际商标协会、中华全国专利代理师协会、中国专利保护协会、北京市专利代理师协会等会员单位，荣登中国商标代理TOP100。
introduction_en: Founded in 2011, forging ahead with perseverance and continuous innovation over the past decade, Chispo Attorneys At Law is today a full-service and international intellectual property law firm in China, offering one-stop, full range of IP-related services spanning IP prosecution, litigation and enforcement, as well as portfolio management and operations.Chispo's professional capabilities and service quality have been widely recognized both within and outside the industry.In 2022, we were honored as the Gold Medal Exemplary Unit in Trademark Agency Services and was ranked among China's Top 100 Trademark Agencies.

introduction_zh:
StudioEIM自1999年成立来，深耕游戏音频25余年，提供音乐、音效、配音及导配的一站式方案。曾助力《地下城与勇士》《龙之谷》等全球大作，为数亿玩家带来沉浸式体验。

凭着深厚信任，我们与多数客户保持10年以上合作，并曾作为腾讯、网易、点点互动等全球巨头备受认可的音频合作伙伴。

从MMORPG到二次元，我们灵活定制方案，作为值得信赖的音频伙伴，助力长线运营与新作开发。
introduction_en:
StudioEIM has provided one-stop game audio solutions—music, sound effects, voice recording, and direction—since 1999 for over 25 years. We have enhanced global hits like Dungeon Fighter Online, Dragon Nest, MU Online, and Crazy Arcade, delivering immersive experiences to millions worldwide.

Based on trust, StudioEIM maintains 10+ year partnerships with most clients and holds a proven track record as an audio partner to global giants including Tencent, NetEase, and Century Games.

Our global experience enables us to deliver optimized solutions for any project size. Spanning MMORPGs to anime-style games, StudioEIM supports successful live operations and new game development as a reliable audio business partner.

introduction_zh: Worldpay（现隶属于Global Payments）是一家领先的支付技术和软件公司，赋能全球不同规模企业的商业发展。我们通过众多的创新解决方案，帮助企业稳步发展。这些解决方案支持无缝支付受理，推动智能化运营并提供卓越的客户体验，覆盖线上线下及全渠道场景。我们的业务遍布全球，拥有丰富的本地专业知识以及卓越的规模优势，每年在全球超过175个市场处理截至数万亿美元的数十亿笔交易。
introduction_en: Worldpay, a Global Payments company, is a leading payment technology and software company that powers commerce for businesses of all sizes worldwide. We help businesses grow with confidence by delivering innovative solutions that enable seamless payment acceptance, smarter operations and exceptional client experiences - online, in-store and everywhere in between. With its global reach, local expertise and scale, we manages trillions in payments volume and billions of transactions across more than 175 markets.

introduction_zh: AppHarbr 是领先的移动广告质量保护平台，为应用和游戏开发者提供实时广告审核与拦截能力。通过 SDK 在广告展示前识别并拦截恶意、欺诈、违规及影响用户体验的广告，帮助开发者减少用户投诉、差评和流失，提升品牌口碑，让广告收入增长的同时，持续打造安全、优质的应用体验。
introduction_en:
At AppHarbr, we’re on a mission to help app developers and game studios deliver high-quality in-app ads while safeguarding the mobile user experience. With proactive ad quality controls, we ensure disruptive and intrusive ads never reach your users.
Our real-time ad quality protection defends against unwanted, malicious, and offensive ads—so you can say goodbye to user churn, complaints, low ratings, and negative reviews caused by bad ad experiences.
With AppHarbr, you’ll maximize engagement without worrying about ad quality issues, protect your brand reputation, and boost user loyalty.

name_zh: 萌大爷文化传媒有限公司
introduction_zh: MantaYaY成立于2021年，是东南亚头部游戏营销机构，专注东南亚本地内容生态与游戏出海。业务涵盖达人营销、内容IP、游戏营销、线下活动执行、女团运营、游戏直播公会、直播电商及短剧。MantaYaY服务覆盖马来西亚、菲律宾、新加坡、印尼、泰国及越南，为中国游戏、IP及消费品牌提供一站式本地化营销方案。凭借本地团队与创作者生态，助力品牌高效触达受众并实现长期增长。
introduction_en: Founded in 2021, MantaYaY is a SEA-based TikTok agency specialising in SEA’s content ecosystem, game market expansion and creator-led growth. Its services include creator marketing, content IP development, gaming marketing, offline activations, girl group operations, live commerce and short-form drama production. Operating across Malaysia, Philippines, Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand and Vietnam, MantaYaY provides localised marketing solutions for game companies, IP owners and consumer brands. Its capabilities span market strategy, creator matching, campaign execution and event activation. With local teams, regional creator networks and deep platform expertise, MantaYaY helps brands enter SEA, connect with local audiences, strengthen community relevance and achieve sustainable growth.

We drive performance across the app lifecycle through CTV user acquisition and mobile retargeting. Our proprietary technology enables access to high-value users, generating $9.42 billion in-app revenue in 2025. In 2025, we’ve been recognized as the #1 Global Remarketing Partner by AppsFlyer.

introduction_zh:
"ONERWAY是一家专注于构建全球金融支付服务的科技企业。总部位于伦敦，同时在上海、中国香港、新加坡、洛杉矶、阿姆斯特丹等地成立分公司。

作为⾏业领先的跨境⽀付企业,ONERWAY致⼒于通过科技创新赋能企业参与跨境新经济共建,建⽴与国际信⽤卡及全球本地⽀付⽹络联通的现代化⽀付架构,提供创新⾼效､低成本的⼀站式跨境⽀付服务解决⽅案,帮助企业赢得全球竞争⼒,促进跨境贸易⽣态繁荣｡"
introduction_en:
ONERWAY is a London-based fintech firm specialising in global payment infrastructure, supported by a strategic network of offices in Shanghai, Hong Kong, Singapore, Los Angeles, and Amsterdam.

As a leading cross-border payment provider, we are committed to empowering businesses in the new cross-border economy through technological innovation.We have established a modern payment architecture integrated with global card and local payment networks worldwide. By delivering innovative, efficient, and cost-effective all-in-one payment solutions, ONERWAY helps companies gain global competitiveness and contributes to a thriving cross-border trade ecosystem.

introduction_zh: Prodege 是全球领先的奖励经济平台，致力于帮助品牌实现用户增长、提升用户参与度及商业变现。旗下拥有 Swagbucks、InboxDollars 等知名忠诚度平台，并通过 BitLabs 提供激励式问卷、Offerwall 和返现购物等解决方案，将用户闲置时间转化为持续收益。自 2005 年成立以来，Prodege 已累计向全球用户发放超过 25 亿美元奖励，持续为品牌和开发者创造价值。
introduction_en: Prodege is the Engine for the Rewarded Economy. Our platform is fueled by leading loyalty programs that propel brand growth empowering both marketers and revenue leaders to grow and engage their customer base. Studio Marketers can reach new customers through positive interactions in one of Prodege’s many loyalty programs. Revenue leaders can use Prodege’s Bitlabs engine to convert Unmonetized Moments (the silent liability of user downtime) into Daily Revenue and Continuous Engagement from offers, surveys and cashback shopping. Founded in 2005 Prodege has awarded over $2.5B in rewards to consumers globally through its family of loyalty programs like Swagbucks and Inboxdollars. Visit www.prodege.com to learn more about our solutions.

introduction_zh: Kochava 是领先的实时数据解决方案提供商，致力于为所有营销渠道赋能，助力企业实现卓越成效。我们的产品和服务支持全球众多以绩效为导向的品牌和平台，帮助他们实现可衡量的增长。凭借多触点归因、现代营销组合模型、端到端营销活动管理以及人工智能驱动的工作流程，以及我们备受赞誉的客户成功团队的支持，Kochava 帮助客户验证结果、预测未来趋势并采取明智的行动。
introduction_en: Kochava is the premier provider of real-time data solutions powering outcomes across every marketing channel. Our offerings support the world’s most performance-focused brands and platforms in achieving measurable growth. Through multi-touch attribution, modern marketing mix modeling, end-to-end campaign management, and AI-driven workflows, all backed by our acclaimed customer success team, Kochava helps clients verify results, predict what’s next, and take informed action.

name_zh: 上海幂集软件有限公司
introduction_zh: MetaX 是一家专注于 CTV（联网电视）流量货币化的领先平台，依托先进的算法和大数据洞察，通过技术创新与资源整合，深度挖掘大屏用户的商业价值。始终致力于为品牌广告主提供高效、精准的营销解决方案，推动平台、应用开发者与品牌之间的价值共创，实现多方共赢。
introduction_en:
MetaX is a CTV and OTT content and traffic monetization platform, powered by MetaX Ads and MetaX OTT solutions.
MetaX Ads, a pioneering advertising marketplace for CTV/OTT. Enable brands to contextually reach the right audiences over omni-channels and multiple scenes.MetaX OTT, a content marketplace and OTT platform, which consists of featured OTT content serving applications with more than 10MM installations.

introduction_zh: Epay.com诞生于2000年，致力于“让跨境收付变得更容易”。依托本地化清算与数智化系统，破解跨境收付“贵、慢、难”的问题。Epay提供全球收款、全球付款、人民币结汇、外汇兑换、多币种账户等一站式服务，广泛服务社交直播、数字服务、游戏、汇款服务商、外贸电商等出海企业。Epay坚持合规与安全，持续以AI风控等技术创新，助力客户高效稳健走向全球。
introduction_en: With the mission of "Epay, Easy Pay!" Epay was founded in 2000 to address the key challenges of traditional cross-border payments—high cost, low speed, and high complexity. Epay provides a secure, one-stop global payment network to support industries such as e-commerce and live streaming in their global expansion. Driven by trust and responsibility, we prioritize user experience and fund security alongside speed and cost.

introduction_zh: Discord 是面向游戏玩家的一体化通讯平台，集成语音、视频与文字聊天，月活跃用户超 2 亿，玩家可随时搭建社群、线上交流。平台搭载 Discord 任务等特色营销工具，无横幅弹窗广告，玩家在站内体验游戏、完成日常操作即可领取游戏内奖励。软件基础功能免费，另设付费 Nitro 会员增值服务，现已成为玩家、游戏厂商与各类社群的核心聚集地。
introduction_en: Discord is the communications platform built for people who play games together — voice, video, and text all in one place, where over 200 million monthly active users hang out, build communities, and stay connected before, during, and after the games they love. Beyond community, Discord has become a powerful platform for game marketing through offerings like Discord Quests, in-app promotional campaigns that reward players for engaging with games directly on Discord — no banner ads, no interruptions, just players discovering new titles and earning real in-game rewards for actions they're already taking. Free to use, with an optional Nitro subscription, Discord has become the go-to home base for gamers, developers, and communities of every kind.

introduction_zh: MiQ 成立于 2010 年，始终坚持以技术创新驱动广告成效，助力品牌、营销机构与媒体代理实现可持续增长。依托以AI技术为核心的 MiQ Sigma 广告平台，我们整合了全球广告生态数据，实时捕捉全球受众的观看习惯、浏览行为及购买动态。基于这些深度洞察，我们的专业团队能够制定中立且定制化的营销策略，以达到更快、更智能、更高效的投放成效。选择 MiQ，让程序化广告突破想象，成就非凡。
introduction_en: We’re not your average programmatic media partner. Since 2010, we’ve been on a journey to make advertising better, and help brands and agencies achieve their best outcomes. That’s why we created Sigma, our award-winning, AI-powered advertising technology that connects the ecosystem together, revealing what audiences everywhere are watching, browsing and buying. Enabled by these insights, our traders make custom, unbiased decisions that deliver faster, smarter and more effective results. With MiQ, programmatic always goes beyond expectations. Headquartered in London, MiQ operates from 21 offices across North America, Europe, APAC and Latin America, and has been recognized by leading industry awards for both its technology and its workplace culture.

introduction_zh: Cloudflare 依托全球连通云网络，为网站、应用、API、AI 智能体与企业网络提供安全、加速、可靠的一体化服务。业务涵盖应用安全与加速、企业零信任网络、边缘计算开发平台以及 AI 安全与智能体服务，全方位满足个人、开发者及各类企业的网络与业务需求。
introduction_en: Powered by Connectivity Cloud, Cloudflare delivers all-in-one secure, accelerated and reliable services for websites, applications, APIs, AI agents and enterprise networks. Its offerings cover application security & acceleration, enterprise zero-trust networking, edge computing development platforms, as well as AI security and agent services, fully meeting the network and business demands of individuals, developers and all types of enterprises.

introduction_zh: 麦炽成立于2018年，是卓越的一站式出海整合营销服务商。我们专注于为中国企业提供涵盖品牌咨询、广告投放、红人营销、创意素材及DTC建站的全链路解决方案。作为谷歌核心代理商，麦炽业务遍布全球200多个国家和地区，已助力数千家企业实现全球化增长，是您出海成功的坚实伙伴。
introduction_en:
Marching Tech was founded in 2018 and is a leading one-stop global marketing service provider for businesses expanding overseas. We specialize in delivering end-to-end solutions for Chinese enterprises, including brand consulting, digital advertising, influencer marketing, creative production, and DTC website development.

As a core Google partner, Marching Tech serves clients across more than 200 countries and regions worldwide. Having helped thousands of businesses achieve sustainable global growth, we are committed to being your trusted partner on the journey to international success.

introduction_zh:
BTWN X 是一家独立广告科技集团，拥有自主 SSP、DSP 与 SDK 平台。每日处理超1600亿次竞价请求，覆盖 Web、App 与 CTV，连接全球优质供需资源。

BTWN X：全球程序化专家
introduction_en:
BTWN X is an independent adtech group with a proprietary SSP and DSP platforms, SDK, and full-service agency, built to deliver real performance at global scale. Since 2012, we’ve empowered publishers, ad networks, and DSPs by uniting exclusive demand and optimized supply under one powerful, ML-driven adtech stack. 
With over 160 billion daily bid requests across web, in-app, and CTV, our platform filters, verifies, and curates traffic to meet the specific needs of our demand partners. DSPs benefit from cleaner bidstreams and higher campaign efficiency, while publishers enjoy direct access to unique advertiser demand — including brand-safe, high-performing campaigns delivered via our in-house agency.
BTWN X: Global Programmatic Expert

introduction_zh:
Bullet Group Inc. 目前以 “数字营销”与“系统开发” 两大核心业务为支柱。
为众多客户与合作伙伴提供高度定制化的解决方案，助力其实现业务增长与技术革新。
秉持“以人为本，连接科技与世界”“创造全新价值”“培养能够培养他人的人才”等三大核心价值观，不断推动人才成长与社会价值创造，在全球市场中持续拓展影响力。
introduction_en:
Bullet Group Inc. currently operates with "Digital Marketing" and "System Development" as its two core business pillars. We provide highly customized solutions to numerous clients and partners, driving their business growth and technological innovation.
Guided by our three core values—"People-centric, connecting technology with the world," "Creating new value," and "Nurturing talent who can cultivate others"—we continuously promote human resource growth and social value creation, while steadily expanding our influence in the global market.

introduction_zh:
UPAPP【开户+谷歌上架/斗篷/PWA】
1.软件服务：谷歌/IOS上架，3年1.5万个包成熟经验，斗篷【2年市场占有率65%以上，月点击超8亿次】，PWA系统4年累计3000+注册甲方用户！
2.开户服务【FB/GG】：FB美金三不限户，包消耗，预付实消，24小时服务，服务费2-3%，月消耗2000万美元以上；Google广告户，服务费2-3%，月消耗500万美元以上！
introduction_en:
UPAPP [Account Opening + Google Ads/Cover/PWA]

1. Software Services: Google/iOS Ads, 3 years of mature experience with 15,000 packages; Cover [2 years market share over 65%, over 800 million monthly clicks]; PWA system, 4 years of accumulated 3000+ registered client users!

2. Account Opening Services [FB/GG]: Unlimited FB USD accounts, guaranteed spending, prepaid, 24-hour service, service fee 2-3%, monthly spending over $20 million; Google Ads accounts, service fee 2-3%, monthly spending over $5 million!

name_zh: 杭州哇嘶嗒科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
Tripo Studio，全球首个AI驱动的一站式3D 工作站。其诞生旨在解决3D创作中“创意难以落地为完整成果”的痛点，重新定义了 AI驱动的3D内容创作流程。
深度触入专业3D建模全流栏，极简界面融合专业工具，从灵感进发到成果导出全流程无缝衔接，让创意从模糊构想走问完整、可用、有价值的可交互3D内容。
仅需一张图片，2秒即可获得3D模型，可用于游戏、3D 打印、影视、动画渲染、XR等各个领域。
introduction_en: Tripo Al provides real-time 3D generation infrastructure for games and interactive applications, powered by its model lineup from TripoSR and H3.1 to P1 smart mesh and W1 world models, enabling developers to generate engine-ready assets from text or images, integrate scalable 3D pipelines through APls and plugins, and support player-generated content systems that make interactive worlds programmable at scale.

name_zh: 烟台赛思汇译翻译有限公司
introduction_zh: SuccessGlo·赛思是一家立足亚洲、服务全球的本地化翻译公司，在中国（北京、济南和烟台）、新加坡、日本（东京）以及越南（河内和胡志明）设立7个分部。我们支持全球60多个语种互译，致力于为客户量身定制最契合的游戏本地化解决方案，同时严格把控对于游戏而言至关重要的准确性、一致性和文化契合度，助力其为全球玩家带来沉浸式游戏体验，成功打造区域级乃至世界级的广泛影响力。

introduction_en: Intellect Ads is a performance-driven digital marketing and user acquisition company specializing in mobile advertising, affiliate marketing, programmatic media buying, and app growth solutions. Founded in 2012, the company helps brands scale through data-driven campaigns focused on measurable KPIs such as installs, registrations, purchases, ROAS, and customer retention. Intellect Ads works across verticals including Ecommerce, BFSI, Gaming, Fintech, and OTT, leveraging platforms like AppsFlyer and Adjust. With expertise in RTB, OEM, CTV, and in-app inventory, the company delivers scalable, transparent, and performance-focused advertising solutions globally.

introduction_zh: Sigmob（北京创智汇聚科技股份有限公司）创立于2017年，致力于为中国移动应用开发者打造全面和一体化的解决方案，帮助开发者与用户建立深入联系，助力每一个移动应用开发者加速增长。旗下两大业务：ToBid聚合广告平台，一站式为移动开发者提供流量变现服务，帮助开发者提升整体广告变现收益；Sigmob移动广告平台，为广告主与开发者提供全面的广告投放、广告变现解决方案.
introduction_en:
Sigmob (Beijing Chuangzhi Huiju Technology Co., Ltd.), founded in 2017, is dedicated to empowering mobile app developers in China with integrated growth and monetization solutions. By helping developers better engage with users, Sigmob enables mobile apps to achieve sustainable growth.
Sigmob operates two core business platforms:
ToBid Mediation Platform: A one-stop ad monetization platform that helps mobile developers maximize ad revenue and improve monetization efficiency.
Sigmob Mobile Advertising Platform: An end-to-end mobile advertising platform providing user acquisition and ad monetization solutions for advertisers and app developers.

name_zh: 北京聚智创想科技有限责任公司
introduction_zh: GatherOne 是企业全球业务增长的首席营销官，以“赋能企业实现全球化有效增长”为宗旨，高效链接流量媒体、广告主、资本等生态伙伴，构建多方共赢的增长生态。凭借全球化媒体资源布局，公司提供精准广告投放、用户增长策略、创意素材优化、品牌国际化等解决方案，聚焦游戏、AI、应用、泛娱乐、金融、电商等高增长赛道，累计服务13000+企业客户。
introduction_en:
GatherOne: Your Global Growth Partner
As a premier partner to top-tier media platforms, we drive scalable growth and enhance brand visibility for gaming, app, and e-commerce advertisers. Our solution is powered by the seamless integration of data-driven advertising, strategic media buying, and compelling, locally tailored creatives.

name_zh: 四川八方腾泰科技有限责任公司
name_en: Sichuan Bafang Tengtai Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh:
八方腾泰是以移动互联网广告、品牌广告、效果广告为一体的综合性移动营销公司，专注品牌传播与效果广告。总部设立在北京，同时上海、杭州、深圳、成都、保定设有分支机构。
深耕主流信息流及手机厂商数字营销十余年，并依托自研智能投放平台，可提供从策略、素材到执行的数据可追溯的全场景精准投流全流程服务。
introduction_en:
BFT is a leading mobile marketing agency specializing in brand communications and performance-driven advertising solutions. With deep expertise in mobile internet advertising, brand marketing, and performance marketing, BFT provides integrated growth strategies for advertisers across the global mobile ecosystem. Headquartered in Beijing, BFT operates branch offices in Shanghai, Hangzhou, Shenzhen, Chengdu, and Baoding.

Backed by more than a decade of experience in mainstream feed media and mobile OEM marketing, BFT leverages its proprietary intelligent advertising platform to deliver full-funnel, data-driven campaign solutions spanning strategy, creative production, media buying, and performance optimization.

name_zh: 迪拜 DMCC 游戏中心
introduction_zh: DMCC Gaming Centre 是迪拜多种商品交易中心（Dubai Multi Commodities Centre）打造的国际游戏于数字娱乐产业生态平台，致力于吸引游戏开发、电竞、人工智能、Web3及数字内容企业落户迪拜。中心为企业提供公司注册、办公空间、签证、融资服务、行业活动及全球商业资源等一站式服务，并依托DMCC的国际商业网络，帮助企业快速进入中东、非洲及全球市场。
introduction_en: The DMCC Gaming Centre is a global gaming and digital entertainment ecosystem established by the Dubai Multi Commodities Centre (DMCC). It is dedicated to attracting game developers, esports organizations, AI companies, Web3 innovators, and digital content businesses to establish and expend their presence in Dubai. The Centre provides a comprehensicve one-stop platform, including company formation, office solutions, visa services, fundraising support, industry events, and access to DMCC's extensive global business network. By leveraging Dubai's strategic location and world-class business environment, the DMCC Gaming Centre enables companies to rapidly expand into the Middle East, Africa, and international markets.

introduction_zh: Xapads 是一家领先的全球广告技术平台，专注于由先进自主人工智能驱动的技术型广告解决方案。通过直接接入全球超过75,000家出版合作伙伴，并与主要OEM厂商实现无缝整合，Xapads 每月覆盖超过21亿用户。 公司提供全面的服务范围，包括CTV（联网电视）、程序化广告、语境定位、富媒体广告以及基于效果的解决方案。这些产品和服务经过精心设计，旨在在客户生命周期的各个阶段提升品牌效果。
introduction_en:
Xapads Media is a global marketing solutions and AdTech company specializing in programmatic advertising across mobile marketing, CTV innovations, web, and in-app environments. It enables brands and publishers to scale performance and awareness through data-driven technology, premium global inventory, and brand-safe media solutions.

With a global reach of over 2.4 billion users, their ecosystem supports the full consumer journey - from awareness through to conversion. They provide reliable access to inventory, practical targeting capabilities, and measurable outcomes, with a consistent focus on transparency in how campaigns are run and optimized.

introduction_zh:
BidRunner 是一支由顶尖营销人员、开发人员、分析师和设计师组成的团队，专注于应用内（In-App）及 CTV 流量获取，并开发基于 CPA（按行为付费）和 CPI（按安装付费）模式的移动应用推广解决方案。

我们的目标是确保您只为能够带来利润的用户行为付费。通过创新的数字广告策略，我们为您的品牌打造真正有效的推广方案。
introduction_en:
BidRunner is a team of top marketers, developers, analysts, and designers specializing in in-app & CTV traffic acquisition and the development of mobile app promotion solutions based on the CPA (cost per action) and CPI (cost per install) models.

We work to ensure you paying only for those customer actions that bring you profit. Using innovative digital
advertising strategies, we create truly working solutions to promote your brand.

introduction_zh: CLICK2COMMISSION 成立于2013年，总部位于迪拜，在印度和美国设有办事处，是一家全球效果营销广告公司。我们致力于帮助品牌和开发者通过全渠道（移动端、联网电视、户外数字媒体）精准触达全球受众，业务覆盖北美、欧洲、东南亚等市场，月活用户超5000万。支持CPI、CPA、CPR等效果计价，提供API、DSP及MMP数据追踪，以AI驱动实时竞价，最大化广告变现效率。
introduction_en: CLICK2COMMISSION, founded in 2013 and headquartered in Dubai, with offices in India and the U.S., is a global performance advertising agency. We help brands precisely reach audiences across all channels, including mobile, CTV, and DOOH, serving markets in North America, Europe, and Southeast Asia, with over 50 million monthly active users. We support CPI, CPA, CPR, and other performance-based pricing models, offering API, DSP, and MMP tracking, powered by AI-driven real-time bidding to maximize ROAS.

introduction_zh: LoopMe 是一家享誉全球的品牌效果广告科技公司。作为行业领航者，LoopMe 率先将前沿 AI 科技与深度消费者洞察相融合。Chartboost 进一步拓展了 LoopMe 在移动应用生态的 SDK 流量覆盖率，并强力推动了其基于效果的品牌广告投放。依托创新的 AI 智能体，LoopMe 全面赋能移动广告投放与程序化广告交易平台，持续为全球顶尖代理商、程序化合作伙伴及品牌广告主驱动确定性增长。
introduction_en: LoopMe is bringing brands into apps, powered by AI agents. LoopMe was the first to apply AI to brand advertising and its Intelligent Marketplace, finding solutions to industry challenges that haven’t previously been solved. With consumer insights and AI at its core, LoopMe makes brand advertising better, outperforming industry benchmarks for leading global brands. Chartboost expands LoopMe's established presence in the mobile mobile app ecosystem, significantly growing its SDK network and strengthening its outcomes-based AI technology platform. LoopMe has achieved a fully organic gross revenue CAGR of 40% for the period 2018-2025.

name_zh: 越南游戏发行商- VTC MOBILE
introduction_zh: VTC MOBILE 是越南文化体育旅游部下属越南多媒体公司VTC的成员公司。 VTC MOBILE 成立于2009年，致力于成为越南首屈一指的移动增值服务提供商。至今凭借超过15年的运营经验，VTC MOBILE 已逐渐确立了市场地位，主要服务领域包括：移动增值服务，电子竞技制作，IT， 媒体，尤其是发行手机游戏和网页，端游游戏。我们很荣幸成为Gameverse 2025第一大游戏发行商.
introduction_en: VTC MOBILE 是越南文化体育旅游部下属越南多媒体公司VTC的成员公司。 VTC MOBILE 成立于2009年，致力于成为越南首屈一指的移动增值服务提供商。至今凭借超过15年的运营经验，VTC MOBILE 已逐渐确立了市场地位，主要服务领域包括：移动增值服务，电子竞技制作，IT， 媒体，尤其是发行手机游戏和网页，端游游戏。我们很荣幸成为Gameverse 2025第一大游戏发行商.，在手机和PC平台上成功发行了100多款游戏，拥有超过9000万注册账户和150万日活跃用户。我们热烈地迎接国际合作机会，实现共同发展。

name_zh: 上海石游网络科技有限公司
introduction_zh: HugOffers 三方网盟 SaaS 广告技术平台支持CPA/CPL/CPS/CPI全链路投放。广告主无需技术团队，可搭建独立投放系统，实现精细化运营、数据监测、增收控险。HugOffers 原生接入大模型，智能数据分析与优化报表；毫秒级响应，防劫持、防作弊能力全面升级；中文技术支持团队现场答疑，告别沟通时差，24小时在线支持。
introduction_en: HugOffers is a third-party affiliate SaaS advertising tech platform covering full CPA/CPL/CPS/CPI campaign workflows. No dedicated tech team required—advertisers get independent delivery systems for precise operation, data monitoring, profit boosting and risk mitigation. Equipped with native LLM, it provides smart data analysis and optimized dashboards, alongside millisecond response and enhanced anti-hijack & anti-fraud tools. Our Chinese tech team offers instant consultation without time lag, with 24/7 online assistance.

name_zh: 上海云曾科技有限公司

It’s Cloudflare Powered+ tier and authorized Service Delivery Partner, and Partner of the Year honor for 5 consecutive years in APAC.  CentCloud has served hundreds of clients, including gaming, AI, minidrama, social media, E-commerce and manufacturing industries. Leveraging Cloudflare's global footprint and products and CentCloud's professional technical service as core competitiveness, we committed to provide integrated solution and localized technical service to Go-global company.

introduction_en: Beijing Huaxia Leyoo Technology Co., Ltd. was founded on December 9, 2013. It is a leading domestic developer of mobile games and digital marketing service provider. Since its establishment, adhering to the core philosophy of "Creating Simple Happiness" and the corporate culture of "Putting Customers First, Following Market Trends, Acting Swiftly in Competition, Valuing Integrity and Respecting People", the company is committed to becoming an innovative integrator at the forefront of the digital entertainment and digital marketing industries.

introduction_zh: Torox 是全球激励型用户获取与变现平台，通过积分墙、激励应用及忠诚度生态，帮助游戏与金融品牌获取高质量、高意向用户，并提供先进优化与反作弊方案。

With direct partnerships across advertisers and publishers, Torox focuses on transparent, measurable, and ROI-driven growth solutions.

introduction_zh:
At Digimodo, we empower brands and agencies to drive meaningful growth through responsible, transparent, and scalable mobile advertising solutions.
We have offices in India & UAE.

At Digimodo, we empower brands and agencies to drive meaningful growth through responsible, transparent, and scalable mobile advertising solutions.

With offices in India and Dubai, Digimodo is built by seasoned professionals with decades of experience in performance and brand marketing. introduction_zh: Digital Element 是全球领先的 IP 地理位置定位与代理 IP 检测解决方案提供商，为全球企业提供高精度 IP 地理位置数据和代理 IP 风险识别能力。我们的产品广泛应用于广告定向、假量识别，游戏运营、流媒体内容分发、电商本地化、网络安全与风险控制等业务场景，帮助企业实现精准地域定向、识别异常流量、降低业务风险，并提升用户体验。
introduction_en:
Digital Element is a global leader in IP geolocation and proxy detection solutions, providing enterprises worldwide with high-precision IP geolocation data and proxy risk identification capabilities. Our products are widely used across various business scenarios—including ad targeting, fraud detection, game operations, streaming content delivery, e-commerce localization, and cybersecurity—helping enterprises achieve precise geographic targeting, identify anomalous traffic, mitigate business risks, and enhance user experience.

Digital Element serves a wide range of leading internet platforms, ad-tech companies, and enterprise clients—including Apple, Meta, TikTok, AppsFlyer, Moloco, and Mobvista—consistently providing reliable data support for digital businesses around the globe.

introduction_zh: YK音乐是一家国际音乐与音频制作公司，专注于为游戏行业提供高品质原创配乐及音频解决方案。服务涵盖原创音乐、交响乐录音、音效设计、配音制作及音频外包。曾参与《Lies of P》《Night Crows》《Love and Deepspace》等国际项目，致力于为全球开发商和发行商打造电影级音频体验。

Our portfolio includes internationally recognized titles such as Lies of P, Night Crows, and Love and Deepspace. We collaborate with game developers and publishers worldwide to create cinematic, emotionally engaging audio experiences, from indie projects to AAA productions. We welcome opportunities for long-term partnerships and co-development.

name_zh: 上海神蓍信息科技有限公司

introduction_en:
Shanghai Shenshi Information Technology Co., Ltd. is a leading domestic media monetization service provider. Its core tool platforms include the AdSet Mediation Ad SDK and the Qidian Mobile Ad Platform, offering customized ad monetization solutions for apps and mini-programs at different stages of development.

The Qidian Ad Platform aggregates comprehensive advertising budget resources, including four major ad networks, four major OEM (device manufacturer) channels, premium DSP/SSP/ADX channels, and direct customer e-commerce channels such as Taobao and JD. This helps developers directly access the broadest range of advertising budgets with just one integration, thereby enhancing their monetization revenue.

name_zh: 北京位元星域科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 北京位元星域科技专注AI安全调度与隐私防护，打造企业可信AI调用底座。自研Token中台兼容Qwen、GLM、DeepSeek、Minimax、GPT、Claude全系模型，毫秒快速切换，解决多模型运维、跨境调用难题。本次展会推出Seedonce 2.0专属优惠与一对一技术服务。自研加密Token体系支持全链路加密、溯源审计与分级权限管控，从源头防范数据风险，保障企业AI业务安全合规运行。
introduction_en:
Beijing Weiyuan Starfield Technology specializes in secure AI scheduling and privacy protection for enterprise AI deployment. Our self-developed Token middleware supports mainstream LLMs including Qwen, GLM, DeepSeek, Minimax, GPT and Claude. It enables fast model switching and solves common pain points such as complex multi-model management and unstable cross-border invocation.
We provide exclusive Seedonce 2.0 offers and one-on-one technical support during the exhibition. Our proprietary encrypted Token system provides full-link encryption, traceable auditing and hierarchical permission control, effectively preventing data risks and ensuring safe, compliant enterprise AI operation.

introduction_zh: AppBroda 是一家专注于移动应用广告变现的 AdTech 公司，帮助全球开发者通过 Google Ad Manager（GAM）提升广告收入。无需集成 SDK，仅需简单配置即可接入优质广告需求。依托 Google AdX 生态及专业优化团队，AppBroda 为游戏和应用开发者提供高效、透明、安全的广告变现解决方案，平均帮助合作伙伴实现 3%-8% 的收入增长。
introduction_en: AppBroda is an AdTech company focused on mobile app monetization, helping developers worldwide maximize advertising revenue through Google Ad Manager (GAM). With no SDK integration required, publishers can get started with a simple setup and access premium advertising demand. Powered by the Google AdX ecosystem and a dedicated optimization team, AppBroda delivers efficient, transparent, and secure monetization solutions for mobile games and apps, helping partners achieve an average revenue uplift of 3%–8%.

The Company keeps deepening its footprint across core Central Asian regions and refining its localized payment service ecosystem on an ongoing basis.

introduction_en: Foundde in 2014,Daoran Company is committed to driving innovation in the entertainment industry technology, and creating differentialed immersive user experiences with interactive products. introduction_zh: 猴子工作室（Studio Monkey）是拥有17年经验的游戏音频专业录音棚。我们以游戏配音与音效设计为核心，曾参与《蔚蓝档案》《剑星》《冒险岛》等众多游戏项目。工作室配备4间专业录音室及顶级设备，致力于打造赋予角色与世界观生命力的声音与音效。同时，我们也为游戏公司提供TTS（AI语音）服务。

Guided by close collaboration and a deep understanding of each project's world and story, we elevate every experience through sound.

introduction_en:

Today, our platform processes over 10 billion ad requests daily, reaches more than 300 million users, and partners with 1,000+ mobile applications.

(Stock Code: 01762.HK), was listed on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in December 2018. name_zh: 香港稳付科技有限公司

introduction_en: StablePay is a leading digital payment solutions provider in Asia, founded by a core team with backgrounds from Peking University, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Alibaba, Ant Financial, ByteDance, and others. It provides one-stop cross-border “collection, management, and payment” services for scenarios such as gaming and cross-border e-commerce, with fees as low as 0.1%.

introduction_en: PickFu is a player research platform that delivers fast, authentic feedback from real gamers. Skip the hassle of recruiting your own audience—launch a test and get actionable insights on your game name, icon, screenshots, store page, or gameplay concept from your target players in minutes, along with the reasons behind every response.

introduction_en:
ByteMobi is a leading global data-driven programmatic mobile advertising platform with deep insights into local markets worldwide. We empower advertisers to acquire large-scale, high-quality users and scale their businesses rapidly in high-potential markets.
With direct partnerships with top OEMs including Xiaomi, OPPO and TRANSSION, as well as premium global publishers and leading SSP platforms, we have built a robust anti-ad-fraud system to ensure genuine traffic quality.
Our services cover 7 core industries such as gaming, dating, finance and lifestyle, spanning over 15 major markets including Europe, North America, Southeast Asia, Latin America and the Middle East.

introduction_zh: 弗利克斯 是一个由人工智能驱动的联盟 营销平台。作为一个价值 170 亿美元的 快速增长行业的一部分，我们在全球范 围内快速发展。我们自豪地跻身于全球 前 1% 的联盟平台之列，客户遍布美国、 欧洲、东南亚、中东和印度。我们的数 据管理平台拥有超过 8500 万用户的购物 详情。凭借这些数据和我们的智能 AI 工 具，我们能够与超过 500 个全球品牌紧密 合作，帮助他们实现真实的销售.
introduction_en: Flickstree is an AI-powered affiliate marketing platform. As part of the booming USD 17 billion industry, we're growing fast globally. We're proud to be among the top 1% of affiliate platforms worldwide, with clients across the US, Europe, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and India. Our data management platform boasts shopping details from over 85 million users. This, along with our smart AI tools, helps us work closely with over 500 global brands, enabling them to achieve real sales.

name_zh: 北京万雪引力科技有限公司
name_en: Origin Snow Grav Technology Co., Limited
introduction_zh: OSG是一家专注于数字增长与商业化服务的科技企业，总部位于美国加利福尼亚州洛斯加托斯。公司致力于帮助开发者释放流量价值、提升商业化效率，并通过持续优化的技术能力和全球化资源网络，为合作伙伴创造长期增长机会。秉承"连接价值，驱动增长”，OSG围绕开发者商业化需求打造了一站式增长与变现平台，覆盖流量接入、广告交易、收益优化、数据分析等多个环节，帮助开发者以更低成本实现更高收益。
introduction_en:
OSG is a technology enterprise specializing in digital growth and commercialization services, with its headquarters in Los Gatos, California, USA. The company is committed to helping developers unlock traffic value and boost commercialization efficiency. Leveraging continuously upgraded technical capabilities and a global resource network, we deliver long-term growth opportunities for all partners.
Upholding the mission of "Connect Value, Fuel Growth", OSG has built an all-in-one growth and monetization platform tailored to developers’ commercialization demands. Covering the full spectrum of traffic integration, ad transactions, revenue optimization, data analytics and more, our platform enables developers to maximize revenue at reduced operational costs.

introduction_zh: 全部美区加白老户，经内购 APP 养号沉淀真实消耗，起量速度快。大客户支持预付实销、多户共享钱包余额，提升资金利用率；后台自主操作资产，账目明细可查，工作日24小时全额退回余额与服务费。
introduction_en: All existing US accounts with whitelisted status have accumulated real spending through the in-app purchase system, resulting in rapid account growth. Large clients are supported with prepaid resale and multiple accounts sharing wallet balances, improving capital utilization. Assets are managed independently in the backend, with detailed account records available. Full refunds of balances and service fees are provided within 24 hours on weekdays.

name_zh: 启赟数字科技（上海）有限公司
introduction_zh:
iPayLinks艾贝盈于2015年成立，以成就客户为使命，通过打造全球一站式跨境支付与资金清结算平台，为跨境企业解决全球业务拓展中的资金收付痛点，帮助跨境企业安全高效地进行全球资金收付、货币兑换和结汇分发等业务。
iPayLinks先后获得元璟、腾讯、联想、凤凰祥瑞、凯洛斯基金等机构投资，连续11年获得PCI-DSS LEVEL1国际卡支付行业认证，业务覆盖150+国家和地区。
introduction_en:
iPayLinks is dedicated to customer success.By establishing a global one-stop cross-border payment and fund clearing/settlement platform,we enable cross-border enterprises to efficiently conduct services such as global fund collection,payment processing,and currency exchange.
iPayLinks has received investments from prominent 
global investment firms，including Vision Plus Capital,Tencent,Lenovo,Phoenix Fortune,and Kairous Capital.

introduction_zh: Agenix Co., Ltd. 是一家专注于泰国及东南亚市场的游戏发行与商务合作公司，为开发商、发行商及合作伙伴提供一站式服务，包括本地化、市场推广、社区运营、KOL营销及商务拓展。我们致力于连接全球游戏企业，帮助优质游戏成功进入东南亚市场，并建立长期合作伙伴关系。
introduction_en: Agenix Co., Ltd. is a game publishing and business partnership company specializing in Thailand and the Southeast Asia (SEA) market. We provide one-stop publishing solutions, including localization, marketing, community management, KOL campaigns, business development, and regional market support. Our mission is to connect global game developers, publishers, and industry partners with the SEA market, helping high-quality games achieve sustainable growth through strategic publishing and long-term partnerships.

introduction_zh:
“PHRONESIS”一词源于古希腊语，意为“实用智慧”。PHRONESIS团队由经验丰富的数字营销专家组成，致力于将智慧、经验与增长策略完美融合。

PHRONESIS是一家数字营销公司，服务范围覆盖亚太、欧洲、东南亚、拉丁美洲、美国和非洲地区。我们为银行、金融服务和保险（BFSI）、电子商务、社交、娱乐、旅游、游戏、公用事业等各行各业的客户提供服务。
introduction_en:
The word "PHRONESIS" is originated from Ancient Greek, meaning "practical wisdom". We at PHRONESIS are experienced digital enthusiast bringing the perfect combination of Intelligence, Experience & Growth strategies.

PHRONESIS is a digital marketing company; offering services across Asia-Pacific, Europe, South-East Asia, LATAM, US & Africa regions. We offer services to clients across verticals like BFSI, Ecommerce, Social, Entertainment, Travel, Gaming, Utility, etc.

introduction_zh: TyrAds 是一家移动效果营销机构，提供简单而独特的解决方案，帮助应用开发者和广告主提升用户获取和变现。我们的奖励平台连接全球超过 4000 万月活跃用户，提升用户留存、参与度和广告投资回报率（ROAS）。我们的解决方案已成功服务于 150 多个全球合作伙伴，覆盖 10 多个国家，包括 Scopely、Huuuge Games 和 NetEase，携手推动可持续增长。
introduction_en: TyrAds is a mobile performance marketing agency specializing in user acquisition and monetization for global app advertisers and developers, with a focus on rewarded advertising. Our rewards platform reaches over 40 million monthly active users worldwide, driving improved retention, engagement, and ROAS. By leveraging hyper-personalization, live operations, and AI-powered recommendations, our simple yet unique solution has supported 150+ global partners across 10+ countries, including Scopely, Huuuge Games, and NetEase, fostering sustainable growth together.

introduction_zh: Tamatem 是中东及北非（MENA）地区领先的游戏发行商，专注于移动游戏发行，本地化以及数字支付解决方案。公司致力于将全球优质游戏引入阿拉伯世界，为开发者提供从本地化，市场推广，增长到运营的一站式服务。通过完善的支付体系，Tamatem有效提升了区域市场用户付费转化率。今年为了进一步扩展业务版图，成功收购了Playbale Factory, 增强了游戏研发与内容创新能力。
introduction_en: Tamatem is a leading game publisher in the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) region, specializing in mobile game publishing, localization services, and digital payment solutions. The company helps global developers successfully enter Arabic-speaking markets through end-to-end support, including localization, marketing, user acquisition, and monetization. With its strong regional payment infrastructure, Tamatem enhances player engagement and revenue performance across MENA. The recent acquisition of Playable Factory has further strengthened Tamatem’s game development and content creation capabilities, reinforcing its position as a key player in the regional gaming ecosystem.

name_zh: 江苏见山数据科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
Dataify专注打造面向AI时代的数据服务平台，围绕数据获取、数据处理、数据交付与基础网络服务，提供稳定、高效、合规的数据服务。
平台聚焦公开网络数据采集、高质量数据集建设及全球网络连接能力，帮助企业便捷地获取多源数据，将其转化为可用于Al训练、模型微调、数据分析和业务决策的高价值数据资产。
introduction_en:
Dataify focuses on building a data service platform for the AI era, offering stable, efficient, and compliant data services around data acquisition, processing, delivery, and basic network services. 
The platform focuses on collecting publicly available online data, creating high-quality datasets, and providing global network connectivity to help companies easily access multi-source data and turn it into high-value data assets for AI training, model fine-tuning, data analysis, and business decisions.

name_zh: 科大讯飞股份有限公司
introduction_zh: 科大讯飞成立于1999年，是亚太地区知名的智能语音与人工智能上市企业。讯飞AI营销AIMarX作为其营销业务核心，依托AI与大数据，为全球客户提供程序化广告、红人营销、媒体代理、联盟营销等全链路服务。自2022年底启动出海战略，AIMarX已覆盖全球30亿用户，在100+国家和地区与1800家+品牌达成合作，深耕电商、本地生活、航旅、娱乐等行业，持续助力全球客户生意增长。
introduction_en:
AIMarX, a global digital marketing platform under iFLYTEK (founded 1999, Asia-Pacific listed AI company), leverages cutting-edge AI to deliver full-funnel marketing solutions — spanning programmatic advertising, media agency, influencer marketing, and affiliate network.
Since launching its globalization strategy in 2022, AIMarX has reached 3 billion users worldwide, partnered with 1,800+ brands across 100+ countries, and achieved breakthroughs in e-commerce, local services, OTA, and entertainment — earning recognition across Europe, the Americas, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Latin America.

introduction_zh: DT (纳斯达克代码: APPS) 致力于紧密连接移动生态。DT 通过整合移动设备、集成移动应用，打造 DT iQ 和 Ignite Graph 智能数据引擎，帮助广告主、开发者和设备伙伴将海量数据转化为可衡量的广告效果，创造更加精准和丰富的用户体验。
introduction_en: DT (NASDAQ: APPS) is unifying the mobile ecosystem by connecting advertisers, app owners, and device partners through on-device integrations, direct app partnerships, and intelligence powered by the Ignite Graph and DT iQ — turning rich data into actionable insights and measurable performance while delivering the scale and performance of a walled garden without the walls. The company's technology is live on more than 1 billion devices and embedded across 80K+ apps, reaching over a billion users each month and enabling growth across the mobile experience.

introduction_zh: 飞书游戏Meetgames是飞书深诺Meetsocial集团旗下的游戏出海营销发行服务，提供海外发行全链路和全生命周期能力支持，帮助游戏企业打破出海壁垒，降低出海门槛，快速起步，获得全球成功。
introduction_en: Meetgames, a game-focused global publishing services platform under MeetSocial Group, delivers end-to-end, full-lifecycle overseas publishing support. We help game companies reduce go-global barriers, accelerate market entry, and achieve sustainable growth worldwide.

introduction_zh:
LaPay是一家专注于为全球企业及数字业务提供一站式跨境支付与本地收单解决方案的金融科技公司。我们致力于打破全球支付的壁垒，通过覆盖超过130+的国家和地区的支付网络，支持多种主流与国际支付方式，帮助客户轻松实现全球收单与资金分发。LaPay以“支付无界，信任有方”为核心理念，用技术驱动全球商业的无缝连接。
让全球支付，更简单，更本地，更可靠。
introduction_en:
LaPay is a fintech company focused on providing one-stop cross-border payment and local acquiring solutions for global enterprise and digital businesses. We are committed to breaking down global payment barriers, through the payment network covering more than 130+ countries and regions, supporting a variety of mainstream and international payment methods, helping customers easily achieve global collection and distribution of funds.We use technology to drive seamless connections in global commerce with the core concept of "Unbounded Payment, Proper Trust".
Make global payments simpler, more local, and more reliable.

introduction_zh: Acctable.net 是专业的海外媒体账户代理，专注为投放团队提供优质稳定的 Facebook 海外账户。账户售后有保障，平台支持 7×24 小时自助充值，是投放团队的信赖之选。
introduction_en: Acctable.net is a reliable provider of Facebook Ad Account. We offer high-quality and stable accounts at competitive prices, along with real-time support to ensure smooth operations and help businesses achieve efficient growth in global digital marketing.

name_zh: 广州安锘科技有限公司
introduction_zh: Anno，专注游戏本地化翻译与配音，覆盖全球40+语言市场，累计交付精品项目3000+部。我们汇聚5000+名母语级精英译员，每一位均深耕游戏语境，从术语统一到文化转译，从情感表达到声效演绎，确保每个字符、每句对白都贴合玩家原生体验。我们信奉“让游戏无边界”——不是一句口号，而是贯穿每个项目的执行准则。脚踏实地，逐字精研，让每一种语言版本，都成为玩家心中的口碑之作。
introduction_en: 无

introduction_zh: 有米科技（股票代码：834156）成立于2010年，深耕全球App推广与变现领域16年。旗下海外广告产品包括海外ASO自投平台ASOGrow、效果广告平台(CPI/CPA)、互动广告变现平台SpinGo以及自研谷歌App矩阵Duit Apps。其海外ASO平台ASOGrow业务覆盖印尼、印度、菲律宾、美国等多个国家地区，提供真人评星评论、关键词排名及榜单优化服务，助力出海App获取更多自然流量。
introduction_en:
Youmi Ads (Stock Code: 834156), founded in 2010, has specialized in global app user acquisition and monetization for 16 years. Our flagship products include the self-serve ASO platform ASOGrow, the performance-based advertising platform (CPI/CPA), the interactive advertising platform SpinGo, and the self-developed Google app portfolio, Duit Apps.

ASOGrow supports both Google Play and the App Store, providing real-user ratings and reviews, keyword ranking optimization, and chart ranking optimization services to help apps achieve sustainable growth in organic traffic and store visibility. Our services cover key markets including Indonesia, India, the Philippines, the United States, and more.

introduction_zh: Involve Asia 成立于 2014 年，总部位于马来西亚，亚洲领先的联盟营销平台，覆盖东南亚六国，涵盖电商销售、应用付费、游戏周边等多类型效果广告交付。汇聚 100 万+ 渠道伙伴，连接品牌广告主与渠道/创作者，服务 TikTok、Shopee、SHEIN、Lazada、Trip.com、CapCut、WPS、Xiaomi 等 500+ 全球品牌，年度 GMV 超 USD 1.3B+
introduction_en: Founded in 2014 and headquartered in Malaysia, Involve Asia is Asia's leading affiliate marketing platform, connecting brand advertisers with publishers and creators across six Southeast Asian markets. The platform delivers performance advertising across e-commerce sales, app monetization, gaming-related products and other verticals, with 1,000,000+ publishers and 500+ global brands — including TikTok, Shopee, SHEIN, Lazada, Trip.com, CapCut, WPS and Xiaomi — and annual GMV exceeding USD 1.3 billion

name_zh: PWN Games 效果广告网络
introduction_zh:
PWN Games 是国际领先的效果广告网络，专注为全球游戏厂商提供基于CPA（按转化效果付费）的PC游戏玩家获取，在PC免费游戏（F2P）领域具备深厚经验。
依托全球1,500+独家PC游戏垂直流量资源，我们已为250+款游戏获取超过4,200万的全球优质PC玩家，合作覆盖腾讯、网易、Scopely、Wargaming等头部游戏厂商，平均合作时长达5年以上。
introduction_en:
PWN Games is a leading performance marketing network specializing in CPA-based global user acquisition for PC games, with deep expertise in free-to-play titles. 

With our exclusive network of 1,500+ vetted traffic sources across the globe, we run highly effective global UA campaigns for PC titles on a CPA(Cost-per Action) model, where advertisers pay only for quality player acquisitions, with qualification metrics defined by the advertiser themselves. 

Founded in 2016 in Montreal, Canada, we have driven 42M+ player acquisitions across 250+ PC titles over the past decade, working with top-tier game publishers — including Tencent, NetEase, Scopely, Wargaming, Gaijin, and more — with an average partnership duration of 5+ years.

introduction_zh: 洄游是业内第一家跨境报酬结算服务商，在外贸、泛娱乐出海、跨境电商、国际物流等行业有很多成功案例，解决跨境薪酬支付、佣金结算等财税合规问题。洄游已服务多家纳斯达克上市公司、国有企业、民营大型企业，并在医疗器械、电子芯片、跨境电商、广告出海、游戏、国际物流等行业都有实施减持、增资扩股、佣金发放、股东分红等实际案例。
introduction_en: Access is a professional solution to the pain point of overseas capital repatriation through cross-border settlement and tax management in the globalisation of enterprises.

introduction_zh: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) 助力数码互动娱乐企业加速全球化发展。面向全球市场拓展，数码互动娱乐企业要推动 AI 高效落地，也要应对跨区域部署、访问体验、数据安全、合规管理和稳定运营等多重挑战。甲骨文OCI凭借高性能、开放、安全、可扩展、原厂本地服务等云技术服务特性，为企业打造坚实技术底座，助力加速AI创新落地，为企业业务创新升级与全球化增长注入强劲动能。
introduction_en: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) empowers Digital Interactive Entertainment Enterprises to accelerate global business expansion. As the demand of the global business expansion, digital interactive entertainment enterprises need to advance the efficient implementation of AI, while meeting multiple challenges including cross-region deployment, access experience, data security, compliance, and stable operations. Depending on the cloud features of high performance, openness for multi-cloud, high security, scalability, and local service support delivered directly by Oracle, OCI can help enterprises build up a resilient technology foundation and accelerate the implementation of AI innovation. OCI also empower the innovation and upgrading of enterprise business, and global growth.

introduction_zh: CRI Middleware China Co., Ltd.（上海希艾维信息科技有限公司），是日本上市公司株式会社CRI集团在华子公司。深耕游戏中间件领域多年，面向中国游戏研发团队，提供涵盖音频、视频及2D图形相关的开发工具、技术支持与整体解决方案。TWOFIVE归属于CRI集团，为海内外企业提供包含配音、作曲和音效等声音创作服务。
introduction_en:
CRI Middleware China Co., Ltd. is the China subsidiary of CRI Middleware Co., Ltd., a publicly listed Japanese company. With many years of experience in the game middleware industry, the company provides Chinese game development teams with development tools, technical support, and comprehensive solutions covering audio, video, and 2D graphics technologies.

TWOFIVE, a member of the CRI Group, provides comprehensive audio production services for companies in Japan and overseas, including voice recording, music composition, and sound effects creation.

introduction_zh: Moclick（魔科力）是拉美与中国的营销科技领航者，为全球企业提供一站式、全渠道效果营销与品牌广告方案。我们深耕移动与网页端全域流，依托自研技术平台及媒体管理专长实现极高颗粒度精准定向。魔科力坚持技术创新、多维洞察与全方位本地化落地驱动，融合线上数字生态与线下场景媒体，提供兼顾高投资回报与中长期品牌价值的品效闭环服务，助力全球品牌沉淀资产，实现可持续全球增长。
introduction_en: Moclick is a premier marketing technology leader connecting China and Latin America, dedicated to providing global enterprises with end-to-end, multi-channel Performance Marketing and Branding solutions. We specialize in driving full-funnel promotion across both Mobile and Web environments, leveraging our robust proprietary platforms and media management expertise to achieve hyper-granular audience targeting. Driven by a powerful combination of technological innovation, multi-dimensional insights, and comprehensive localization, Moclick seamlessly integrates digital ecosystems with offline media exposition. We deliver closed-loop services that balance immediate high ROI with sustainable, long-term brand equity, empowering global brands to unlock growth on a global scale.

introduction_zh: Gamersmarket总部位于中国香港，在大陆、新加坡、美国、日本设有分支。我们是Valve、SIE、Nintendo等全球知名游戏品牌的官方合作伙伴，深耕游戏数字产品赛道多年，面向全球提供Steam、PlayStation、Nintendo等主流充值卡及游戏的分销服务。业务已覆盖大中华区、北美、欧盟、东南亚及中东等主要市场。我们致力于通过数据驱动与API自动化技术，让游戏数字业务更简单。
introduction_en: Headquartered in Hong Kong, Gamersmarket operates branches across Mainland China, Singapore, the USA, and Japan. As an official partner of global gaming giants including Valve, SIE, and Nintendo, we have deep-rooted expertise in the digital gaming sector. We provide global distribution services for mainstream gift cards and games across major platforms like Steam, PlayStation, and Nintendo. Our business network covers key international markets including Greater China, North America, the EU, Southeast Asia, and the Middle East. Driven by data and powered by API automation technology, we are dedicated to making digital gaming business simpler.

introduction_zh: SensorTower是全球领先的数字情报平台，帮助企业洞察消费者行为及移动应用、网站、数字广告、零售媒体和游戏市场的发展趋势。依托覆盖全球的数据网络，为品牌、广告主、发行商、投资机构及咨询公司提供全面的市场洞察与竞争情报，助力企业发现增长机会、洞察竞争格局并制定更具前瞻性的商业决策。目前SensorTower已服务全球超过2500家企业客户，业务覆盖科技、游戏、电商、媒体、消费品、金融等行业。
introduction_en: Sensor Tower is a global provider of digital intelligence solutions, empowering companies to understand consumer behavior and market performance across mobile apps, digital platforms, and gaming ecosystems.  Headquartered in San Francisco, Sensor Tower’s insights are trusted by more than 2,500 enterprises worldwide.

introduction_zh: Payful是全球专业的跨境支付平台，以领先的创新技术实力布局全球，在中国大陆、中国香港、美国、新加坡、日本设有多处办事处，业务覆盖100+国家和地区。Payful专注为全球跨境电商卖家、外贸企业、国际物流、航旅酒店、留学等细分市场客户提供定制化的跨境收款、外贸收款、服贸收款、全球付款、汇率管理等全链路数字化跨境支付服务，为国际贸易链提供安全、高效以及低成本的综合金融科技解决方案。
introduction_en:
Payful is a leading global cross-border payment platform powered by cutting-edge technology. With a strategic global footprint, we operate offices across Mainland China, Hong Kong SAR, the United States, Singapore, and Japan, serving over 100 countries and regions.

Payful is dedicated to delivering tailored, end-to-end digital payment solutions—including e-commerce receivables, B2B trade collections, service trade payments, global payouts, and FX management—for niche markets such as cross-border e-commerce sellers, foreign trade enterprises, international logistics, travel & hospitality, and overseas education. We are committed to empowering the global trade ecosystem with secure, efficient, and cost-effective integrated fintech solutions.

name_zh: 玄武云科技控股有限公司
name_en: Xuan Wu Cloud Technology Holdings Limited.
introduction_zh:
玄武云科技控股有限公司（简称玄武云，股票代码：2392.HK），聚焦AI+云通信领域，提供一站式融合通信数智化解决方案与服务。
其中，玄武云国际云通信深耕国际通信领域，专注为出海企业提供提供国际短信、国际语音、呼叫中心、国际融合通信平台等产品及服务，与全球100+本地运营商合作，业务覆盖全球240+国家及地区，助力企业实现全球业务布局和业绩增长。
introduction_en:
Xuanwu Cloud Technology Holdings Limited (referred to as Xuanwu Cloud, Stock Code: 2392.HK) focuses on the AI-powered cloud communications sector, delivering one-stop digital intelligent solutions and services for unified communications.
Its cross-border cloud communications division specializes in international telecommunications, supplying overseas enterprises with a full suite of products and services including international SMS, international voice, cloud contact centers and global unified communications platforms. Having established partnerships with over 100 local mobile network operators (MNOs) worldwide, it maintains business coverage across more than 240 countries and territories, empowering enterprises to deploy global operations and drive revenue growth.

introduction_zh: Cloud Ace 是 Google Cloud 服务及联合销售钻石级合作伙伴，以及谷歌云、谷歌地图官方授权一级代理商。我们凭借卓越的技术实力与服务品质，连续多年荣获 Google Cloud 年度合作伙伴，并在人工智能等六大技术领域斩获谷歌云高级能力认证。我们致力于为企业提供从云端架构设计、运维支持、系统开发到生成式 AI 应用的一站式解决方案，全方位赋能 AI 游戏出海与全球化业绩增长。
introduction_en: Cloud Ace is a Google Cloud Service & Co-Sell Diamond Partner, as well as an officially authorized Tier-1 reseller for Google Cloud and Google Maps. Leveraging our exceptional technical expertise and service quality, we have been recognized as the Google Cloud Partner of the Year for multiple consecutive years and have achieved Google Cloud Advanced Competencies across six technical domains, including Artificial Intelligence. We are dedicated to providing enterprises with one-stop solutions ranging from cloud architecture design, O&M support, and system development to generative AI applications, comprehensively empowering AI-powered game global expansion and global revenue growth.

name_zh: 北京星空智盛科技发展有限公司
name_en: Beijing ThinkingStars Technology And Development Co., Ltd
introduction_zh: 北京星空智盛科技发展有限公司（ThinkingStars）是一家专注于原创游戏研发的中国公司，致力于为全球玩家打造兼具创新玩法、优秀叙事与独特艺术风格的高品质作品。公司代表作《纪元变异（ANNO: Mutationem）》已登陆 PlayStation、Xbox、Nintendo Switch 及 PC 等全球主流游戏平台，获得国际媒体与玩家的广泛认可，并继续开发面向全球的主机游戏产品
introduction_en: Beijing ThinkingStars Technology Development Co., Ltd. is an independent game development studio based in Beijing, China, focused on creating original IPs for global players. The company is best known for ANNO: Mutationem, a cyberpunk action-adventure RPG released on PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, and PC. Recognized for its distinctive blend of 2D pixel art and 3D environments, the title has earned praise from players and media worldwide. Building on this success, ThinkingStars continues to develop new original projects, combining immersive storytelling, unique artistic direction, and engaging gameplay experiences while expanding its presence through global platform and publishing partnerships.

name_zh: 北京瑕趣科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
Imperfect Games是一家专注于帮游戏开发者打开中国PC游戏市场的公司。我们在2025年5月成立，我们依托深厚的行业积累和优质资源，为Steam游戏开发者提供在中国市场的发行与营销运营支持。
核心成员均来自中国最大游戏平台资深团队。
拥有业内顶尖口碑、广泛人脉及独到信息网络。
善用数据驱动策略，提供专业直观的定制化解决方案。
深度聆听一线玩家声音，为游戏优化提供全方位建议。
introduction_en:
Imperfect Games is a company dedicated to helping game developers expand their presence in China's PC gaming market. Founded in May 2025, we leverage our extensive industry expertise and premium resources to assist Steam game developers with their domestic distribution and marketing operations in China.
Our core team consists of veterans from China's largest gaming platform.
We possess exceptional industry reputation, extensive networks, and unparalleled market intelligence.
Leveraging data-driven strategies, we deliver professional, intuitive, and effective customized solutions.
We actively engage with grassroots player communities, offering comprehensive game optimization recommendations informed by frontline player insights.

name_zh: 上海翼熵网络科技有限公司
name_en: Shanghai ENTROWING Network Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 翼熵网络(ENTROWING)成立于2024年，为了制作出有趣且拥有艺术价值的游戏而诞生。拥有完整3D游戏工作流和独立游戏发行能力。游戏：《领航员计划》《宇宙魔弹》
introduction_en: ENTROWING Network was founded in 2024 to create fun and artistically valuable games. Complete 3D game production workflow and independent game publishing capabilities. Game "Navigator Project" "Godrop"

introduction_zh: Outside the Zoo，总部位于中国香港，是一家独立艺术与娱乐制作工作室，以原创与无限想象力为核心，专注打造独特的知识产权与故事。首款游戏《皇家金喙与雪岛的诅咒》以手绘风格呈现电影化街机冒险，主角 Royal 在雪岛失忆，却依然勇敢前行，拯救他人并寻找自我。Outside the Zoo 同时推出原创角色 IP ，玩具与服饰。诚邀大家体验 Royal 的冒险，加入这段奇妙的创意旅程。
introduction_en: Outside the Zoo, based in Hong Kong, is an independent arts and entertainment studio dedicated to originality and imagination. Our debut game Royal Goldenbeak and the Curse of Snowy Island has a free demo now on Steam, with full release in July. This hand‑drawn cinematic arcade adventure follows Royal, a penguin who awakens on a snowy island with no memory, yet moves forward with courage to rescue others and rediscover identity. Why is Royal on Snowy Island? What lies ahead? Players must uncover the answers themselves. Beyond the game, Outside the Zoo brings original characters into reality through collectibles, character IPs, and lifestyle apparel. At ChinaJoy 2026, we invite you to step into our world, experience Royal’s journey, and discover creations filled with wonder and imagination.

name_zh: 深圳乐炭网络科技有限公司
name_en: Shenzhen Joycoal Network Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh:
深圳乐炭网络科技有限公司（JOYCOAL GAMES）是一家专注全球化游戏研发的初创团队，成员均为资深游戏人，兼具海外发行与玩法创新经验。
公司正全力打造一款融合卡牌构筑、自走棋玩法、肉鸽、多人PVP与二级交易系统的策略新品。玩家将扮演异世界的英雄，通过"魔法扑克牌"构筑来自不同异世界的角色牌组，召唤各色魔神战斗。
游戏面向全球市场发行。
introduction_en:
JOYCOAL GAMES, a start-up team in Shenzhen, specializes in global game development. Its members are all experienced game professionals, possessing both overseas publishing and gameplay innovation expertise.
The company is fully committed to developing a new strategic product that integrates card building, auto-chess gameplay, roguelike elements, multiplayer PVP, and a secondary trading system. Players will take on the role of heroes from another world, constructing decks of characters from diverse realms using "magic playing cards" and summoning various demonic gods to battle.
The game will be released for the global market.

name_zh: 狸屿游戏工作室有限公司
introduction_zh:
"我们是一家中国香港的独立游戏公司，专注打造猫咪主角的精品休闲手游。
针对高压的职场人士，我们以“治愈”为核心理念，通过温馨画风与轻松交互，为上班族提供放松身心的情感避风港。
团队由中美资深开发者组成，核心成员曾任职于谷歌、微软及英伟达等科技巨头。深厚的技术积淀与国际化视野，让我们将前沿技术与细腻艺术完美结合，确保产品在性能与视觉上均达国际一流水平，为全球玩家带来高品质的治愈体验。
"
introduction_en:
We are a boutique indie studio of fewer than 10 members, comprised of senior and staff-level experts formerly from tech giants like Google, Microsoft, and NVIDIA. Geographically distributed across the U.S. and China, we combine Silicon Valley innovation with world-class development efficiency.

We are committed to delivering high-quality, scalable titles with a global-first mindset, ensuring a reliable and highly marketable product for our publishing partners.

introduction_zh: 春叶游戏（SpringLeaf Games） 由独立开发者叶羽创立。创始人拥有十年游戏行业经验，曾任主策，长期专注于策略与Roguelike玩法设计。工作室已推出《Bombox》《绿叶小镇》等作品，目前正在开发战棋Roguelike新作《夜色幻想》。春叶游戏秉持“用心制作，传递乐趣”的理念，致力于打造兼具策略深度与丰富重玩价值的独立游戏。
introduction_en: SpringLeaf Games was founded by independent game developer ENI (Ye Yu). With over ten years of experience in the game industry and a background as a Lead Game Designer, ENI has long focused on strategy and roguelike game design. The studio has released titles including Bombox and Leaf Town, and is currently developing Night Fantasy, a tactical roguelike RPG. Guided by the philosophy of "Crafted with Passion, Designed for Fun," SpringLeaf Games is dedicated to creating independent games that combine strategic depth with strong replayability.

name_zh: 北京绮光科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 北京绮光科技是一家小而美的独立游戏公司，核心是来自知名Top级的出海休闲游戏公司，高级和资深程序与美术组成。我们本身就是休闲游戏的玩家，因为喜欢，所以更专注，愿意打磨节奏和细节、懂那个“治愈感”。只想把愉快和温馨装进每个细节带给玩家。
introduction_en: Quira Game is a small yet exquisite independent game company, with its core team consisting of senior and experienced programmers and artists from renowned top-tier casual gaming companies. We are gamers ourselves, driven by passion, which fuels our focus on refining game-play rhythms and details—understanding that "healing vibe." We aim to infuse every detail with joy and warmth, delivering it to players.

introduction_zh: 游戏首先要好玩！SYZYGY.TECH是秉承着玩法为唯一重点的少人数工作室。SYZYGY成立的时候，以网络游戏开发、电影动画为从业背景的主创们认为游戏本身能够带来欢乐、同乐才是重点，所以每天的开发结束后，所有人会聚在一起玩我们的游戏，如果这一天工作室里爆发出笑声和尖叫，说明我们做对了某些事，反之，则检查今天的工作内容出了什么问题。当我们有了更新更棒的想法时，就是立项下一款游戏的时刻。
introduction_en:
SYZYGY.TECH – Gameplay First.
We’re a small studio where fun comes before everything else. Our core team comes from online game dev and film/VFX, but we believe games are about joy and playing together. Every day after work, we all gather to play our own game. If we hear laughter and screams, we know we’re on the right track. If not, we go back and fix it. When a fresh, better idea hits, that’s when we greenlight the next project.

name_zh: 吉林音像出版社有限责任公司
name_en: Jilin Audio& Visual Publishing House Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 吉林音像出版社具备正规网络游戏出版资质，主营游戏版号申报、内容审核、出版备案、合规运营全流程服务。深耕数字文娱领域多年，严格落实网络内容审核规范，把控游戏剧情、画面、文案合规性。可承接移动端、休闲、电竞、动漫衍生类游戏出版业务，提供材料整理、总局报审、后续备案咨询一站式支持。坚守内容正向导向，依托本地化出版资源，为游戏研发企业高效合规完成出版上线手续。
introduction_en: Jilin Audio-Visual Publishing House holds official online game publishing qualifications, offering full services of version number application, content review, filing and compliance operation. With rich experience in digital entertainment, we strictly check game plots, graphics and texts. We provide one-stop publishing support for mobile, casual, esports and animation derivative games, helping developers launch games efficiently and compliantly with local publishing resources.

name_zh: 上海要玩网络技术有限公司
name_en: Shanghai Yao Wan Network Technology Co., Ltd
introduction_zh: 公司2011年成立于上海，注册资本1000万元，是一家以从事互联网和相关服务为主的企业。主营互联网服务、软件开发、版权代理等业务，深耕游戏研发、运营与推广。公司秉持精品化研发思路，依托成熟团队自研多款优质游戏，秉持“好玩当然要玩”的品牌理念，聚焦用户体验打磨产品。
introduction_en: Shanghai Yaotan Network Technology Co., Ltd., founded in Shanghai in 2011 with a registered capital of 10 million yuan, is an enterprise mainly engaged in Internet and related services. It mainly engages in Internet services, software development, copyright agency and other businesses, and focuses on game research and development, operation and promotion. The company adheres to the concept of boutique research and development, relies on a mature team to independently develop multiple high-quality games, and upholds the brand concept of "fun, of course, play", focusing on user experience to polish products.

introduction_zh: 西梅树工作室（PlumTree Studio）是一家成立于2019年的独立游戏团队，专注于休闲、模拟经营类游戏创作。工作室作品包括《噗噗的冒险乐园》《小闹花园》《异星鼠鼠》等，风格可爱治愈，注重轻量玩法、收集成长与温暖陪伴感，致力于为玩家带来轻松、有趣且富有个性的游戏体验。
introduction_en: PlumTreeStudio is an independent game studio founded in 2019, focusing on casual, simulation, management, and desktop companion games. Its works include PuPu’s Adventure Park, BuGarden, and Astro Mouse. With a cute and cozy style, the studio emphasizes light gameplay, collection, growth, and a warm sense of companionship, aiming to create relaxing, charming, and distinctive game experiences for players.

name_zh: 厦门仙掌互娱有限公司
name_en: Xiamen Xianzhang Interactive Entertainment Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 厦门仙掌互娱有限公司是一家专注于移动游戏研发、深耕手游领域的独立工作室。凭借对游戏设计的热爱与专业，已成功开发并推出《纳米特工》、《特种鸡动队》、《苟荒纪》等优质手游作品。我们坚持以玩家体验为核心，注重玩法创新与细节打磨，致力于打造兼具趣味性与独特性的移动游戏，用匠心打磨每一款作品，传递游戏的快乐与温度。
introduction_en: Xiamen Xianzhang Interactive Entertainment Co., Ltd. is an independent studio focusing on mobile game development. Deeply rooted in the mobile game field, with passion and professionalism for game design, we have successfully developed and launched high-quality mobile game works such as Nano Agent, Chicken Tacticals and Zombhunt. We put player experience at the core, focus on gameplay innovation and detail polishing, and are committed to creating interesting and unique mobile games, crafting each work with ingenuity to convey the joy and warmth of games.

introduction_zh: Esprit Games 成立于2014年，是国际游戏发行商，团队60+人，专注H5与移动端免费游戏发行、运营和增长。提供营销、本地化、社区运营及玩家支持服务，并拓展PC付费游戏业务，为独立开发者提供发行与联合投资支持，助力项目实现全球化与长期商业成功。
introduction_en:
Esprit Games is an international game publisher founded in 2014. With a team of 60+ professionals worldwide, we specialize in publishing, operating, and growing online games for global audiences.

Our core business focuses on H5 and mobile free-to-play titles. Through publishing, marketing, localization, community management, and player support, we help games reach their full potential and build engaged player communities.

As part of our growth strategy, we are expanding into the premium PC games market and building a diverse portfolio of high-quality titles for players worldwide.

We are always open to partnerships with indie developers and studios, including publishing and co-funding opportunities, helping promising projects reach wider audiences and achieve long-term success.

introduction_zh:
由三人组成的独立游戏团队，均毕业于国内985或顶尖艺术类院校。
具有多年独立游戏开发经验。
来自奇绩创坛、游戏扳机被投项目核心开发组。
introduction_en:
An independent game team of three members, all graduates from China’s top 985 universities or leading art schools.

The team has years of experience in indie game development.

Core members previously worked on a game project backed by MiraclePlus and Game Trigger.

name_zh: 深圳市燧星未来科技有限公司
name_en: Shenzhen Suixing Future Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 本公司目前致力于《诸天领主》独立游戏的开发。
introduction_en: Our company is currently dedicated to the development of the indie game "Honor of Lord."

name_zh: 宁波梦幻网络科技有限公司
name_en: Ningbo Dream Network Tech Co., Ltd.
logo: https://appobs.chinajoy.net/user/admin/exhibitionMaterials/1781265433045_宁波梦幻网络科技有限公司.jpg
introduction_zh:
宁波梦幻网络科技有限公司 2021 年扎根浙江宁波，是一支专注原创内容的本土化独立游戏研发团队。团队汇聚资深程序、原画、游戏策划与剧情编剧等专业人才，全体成员深耕单机与独立游戏领域多年，拥有扎实的项目研发经验。
始终坚守小而精、重内容、强原创的核心研发理念，潜心打磨作品。我们专注于国产原创单机及 PC 独立游戏的开发创作，坚持以匠心打造优质游戏内容，力求为玩家带来独具本土特色与创意的游戏体验。
introduction_en:
Ningbo Dream Network Tech Co., Ltd. in Ningbo, Zhejiang in 2021, Missile Cat Studio is a local indie game development team. Our core members are experienced programmers, artists, game designers and story writers with years of experience in standalone and indie game development.
Rooted in the vibrant cultural and creative industry of Ningbo, we adhere to the philosophy of "lean but refined, content-oriented and original". We focus on developing original domestic standalone and PC indie games, committed to creating high-quality gaming works with ingenuity.

name_zh: 杭州魂族网络科技有限公司
name_en: Hangzhou Hunzu Network Technology Co., Ltd
introduction_zh: 杭州魂族网络科技有限公司成立于2017年初，是一家集自主设计、研发、运营于一体的独立游戏公司。秉承“游戏让生活更美好”的理念，依托现有的平台及资源，不断开拓和整合整个游戏生命周期的上下游，为玩家提供更多更好玩的游戏产品。当前代表作《魂族崛起》游戏集挖矿+塔防+肉鸽于一身的独特玩法，纯正的欧卡手绘风，希望能给玩家带来别样的体验。
introduction_en: Hangzhou Hunzu Network Technology Co., Ltd., founded in early 2017, is an independent game company that integrates independent design, research and development, and operation. Adhering to the concept of "games make life better", relying on existing platforms and resources, we continuously explore and integrate upstream and downstream aspects of the entire game lifecycle, providing players with more and better game products. Our current flagship game, "Rise of the Hunzu", combines mining, tower defense, and roguelike elements in a unique gameplay, featuring a pure European-style hand-drawn art style. We hope to bring players a unique experience.

name_zh: 上海麦思阿噗互联网科技有限责任公司
introduction_zh: Messed Up Game Studio 是一家专注于原创游戏研发的独立游戏团队。团队成员来自程序、设计、策划等不同领域，以对游戏的热爱为纽带，坚持打造兼具创意、策略与趣味性的原创作品。团队采用扁平化协作模式，注重创新与玩家体验，致力于通过高品质游戏内容，为全球玩家创造充满欢乐与惊喜的互动体验。未来将持续探索更多原创IP与创新玩法。
introduction_en: Founded by a passionate team of game developers, Messed Up Game Studio is an independent studio focused on creating original multiplayer gaming experiences. Bringing together talents from programming, design, art, and production, we believe great games are born from creativity, collaboration, and a deep understanding of players. Through our flat team structure and player-first philosophy, we craft games that combine innovation, strategy, and fun for audiences worldwide. As we grow, we remain committed to building original IPs and exploring fresh gameplay experiences that surprise and delight players.

name_zh: 海口幻海网络科技有限公司
name_en: Haikou MiraWave Network Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 海口幻海网络科技有限公司是一家专注于独立游戏研发的游戏公司，面向全球市场打造具有原创玩法与鲜明艺术风格的精品游戏。创始人毕业于美国南加州大学游戏专业，曾在 USC Games 旗舰毕设项目 AGP 中担任创意总监，并上线作品《Machine Heart》。其后加入暴雪娱乐，在《暗黑破坏神 IV》团队担任 Gamepla Engineer 三年，具备从创意设计到商业化产品开发的完整经验。
