introduction_en: Haikou MiraWave Network Technology Co., Ltd. is a game development company focused on creating independent games with original gameplay and distinctive art styles for the global market. Its founder graduated from the renowned USC Games program at the University of Southern California, served as Creative Director on one of the Advanced Game Projects (AGP), and released the game Machine Heart on Steam. He later joined Blizzard Entertainment and worked on the AAA title Diablo IV as a Gameplay Engineer for three years. The company brings end-to-end expertise from creative design to commercial product development.

introduction_zh: 迷逻辑工作室是一个于2023年组建的6人独立游戏团队，位于上海，由KFS建筑师事务所投资。
introduction_en: Fuzzilogic Studio is a 6-member game-developing team founded in 2023 and located in Shanghai.

name_zh: 天津新创元科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 天津新创元科技有限公司成立于2013年1月，是一家专业从事游戏研发、发行、运营和出版的国家高新技术企业，总部设在天津，在上海、海南、河南等地设有5家分公司。2024年8月8日公司获得国家新闻出版署颁发的网络出版服务许可证，新创元正式成为游戏出版服务单位。2026年1月至5月每月获批游戏版号6款，现已出版83款游戏版号，每月获批游戏数量和单款游戏获批速度均位居国内出版单位前列。
introduction_en: Tianjin NewCreate Technology Co., Ltd.,was founded in January 2013.This national high-tech enterprise specializes in game R&D,distribution, operation and publishing. Headquartered in Tianjin, it has five branch companies located inShanghai, Hainan,Henan and other regions. On August8,2024, the company was granted the Online Publishing Service License by the National Press and Publication Administration,marking Xinchuangyuan's official qualification as a game publishing service provider.From January to May 2026,the company obtained approval for6game version numbers each month,with a total of 83 game version numbers published to date.It ranks among the top domestic publishing institutions in terms of the monthly number of approved games and the approval efficiency for individual game titles.

introduction_zh: 我们是一家以Steam游戏研发为主的公司，致力于制作好玩有趣的游戏！
introduction_en: We are a game company, committed to making interesting games!

introduction_zh:
未来电视有限公司是中央广播电视总台央视网旗下自主可控、具有强大影响力的新媒体运营机构。
自2011年成立以来，一直致力于为海内外用户提供优质视听内容服务，促进中外文化交流传播。
introduction_en: Future TV Co., Ltd.​ is a proprietary, influential new media operator under CCTV.com (China Media Group / CMG). Since its establishment in 2011, the company has been dedicated to providing high-quality audiovisual content services to users worldwide, while promoting cultural exchanges between China and the rest of the world.

name_zh: 天津天匠动画科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 天匠动画成立于2013年，是一家以游戏研发、游戏发行、游戏美术制作为核心，同时涵盖游戏程序和数字孪生领域的互联网公司。公司汇聚160余名专业制作人员，核心团队拥有十余年行业经验，具备从策划到全流程制作的完整能力。此外，公司在东京设有分公司，持续整合国内外资源，致力于为国内外客户提供高品质的数字创意服务。
introduction_en: Tenjoy Studio is an Internet company founded in 2013, specializing in game development, publishing, game asset production, programming, and digital twins. With over 160 experienced professionals and a branch office in Tokyo, the studio delivers high-quality digital creative services to domestic and international clients across the game industry.

name_zh: 天津坤舆科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 天津坤舆科技有限公司是一家专注于互动叙事与情感体验的游戏研发发行公司。团队在影游互动、文字冒险、休闲模拟等方向持续探索，力求在玩法与表达之间找到平衡。自研作品包括民俗悬疑游戏《山鬼志：寒衣》、影游《怦然心动的瞬间》，以及在研的卡皮巴拉IP桌面游戏；发行作品有《开局五个亿》多端、《重生了还要我谈恋爱》移动版、《心动恋旅：樱花篇》NS版、即将上线的《橘香仲夏》《眼忙嘴乱》等。
introduction_en: Tianjin Kunyu Technology Co., Ltd. is a game developer and publisher focusing on interactive narrative and emotional experiences. The team explores genres such as interactive film games, text adventures, and casual sims, striving to balance gameplay and storytelling. Its self-developed titles include the folk horror game Winter: Clothing, the interactive film and an in-development tabletop game based on the Capybara IP. Published games include Start with Half Billion: Love Choice, Reborn and Still in Love, Love Tour: Sakura Chapter(Switch), and the upcoming Citrus Summer and Don't Lose Face.

name_zh: 天津神匠互娱科技发展有限公司
introduction_zh: 神匠游戏是Tenjoy集团旗下独立游戏工作室，致力于轻网络化独立游戏的开发，公司将秉承高效、创新、精品的研发理念持续不断地为全球用户提供优秀的产品和服务。工作室目前拥有独立游戏《漠土之息》、超休闲手游《一起来扫雷》、轻策略4XSLG手游《小小星系》等产品。
introduction_en: Sunjoy Game is an indie game studio under the Tenjoy Group, dedicated to the development of lightly networked indie games. The company adheres to the R&D philosophy of efficiency, innovation, and high quality, continuously providing excellent products and services to global users. The studio's current portfolio includes the indie game Breath of the Wasteland, the hyper-casual mobile game Let's Minesweeper, and the light 4X SLG mobile game Little Big Starallies

name_zh: 南京鼎尊网络发展优先公司
introduction_zh: 南京鼎尊网络是一家专注于独立游戏制作的公司。目前有四个游戏项目：1、卡牌对战游戏《野球拳》上线Steam平台；2、正在研发策略经营建造历史模拟类游戏《江山多娇》。这款游戏突破了传统策略游戏的框架，提供自由划分领土、定制官职和建筑，让玩家体验真正独特的策略、建造和经营乐趣；3、桌面建造冒险游戏《魔金传说》；4、像素飞船建造射击游戏《星际崔客》。
introduction_en:
Nanjing Dingzun Network is a company focused on independent game development. It currently has four game projects:
“The Warilin of Heroes” – a card battle game that has been launched on the Steam platform.
“Long May You Reign” (The Majestic Land) – a strategy, management, construction, and historical simulation game currently in development. This game breaks the framework of traditional strategy games, offering players the freedom to divide territories, customize official positions and buildings, and experience truly unique strategic, construction, and management fun.
“Legends of Arcanor” – a desktop construction adventure game.
“Space Traek” (Interstellar Cuike) – a pixel-style spaceship building and shooting game.

name_zh: 上海希艾维信息科技有限公司
introduction_zh: CRI Middleware中国（上海希艾维信息科技有限公司）成立于2019年，是一家致力于为中国的游戏研发公司提供音频、视频、2D图形相关开发工具和解决方案的综合性的技术服务公司，并且致力于构建中日开发者的沟通桥梁。大股东株式会社CRI Middleware Co.,Ltd.是一家来自日本的老牌的游戏中间件厂商，自2016 年进入中国以来，一直致力于帮助中国本地的开发者，解决音频和视频的痛点。
introduction_en:
CRI Middleware China, established in 2019, is a comprehensive technology service provider dedicated to delivering audio, video, and 2D graphics development tools and solutions for game developers in China. The company also serves as a bridge between Chinese and Japanese developers, promoting technical collaboration and industry exchange.

Its major shareholder, CRI Middleware Co., Ltd., is a leading Japanese game middleware company. Since entering the Chinese market in 2016, CRI has been committed to supporting local developers by addressing challenges in audio and video development.

introduction_zh:
7799Music是一家提供配乐、音效、配音等音频内容制作的一站式工作室。
合作案例及公司：烽火与炊烟，宋上繁华，忆蚀，怪奇漫游指南，哥布林维克，电魂，4399，会畅科技等。
更多案例以及介绍请移步官网：www.7799music.com。
introduction_en:
7799Music is a one-stop audio production studio specializing in original soundtracks, sound effects, voice-over recording and other audio content services.
Visit our official website www.7799music.com to view more portfolio works and detailed introductions.

introduction_zh: 专注于克苏鲁题材的独立游戏开发者，已经在Steam上架有克系文字冒险游戏《珍珠梦》、克系碎片化解密游戏《耶兰多的低语》、克系挂机种草游戏《本草计划》，现有2个项目正在开发中。
introduction_en: An indie game developer dedicated to Cthulhu Mythos-themed games. Titles already available on Steam include the Lovecraftian text adventure Pearl Dream, the fragmented puzzle game Whispers of Y'Ryando, and the idle-style cultivation game Herba Project. Two additional projects are presently under development.

introduction_zh: 辛酉工作室专注于剧情向独立游戏产品研发。
introduction_en: Xin You Studio dedicated to the production of narrative-driven indie games.

introduction_zh: 仙海游Game深度融合前沿AI 智能技术与游戏开发引擎的强大效能，以技术创新驱动精品创作。我们凭借卓越的智能化研发管线与优秀的人才团队，持续打造高品质游戏作品，树立游戏研发行业标杆！
introduction_en: Xianhaiyou Games leverages deep integration of advanced AI and game engine technology to drive innovation. Our intelligent R&D infrastructure and talented team position us to consistently produce high-quality titles that establish industry benchmarks.

introduction_zh: LEAFSUMMER（叶夏）是一个女性创作者主导的独立游戏工作室，专注于创作有温度的女性向二次元游戏。我们希望通过可爱的角色、温柔的故事和轻幻想的世界，让玩家感受到被听见、被理解，也被温柔地陪伴。《女儿的魔法》是我们献给爱、成长与勇气的一次尝试。作为一个还在成长中的小小工作室，我们珍惜每一次相遇，也希望把这份小小的魔法带到更多人的心里。
introduction_en: LEAFSUMMER is a female-led indie game studio focused on creating warm, anime-inspired games for women and players who love heartfelt stories. Through lovable characters, gentle storytelling, and light fantasy worlds, we hope to create experiences where players feel heard, understood, and loved. Princess Tomorrow is our heartfelt attempt to explore love, growth, and courage. As a small studio still growing, we cherish every encounter and hope to bring this little piece of magic to more hearts.

name_zh: 汕头小小网络有限公司
introduction_zh:
汕头小小网络有限公司，30人专业研发团队、知名游戏公司任职经验、 团队结构完善、人员稳定。
自研产品50款，累积用户超2000万，单款最高流水超1200万。
定制产品累积超500单，服务过阿里、腾讯、字节等177甲方。
introduction_en:
Shantou SmallGame Network Co., Ltd 
We have a 30-person professional game R&D team. Team members have working experience at famous game companies, with a complete organizational structure and low staff turnover.
We have developed 50 self-owned products, gaining over 20 million total users. The maximum revenue of a single product tops 12 million RMB.
We have completed over 500 customized projects and served 177 clients including Alibaba, Tencent and ByteDance.

introduction_zh:
Mejoy Ads，出海新媒体增长专家。Mejoy Ads 致力于助力数字时代的全球化商业增长，为中国出海企业提供效果营销定制解决方案和广告托管服务，凭借优质的广告优化经验和素材创意制作等服务，为出海企业提供高质量的流量和用户，提升营销效率和ROI。

Mejoy Ads 可投放：NewsBreak、SmartNews、Reddit、Apple News、Meta等全媒体矩阵，满足广告主买量需求。
introduction_en:
Mejoy Ads
Your Overseas Growth Engine.

Mejoy Ads specializes in helping Chinese brands scale internationally through data-driven user acquisition and performance marketing solutions.

From strategic planning and media buying to creative production and campaign optimization, we deliver end-to-end advertising services that connect brands with high-value users worldwide. Our expertise enables advertisers to improve acquisition efficiency, maximize marketing ROI, and achieve sustainable growth in competitive global markets.

With access to leading media platforms such as NewsBreak, SmartNews, Reddit, Apple News, Meta and other leading global media partners，Mejoy Ads provides advertisers with scalable, high-quality traffic sources tailored to diverse growth objectives.

name_zh: 上海部恩科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
SteamPY（匹歪）是目前国内玩家首选的正版游戏交易平台，目前已为90%PC游戏提供交易支持。
依托全自动CDkey分发系统和实时交易数据，用户可以低人力成本管理游戏CDkey交易。平台采用银行级加密技术保障交易安全，0纠纷，支持Api直连实现库存同步与销售数据可视化。PY坚守低商业化推广原则，为优秀游戏产品提供曝光与宣传支持。
introduction_en:
SteamPY is the leading game trading platform in China, trusted by millions of PC gamers and supporting transactions for more than 90% of PC game titles.
Powered by a fully automated CDkey distribution system and real-time transaction data, SteamPY enables users to manage their game key sales, distribution, and transactions with minimal operational. The platform uses bank-grade encryption to secure transactions, maintains zero dispute record, and offers API direct connectivity to synchronize inventory and data visualization sales. Committed to a low-commercialization approach, SteamPY also provides promotional opportunities and marketing support to help outstanding game titles gain greater visibility among players.

name_zh: 西安仙踪林信息科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 西安仙踪林（IMMORTALS STUDIOS）2018年成立于西安，并设吉隆坡分公司。我们是一支富有热忱的艺术家团队，专注于概念设计、角色建模、场景绘制及特效呈现。我们坚信，卓越的游戏艺术是视觉享受与情感叙事的融合。在技术探索与艺术传承中，我们持续创新，结合前沿工具与美术精髓，为每一款游戏作品注入独特灵魂。
introduction_en: Immortals Studios is a game art outsourcing company where imagination and passion create spellbinding visuals. We deliver 2D concept art, 3D modeling, level design, texturing, animation, and VFX for all game genres—from casual puzzlers to AAA hyper-realistic epics. Our clients include Blizzard, Tencent, Nexon, Mihoyo, Hi-Rez, and Krafton. We offer flexible pricing that adapts to client budgets or competitive fixed rates. What sets us apart is our commitment to lasting relationships, collaboration, strong management, and rigorous quality control. With offices in Xi'an (China) and Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), Immortals Studios is your go-to partner for unforgettable game art.

introduction_zh: tpay is the leading payment connector across the Middle East, Turkey, & Africa (META), helping gaming companies monetize and scale across one of the world's fastest-growing digital regions.
introduction_en: tpay is the leading payment connector across the Middle East, Turkey, & Africa, helping gaming companies monetize and scale across one of the world’s fastest-growing digital regions. Operating in 30+ countries and partnering with hundreds of mobile operators, tpay enables seamless access to Direct Carrier Billing (DCB), mobile wallets, and other localized payment methods through a single integration. Trusted by global gaming and digital leaders including Tencent, Riot Games, Garena, Google, Huawei, MBC, and others, tpay helps merchants increase conversion, expand payment reach, and unlock new revenue opportunities. By simplifying local payment acceptance and delivering reliable connectivity across the region, tpay enables secure, frictionless digital transactions at scale throughout META.

introduction_zh: 蒸汽平台是畅玩游戏、讨论游戏、创造游戏的快乐所在。
introduction_en: Steam China is the place to play, discuss, and create games.

introduction_zh: Headup Games是一家德国独立游戏发行商，总部位于德国杜伦主要从事电子游戏的发行与推广。Headup 以支持独立开发团队闻名，最具代表性的作品是由ClockStone开发的《桥梁工程师》系列。
introduction_en:
Headup GmbH is a German video game publisher based in Düren. Founded in 2009, the company publishes and supports a wide range of indie and mid-sized titles across PC and consoles, working closely with development studios worldwide to bring distinctive, gameplay-focused experiences to global audiences.

Known for its diverse catalogue and strong presence in the indie games space, Headup focuses on identifying creative projects and helping them reach international markets across major platforms.

introduction_zh: ESDigital Games是一家全球游戏发行商，专注于PC及主机游戏发行。我们提供市场营销、公关、达人合作、本地化、社区运营及发行服务，帮助开发者触达全球玩家。代表作品包括《Steel Seed》《AWAKEN – Astral Blade》《Unusual Findings》，以及即将推出的《Go Slimey Go!》《Sky of Tides》等。
introduction_en: ESDigital Games is a global video game publisher bringing standout titles to players across PC and consoles. With expertise in marketing, PR, influencer relations, localization, social media, community management, digital and physical distribution and platform publishing, we help developers reach wider audiences while they focus on creating great games. Our portfolio includes Redeemer, 9 Monkeys of Shaolin, Steel Seed, AWAKEN – Astral Blade,  Unusual Findings, and more, with upcoming titles such as Go Slimey Go!, Sky of Tides and Island of Winds.

introduction_zh:
ZoopTEK是一家美国独立游戏开发与发行公司，主要从事电子游戏设计、程序开发和发行工作。公司成立于1999年至2000年前后，总部位于美国伊利诺伊州地区，长期专注于独立游戏项目的研发。
最早因多人射击游戏《Paint Ball 3 EXTREME》而成立。该作品在运营期间累计获得超过 8 万次下载，为公司后续发展奠定了基础。此后，公司陆续开发了策略、动作、射击和多人在线等多个类型的游戏。
introduction_en:
ZoopTEK is an independent video game development and publishing company based in the United States. Founded around 1999–2000 and headquartered in Illinois, the company has focused primarily on the development of independent game projects.

The company was originally established around the development of the multiplayer shooter *Paint Ball 3 EXTREME*. During its active years, the game accumulated more than 80,000 downloads, helping to establish a foundation for the company's future growth. Since then, ZoopTEK has developed games across a variety of genres, including strategy, action, shooter, and multiplayer online titles.

introduction_zh: HexMap Games is an indie studio crafting turn-based strategy and management games with deep worldbuilding and long-session depth.
introduction_en: HexMap Games is an indie game studio creating strategy and management games with strong worldbuilding and long session depth. Thieves Guild Master™ is our current project: a medieval fantasy thieves’ guild management game about contracts, crew building, guild progression, and city influence.

introduction_zh:
我们是一支分布在澳洲和中国的5人建制的独立游戏开发团队，涵盖编剧、程序、美术与统筹。团队建制完整，不依赖外部核心外包，内部自带专业的全栈开发与跨文化本地化能力。
这里既有具备大型金融科技与企业级IT架构经验的成员；同时，我们也拥有前游戏行业资深从业者与纯粹的艺术导向人才。这种“现实骨感”与“艺术敏锐”的结合，构成了我们独特的创作视角。
introduction_en:
We are an independent, five-member game development studio based in Australia and China, with roles spanning narrative design, programming, art, and production. We operate as a fully integrated unit without relying on core external outsourcing, equipped with in-house professional full-stack development and cross-cultural localization capabilities.

Our roster features professionals with experience in large-scale FinTech and enterprise-level IT architecture, as well as veteran game developers and purely art-focused talents. It is exactly this collision of "harsh reality" and "artistic intuition" that shapes our unique creative vision.

introduction_zh: Artisans' Den 是由 Tobias Edvardsen 创立的个人独资企业，并与一支由翻译人员和活动助理组成的团队合作。公司专注于游戏与艺术创作，目前的核心项目为 《Rushaug: Feline Warfare》。
introduction_en: Artisan's Den is a sole proprietorship of Tobias Edvardsen, and his team of translators and event assistants. Making games and art with "Rushaug: Feline Warfare" being the primary project.

introduction_zh: Superjoy是一家韩国游戏开发与发行公司，专注于手机、PC（Steam）及HTML5游戏。我们希望与PC游戏发行商及HTML5游戏平台建立合作关系。旗下HTML5游戏目前位居韩国Toss平台畅销榜第一，期待与您携手开拓全球市场。
introduction_en:
Superjoy is a South Korean game developer and publisher specializing in mobile, PC (Steam), and HTML5 games.

At ChinaJoy 2026, we are seeking opportunities to partner with PC game publishers and HTML5 game platform operators.

Our primary goal is to establish strategic collaborations with HTML5 platform companies to bring our games to a broader global audience.

One of our HTML5 titles is currently the No. 1 top-grossing game on Toss, one of South Korea's largest mobile platforms, demonstrating our strong expertise in developing and operating successful HTML5 games.

We look forward to meeting companies interested in publishing, platform partnerships, and long-term business collaboration.

introduction_zh: 我们是来自印度尼西亚的四人独立游戏开发团队。目前正在开发一款名为《Luminote》的叙事型水族造景模拟游戏。我们致力于打造一款能够满足世界需求的原创产品。
introduction_en: An four-man indie game developer group from Indonesia. Currently working on Luminote, a narrative aquascape simulation game. We're thriving to make our own product to satisfy the world.

introduction_zh: 金契地精(Goldpact Goblins)是一支由经验丰富的发行老兵组成的精锐团队。不同于发行和研发的强绑定关系，金契地精(Goldpact Goblins)为单机厂商提供了更为灵活的发行业务解决方案。我们可在全球范围内提供包括：产品研发支持、市场营销策略制定、Discord社群运营、Steam社区维护及评测管理、社交媒体运营、公关与市场推广支持、KOL合作与拓展管理等的全流程服务。
introduction_en: Goldpact Goblins is an elite team founded by seasoned publishing veterans. Unlike the traditional publisher and developer model, Goldpact Goblins delivers more flexible publishing solutions to indie studios in need of publishing services. We offer end-to-end global services including: development support, marketing strategy, Discord management, Steam community maintenance and review monitoring, social media management, PR and marketing campaign support, as well as KOL outreach and management.

introduction_zh: UBIS是一家同时拥有 AI 游戏开发平台与自主游戏IP的AI游戏工作室。公司自主研发的 UBIS AI AGENT可仅基于二维原画自动生成完整的三维角色及动画数据，无需额外进行 3D 建模，大幅革新了游戏开发的整体制作流程。该技术可将传统需要数百小时完成的制作流程大幅缩短并已， 在实际游戏开发项目中验证了其商业化价值、生产效率及可落地性。
introduction_en: UBIS is an AI game studio that combines an AI-powered game development platform with proprietary game IP. Our proprietary technology, UBIS AI AGENT, automatically generates fully rigged 3D characters and animation data directly from 2D concept art, eliminating the need for additional 3D modeling and significantly transforming the entire game production pipeline. Leveraging this AI technology, UBIS is simultaneously developing its own flagship title, LUNA, a subculture-themed PvPvE MOBA game, while expanding its business by providing an AI-powered game development platform (SaaS) to external game studios. Through dual-revenue recurring subscription income from its AI SaaS platform with revenue generated from game IP growth and licensing, UBIS is building a sustainable business model.

introduction_zh:
GAME AiCON Seoul是韩国规模领先的国际化B2B游戏产业平台，致力于连接中国、日本、韩国及全球游戏产业伙伴。
活动涵盖商务对接、游戏展示、行业论坛、开发者交流与国际合作，帮助开发者、发行商及投资机构建立合作关系，共同推动亚洲游戏产业的全球化发展。
introduction_en:
GAME AiCON Seoul is a leading B2B game conference and networking platform based in Seoul, South Korea. 
We connect game developers, publishers, investors, service providers, and industry leaders from across Asia and around the world. 
Through conferences, business matchmaking, indie showcases, networking events, and industry partnerships, GAME AiCON helps create new business opportunities and supports global collaboration within the game industry. 
Our mission is to connect Asia and inspire the world by building meaningful relationships across the global game ecosystem.

introduction_zh: BitSummit创办于2013年，是日本领先的独立游戏盛会，每年在京都举办。活动汇聚来自日本及世界各地的优秀独立游戏、开发者、发行商、媒体与玩家，通过试玩展示、舞台节目、奖项评选及商务交流，向全球推广富有创意的独立游戏与开发团队。
introduction_en: Launched in 2013, BitSummit is Japan’s leading independent game festival, created to showcase innovative indie games from Japan and connect their developers with players, media, publishers, and partners worldwide. Held annually in Kyoto, the event brings together selected indie titles, hands-on exhibits, live stage programming, awards, business networking, and opportunities for international discovery. BitSummit is organized by the Japan Independent Games Association (JIGA), the BitSummit Executive Committee, and Kyoto Prefecture, with support from KYOTO CMEX.

name_zh: 永幻文化发展（上海）有限公司
introduction_zh: 永恒的爱与忧伤
introduction_en: Everlasting Love and Sorrow

introduction_zh: 艾菲联盟营销网络是领先的全球营销解决方案提供商，通过广泛的联盟合作网络，为客户提供全面的营销服务。凭借丰富的360度整合营销经验，我们帮助企业获得更高的品牌曝光度和用户参与度，在竞争激烈的市场环境中脱颖而出。我们坚持创新与合作并重，致力于为客户创造卓越且可持续的商业价值。
introduction_en: Affalliances is the leading global marketing solution provider, offering a comprehensive range of services through our extensive network of affiliate alliances. Our expertise in 360-degree marketing strategies ensures that businesses receive the exposure and engagement they need to succeed in today's competitive landscape. With a focus on innovation and collaboration, we are dedicated to driving impactful results for our clients.

name_zh: 厦门异次元网络技术有限公司
introduction_zh: 厦门异次元网络技术有限公司，专注卡牌游戏研发。核心作品《元气唤灵师》已登陆TapTap，以东方幻想为题材，融合3D手办风格卡牌收集、策略战斗，打造沉浸式体验。我们深耕玩法创新，致力于为玩家呈现高品质卡牌游戏佳作。
introduction_en: Xiamen Yiziyuan Network Tech Co., Ltd. is all about making card games. Our main game, Spirit Summoner, is already on TapTap. It’s got Eastern fantasy vibes, mixed with 3D figure-style card collecting and strategic battles—super immersive! We’re big on trying new gameplay stuff, and we’re here to make top-notch card games for players.

introduction_zh: 505 Pulse 是由全球数字娱乐公司Digital Bros Group 旗下运营的独立游戏发行品牌。该品牌致力于为开发者的项目注入活力，提供从质量保证与本地化到制作、平台提交、市场营销、公关及项目融资等全方位的开发支持。凭借覆盖 PlayStation、Xbox、任天堂、Steam 等平台的全球影响力，505 Pulse 确保游戏能够触达全球玩家。
introduction_en: 505 Pulse is the indie-focused publishing label powered by the global digital entertainment powerhouse, Digital Bros Group. The label aims to breathe life into developers' projects by offering a full suite of development support, ranging from QA & Localization to Production, Platform Submissions, Marketing, PR, and Project Funding. With a global reach spanning platforms such as PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo, Steam, and beyond, 505 Pulse ensures that games reach players worldwide.

introduction_zh: RTBDemand 整合了自动化广告运营（Autonomous AdOps）、AI 驱动的收益优化以及应用增长合作伙伴服务。现诚邀游戏、短剧、社交约会、工具类及加密货币类应用开发者/发行商合作。平台拥有 25 家以上需求方合作伙伴，并提供全天候（24/7）AI 智能运营支持。
introduction_en: RTBDemand combines Autonomous AdOps, AI revenue optimization, and app growth partnerships. Seeking Gaming, Short Drama, Dating, Utility, and Crypto app publishers. 25+ demand partners. 24/7 AI Ops

introduction_zh:
Wales Interactive是一家来自英国威尔士的获奖独立游戏开发与发行公司，同时也是互动影视游戏领域的先行者之一。

我们的作品已被全球数百万玩家体验，包括《斯盖尔仪式》《斯盖尔之女》《夜班》《复体》《五次约会》《死亡重启》等广受好评的作品。

通过不断探索游戏与影视叙事的融合，我们希望为玩家带来独特而难忘的互动体验，将来自威尔士的创意与热情带给世界各地的玩家。
introduction_en: Wales Interactive is a multi-award-winning indie video games and interactive film developer & publisher based in Wales, UK.  Our growing portfolio of titles have been played by millions globally, including; Sker Ritual, Maid of Sker, Late Shift, The Complex, Five Dates, The Bunker and many more. Our products are entertaining the world as well as putting Wales on the video games map.

name_zh: 若奇一科技(上海)有限公司
introduction_zh: Rokky 是国际游戏发行与分销公司，作为 B2B 分销商与全球 200 多家商店合作，专注西方、独联体与中国的跨市场发行。针对《断剑：重制版》，Rokky 携手英国开发商 Revolution Software，担任中国及独联体联合发行方，负责简繁中文本地化、营销公关、KOL 与社区。2026 ChinaJoy 展示第一部《圣殿骑士的阴影》（7月29日上线）与第二部（稍后推出），并提供试玩。
introduction_en:
Rokky is an international game distribution and publishing company. It works with 200+ stores worldwide as a B2B digital distributor, with a focus on cross-market launches spanning the West, the CIS and China. 
For Broken Sword: Reforged, Rokky partners with Revolution Software — the UK studio behind the classic Broken Sword adventure series — as co-publisher for China and the CIS, handling Simplified and Traditional Chinese localization, marketing & PR, KOL outreach and community. At ChinaJoy 2026 we present both Part 1 (Shadow of the Templars, launched 29 July) and Part 2 (arriving later), with a playable demo at our booth.

introduction_zh: 在 DoneGames，我们是一家独立游戏工作室，由一群热爱动作冒险游戏和精彩叙事的创作者共同创立。团队成员包括充满热情的玩家、故事创作者和创意人才。我们坚信，游戏是最具沉浸感的叙事媒介之一，而我们的使命就是不断突破这一媒介的边界
introduction_en:
At DoneGames, we’re an independent game studio driven by a deep love for action-adventure games and powerful storytelling. Founded by a team of passionate gamers, storytellers, and creatives, we believe that games are one of the most immersive storytelling mediums and we’re here to push that boundary.
We’re currently developing a cinematic, narrative-focused action-adventure title that blends heart-pounding gameplay with rich, emotionally resonant storytelling. Every line of dialogue, every mechanic, and every environment is crafted with intention all in service of the story we want to tell.
Our approach combines classic adventure game sensibilities with modern action gameplay, designed to create unforgettable journeys that stay with players long after the credits roll.

introduction_zh: Ankama（安卡玛）是法国独立创意集团，拥有25年以上游戏、动画与出版经验，旗下拥有《DOFUS》《WAVEN》等知名IP。集团在法国和日本设有工作室，正积极拓展亚洲市场，将在ChinaJoy重点推出新作《Tactile Wars: All Stars》，并寻求发行与授权合作伙伴。
introduction_en: Ankama is a French independent creative group with over 25 years of expertise in video games, animation, publishing and licensing. Creator of the iconic DOFUS universe, Ankama builds rich transmedia worlds spanning games, animated series and films, manga and merchandise. Its portfolio includes the tactical MMO DOFUS, the strategy game WAVEN, and acclaimed animation such as Wakfu and Radiant, broadcast in Japan on NHK. With studios in France and Japan, Ankama is now expanding across Asia, bringing new titles such as Tactile Wars: All Stars to global audiences. At ChinaJoy, Ankama is looking for publishing and licensing partners to share its universes with Chinese players.

introduction_zh: Information Superhighway Games 是一家独立游戏工作室，正在开发城市建造游戏 Microlandia。游戏采用经典 SimCity 式体验，并以交通、住房、健康、土地使用和公共政策为核心，构建深入的城市模拟。我们希望寻找中国市场发行、本地化和平台合作伙伴。
introduction_en: Information Superhighway Games is an independent game studio creating Microlandia, a city builder that looks and plays like classic SimCity on the surface, but runs on a deep simulation of transport, housing, health, poverty, land use, and policy consequences. Microlandia launched on PC and Mac in December 2025 and is already profitable. We are looking for partners to help bring the game to new platforms and to build the right China-market version with strong localization, publishing, and distribution support.

introduction_zh: 伊邪那岐游戏是一家日本游戏发行商，专注于原创剧情游戏的企划、发行与全球推广，与优秀创作者合作，面向多平台推出独具特色的作品。代表作包括《Death Come True》《World's End Club》《冤罪执行游戏Yurukill》。2026年1月已推出铃木理香新作《Dark Auction》。9月将推出由北山宏光主演的真人多视角悬疑游戏《AKIBA LOST》。
introduction_en:
IZANAGI GAMES is a Japanese video game publisher. We collaborate with talented creators to publish adventure games, mystery titles, visual novels, and indie games across multiple platforms. In addition to publishing, we support localization, marketing, and global distribution to bring outstanding Japanese games to players around the world.

Our portfolio includes Death Come True, World's End Club, and Yurukill: The Calumniation Games, which have been released globally across various platforms. In January 2026, we released Dark Auction, a brand-new mystery adventure game created by Rika Suzuki. In September 2026, we are scheduled to release AKIBA LOST, a feature-length live-action ensemble multi-angle suspense game starring Hiromitsu Kitayama.

introduction_zh:
我们是一支由来自西班牙和墨西哥的资深和初级专业人士组成的团队，共同开发我们的第一款游戏：Quixrace。
我们参加了2025年巴塞罗那游戏节（BCN Game Fest 2025），并获得了观众的积极反馈。
这鼓励我们参加2026年中国国际游戏展（ChinaJoy 2026），聆听亚洲观众的意见，因为我们希望在中国发行我们的游戏。
introduction_en:
We are a team of senior and junior professionals from Spain and Mexico, working together to develop our first game: Quixrace.
Alex Cayrol, our programmer, has a degree in physics and teaches C#.
Pol Folch, a graduate in video game design, is in charge of level design and game progression.
Pedro Orts is our senior illustrator.
Dux Music is a music composer with experience in video games.
Eduard Abad is a journalist and is creating the reality where the action takes place.
David Cousinou is a senior art director and is leading the project.
We attended BCN Game Fest 2025 in Barcelona and received positive feedback from the audience.
This encouraged us to come to ChinaJoy 2026 to hear the opinions of the Asian audience, as we would like to publish our game in China.

introduction_zh: Grimoire Entertainment 是一家独立游戏工作室，专注于打造高品质、有商业潜力的游戏。我们将出色的创意与扎实的技术实力相结合——从独具特色的世界观构建，到能让游戏在上线后持续稳定运营的数据与 LiveOps 系统。我们的首款作品《Echo of Souls》是一款赛博朋克风格的 2.5D 动作平台跳跃游戏。我们致力于打造既能打动玩家、又能在市场中实现自我造血的游戏。
introduction_en: Grimoire Entertainment is an independent studio building high-quality, commercially-minded games. We pair creative ambition with real engineering discipline — from distinctive worldbuilding to the data and LiveOps infrastructure that keeps games performing after launch. Our debut title, Echo of Souls, is a cyberpunk 2.5D action platformer. We make games designed to captivate players and sustain themselves in the market.

introduction_zh: SAGA Barcelona Game Fest 是南欧最大的电子游戏产业展会，将于10月9、10、11日在巴塞罗那举行，预计吸引超过两万名参观者、2500位业界专业人士及200多家企业参展，展示各自的游戏作品。
introduction_en: SAGA Barcelona Game Fest is the largest video game industry fair in Southern Europe. It will take place on October 9, 10, and 11 in Barcelona. The event is expected to attract over 20,000 attendees, 2,500 industry professionals, and more than 200 companies showcasing their video games.

introduction_zh: 伦敦游戏节（London Games Festival）是由Games London负责举办，并得到了伦敦市长及英国政府支持的活动。自2016年创立以来，它已促成高达1.1亿英镑的交易，创造了近1,000个工作岗位，让伦敦成为欧洲第一大游戏城市。
introduction_en:
London Games Festival is delivered by Games London, a groundbreaking programme from Film London, the capital's screen industries agency. Games London is backed by the Mayor of London and supported by the UK Government via the Games Growth Package, part of the Creative Industries Sector Plan.

Games London delivers initiatives to make London the games capital of the world, including the London Games Festival and tentpole events - Ensemble, the Games Finance Market and New Game Plus. Other activity includes trade missions, accelerator schemes for founders, and work on development skills.

Since 2016 Games London has helped facilitate over £110m of investment deals and software sales for games studios, creating nearly 1,000 jobs.

introduction_zh: 独立之光是2015年成立的国内首个专门为游戏创作者搭建的公益交流平台，我们的目标就是把有理想、有创意的独立开发者，和教育、投资、孵化、社区这些社会资源真正连接起来，帮他们走得更远、走得更稳。旗下“光之希望”支持体系，已经帮助了上百个开发团队走出第一步。
introduction_en: Indielight, established in 2015, is the first non-profit platform in China dedicated to game creators. Our goal is to connect idealistic and creative independent developers with social resources such as education, investment, incubation, and community, helping them go further and more steadily. Its "Hope of Light" support system, has already helped hundreds of development teams take their first steps.

introduction_zh:
东品游戏成立于2010年9月1日，是面向全球开发者的专业、具备丰富经验的中国精品游戏发行商。东品游戏拥有专业的发行团队，从制作到游戏上线，为每个合作伙伴提供一站式发行方案，专注实现每个游戏专属价值和切实的盈利。
在移动端已经成功发行《王国保卫战5》、《百战天虫》、《逃脱者：突出重围》、《模拟地铁》、《钢铁战队》、《永不言弃！》等游戏，积累了千万级的用户。东品游戏积极与更多潜在伙伴建立深厚合作关系。
introduction_en:
Founded on September 1, 2010, East2West Games is an experienced Chinese publisher of premium games, working with developers from around the world.

With a professional publishing team, East2West Games provides each partner with a comprehensive, one-stop publishing solution covering every stage from production support to market launch. We are committed to maximizing the unique value and commercial potential of every game we publish.

On mobile platforms, East2West Games has successfully published titles including Kingdom Rush 5: Alliance, Worms, The Escapists2, Mini Metro, Iron Marines, and Give It Up!, building a user base of tens of millions.

East2West Games is always looking to establish strong and long-term partnerships with more talented developers and industry partners worldwide.

name_zh: 杭州黑岩网络科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
黑岩科技成立于2013年，是一家具备高水准技术实力，集游戏、动画、影视、虚拟制作等数字内容研发及运营的互动娱乐公司。
拥有从内容、服务、技术、人力到资源端的完整产业链：经过十年在引擎技术、AIGC等领域的发展与沉淀，已实现游戏开发、原创动画制作出品、AIGC全品类内容等完整自主的产业模块，致力于IP全版权开发、 AI短剧制作、AI短剧投资发行、影游联动等多种业务形态，建设全球化的AIGC内容生态。
introduction_en:
Founded in 2013, D.ROCK is a high-caliber interactive entertainment company specializing in the development and operation of digital content, including games, animation, film and television, and virtual production. 
It possesses a complete industrial chain from content, services, technology, human resources to the resource side. After ten years of development and accumulation in engine technology, AIGC and other fields, the company has achieved fully independent industrial modules including game development, original animation production and distribution, and full-category AIGC content. It is committed to various business forms such as full IP copyright development, AI short drama production, AI short drama investment and distribution, and film-game synergy.

introduction_zh: 373 STUDIO的座右铭是“Solo Today, Studio Tomorrow”，愿景是从独立开发蜕变为志同道合的团队。我们秉持开源精神，公开分享技术诀窍、流程与经验。虽多数成员无开发背景，但制作人以个人项目为实战教材，带队亲历自研自发全过程。我们不仅做游戏，更在构建一种“造物”文化。
introduction_en: 373 STUDIO's motto is "Solo Today, Studio Tomorrow" — a vision of growing from a one-person operation into a team of like-minded creators. We approach game development with an open-source spirit. We believe in making our know-how, processes, and experiences openly available — so that anyone can learn from and build upon them. Most of our members have no prior game development background, but our producer uses their own project as a live teaching tool, guiding the team through the realities of development firsthand. This openness extends to the entire self-development and self-publishing journey. We're not just making games — we're building a culture of making.

name_zh: 钟夏游戏（成都星夏网络科技有限公司）
introduction_zh:
创办于2025年的游戏品牌【钟夏游戏】。有业内一流的美术、文案、演出、程序为追求极致的内容质量拼死搏斗。公司群从不闲聊，效率至上，玩命做产品，玩命做宣发。
自研自发了流程超过15小时，全程应用L2D动画和口型动态，超过70张高画质CG，品质位于国内顶级水平线的长篇AVG《中国式地雷女》。
团队同步开发高品质的IAA、IAP类小游戏。
十分欢迎洽谈代理发行，产品定制，外包或接包，及各类宣发相关合作。
introduction_en:
Founded in 2025, ZHONGXIA GAMES is a premium game development studio. Our team consists of industry-leading artists, writers, directors, and programmers who are fiercely committed to pushing the boundaries of content quality.
We are the developer and publisher of Chinese Jirai Onna, a long-form AVG title that stands as a benchmark of quality within the domestic market. The game offers over 15 hours of gameplay, featuring full-scale Live2D animation, real-time lip-syncing, and over 70 high-definition CG illustrations.
In addition , our team is currently developing high-quality IAA and IAP mobile games.
We are open to discussions regarding
●Global distribution and publishing partnerships
●Custom game development
●Outsourcing and co-development projects
●Marketing and PR collaborations

introduction_zh: 大家好，我是小客，一个普通的游戏爱好者，也是一名业余开发者。制作这个项目的起因很简单：我无法对日本当局近年来歪曲历史的错误言行视而不见。今年二月，中国驻日大使馆发文揭露了日本教材正逐步淡化侵华罪行。同年四月，得益于X平台自动翻译功能的普及，全世界正义的网友开始自发联合起来，共同反击网络上否认南京大屠杀和侵华暴行的声音。这就是我做这个项目的核心动力，让更多人了解并记住这段历史。
introduction_en: Hello everyone, I’m Xiaoke, an ordinary gaming enthusiast and amateur developer. The motivation behind this project is simple: I could no longer stand by and watch the Japanese government's recent attempts to distort history. In February of this year, the Chinese Embassy in Japan released a statement exposing how Japanese textbooks are gradually downplaying the war crimes committed during the invasion of China. By April, thanks to the widespread use of the auto-translate feature on X (formerly Twitter), righteous netizens from all over the world spontaneously united to fight back against online rhetoric denying the Nanjing Massacre and other atrocities. This became the core driving force behind my project: to ensure more people understand and remember this chapter of history.

introduction_zh:
Thera Interactive公司

由Sergei Kachmar创立。

自2016年起，他便投身于游戏开发。
2022年，他在阿联酋成立了这家工作室，并将旗下项目推向全球市场。

如今，Thera Interactive已发展为一支拥有40名员工的完全独立、自筹资金团队。并且团队里的所有成员都因同一个大胆而鲜明的创意愿景凝聚在一起。
introduction_en:
Thera Interactive.
Founded by Sergei Kachmar
A game developer at heart since 2016.
In 2022 he established the studio in the UAE and took the projects global.
Today Thera Interactive is a fully independent, self-funded team of 40 employees united by one bold creative vision.

name_zh: 北京一骑当千网络科技股份有限公司
name_en: Legend of Warrior Network Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 北京一骑当千网络科技股份有限公司 2013 年成立，2016 年登陆新三板，是高新技术游戏文创企业。自研 QK 引擎，主营网络游戏研发、全球发行运营，旗下 The7 Studio 打造科幻 RTS《群星战场 WarOS》，融合即时战略与 RPG 养成。代表作含《一骑当千 OL》《新特种部队》，产品覆盖海内外多地区。团队深耕策略游戏赛道，自研多语言本地化体系，持续输出国产原创精品，拓展全球游戏市场。
introduction_en: Founded in 2013, Legend of Warrior Network Co., Ltd. was listed on NEEQ in 2016 as a high-tech game enterprise. We independently developed the QK engine, focusing on game R&D and global publishing. Our in-house studio The7 Studio created sci-fi RTS WarOS, combining real-time strategy and RPG progression. Hit works include Legend of Warriors OL and Special Force, launched across global markets. Our team specializes in strategy games with self-developed multi-language localization system. Committed to original domestic game production, we keep delivering high-quality titles and expanding global gaming footprint.

introduction_zh:
当我们说小鸟炸弹时，我们到底在说什么？答案可能令你惊讶...
小鸟炸弹是这个项目程序的名字，也是这个项目美术的名字，甚至还是这个项目策划的名字。
三个人是同一个名字？but...why？
introduction_en:
Hey？
"When we say 'Bird Bomb,' what exactly are we talking about? The answer might surprise you...
Bird Bomb is the name of this project's programmer, the name of its artist, and even the name of its designer.
Three people, one name? But... why?"

introduction_zh: ManaWanderer 是一个由 8 名成员组成的小型独立游戏团队，在业余时间搭伴创作。本次端上了两款作品，第一款是穿着恐龙睡衣到处闯祸的双人欢乐游戏；另一款是发生在火星上的满是黑色幽默的刁民模拟器游戏DEMO。我们的理念是（没有蛀牙）创作出能让朋友之间一起欢笑、吐槽、创造回忆的瞬间，希望我们的作品能带来这样的效果~
introduction_en: ManaWanderer is a small indie game team of 8 members who create games together in their spare time. They've released two titles: the first is a hilarious two-player game where players wear dinosaur pajamas and cause chaos; the other is a darkly humorous demo of a troublemaker simulator set on Mars. Our philosophy is (without cavities) to create moments that allow friends to laugh, joke, and create memories together—we hope our work achieves that!

introduction_zh: 经营游戏研发、外包和商务，美日风格通吃，音乐艺人声优不动产，主项目核心头部重度，加多个快速项目模版
introduction_en: develop, out-resource, consulting and agent, capable of both american style and japanese style, with several half-accomplished game engineering packages

introduction_zh: 游戏性是检验游戏的唯一标准。
introduction_en: Gameplay is the sole criterion for testing a game

introduction_zh: DanchieGo做的游戏，专治“以貌取游”。颜色软乎乎，角色萌哒哒，你一屁股坐下，等着被治愈。结果挡路墙说立就立，队友说冻就冻，你才发现，被套路的是自己。我们是2023年起就埋头苦干的独立艺术工作室，最爱干的事，就是用最软的画风，包最坑的互搏。可爱是陷阱，掉进去才叫爽。
introduction_en: DanchieGo makes games you'll misjudge. They look gentle, all soft colors and characters begging to be hugged, so you sit down expecting something sweet. Then the first wall goes up, the first friend gets frozen, and you realize the table's turned on you. An indie art studio building since 2023, dressing fierce competition in the softest art we can draw. Cute is the trap. The game is the bite.

introduction_zh:
我们是流变游戏，团队前身曾在2020~2022年开发过《互联网原住民》steam无宣发自然量销售2.5万份83%特别好评，团队前作开发完成后解散重组，依旧是原班人马。
新作现有3人参与开发中。
introduction_en: We are LiuBian Games (formerly the dev team behind Internet Generation). Between 2020 and 2022, we developed and launched our previous title on Steam, which achieved 25,000 copies sold with an 83% 'Very Positive' rating. Following its completion, the team went through a restructuring but retains the core original lineup. Currently, we have a 3-person team actively developing our next upcoming title.

introduction_zh: “织乌游戏”工作室成立于2024年，正在开发的游戏《蛛丝王朝》已经进入项目后期，寻找有足够经验的发行商合作。
introduction_en: Zhiwu Games, founded in 2024, is deep in late production on Spider Silk Dynasty. We’re looking for experienced publishing partners to bring the game to market.

introduction_zh: Gonggamore Contents Inc. is an indie game developer and publisher based in South Korea.
introduction_en: Gonggamore Contents Inc. is an indie game developer and publisher based in South Korea. We develop original games, support global indie developers, and help outstanding titles reach international markets through publishing, localization, and business partnerships. Our Steam publishing platform, Link Compass, connects developers with players, publishers, and investors across Asia. At ChinaJoy 2026, we are showcasing METAL SUITS: Counter-Attack, together with our growing portfolio of indie games.

introduction_zh: 渲缘游戏工作室成立于2018年，公司主营游戏美术外包业务包括:3D角色模型、3D场景模型、3D动画、定制游戏。公司自成立以来于国内外的知名游戏厂商建立并维系着良好的合作关系,参与制作的游戏类型涵盖AAA主机游戏、网络游戏、移动平台等。我们团队核心技术人员从事游戏开发已有10年以上的经验，熟悉国内外各类游戏的开发流程以及美术风格。多年美术外包制作工作中,我们严格遵守保密、务实、诚信的基本原则。
introduction_en:
High-Quality Game Art & Development Services
Founded in 2018 and based in the "8D Cyber City" Chongqing, China, RendererGame Studios specializes in high-quality 3D game art production and customgame development services. As a professional game art outsourcing team, our core services include: 3DCharacter Modeling, 3D Environment Modeling, 3D Animation, Custom Gameglobal studios across AAA, console, PC, and mobile titles, delivering reliable, efficient, and visually polished assets. We partner withdelivering reliable, efficient, and visually polished assets. With a team of seasoned professionals and over a decade of experience, we bring both creativity and technical precision to every project.

introduction_zh:
游戏曙光工作室成立于2024年10月，我们的初心是突破传统游戏的设计，致力于创作能够实现精神赋能的游戏新品牌。
我们是一家追逐梦想的游戏工作室，在我们眼中游戏不只是盈利的商品，游戏还是绝佳的文化载体。只要能找到好的切入点，就一定能通过游戏输出我们自己的文化与精神。
我们的团队是以制作人为核心，由制作人独自统揽研发中的策划、美术、程序、测试的核心工作，再由兼职伙伴分摊可量化工作的麻雀型独立开发团队。
introduction_en:
About Dawn Game Studio
Founded in October 2024, Dawn Game Studio was built on the vision of breaking beyond traditional game design conventions to build a new brand of games that deliver genuine spiritual empowerment.
We are a dream-driven indie studio. We believe games are far more than just commercial products — they are a powerful medium for cultural expression. With the right creative angle, we are confident we can share our unique cultural perspectives and values through interactive experiences.
Our team operates as a lean, compact indie development unit centered around our lead producer, who oversees all core development work including game design, art, programming, and quality assurance. Part-time collaborators support the team by handling quantifiable, task-based workloads.

introduction_zh: 您好！我们是来自欧洲丹麦的Kawn Corp！作为游戏《EAWA》的巴基斯坦籍总监，我很荣幸能来到中国！我们非常希望能开拓斯堪的纳维亚市场的商机。
introduction_en:
Kawn Corp. is a small, newly upstarted game studio based in Zealand, Denmark, Scandinavia - Europe. Consisting of a handful of newly educated alumnus in the gaming industry, and skilled digital artists. 
What makes Kawn Corp. special, is that we view our employees as a part of a family; for us, the most important aspect of being part of our community is feeling at home, being heard and having a say in each project - i.e. we are all equal. 
We have a Pakistani Director, Vietnamese Texture artist and Spanish Modelers/programmers- A very International Studio. We appreciate any reaching out to us. 
Currently in the works of producing Project: EAWA an open world fantasy/sci-fi based 3D game. We are looking for funding, as it would open up for Northern European Market opportunities.

name_zh: 长沙寻简智能科技有限公司
introduction_zh: None Studio 成立于 2026 年 2 月,由策划 Fionn、程序 Kun Jiang、美术 Echo 三人利用业余时间组建。目前四款作品已在 Steam 上线商店页: 本次参展新作《皮格马利与腐朽国度》、以及 Demo 已完成、即将上线的《放学后·追忆美好旧日时光》、《雾城谍影》、《国王棋》。期待在现场遇见发行伙伴与玩家。
introduction_en:
None Studio was founded in February 2026 by Fionn, a game designer, Kun Jiang, a programmer, and Echo, an artist, who came together to develop games in their spare time.
The studio currently has four titles with Steam store pages: its new exhibition title, Pygmalion and the Kingdom of Rot, as well as After School: Days Gone By, Shadows Over Fog City, and King’s Chess, all of which have completed demos and are preparing for release.
We look forward to meeting publishing partners and players at the event.

introduction_zh: OldJoker233 是由独立开发者运营的个人游戏工作室，专注于游戏开发、玩法原型设计及独立游戏项目制作，持续探索塔防、Roguelike、RTS 等玩法方向。
introduction_en: OldJoker233 is an independent game studio run by a developer, focusing on game development, gameplay prototyping, and independent game project production, and continuously exploring gameplay directions such as tower defense, roguelike, and RTS.

introduction_zh: 火鸢游戏成立于 2022 年，目前位于中国上海，是一家专注于原创内容的独立游戏开发团队。团队由拥有丰富经验的一线从业者组成，因对游戏创作的热爱与共同理想汇聚而成。我们的团队：研发团队规模在20-30人。火鸢游戏将始终坚持以玩家视角为核心，既不盲目追逐市场热点，也不拘泥于固定模板，力求打造出一款真诚且富有表达力的作品，成为新一代玩家共同记忆的一部分。
introduction_en:
Firis Games was founded in 2022 and is based in Shanghai, China. We are an independent game development studio dedicated to original content. Our team brings together seasoned industry professionals from frontline roles, united by a shared passion for game creation and a common creative vision.

With a development team of 20–30 members, Fire Kite Games consistently adheres to a player-centric philosophy—neither chasing market trends blindly nor confining ourselves to rigid formulas. Our goal is to craft a sincere and expressive work that resonates with players, becoming part of a new generation’s shared gaming memories.
website: 上海市松江区顺庆路500号C504

introduction_zh: 集英社游戏是一家横跨出版和游戏两个行业而诞生的新公司，旨在为全球玩家创造全新的游戏体验。
introduction_en: Shueisha Games is the game publishing label of Shueisha Inc., one of Japan’s leading media companies and the publisher of Weekly Shonen Jump. Shueisha Games publishes and co-develops original titles in partnership with independent studios around the world.

introduction_zh:
SoloGame是一家专注全球游戏本地化发行与整合营销的专业服务商。
历经12年市场积累，SoloGame已在上海、北京、天津、苏州、深圳、广州、西安、成都、中国香港、东京、阿布扎比、雅加达建立全球分支网络，构建起“中国深度运营+全球定制化发行”的双轨驱动模式，120人专业团队累计参与全球游戏市场项目超11,000个。
introduction_en:
SoloGame is a professional game publishing and integrated marketing company, focus on localized global game publishing.
With 12 years of industry experience, SoloGame has established branches in Shanghai, Beijing, Tianjin, Suzhou, Shenzhen, Guangzhou, Xi'an, Chengdu, Hong Kong, Tokyo, Abu Dhabi, and Jakarta. Our dual-engine model — deep China operations combined with globally customized publishing — is supported by a 120-person professional team that has participated in over 11,000 game projects worldwide.
We champion the indie spirit — dedicated to serving independent developers and niche quality games, believing that individual creativity can reshape the industry. We pursue breakthrough focus: cultivating each title with precision to drive global impact.

name_zh: 东莞市东三社文创科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
东莞市东三社文创科技有限公司创立于2019年，总部坐落于粤港澳大湾区核心腹地--东莞市黄江镇，并在上海设立运营中心。企业注册资本100万元人民币，拥有现代化生产基地7500平方米，配备国际领先的智能化生产体系。
上海市东三居文化传媒有限公司坐落于上海，提供一站式动漫产品服务;整体方案一产品设计一研发一生产一增值服务;由多年服务于500强客户的团队组成，帮助客户成功是我们的目标。
introduction_en: 无

name_zh: 杭州泉游科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
泉游科技——专注独立单机游戏开发，致力于创意与玩法突破。目前已于Steam上线肉鸽RTS《神选战争》、解谜游戏《噬丹》，收获玩家好评。
在研新品：与B站89万粉UP主“PP的冒险手册”合作的RPG《冒险与料理》，融合烹饪与冒险；另有一款短篇恐怖游戏，氛围沉浸。
团队专业，核心成员拥有多款爆款产品经验。欢迎发行、投资及合作伙伴交流洽谈。
introduction_en:
Spring Tour Technology – Focused on independent single-player game development, dedicated to creativity and gameplay innovation.
Two titles already available on Steam: the roguelite RTS Chosen War and the puzzle game Devour the Pill, both well received by players.
Currently in development: Adventure & Cuisine, an RPG created in collaboration with Bilibili’s 890k-follower creator “PP's Adventure Manual”, blending cooking with adventure; and a short-form horror game with an immersive atmosphere.
Our professional team includes members with experience on multiple hit titles. We welcome publishers, investors, and partners to connect with us at ChinaJoy.

name_zh: 上海泼泼猫文化传媒有限公司
name_en: Shanghai Popocat Culture Media Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 上海泼泼猫文化传媒（泼泼猫工作室）是一家深耕原创叙事游戏与角色IP孵化的独立开发商。主打产品《履云录》是一款融合战术战斗与视觉小说叙事的3D战棋RPG，现已登陆Steam抢先体验。我们正持续深化内容更新、多语言本地化及跨平台移植，并拓展番外漫画等泛娱乐生态，致力于打造具有全球影响力的长线IP。
introduction_en: Popocat Studio is a Shanghai-based indie studio focused on original narrative games and character IP. Our flagship project, Elysium Above, is a story-rich 3D SRPG/TRPG combining tactical battles, visual-novel-style storytelling, and anthropomorphic characters. It is available on Steam Early Access with Chinese and English support. We have delivered regular updates, expanded localization, and developed side comics and community content, creating a foundation for global publishing, platform expansion, and long-term IP growth.

introduction_zh:
叛星观察工作室，团队成员均为在校或刚毕业的年轻人，一群走在创作路上的同路人。
对我们来说，游戏始终是一种面向自己、也面向玩家的艺术。我们认真做游戏，希望把一些好的期待、一些想说的话，传递给更多的人。
目前我们正在打磨首部作品——《不夜城游神》，一款 2.5D、《极乐迪斯科》式的叙事游戏。我们希望在这个追逐写实大作、热门赛道扎堆的行业里，做一款拿得出手的国产叙事向作品，用艺术表现和叙事打动玩家。
introduction_en:
Mazzaroth Lab is a team of young creators—all of us still in college or fresh out of school, fellow travelers on the road of creation.
To us, games will always be an art—made both for ourselves and for the players. We make games in earnest, hoping to share a few good hopes and things worth saying with as many people as we can.
Our debut title, Sleepless City's Deity Parade, is a 2.5D, Disco Elysium-style narrative game. In an industry chasing photorealistic blockbusters and crowding into a few trending genres, we want to make a homegrown narrative work we can be proud of—one that moves players through artistry and storytelling.

introduction_zh: 革新工业是一家 2021 年成立的泰国游戏开发工作室，主打面向全球 PC 端市场的模拟策略类游戏。工作室自研原创游戏 IP，作品核心玩法涵盖战术作战、舰队调度、商贸经营、地图探索以及动态大世界体系。其旗舰作品《飞空艇时代：贸易帝国》依托 Steam 平台与多方发行合作，收获了全球多国玩家；该工作室也正持续依托天空朋克世界观，推出系列新作并迭代自研技术，拓展这一 IP 宇宙。
introduction_en: Revolution Industry is a Thai game development studio founded in 2021, specializing in simulation strategy games for the global PC market. The studio develops original IPs built around tactical combat, fleet management, trading, exploration, and dynamic world systems. Its flagship title, Airship: Kingdoms Adrift, has reached international players through Steam and publishing partnerships, while the studio continues expanding its skypunk franchise with new titles and technologies.

name_zh: 科隆游戏展亚洲 x 泰国游戏展
name_en: gamescom asia x Thailand Game Show
introduction_zh: 科隆游戏展亚洲 x 泰国游戏展是东南亚规模最大的 B2B2C 游戏盛会，汇聚了来自全球的游戏行业从业者、发行商、开发者以及广大玩家。该活动设有专门的商务区、行业会议以及精彩纷呈的娱乐区，全方位展示游戏文化的魅力，同时也将泰国打造为日益崛起的全球游戏枢纽。
introduction_en: gamescom asia x Thailand Game Show is Southeast Asia’s largest gaming B2B2C event, bringing together game industry professionals, publishers, developers, and fans from around the world. Featuring a dedicated business area, industry conference, and vibrant entertainment area, the event showcases the full spectrum of gaming culture while positioning Thailand as a growing global gaming hub. From 29 October to 1 November 2026 at the Queen Sirikit National Convention Centre, Bangkok, Thailand.

name_zh: 广州小有内容互动娱乐有限公司
introduction_zh: 广州小有内容工作室创立于2022年3月，致力于网络互动微短剧的制作和发行。《完蛋！我被美女包围了！》作为工作室首个上线产品，迅速引爆全球。2023年10月上线后，产品荣登Steam2023国区总榜第二，全网话题曝光超过50亿，市场口碑双丰收；让短剧、互动剧等题材成为2023年最热产业，是2023年现象级产品。
introduction_en: Intiny was founded in March 2022, dedicated to the production and distribution of interactive micro-short dramas. "Love is All Around" as the studio's first online product, quickly became a global sensation. After its launch in October 2023, the product ranked second on the Steam 2023 China region overall chart, with over 5 billion topic exposures across the internet, achieving both market and word-of-mouth success. It made short dramas, interactive dramas, and other themes the hottest industry in 2023, becoming a phenomenal product of the year.

name_zh: 北京暗黑游科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 暗黑游是一家成立于2025年的年轻游戏公司。我们致力于使用行业前沿技术深耕经典赛道，《星坠长歌》是我们正在研发中的第一款项目，这是一款基于UE5引擎打造的PC端俯视角ARPG类刷宝游戏，可以简单的理解为“讲述东方故事的暗黑like刷宝游戏”。我们正在努力打造出一款画面表现达到业界一流标准的、能够深耕经典赛道中的细分空白市场的、能够全球化发行的、能够长线运营的“讲述东方故事的暗黑like刷宝游戏”。
introduction_en: 无

introduction_zh: Huoli Games 专注 AI 驱动游戏研发，依托自研全链路 AI 工作流，打造兼具本地化文化特色与强情绪叙事的中轻度手游及原生 AI 游戏。
introduction_en: Huoli Games specializes in AI-powered game development. Leveraging our proprietary end-to-end AI workflow, we develop casual and mid-core mobile titles alongside native AI games infused with regional cultural motifs and emotionally resonant narratives.

introduction_zh: 团队专注海外休闲小游戏研发与发行，深耕 TikTok Minis 等全球化平台，核心品类覆盖益智解谜、策略塔防、超休闲玩法，具备成熟的快速迭代研发体系与数据驱动调优能力，坚持精品化、长线化产品理念，致力于打造受全球用户喜爱的轻量化游戏精品。
introduction_en:
Our team specializes in the R&D and global publishing of casual mini-games, with deep expertise in global platforms such as TikTok Minis. Our core product categories cover puzzle titles, strategy tower defense and hyper-casual games.
We have built a mature rapid-iteration R&D system and data-driven optimization capabilities. Adhering to the product philosophy of premium quality and long-term operation, we are dedicated to creating lightweight, high-quality games beloved by users worldwide.

introduction_zh: 虚境石扉 FantaPass MR Studio 是一家专注混合现实（MR）原创玩法的独立游戏工作室。我们的作品 Bullet Hell IRL（《弹雨临身》）和 Superhero IRL（《超英降临》）已登陆 Meta Quest 3/3S 抢先体验。我们以混合现实中的真实身体移动为核心，让玩家在现实空间中闪避弹幕、击碎子弹、出拳、盾击、追击、后撤。
introduction_en:
FantaPass MR Studio is an indie game studio focused on original gameplay for mixed reality. 
Our titles, Bullet Hell IRL and Superhero IRL, are now in Early Access on Meta Quest 3/3S. We build around real body movement in mixed reality. Players dodge bullet hell, shoot incoming bullets, punch, shield-bash, chase, and retreat in real space, turning physical action into the core of play.
Be the Hero, In Real Life!

introduction_zh: Microids​ 是一家 1985年创立于法国巴黎​ 的老牌视频游戏 开发商 + 发行商 + 分销商，是法国现存历史最悠久的游戏公司之一，隶属于出版传媒集团 Média-Participations，在全球发行游戏 超过200款，累计销量 超千万套。
introduction_en: Microids​ is a veteran French video game developer, publisher, and distributor, founded in 1985 in Paris. As one of the oldest surviving game companies in France, it operates under the umbrella of the publishing and media group Média-Participations. To date, Microids has released over 200 games worldwide, with combined sales exceeding ten million units.

name_zh: 上海字节智连信息技术有限公司
introduction_zh: ByteC Technology，全球领先的电商重定向营销和CPS平台。管理程序化广告、联盟营销和创作者的统一平台——由超10亿美元的商务合作伙伴和AI驱动，将发现转化为业绩。
introduction_en: Global Leading E-commerce Retargeting and CPS platform. The unified platform to manage programmatic ads, affiliates, and creators — powered by $1B+ in partnership commerce and AI that turns discovery into performance.

introduction_zh: The Node：国际化网红营销机构，业务覆盖欧美、亚洲，依托 Twitch、YouTube、Instagram、TikTok 提供全案营销，定制品牌直播贴片与创意素材。拥有 20000 + 全球创作者、5000 + 欧美达人，独家代理法国百位头部游戏博主，中欧零时差对接。落地 20000 + 营销项目，服务腾讯、网易、莉莉丝、IGG、动视，创下单活动 50 万新增安装、区域直播年度第一等佳绩。
introduction_en: The Node : international influencer marketing agency (US, Europe & Asia). End-to-end campaigns on Twitch, YouTube, Instagram and TikTok, custom overlays and creative assets tailored to every brand.

introduction_zh: 舜禹环球通是中国头部本地化服务商，深耕语言服务30年，在CSA 2025语言服务百强榜中位列全球第22。我们已为159个国家与地区提供140+语言的本地化服务，累计交付600+数字娱乐项目，并拥有1500+母语游戏本地化专家。我们的服务涵盖游戏本地化翻译、音频与配音、LQA/FQA测试、文化顾问与合规咨询。在AI重塑语言服务行业的当下，我们以"AI辅助翻译+六步分流管线"驱动交付，提效30-50%
introduction_en: Sunyu Transphere is a leading language service provider (LSP) in China, with 30 years of expertise in language services. We are ranked No. 22 on CSA Research's 2025 Global Top 100 LSP list. To date, we have delivered localization in 140+ languages across 159 countries and regions, with 600+ digital entertainment projects shipped, supported by a team of 1,500+ native-speaker game localization experts. Our services span game localization, audio localization and voice-over, LQA/FQA testing, cultural consulting, and compliance advisory. As AI reshapes the language services industry, we power our delivery with an "AI-Assisted Translation + Six-Step Triage Pipeline", achieving a 30–50% efficiency gain.

introduction_zh:
PayCools，崛起于东南亚，是深耕全球新兴市场的数字支付与金融科技基础设施提供商。
公司致力于构建安全、高效的跨境资金清结算网络，业务覆盖东南亚、拉美、中东等高增长地区，拥有本地化服务团队与多国支付牌照矩阵。通过“全球化视野结合本地化运营”的策略，提供具成本效益且资金流转高效的支付服务。
凭借稳定的系统架构、严格的数据隐私保护机制及本地化服务网络，已深融蓝筹级企业生态，积累多行业客户基础。
introduction_en:
PayCools, a rising star in Southeast Asia, is a digital payment and fintech infrastructure provider focused on global emerging markets. The company builds a secure, efficient cross-border fund clearing network covering high-growth regions such as Southeast Asia, Latin America, and the Middle East, supported by localized service teams and multiple payment licenses. By combining global vision with localized execution, PayCools delivers cost-effective and highly efficient fund transfer services.

With robust system architecture, strict data privacy protection, and localized service networks, PayCools has become deeply integrated into blue-chip enterprise ecosystems and built a strong cross-industry client base.

introduction_zh: 蓝瀚互动 BlueVision 是蓝标传媒旗下专注于出海营销业务的全资子公司，隶属于蓝色光标集团（股票代码：SZ.300058）。持有 40+ 海外媒体官方一级代理商认证，长期服务品牌、电商、游戏、短剧、应用、AI、泛娱乐、金融科技等出海行业，提供从出海策略、媒介增长、内容创意、社交传播，到联盟营销与 AI 创新营销的一站式出海增长服务，助力客户在全球市场建立可持续增长能力。
introduction_en: BlueVision is a wholly owned subsidiary of BlueMedia and part of BlueFocus Communications Group (SZ.300058), specializing in global marketing services for Chinese companies going overseas. BlueVision holds official first-tier agency certifications from 40+ global media platforms, and serves companies across brands, e-commerce, gaming, short drama, apps, AI, entertainment, fintech and other global-facing sectors. We provide integrated services spanning go-to-market strategy, media-driven growth, creative content, social engagement, affiliate marketing and AI-powered marketing innovation, helping clients build sustainable growth in global markets.

introduction_zh: Xsolla成立于2005年，总部位于美国洛杉矶，是全球领先的游戏商务公司，为游戏开发者与发行商提供支付、反欺诈、法务与财务合规、商业变现、投融资等全链路解决方案，助力全球市场增长。在中国，艾克索拉专注为游戏企业提供全矩阵解决方案，依托全球化本地支付网络、专业法务财务支持及多元变现工具，助力中国游戏出海，成为其重要合作伙伴。
introduction_en:
Xsolla is a global leader in video game commerce, founded in 2005 and headquartered in Los Angeles, USA. The company is dedicated to providing end-to-end solutions for game developers and publishers worldwide, including payment processing, fraud prevention, legal and financial compliance, business monetization, and investment support, helping gaming enterprises achieve sustainable growth and commercial success in the global market.
In China, Xsolla focuses on offering a comprehensive suite of solutions to empower Chinese game companies in expanding their presence globally. With its localized global payment network, professional legal and financial support, and diverse publishing and monetization tools, Xsolla has become a key partner for Chinese gaming enterprises going global.

introduction_zh: 亿动广告传媒（Madhouse Inc.）是蓝标传媒旗下子公司，成立于2006年。亿动广告传媒聚合全球优质资源，为中国品牌提供提供市场洞察、创意策划、线上广告优化、网红营销、社媒运营、素材制作等整合营销解决方案，具备多年游戏、品牌、电商等行业出海服务经验，为客户提供更精准的广告投放策略，通过专业产品能力及优质服务，提升广告效果和客户品牌价值，助力每一个中国品牌走向全球。
introduction_en: Founded in 2006, Madhouse Inc. is a subsidiary of BlueMedia Group, and its aim is to maximize mobile marketing investment. As a leading integrated marketing communication agency for overseas markets in China, Madhouse provides solutions for mobile app marketers to acquire high-quality users globally. With strong capability in technology, data analysis, resource and service provision, Madhouse helps clients engage target audiences, build brand awareness and succeed in the global market.

name_zh: 莫洛克（北京）信息技术有限公司
introduction_zh: Moloco 是 AI 原生效果广告公司，聚焦开放互联网生态。自 2013 年成立以来，Moloco 深耕 AI 广告系统已逾十年，致力于持续提升广告效果，塑造互联网经济的未来。Moloco Ads 的广告展示覆盖全球 230 多个国家和地区（2026 年 2 月数据），公司在美国、英国、德国、韩国、中国、印度、日本和新加坡均设有办公室。
introduction_en: Moloco is an AI-native performance advertising company built for the open Internet. Founded in 2013, Moloco has spent more than a decade building AI systems that make ads more effective and has dedicated itself to shaping the future of the Internet economy. Moloco Ads served ad impressions across more than 230 countries and territories (in February 2026), and the company has offices throughout the US, the UK, Germany, Korea, China, India, Japan, and Singapore.

introduction_zh: Oceanpayment是全球数字支付解决方案领先品牌，拥有全球数字支付技术和业务资质全牌照，集团总部位于中国香港，在深圳、杭州、新加坡、美国、欧洲、澳洲设有分支机构。致力于为中国跨境商户和全球电子商务企业提供安全、便捷、专业、简单的支付基础设施和解决方案。目前，系统平台支撑全球500多种支付产品，覆盖200多个国家和地区，为数十万家电子商务网站提供优质服务。
introduction_en: Oceanpayment is a global payment service provider that offers safe, convenient, professional and simple payment solutions to merchants conducting cross-border business. Processing transactions continually for several hundred thousand merchants across 200 countries, Oceanpayment helps businesses of all sizes, from small to large enterprises, accept and process payments to maximize business opportunities and revenue growth. By offering over 500 payment methods in one platform, Oceanpayment enables merchants to accept a variety of payment types, across multiple channels, anywhere in the world.

introduction_zh: CoGoLinks结行国际是结行科技集团的子品牌，是中国跨境贸易数字化解决方案的赋能者，专业的全球化跨境支付服务平台，专注于研发更智能灵活的（国际）账户体系，为中国出海企业及商业个体提供安全、稳定、高效的收付款及增值服务，并通过数字化产品连结产业上下游服务商，推动全球贸易加速发展，助力中国跨境贸易商家迅速实现市场的倍数扩张，把生意做到世界各个角落。
introduction_en: CoGoLinks, a sub-brand of VBill, is an enabler of digital solutions for cross-border trade in China. It is also a professional global cross-border payment service platform that focuses on developing and researching into a more intelligent and flexible (international) account systems to offer secure, stable and efficient payment as well as value-added services for Chinese overseas enterprises and commercial individuals. Through our digital products, CoGoLinks connects upstream and downstream service providers in the industry to promote the accelerated development of global trade, enabling Chinese cross-border trade merchants to rapidly expand into multiple markets worldwide and do business in every corner of the world.

introduction_zh: Yuno 是全球领先的金融基础设施服务平台，致力于为企业级客户与高成长公司简化全球支付流程。通过统一的API接口，商户可一站式接入超1000种支付方式与反欺诈工具，从而显著提升支付成功率、降低运营成本并保障交易安全。目前，Yuno已构建覆盖全球的支付网络，服务客户包括McDonald’s、NetEase Games、GoFundMe、Uber、inDrive及 Rappi 等知名品牌。
introduction_en: Yuno is a leading financial infrastructure platform that simplifies global payments for enterprise merchants and fast‑scaling companies around the world. With a unified API connecting over 1,000 payment methods and fraud tools, Yuno optimizes acceptance rates, reduces costs, and enhances security. Yuno supports leading brands across LATAM, North America, Europe, the Middle East, and APAC, including McDonald’s, NetEase Games, GoFundMe, Uber,  inDrive, and Rappi.

introduction_zh: Mistplay 是“玩赚”激励模式的先驱，为全球手游和应用发行商提供高效的激励广告及变现解决方案。凭借其创新的AI引擎和“玩赚”激励模式，Mistplay致力于驱动长期增长及留存。Mistplay成立于2015年，总部位于加拿大蒙特利尔，通过与发行商深度合作，解锁规模化的激励型用户互动。更多信息，欢迎关注Mistplay微信公众号。
introduction_en: Mistplay is a pioneer of play-and-earn, providing rewarded advertising and monetization solutions to mobile game and app publishers worldwide. Leveraging its AI engine and play-and-earn model, Mistplay drives sustainable growth and engagement. Founded in 2015, and headquartered in Montreal, Mistplay partners with publishers to unlock scalable rewarded engagement.

name_zh: 上海瑞狮网络科技有限公司
introduction_zh: Vlion是2014年成立公司总部位于上海市，目前公司总人数有100余人，基于自身强大广告技术和AI能力为合作伙伴提供收入增长，业务单位包括 DIGO（智能用户增长平台）Menta(APP商业化SDK ）QUK（电商联盟平台）等，是国内外TOP广告技术公司，更是一家专注于收入增长的合作伙伴。
introduction_en: Vlion was founded in 2014 and is headquartered in Shanghai. Currently, the company has a total of more than 100 employees and provides revenue growth for partners based on its strong advertising technology and AI capabilities. Its business units include DIGO (Intelligent User Growth Platform), Menta (App  Monetization SDK Platform), QUK (E-commerce network Platform), etc. Vlion is a top advertising technology company both domestically and internationally, and a dedicated revenue growth partner.

name_zh: 菲律宾贸易投资中心（上海）
introduction_zh:
菲律宾贸易投资中心（上海）代表菲律宾贸易和工业部，通过向对菲律宾感兴趣的中国投资者、贸易商及相关机构提供信息、建议、咨询、企业对企业（B2B）及投资指导服务，促进贸易与投资。

在ChinaJoy展会上，菲律宾游戏开发者协会（GDAP）的成员与菲律宾贸易投资中心（上海）共同参展，代表菲律宾对游戏行业的关注。
introduction_en:
PTIC Shanghai, representing the Philippine Department of Trade and Industry (DTI), promotes trade and investment by providing information, advice, consulting, B2B and investment handholding services to Chinese investors, traders, and entities interested in the Philippines.

At ChinaJoy, members of the Game Developers Association of the Philippines (GDAP) participated alongside PTIC Shanghai to represent Philippine interests in the gaming industry.

introduction_zh:
GameOps 十五年来一直为电子游戏行业提供全方位支持。我们凭借全面覆盖游戏运营各个环节的整体化服务方式，建立了作为领先游戏支持服务提供商的良好声誉。总部位于菲律宾首都马尼拉。文化契合、完整专业流程的团队。不仅是服务商，更是您在海外的专属团队

GameOps积极发挥领导作用，推动菲律宾新兴电子游戏产业的发展。具体包括：为菲律宾本地游戏开发者启动孵化器项目, 创办菲律宾首个国际游戏产业盛会。
introduction_en:
GameOps has been providing all encompassing support to the video game industry for over 15 years. We have developed a reputation as a leading provider of games support services with a holistic approach that encompasses every aspect of operating a video game. Based in the Philippines. Culturally aligned and process-driven teams. More than a vendor – we operate as your offshore department.

GameOps takes an active leadership role in championing the Philippines’ emerging Video Game Industry. This includes: Launching an incubator for Philippine-based game developers  -- MEE Games, Founding the Philippines’ first international games industry event -- GameDev Summit.

introduction_zh: Neun Farben 是一家位于菲律宾、拥有 13 年历史的创意制作工作室，专注于日式风格的 3D 造型建模、游戏动画、视觉特效（VFX）以及后期制作。我们拥有一支由100多名艺术家（主要为动画师）组成的团队，为游戏开发商和发行商提供从分镜设计到最终交付的端到端制作服务，包括制作电影级预告片和游戏内动画。
introduction_en: Neun Farben is a 13-year-old creative production studio based in Philippines specializing in Japanese-style 3D stylized modeling, game animation, VFX, and post-production. With a team of 100+ artists primarily animators we support game developers, publishers across the full pipeline, from storyboarding to final delivery, producing cinematic trailers, in-game animations.

introduction_zh: MediaGo 是百度国际旗下的智能广告平台，依托百度 AI 底层技术，基于深度学习算法，强势赋能各规模的企业成长，为企业创造真实价值。我们在全球设立12个运营中心，已成功为超10000家合作伙伴提供本土化、全方位的商业成长服务。
introduction_en:
About MediaGo
MediaGo is a leading intelligent advertising platform. Based on deep learning algorithms, MediaGo empowers businesses of all scales, creating tangible value for companies. With 12 operational centers worldwide, MediaGo has successfully provided localized and comprehensive business growth services to over 10,000 partners.

name_zh: 艾崖莳信息技术（上海）有限公司
introduction_zh: AnyMind Group是一家营销、电商与数位转型的BPaaS公司。本次携手游戏电竞品牌REJECT入驻IP展区，展现跨境IP双向出海无限商机。该品牌坐拥梅原大吾、Dep等明星，更入选全球仅40席的EWC电竞世界杯合作伙伴计划。我们依托杭州AI研发中心，通过AnyAI联动AnyTag红人资源，推动跨界流量与零售场景融合，助力企业全球增长。
introduction_en: AnyMind Group is a BPaaS company driving marketing, e-commerce, and digital transformation. Partnering with the gaming and esports brand REJECT in the IP Zone, we unlock boundless cross-border opportunities. Boasting icons like Daigo Umehara and Dep, REJECT is selected as one of only 40 global clubs in the EWC Foundation Club Partner Program. Powered by our Hangzhou AI R&D hub, we connect our proprietary AI platform, AnyAI, with the AnyTag influencer ecosystem to seamlessly merge online traffic with physical retail environments, empowering modern enterprises to achieve scalable global growth.

name_zh: 西班牙对外贸易发展和投资局
introduction_zh:
西班牙对外贸易发展和投资局（ICEX，全称 España Exportación e Inversiones）是隶属于西班牙经济、贸易和企业部的国家级公共机构。其核心职责是推动西班牙企业走向国际化、提升其全球竞争力，以及促进外国企业在西班牙的投资与合作。
本届ChinaJoy西班牙官方展团组织12家企业和机构参展，涵盖视频游戏开发，人工智能内容生成、广告技术、电子外行业专业服务等领域。
introduction_en: ICEX Trade and Investment is a national public institution attached to the Spanish Ministry of Spanish Ministry of Economy, Trade and Enterprises. Its core responsibilities are to promote the internationalization of Spanish companies, enhance their global competitiveness, and facilitate foreign investment and cooperation in Spain. This year's ChinaJoy Spanish Official Pavilion brings together 12 companies and institutions, covering video game development, AI-powered content generation, adtech, gaming peripherals, and specialized industry services.

introduction_zh: 我们是一家专注电子游戏与沉浸式体验的开发公司，旗下拥有《Tenebrea》《Shadows on the Wall》等原创项目，面向PC和主机平台，其中后者更适配VR以强化沉浸感。同时，我们成功将《Evil Inside》《Order 13》改编为VR版本，提升真实交互体验。此外，我们也为企业提供定制化游戏化方案，助力品牌提升用户参与度和沟通效果。
introduction_en:
We are a company specialized in video game development and immersive experiences. We have our own projects such as Tenebrea, a game in development for PC and consoles based in a true paranormal case. We are also working on Shadows on the Wall, a project for PC and consoles that will include a virtual reality adaptation to enhance immersion.

In terms of adaptations, we have already released Evil Inside VR, currently available on the market, and we are developing Order 13 VR, bringing PC-based experiences into virtual reality. Additionally, we offer gamification solutions for companies.

introduction_zh:
DALOAR是拥有20名3D图形与游戏开发专家的西班牙工作室。我们专注于打造高质量、注重剧情的游戏，并始终以黑暗氛围和恐怖题材为创作核心。
 
工作室推出了首款第一人称恐怖游戏《诡岛灵探》（The Occultist），该作在全球荣获超30项大奖与提名，包括2023年devcom重磅炸弹奖。继首作成功后，团队目前正全力开发全新的未来项目，继续为全球玩家带来黑暗与惊悚的体验。
introduction_en:
DALOAR is a Spanish video game studio formed by 20 skilled professionals with a strong background in game development and 3D graphics. The team is dedicated to producing high-quality, narrative-driven games, with a special emphasis on dark atmospheres and horror themes that set their work apart.

The studio made its mark with The Occultist, a story-centered first-person horror game and their debut release. Throughout its development and after launch, the game garnered significant industry attention, collecting over 30 awards and nominations internationally. A standout achievement was winning the 2023 devcom Blockbuster Award.

Following this success, DALOAR is now actively working on new projects, continuing to craft eerie, immersive experiences that appeal to horror fans around the world.

introduction_zh: 西班牙瓦伦西亚工作室Nox Noctis专注恐怖游戏，已推出《Do Not Open》及衍生作《OVRDARK》。新作《YOSHIMI》为3D平台跳跃类，融合潜行、解谜与轻度战斗，试玩Demo现已上线。团队正寻全球发行伙伴以推进开发，同时积极拓展亚洲市场，欲借现有IP寻求本地化代理、平台合作及联合推广等商业机会。
introduction_en:
Nox Noctis is a Valencia-based Spanish studio specializing in psychological horror games with a focus on narrative and immersion. The studio has released two titles—Do Not Open and OVRDARK: A Do Not Open Story—which have helped establish its presence in the genre.

Currently, the team is working on its third project, YOSHIMI, a 3D platformer that blends stealth, puzzle-solving, and combat while staying true to the studio's horror identity. A playable demo is already available.

Nox Noctis is now seeking a publishing partner to support YOSHIMI's next development phases. Additionally, the studio is looking to expand into Asian markets, building on its existing titles and exploring new partnerships in the region.

introduction_zh: MystherAI专注AI原生电影制作与虚拟制作技术，开发Next Anima平台，支持将文本快速转为可编辑3D世界，并与Unreal Engine深度集成。为影人、特效团队、游戏开发者提供智能场景、资产、角色及镜头生成，强调导演主导创作流程，保留完全控制权，目标成为AI影视与互动叙事的核心平台。
introduction_en:
MystherAI is an AI-native filmmaking and virtual production company developing Next Anima, a platform that transforms text into fully editable 3D worlds inside Unreal Engine.

Our technology enables filmmakers, VFX studios, game developers and content creators to generate cinematic environments, intelligent assets, characters and camera systems while maintaining complete creative control over production.

Unlike traditional AI video generators, Next Anima focuses on director-driven storytelling, allowing creators to build reusable worlds, direct cameras, manage assets and produce cinematic experiences using AI-powered workflows.

Our mission is to become the operating system for the next generation of AI-native filmmaking and interactive storytelling.

introduction_zh:
和你的朋友们化身最闹腾的地精，加入这款快节奏的竞技场疯狂大乱斗！
快拉上你的三个好友，一头扎进这场最离谱的混战，争夺“最闹地精”的桂冠！想要在这款快节奏的竞技场大乱斗中制霸全场？那就连抡带砸、闪转腾挪、极尽嘲讽、引爆全场！自由组合强大的效果与技能，打造最不讲武德的超标配置，把无尽的荒谬与混乱留在身后。让混沌，主宰一切！
introduction_en:
We're Sand Castles, the studio behind games like Bred & Fred and most recently, Gnaughty Gnomes! We develop fun and cute ideas that if we are lucky, we manage to make them alive. A game development studio creating projects that primarily we would play ourselves.
Our slogan is: If it makes us laugh, let’s make it real

introduction_zh: Tappx是全球领先的AdTech公司，为移动应用、网页及CTV提供程序化广告、用户增长与流量变现方案，是游戏出海团队理想的增长伙伴。专注效果营销，提供CPI/CPA/CPR等按效果付费服务，每月处理超800亿广告请求。深耕欧美成熟市场，加速拓展拉美及亚太，携手全球顶级媒体与交易平台，结合自研机器学习、HUMAN品牌安全反作弊方案及资深团队实战经验，助力客户实现透明高效的可持续增长。
introduction_en: Tappx is a fast-growing AdTech company offering monetization, user acquisition, and programmatic advertising for mobile apps, web, and CTV. It supports mobile game publishers' global growth with proprietary tech that maximizes ad revenue. Brands and agencies run transparent, performance-driven campaigns (CPC, CPI, CPA, CPR). The platform processes 80B+ ad requests monthly, using ML, real-time optimization, and premium inventory. Tappx has strong Tier 1 presence and expands in LATAM and APAC, partnering with top publishers, SSPs, exchanges, and measurement providers. It ensures traffic quality with proprietary anti-fraud and HUMAN solutions. Its greatest strength: expert teams, hands-on management, and close collaboration, delivering measurable growth and long-term partnerships.

introduction_zh:
万物皆陨 (All Things Should Fall) 项目以全新视角融合动作与平台跳跃，多元玩法等你掌握，爽快尽兴、回味无穷。
探索鲜活世界，秘藏与强敌并存。解锁元素之力，组合连段破敌。抉择影响羁绊，升级飞船，穿越云海。
introduction_en:
All Things Should Fall is a new approach to the mix of Action and Platformers, creating an insanely fun and satisfying game that includes multiple playstyles to master.
- Explore a dynamic world with tons of secrets and enemies, and unveil the path to the core of each biome.
- Increase your arsenal by unlocking new elements to travel through each level, discovering more and more layers in every world visited.
- A fast and fluid combat system where elemental domination combines and unlocks more and more combos as you progress.
- Develop deep connections where your decisions will change the bonds you create with a diverse cast of characters.
- Navigate to new worlds by upgrading your ship and fight your way through the sea of clouds!

introduction_zh:
昂拓 是源自西班牙的全球全方位游戏发行与联合开发伙伴。我们由拥有超十年经验的行业专家构成，提供一站式解决方案：
- 全案发行：全球策略、公关宣发与海外红人营销。
- 技术协同：高级联合开发、多平台移植与技术咨询。
- 开发者至上：专注于可持续合作，确保创作者享有最大收益分成。

从移植到全球上线，我们致力于释放您游戏的商业潜力。期待与您在展会携手合作！
introduction_en:
Entalto Publishing is a premier, full-service global publisher and co-development partner based in Spain. Founded by industry veterans with over a decade of expertise, we deliver a complete in-house ecosystem tailored to bring outstanding titles to the international marketplace.
- We provide comprehensive, end-to-end solutions for studios of all sizes:
- Full-Cycle Publishing: Strategic global marketing, PR, and international distribution.
- Technical Excellence: Expert co-development, multi-platform porting, and technical consultancy.
- Targeted Outreach: Global influencer campaigns to maximise your game's visibility.

introduction_zh:
加那利群岛游戏是西班牙加那利群岛官方游戏产业推广计划，由PROEXCA牵头，旨在将该地区打造为欧洲游戏开发与发行枢纽。

我们连接全球开发者、发行商和投资者，提供战略性、高性价比的欧盟区位。核心优势包括高达54%的制作税收返还、4%企业所得税，以及丰富的人才资源。

我们支持本土工作室，促进国际合作，助力企业融入本地生态。加那利群岛，是您游戏业务的理想之选。
introduction_en:
Canary Islands Games is the official initiative to promote and internationalize the video game industry in the Canary Islands. Led by PROEXCA, we aim to make the region a top European hub for game development and services.

We connect global developers, publishers, and investors with a strategic, cost-effective EU location rich in talent. Benefits include up to 54% production tax credits, a 4% corporate tax rate, and top local professionals.

We support local studios, foster global partnerships, and help businesses join our thriving ecosystem. Discover why the Canary Islands are ideal for your next gaming project.

introduction_zh:
Stage Clear Studios成功后，Zero Fraction Studios于2024年底成立，延续我们在游戏开发、移植与联合开发方面的经验。

作品包括《蝙蝠侠：阿卡姆阴影》等AA级VR游戏，及30余款移植至PS4、PS5、XOne、XSeries和Switch的游戏。

团队成员曾参与《死亡空间》、《教父2》、《FIFA》等AAA级大作开发。
introduction_en:
Following the success of Stage Clear Studios, Zero Fraction Studios was born at the end of 2024, continuing the experience gained in development, porting and co-development.

Our portfolio includes such renowned AA VR games such as Batman: Arkham Shadow
+30 ported games to PS4, PS5, XOne, XSeries, Switch

Our team's background includes AAA titles such as Dead Space, The Godfather 2, FIFA and more.

introduction_zh:
L33t Pro Games 是一家西班牙独立游戏工作室。
作品涵盖动作RPG《Demonic Gauntlet》、六边形战棋《Hexagon Imperium》、AI竞技场《BotArena》及每日益智合集《Pasatiempos》，登陆网页、Steam与Android平台。
在研新作：《War Lynx》《Underhell》《Crusader and Demons》。
口号：地狱即代码。
introduction_en:
L33t Pro Games is a Spanish indie studio building free-to-play browser games — no downloads, instant play on any device.

Current titles: Demonic Gauntlet (dark action RPG), Hexagon Imperium (turn-based hex strategy), BotArena (AI-driven arena), and Pasatiempos (daily puzzles). All on web, Steam, Android, Minijuegos, and CrazyGames.

In development: War Lynx, Underhell, Crusader and Demons — expanding into action, strategy, and dark fantasy.

Lean, fast, web + AI-powered. Where Hell Meets Code.

introduction_zh: adjoe 是一家颠覆传统行业的领先移动广告技术公司。自2018年创立以来，总部设在德国汉堡，隶属于Applike集团。短短几年内，adjoe 已迅速崛起，每年触达6亿移动用户，与全球500多家游戏工作室及超过1000款游戏合作，成为行业中的强劲力量。
introduction_en: adjoe introduces new ways for apps to monetize and scale by improving how users experience ads. From its offices in Hamburg, Boston, Singapore, and Tokyo, the company runs the world’s leading – and fastest growing – rewarded advertising channel. Thanks to its advanced AI and first-party data, adjoe serves over 770 million mobile users globally with highly personalized ad experiences.

introduction_zh: IGG集团创立于2006年，是全球领先的手机游戏与移动应用开发商及营运商，拥有庞大的全球市场及客户群体，总游戏用户数约16亿，游戏月活跃用户近1,700万。继承在客户端游戏及网页游戏方面多年研发及全球运营的经验，2013年集团审时度势，将战略重心转向手机游戏领域。历经多年耕耘，集团现以23种不同语言版本向全球发行手游产品，移动应用业务经过十余年的打磨，卓然有成，成为集团新兴重要业务模块。
introduction_en: Established in 2006, IGG is a leading global developer and operator of mobile games and applications with a strong global presence and international customer base of approximately 1.6 billion gamers in total and nearly 17 million monthly active user ("MAU"). Leveraging its success in client and browser PC online games, the Group changed its strategy to target the mobile games market in 2013. After years of effort, the Group's mobile games are now available in 23 different languages worldwide, and the APP Business has gained significant momentum in recent years and has emerged as an important business division of the Group.
