Our main products include PVC soft rubber items, acrylic decorations, injection dolls and felt products. We offer personalized customization and one-stop OEM services. Our high-quality products sell well worldwide. We look forward to cooperating with all partners for mutual benefits.

introduction_en: Aurora Global are an international advertising agency, providing services, consulting and solutions for advertisers on leading digitalplatforms including Meta, TikTok and Google. We support advertisers by connecting them with dedicated account managers, payment methods for advertising spend, platform compliance support and training.

introduction_en:
Bidkinetic is a performance marketing network spanning mobile and web, delivering user acquisition and sales across 150+ countries. We work two ways: app installs and in-app events on mobile (CPI, CPA), and validated online sales and bookings on the web (CPS).
Our mobile side covers iGaming, fintech, e-commerce, and streaming — tracked end-to-end on MMP and screened for fraud. Our web CPS side runs e-commerce, travel, and subscription brands through a global publisher network of cashback, coupon, content, and search partners, paid on completed sales. RevShare and Hybrid models available across both.
Advertisers get real scale with validated traffic. Publishers get direct demand and fast, transparent payouts.
Find us at booth W4D505. WeChat: parthkotnala_1. Let's map your next market.

introduction_zh: Filly Media 是一家全球移动效果营销机构，帮助移动应用获取全球优质用户，并携手 5,000 多家全球媒体合作伙伴，实现网站、应用及流量的高效变现。
introduction_en:
Filly Media is a global mobile performance marketing agency that connects leading mobile app advertisers with high-quality users worldwide. We help app developers and brands scale user acquisition through performance-driven marketing campaigns across multiple channels and geographies.

With a trusted network of 5,000+ publishers worldwide, we also empower website owners, app developers, influencers, and media buyers to maximize their revenue through high-converting mobile campaigns. By combining advanced performance marketing strategies, data-driven optimization, and global reach, Filly Media delivers measurable growth for advertisers while creating sustainable monetization opportunities for publishers.

introduction_en: CoralGlobal is committed to delivering one-stop comprehensive cross-border solutions for cross-border trading enterprises. introduction_zh: Performance Launchpad 是一家专注于效果营销与数字增长的全球营销机构，致力于帮助品牌和移动应用实现高质量用户增长。我们依托数据驱动的方法、全球媒体资源及丰富的行业经验，提供用户获取、联盟营销、程序化广告及效果优化等一站式解决方案。以创新、透明和结果为核心，我们助力金融科技、电商、游戏等行业客户突破增长边界，在全球市场中持续创造价值。
introduction_en: Performance Launchpad is a global performance marketing and digital growth agency focused on helping brands and mobile applications achieve sustainable, high-quality user acquisition. Through data-driven strategies, global media partnerships, and expertise in affiliate marketing, programmatic advertising, rewarded traffic, and performance optimization, we deliver measurable business outcomes. Guided by innovation, transparency, and results, we empower clients across fintech, e-commerce, gaming, and subscription services to accelerate growth, maximize ROI, and build a lasting competitive advantage in global markets.

introduction_en: Payoneer is the all-in-one financial platform for borderless business and global payments. Payoneer empowers millions of businesses with the financial tools and services they need to grow and transact globally with confidence. We make it easier for SMBs, particularly in emerging markets, to connect to the global economy, pay and get paid, manage their funds across multiple currencies, and grow their businesses.

introduction_zh: YouAppi 是全球领先的增长与用户留存 DSP 平台，专注于为移动应用和 CTV（联网电视）提供高效的用户获取、再唤醒和重定向营销解决方案。自 2011 年成立以来，YouAppi 始终致力于为全球顶尖的移动广告主提供优质服务，并建立了长期稳定的合作关系。YouAppi 先后荣登2021 年德勤北美高科技成长 500 强及2023 年5000太平洋增长最快企业榜单。隶属于Affle上市集团。
introduction_en: YouAppi is a leading growth and retention DSP, a platform specializing in user acquisition, re-engagement and retargeting for mobile apps and CTV. Established in 2011, YouAppi has been a long-term partner to global top mobile advertisers, earning recent awards including top 100 fastest-growing companies in North America on the 2021 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ and 2023 Inc. 5000 Regionals: Pacific list. YouAppi is also consistently ranked a global top 2 remarketing company on the Appsflyer performance index both in gaming and non-gaming, dated most recently in 2025. YouAppi is powered by Affle Group, a global technology company with a proprietary consumer intelligence platform.

introduction_en: RixDesk is RixEngine’s AI marketing agent for advertisers. It gives marketing teams a single, intelligent workspace to manage complex campaigns with greater clarity, speed, and control. Built around real advertising workflows, RixDesk centralizes strategy planning, audience insights, budget management, creative optimization, real-time bidding, and performance analysis. By reducing manual work and making campaign changes easier to act on, RixDesk helps advertisers monitor performance more clearly, respond faster to changes, and improve campaigns from planning to optimization.

introduction_zh: NetMarvel 致力于通过技术驱动的精细化广告运营与全域的社媒内容营销方案，助力手游和应用广告主在复杂多变的全球市场中，以确定性 ROI 策略锁定高质量用户，实现商业价值跃升。
introduction_en: NetMarvel empowers mobile game and app advertisers to thrive in the dynamic global market. Leveraging tech-oriented, performance-based ad operations and full-funnel social media solutions, we drive high-value user acquisition and maximize commercial growth through ROI-driven strategies.

introduction_zh:
Antom是蚂蚁国际旗下提供全球支付、业务增长与数字化解决方案的一站式平台。我们面向不同规模的全球企业，致力于提供领先的AI驱动支付解决方案，助力商户开启全球增长新机遇，共创智付未来。

万里汇（WorldFirst）是蚂蚁国际旗下品牌，专为开发者提供安全、省心、合规的跨境收付款、外汇风险管理产品、一站式金融服务。
introduction_en:
Ant International's Antom is a leading merchant payment and digitalisation platform for businesses of all sizes worldwide. We provide unified, vertical-specific and AI-driven solutions for payments, growth and digitalisation – unlocking new business growth possibilities beyond payments.
Managing a global business is becoming increasingly complex. Since 2004, WorldFirst has been at the forefront of developing simplified and secure global payment solutions, fuelling the growth of more than a million businesses worldwide to date.

introduction_zh: RevX是Affle集团旗下一家备受认可的全球广告解决方案提供商，致力于推动应用APP、社交媒体、移动网页（mWeb）及联网电视（CTV）等多渠道的转化效果。13 年来，持续为游戏及非游戏行业的全球客户创造卓越成果。其程序化 DSP 平台及 AI 驱动的优化引擎 Intellibid，通过解读用户行为与数据信号，跨渠道、跨场景、跨设备触达并激活高质量用户，提升LTV。
introduction_en: RevX, a leading global advertising solutions provider under the Affle Group, empowers advertisers to drive high-quality conversions across mobile apps, social media, mobile web (mWeb), and Connected TV (CTV). For over 13 years, RevX has helped gaming and non-gaming brands worldwide achieve sustainable growth. Leveraging its programmatic DSP and AI-powered optimization engine, IntelliBid, RevX interprets user behavior and data signals to reach, engage, and convert high-value audiences across channels, touchpoints, and devices—maximizing customer lifetime value (LTV).

introduction_zh: 点点数据是全球领先的移动应用与游戏市场情报提供商，为全球移动开发者、发行商、金融科技公司、上市公司及投资机构提供全面而可信的决策依据，涵盖下载量、收入、用户行为、竞品表现、SDK 集成信息等核心维度；同时提供应用商店优化（ASO）与苹果搜索广告（ASA）服务，助力企业在竞争激烈的全球市场中精准识别增长机会，以数据驱动业务增长。
introduction_en: DianDian is a leading global provider of market intelligence for the mobile app and gaming sectors. Our platform boasts over 800,000 registered users, more than 6,000 enterprise partners and over 30 million annual visits. We deliver decision-support tools to mobile developers, publishers, fintech enterprises, listed companies and investment institutions, covering core metrics including app downloads, revenue, user behavior, competitor performance and SDK integration data. We also offer specialized services focused on App Store Optimization (ASO) and Apple Search Ads (ASA). Our solutions empower businesses to identify growth opportunities and accelerate performance in the highly competitive global mobile market.

introduction_zh: 久游网，2003年4月份成立于上海。作为一家老牌互联网游戏运营商，得益于中国游戏产业的蓬勃发展，久游网已悄然走过20个年头，创下了国内首家音舞游戏百万同时在线的产业记录，开辟了音舞游戏商业化模式和品质化经营的先河。未来，久游网将继续弘扬社会主义核心价值观，持续深化精品游戏策略，守法合规，坚持文化自信，传播中国文化，用优秀的游戏来打动更多的玩家，并致力实践社会责任。久游网，初心不改，笃行致远！
introduction_en:
Founded in 2003, 9You.com is now a 100% subsidiary of Hunan TV & Broadcast Intermediary Co., Ltd.
As the first-generation leader of China internet game industry, 9you.com has accumulated a great many loyal users through series of music and dance products known as “Audition” and deep cultivation of Japanese classic IP named “Gundam”.
The VIP members of 9You Online Amusement Club has been around 600 million. With a progressive iteration of the huge user management system, it has formed a positive circulation system between game content and user service. And 9You will keep upgrading the system through comprehensive entertainment diversification strategy and introduction of high-quality content, so as to achieve the superlative user service.

introduction_zh: 融云是全球智能通信云服务商，致力于提供融合 AI 的即时通讯与音视频云服务，赋能开发者和企业的创新能力，在数字化领域不断创造新的应用场景和商业价值。成立至今，凭借产品、技术、服务等多方面优势，融云收获了数十万开发者，支撑起社交、娱乐、游戏、教育、电商、医疗、政务等各行业应用的通信需求，并打造出一系列中企出海的最佳实践案例。
introduction_en: Nexconn is a global pioneer in AI-driven cloud communications, built on over a decade of technical excellence in the world’s most demanding digital markets. Through a powerful combination of In-App Messaging SDKs and Programmable Communication APIs, we offer the essential building blocks to integrate sophisticated, AI-powered chat, voice and video capabilities into any platform. Whether you are scaling a customer-facing app or deploying secure and intelligent SaaS solutions, Nexconn is your ideal choice of CPaaS infrastructure that accelerates your time-to-market while bridging the gap between artificial intelligence and authentic human connection.

introduction_zh: Decodo是一家全球代理IP与网络数据采集平台，为AI数据管道、跨境电商及大规模数据抓取提供强力支持。拥有覆盖195+个地区的1.25亿+IP资源、99.86%的高成功率，以及网页抓取API、站点解锁器和AI解析器等核心工具，Decodo助力企业高效采集、整合并激活网络数据。
introduction_en: Decodo is a global proxy and web data collection platform powering AI data pipelines, cross-border eCommerce, and large-scale scraping. With 125M+ IPs across 195+ locations, a 99.86% success rate, and tools including a Web Scraping API, Site Unblocker, and AI Parser, Decodo helps businesses collect, structure, and activate web data at scale.

introduction_zh: Theorycraft Marketing（西欧理）是一家全球游戏营销机构，专注帮助亚洲游戏成功拓展欧美市场。我们提供效果广告、KOL与网红营销、创意制作、明星合作及品牌联动服务，曾助力《Last War: Survival》《PUBG》《Angry Birds》等项目实现海外增长，以数据驱动策略连接全球玩家。
introduction_en:
Theorycraft Marketing is a global marketing agency helping Asian game developers and publishers successfully scale in Western markets. We combine performance-driven Paid Media, KOL & Influencer Marketing, Creative Production, Celebrity Collaborations, and Strategic Brand Partnerships to drive awareness, acquisition, and long-term growth.

With experience supporting both indie studios and global hits like Last War: Survival, PUBG and Angry Birds, we create culturally relevant campaigns that connect games with audiences across North America and Europe. From market entry and game launches to large-scale user acquisition, Theorycraft delivers data-driven strategies and measurable results that help Asian games thrive in the West.

introduction_zh:
Adsterra深耕中国市场，长期服务中国广告主与流量合作伙伴，提供中文支持、本地化支付解决方案，并深入理解中国用户及流量特点。

作为全球广告与流量变现平台，Adsterra为广告主、媒体代理及流量主提供高效可靠的增长解决方案。平台覆盖248个国家和地区，支持多种广告形式、灵活的合作模式、快速审核及精准定向能力。

目前，已有超过65,000家合作伙伴选择Adsterra，共同实现长期稳定增长。
introduction_en:
Adsterra has strong experience in the Chinese market, working with Chinese advertisers and traffic partners, providing Chinese-language support and a deep understanding of the Chinese traffic ecosystem and user behavior.

As a global advertising and traffic monetization platform, Adsterra operates under a unique Partner Care approach, offering advertisers, agencies, and publishers efficient, secure, and sustainable growth solutions.

The platform covers 248 countries and regions and supports a wide range of ad formats, flexible cooperation models, fast moderation, and precise targeting capabilities.

More than 65,000 partners worldwide already use Adsterra to achieve stable growth and revenue performance.

introduction_zh: iGameBUY 是专注于全球游戏支付与增长的 B2C 平台，亮相 2026 ChinaJoy BTOB（W4-E508 展位），面向开发者、发行商及平台运营商提供高效支付、本地化及商业化解决方案。平台深耕中国香港、中国台湾省及东南亚市场，支持一次 API 接入多元支付方式（电子钱包、银行卡及国际信用卡），助力游戏快速出海。
introduction_en: iGameBUY is a B2C platform specializing in global game payments and growth. It will showcase at the 2026 ChinaJoy BTOB (booth W4-E508), offering developers, publishers, and partners efficient payment, localization, and commercialization solutions. Focused on Hong Kong, Taiwan, and Southeast Asia, the platform enables one-time API access to diverse payment methods including e-wallets, bank cards, and international credit cards, accelerating overseas game launches. iGameBUY also provides joint marketing, brand collaborations, and membership activities for long-term growth, reducing integration costs and boosting international market performance for mutual success.

introduction_zh:
创新，合作和信心是我们的核心价值。作为一间充满活力与热诚的科技新创公司，由不同领域专家组成的专业团队为我们的客户提供各种云端服务，包括产品销售、策略咨询、云端架构实践和迁移、以及技术支持。
协助企业加速数字转型并提供客户全方位的专业服务。配合客制化的专属解决方案，让客户在拓展业务市场时能无后顾之忧。
站得更高，看得更远！我们有信心，在您的云端旅程上开拓新视野！
introduction_en: Innovation, Partnership, Confidence. These are Higher Cloud's core values.  Our team is made up of enthusiastic experts that come from varying professional backgrounds. The best of the best have come together from different fields to form Higher Cloud, the perfect tech startup.  We provide our customers with a variety of cloud services, including product sales, strategy advisory and cloud architecting.  We also provide services for cloud migrations and technical support.

name_en: 上海萌同科技有限公司

introduction_en: The company is located at No. 233 Qingwei Road, Qingcun Town, Fengxian District, Shanghai. It mainly produces game and anime peripheral products including tin badges (button pins) and acrylic printed goods. Equipped with high-efficiency production workshops, we provide one-stop integrated services covering design, manufacturing, quality inspection and packaging.

name_zh: 北京奇游灵动科技有限公司
introduction_zh: MIRACLE GAMES 开放平台是专注于 Microsoft Store 终端应用和游戏推广运营的服务平台，由微软孵化，同时也是微软一直扶持的合作伙伴。从2016年开始，我们以“赋能开发者，联结玩家，构筑乐趣世界”为使命，始终致力于推动微软生态在中国市场的普及，帮助开发者在 Windows 等平台上获得用户和快速变现。
introduction_en:
MIRACLE GAMES is the only service provider in China that specializes in global promotion and operation of terminal applications and games in the Microsoft Store (MSOW). We were incubated by Microsoft and have been supported as a partner by Microsoft since our inception in 2016. Our primary focus has been on driving the popularity of the Microsoft ecosystem in the Chinese market.

Creating a global gaming ecosystem
Building the future of entertainment technology
Our mission-Empower developers, Connect players, Build a world of fun
MIRACLE GAMES Open Platform is dedicated to the promotion and operation of applications and games on the Microsoft Store

introduction_zh: AppTweak 是一家以数据科学驱动的应用商店营销与情报平台，2014 年创立于布鲁塞尔，在全球八座城市设有办公室，服务超过 2000 家客户。其核心 Atlas AI 自 2014 年起持续基于应用商店数据训练；平台涵盖 ASO 情报、Apple Ads 投放管理、评分评论管理与市场情报，助力 Uber、Zynga、The North Face 等移动领军企业提升自然与付费UA表现。
introduction_en:
AppTweak is an App Store Marketing & Intelligence Platform driven by data science, enabling mobile leaders to optimize their app’s organic and paid performance in the app stores.

AppTweak stands out as the industry’s most comprehensive platform, providing ASO Intelligence, Search Ads Campaign Management, App Store Review Management, and Market Intelligence. We empower app marketers with tools, data, and managed services to make more informed decisions and stay ahead of the competition.

At the core of AppTweak is Atlas AI, our proprietary deep-learning language model trained on app store data since 2014. This technology, combined with unparalleled support, makes AppTweak the trusted partner for mobile leaders such as Uber, Zynga, and The North Face.

introduction_zh:
全球领先的视频数据监测与分析平台。

覆盖 YouTube，TikTok，Facebook，Instagram，Twitch 5大主流平台。欧、美、东南亚等地区，聚合了全球超过250亿个数据源。

强大的AI图像分析技术，追踪热门内容与流量趋势，粉丝增长及创作者排行榜，为品牌定制品牌出海战略.

深受 Amazon、Activision、Sony 等全球知名品牌的信赖。
introduction_en:
The world's leading video intelligence platform.

We provide comprehensive coverage across YouTube, TikTok, Facebook, Instagram, and Twitch, aggregating more than 15 billion data points from North America, Europe, Southeast Asia, and other major markets worldwide.

Leveraging advanced AI-powered video analysis, our platform identifies trending content, tracks audience growth, monitors video performance, and delivers industry-leading KOL rankings, helping brands make decisions to accelerate global growth.

name_zh: HaiPay · Light X 光帆动力
introduction_zh: Light X 光帆动力与 HaiPay 于 W4-F101 联合展示出海增长与支付商业化解决方案。LightX聚焦泛娱生态出海营销，提供策略-技术-内容-投放增长闭环服务。HaiPay 面向出海企业提供本地收单、本地支付、跨境代收代付、结算、风控及全球发薪能力。双方共同服务游戏、数字娱乐、SaaS、独立站与跨境业务，助力企业完成从用户增长到交易转化的全球化闭环。
introduction_en: Light X and HaiPay jointly present global growth and payment solutions at W4-F101. Light X focuses on overseas marketing for the pan-entertainment ecosystem, providing strategy, technology, content, campaign operations and distribution support. HaiPay provides localized payment solutions for global businesses, covering local acquiring, local payment methods, cross-border collection and payout, settlement, risk control and global payroll. Together, the two brands support gaming, digital entertainment, SaaS, independent websites and cross-border businesses, helping companies connect user growth with transaction conversion in global markets.

introduction_zh: InMobi Advertising是全球科技公司InMobi旗下的智能体AI广告平台，致力于帮助广告主与开发者高效实现全球增长商业目标。凭借专有智能体AI技术以及广泛的消费者触达能力和旗舰消费者平台Glance，为全球合作伙伴提供全渠道营销服务，引领广告与商业的发展。Glance 是 InMobi 旗下 AI 消费体验平台，通过移动端与电视端打造高度个性化的消费体验
introduction_en: InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

introduction_zh: ThinkingAI于 2026 年发布全球首创企业级 AI Agent 平台：Agentic Engine。该平台具备全域感知的能力，支持私有化部署。企业可创建和管理各类 Agent，支持多 Agent 协作，实现从感知到行动的闭环。目前 ThinkingAI 已服务全球 1500 家企业，超过 8000 款产品。ThinkingAI，让每一家企业都拥有自己的 AI Agent 团队。
introduction_en: ThinkingAI has launched Agentic Engine, the world's first enterprise-grade AI Agent platform of 2026. Equipped with all-domain perception capabilities, the platform supports on-premises deployment. It empowers enterprises to create and manage various types of Agents, enabling multi-Agent collaboration to achieve a closed loop from perception to action. To date, ThinkingAI has served over 1,500 enterprises and 8,000 products globally. ThinkingAI: Empowering every enterprise with its own AI Agent team.

introduction_zh: Waffo是全球支付变现平台，获汇丰、高榕、BAI Capital、Illuminate Financial等投资，服务AI、SaaS、游戏及数字商。业务重点覆盖亚太、北美、拉美及非洲，集成480+支付方式，助力企业实现全球规模化增长。
introduction_en:
Waffo is a payment and monetization platform built for global digital businesses, serving AI, SaaS, gaming, online content, and other digital-native companies.                                                                                                
The platform connects 173+ countries and regions with 480+ local payment methods, with key coverage across Asia Pacific, North America, Latin America, and Africa. Supporting instant payments, one-time payments, and localized checkout experiences — helping businesses improve payment conversion, boost user retention, and achieve scalable growth.

introduction_zh: Bidnex是一家面向全球市场的程序化广告平台，长期深耕程序化广告交易、效果营销增长以及云与AI基础设施等领域，为游戏、App及数字娱乐企业提供从用户增长、流量变现到算力资源支持的一站式服务。
introduction_en: Bidnex is a global programmatic advertising platform specializing in programmatic advertising, performance marketing, and cloud & AI infrastructure. We provide game, app, and digital entertainment companies with end-to-end solutions covering user acquisition, traffic monetization, and computing resource support, helping businesses accelerate growth and scale globally.

introduction_zh: Stripe 为全球逾千万企业提供可编程的金融服务。数以千万计的公司依托 Stripe 建立线上和线下支付渠道、在自身平台内嵌入金融服务、构建创新灵活的营收模式，并发展更具盈利能力的业务。Stripe 总部位于旧金山和都柏林，每年处理的支付总额超过 1.9 万亿美元，相当于全球 GDP 的 1.6%。
introduction_en: Stripe is building programmable financial services for millions of businesses globally. Millions of companies use Stripe to accept payments online and in person, embed financial services, power custom revenue models, and build a more profitable business. Headquartered in San Francisco and Dublin, Stripe processes over $1.9 trillion of payments annually, equivalent to 1.6% of global GDP.

introduction_zh: Edge226很高兴连续第三年亮相ChinaJoy！作为AI驱动的全渠道效果营销平台，我们通过CTV、程序化广告DSP及激励广告三大核心解决方案，帮助移动应用与游戏高效获取优质用户、拓展增量流量、提升ROAS并实现规模化增长。欢迎莅临Edge226展位，与团队深入交流，了解我们如何结合数据洞察、智能优化与全球媒体资源，为品牌和开发者提供覆盖用户全生命周期的投放策略，提升营销效率与可衡量业务成果。
introduction_en: Edge226 is excited to return to ChinaJoy for the third consecutive year! As the cross-channel performance marketing platform powered by AI, we help mobile apps and games scale through three high-performing advertising solutions: CTV, in-app, and rewarded advertising. Whether you're looking to acquire high-quality users, expand into new channels, or drive measurable growth, our team is here to help. Stop by to learn how Edge226 delivers performance-driven campaigns across every stage of the user journey.

introduction_en: J-PAY is a globally licensed PSP regulated in Hong Kong, the US, and Canada, with branch offices worldwide. We provide cross-border acquiring and collections across 140+ countries, supporting global cards and 200+ local APMs in SEA, the Middle East, LATAM, and beyond. Our solutions include multi-currency settlements, API integration, QR codes, live multi-currency virtual accounts, and UPI—serving e-commerce, travel, education, subscriptions, AI, SaaS, and digital entertainment. Backed by AI, data intelligence, and local clearing, we deliver secure, cost-efficient processing with PCI DSS Level 1 security.

name_zh: 西安创天网络科技有限责任公司
introduction_zh: 西安创天网络科技有限责任公司成立于 2015 年，坐落于西安高新区，是一家集网络游戏研发、运营、全球发行为一体的国家级高新技术企业，深耕经典怀旧网游细分赛道，在国内经典端游运营领域具备较高行业知名度与市场影响力。公司主营业务涵盖端游手游自主研发，独家代理运营，数字内容服务等，企业始终坚持传承经典游戏 IP、打磨精品数字娱乐内容，为广大玩家提供优质互联网服务。
introduction_en: Xi An SKY Online Co.,Ltd, established in 2015 and located in Xi'an High-tech Zone, is a national high-tech enterprise integrating online game development, operation, and global distribution. It specializes in the niche market of classic nostalgic online games and enjoys high industry recognition and market influence in the domestic classic desktop game operation field. introduction_zh: 火狗创意有限公司是中国香港知名的游戏动漫创作公司，成立于1999年，以出色的二次元动漫风格广受支持者喜爱。著名作品有2000年创业作的《爱神餐馆》，该作及其续作《爱神餐馆2》为首只打入日本家用游戏市场的香港原创作品系列。其后的主要作品《绯雪千夜》系列、《翠绿领域》卡牌游戏、《星界之梯》手游系列等等，均深得国际玩家支持。漫画作品《十五二十》亦曾获得日本国际漫画奖奖励奖，英文版足迹亦遍布欧美漫画市场。
introduction_en: 火狗创意有限公司是中国香港知名的游戏动漫创作公司，成立于1999年，以出色的二次元动漫风格广受支持者喜爱。著名作品有2000年创业作的《爱神餐馆》，该作及其续作《爱神餐馆2》为首只打入日本家用游戏市场的中国香港原创作品系列。其后的主要作品《绯雪千夜》系列、《翠绿领域》卡牌游戏、《星界之梯》手游系列等等，均深得国际玩家支持。漫画作品《十五二十》亦曾获得日本国际漫画奖奖励奖，英文版足迹亦遍布欧美漫画市场。

introduction_en: 真诚工作室创办于2013年，专注制作中国香港风格剧情游戏作品，已开发超过20个作品，并持续性地为玩家带来优质的剧情故事体验。

introduction_zh: WooshPay 是全球跨境支付金融基础设施服务商，伦敦、新加坡双总部，杭州金融科技准独角兽，官网wooshpay.com。成立五年已获得红杉资本、云锋基金、顺为资本、险峰长青、蓝湖资本多轮投资。持有英国、中国香港支付牌照，受英国 FCA 与中国香港海关监管，业务覆盖 170 个国家，深耕新兴市场，提供定制跨境支付方案。为小米、游戏知名商家funplus等出海企业提供多币种收款，风控与全球资金结算
introduction_en: WooshPay is a global cross-border payment infrastructure provider headquartered in London and Singapore, and recognised as a fintech quasi-unicorn in Hangzhou. Founded in 2021, it has raised three rounds of funding from leading VCs, including a Seed round led by Sequoia China, an Angel round led by Shunwei Capital, and a strategic Series A investment from Yunfeng Capital. Regulated by the UK’s Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) and Hong Kong Customs and Excise Department, WooshPay operates in 170 countries and territories, focused on emerging markets, providing tailored payment solutions. The company offers multi-currency collection, risk management and global fund settlement services for businesses expanding internationally, serving clients such as Xiaomi and leading gaming company FunPlus

introduction_zh: Collectcent Digital Media是一家拥有13年经验的全球效果营销与变现公司，服务移动端、网页及应用内流量。每月运营9000+活动，覆盖CPI、CPA、CPS、CPC模式，专注金融、电商、游戏等领域，助力全球媒体实现高质量增长与长期合作。
introduction_en: Collectcent Digital Media is a 13-year-old global performance marketing and monetization company partnering with publishers across mobile, web, and in-app ecosystems. With over 9,000 live campaigns running monthly, we deliver high-performing demand across CPI, CPA, CPS, and CPC models in key verticals such as fintech, e-commerce, gaming, entertainment, and utility apps. Our ecosystem is powered by proprietary technologies including Vola.Ads DSP and MotionSpot SSP, along with integrations with leading global demand partners and exchanges. We operate across major markets including India, SEA, LATAM, Russia, and Tier 1 regions, focusing on quality traffic, scalable growth, and long-term publisher partnerships.

introduction_zh: Liftoff是专为移动应用经济打造的效果营销与变现平台。其由人工智能驱动的Cortex™平台将营销、创意与广告变现能力深度融合，帮助应用在整个生命周期内实现规模化、可衡量的业务增长。致力于帮助广告主获取高价值用户并实现可持续增长，同时通过先进的广告变现技术与解决方案，帮助应用开发者和发行商最大化广告收益。公司成立于2012年，总部位于美国加利福尼亚州红木城，服务覆盖游戏等多领域客户。
introduction_en: Liftoff is a leading growth and monetization engine built for the mobile app economy. Its AI-powered platform, Cortex, unifies marketing, creative, and monetization to deliver measurable performance at scale across the app lifecycle. Liftoff enables advertisers to unlock profitable user growth while helping app publishers maximize revenue with advanced ad monetization technology. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, California, Liftoff supports a diverse, global customer base across gaming, consumer, and emerging app categories.

name_zh: 致遠國際支付有限公司
introduction_zh: Futurepay是科技驱动的跨境支付与金融基础设施服务商，面向跨境电商、出海品牌、外贸企业及平台型公司，提供覆盖“收、付、管、兑、控”的一站式资金服务。依托自研支付核心系统与开放API，Futurepay将复杂跨境交易链路产品化、模块化，帮助企业在多市场、多币种、多场景下提升支付成功率、降低资金成本、增强合规确定性，打造全球化经营的“资金底座”，助力客户将支付从成本中心升级为增长引擎。
introduction_en: Futurepay is a technology-driven cross-border payments and financial infrastructure provider serving cross-border e-commerce businesses, globalizing brands, foreign trade companies, and platform enterprises. It offers one-stop fund services covering collection, payment, treasury management, FX conversion, and risk control. Powered by its proprietary payment core system and open APIs, Futurepay productizes and modularizes complex cross-border transaction flows, helping businesses improve payment success rates, reduce funding costs, and strengthen compliance certainty across multiple markets, currencies, and scenarios. Futurepay serves as the financial foundation for global operations, enabling clients to transform payments from a cost center into a growth engine.

name_zh: 成都柒鲨网络科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 成都柒鲨网络科技（T7SN）是国内领先的数字视觉综合服务商，专注为游戏、动漫、影视、VR等领域提供全流程创意设计与制作开发服务。公司核心团队均来自业内头部企业，拥有多年项目开发与成熟管理经验，已与腾讯、网易、IGG、西山居、心动、英雄互娱、Playstudios等数十家国内外知名厂商达成长期合作。累计参与《超激斗梦境》《我叫MT》《火炬之光》《时光公主》《弹壳特攻队》《天地劫》等。
introduction_en: Chengdu Qisha Network Technology Co., Ltd. (T7SN)​ is a leading digital visual comprehensive service provider, specializing in the R&D and application of computer graphics and imagery. We provide end-to-end creative design and production services for the gaming, animation, film, television, and VR industries. We have established long-term partnerships with dozens of renowned domestic and international publishers, including Tencent, NetEase, IGG, Xishanju, XD, Hero Interactive Entertainment, and Playstudios.Covering platforms ranging from consoles and mobile to PC and VR, T7SN has successfully participated in the full-cycle outsourcing production of numerous hit titles, such as Super Brawl Dreams, I Am MT, Torchlight, Time Princess, Shell Shockers, and Tian Di Jie.

introduction_zh: 坐落于浦东惠南核心的浦东游戏动漫园，是镇级文化产业示范核心载体，深耕数字动漫、游戏科创、文旅融合领域，构筑人才实训、创业孵化、IP商业化三位一体黄金产业生态，搭载Unity集训营，定向输送游戏开发、XR交互、技术美术、AI数字文创优质人才，为企业破解用工、技术迭代难题。
introduction_en: Pudong Gaming & Animation Park, situated in the heart of Huinan, Pudong, serves as the core demonstration carrier of town-level cultural industries. Focused on digital animation, game technology innovation and integrated cultural tourism, it has built a robust three-in-one industrial ecosystem encompassing talent training, startup incubation and IP commercialization. Equipped with a Unity Training Camp, the park delivers targeted talent supply in game development, XR interaction, technical art and AI digital cultural creativity, helping enterprises address staffing shortages and challenges amid technological upgrades.

name_zh: 杭州高新区国家动画产业基地
name_en: Hangzhou High Tech Zone National Animation Industry Base
introduction_zh: 杭州高新区国家动画产业基地于2004年获批成为全国首批国家级动画产业基地 ，依托杭州高新区的数字经济优势，构建了“动漫制作-文学创作-游戏开发-版权运作-衍生品设计”全产业链生态 。该基地培育了中南卡通、网易（杭州）、电魂网络、玄机科技等头部企业，通过连续迭代的产业扶持政策和“文化+科技”融合发展战略 ，成为浙江省动漫游戏产业“第一区”。

name_zh: 北京一零跃动网络科技有限公司
name_en: BEIJING ONE ZERO WAVE TECH INFORMATION CO., LTD.
introduction_zh:
Surfin是一家总部位于新加坡的领先金融科技企业。专注于消费金融、理财、财富与资产管理、支付与汇款，以及金融科技即服务。凭借借贷科技、财富科技和支付科技等自主研发的数字技术，我们为横跨三大洲的十个发展中国家超过 1.06 亿的用户提供服务。
我们的机构客户同样受益于Surfin Lab/Surfin scrore以及 surfin cloud。这些产品为新兴市场提供了全面的智能风险管理
introduction_en: Surfin is a Singapore-based fintech leader specializing in Consumer Finance, Wealth & Asset Management, Payments & Remittances and Fintech-as-a-Service. With proprietary digital technologies like Lend Tech, Wealth Tech, and Pay Tech, we serve over 106 million users in 10 developing countries across three continents. Our institutional clients benefit from SurfinLab, Surfin Score, and Surfin Cloud, which offer comprehensive smart risk management, machine-learning credit ratings, and AI-powered digital banking services in emerging markets.

introduction_zh: Unity 是全球领先的游戏引擎，提供游戏开发、部署和增长所需的技术与服务。每月有超过 30 亿消费者通过 Unity 创造的游戏和互动体验进行娱乐。从原型设计到正式发布，从广告投放到用户获取，从点击转化到商业变现，Unity 为游戏全生命周期提供一站式支持。依托行业领先的开发者社区和深刻理解玩家需求的强大引擎，Unity 持续助力开发者打造玩家喜爱的游戏和互动体验。
introduction_en: Unity is the world’s leading game engine to develop, deploy, and grow games and interactive experiences people love, powering play for more than 3 billion consumers each month. From prototype to production, ad to install, click to commerce - everything that a great game needs is already inside Unity, supported by the most successful game development community in history, powered by an engine that ensures each decision is informed by what players love.

introduction_zh: Razer Gold是全球大型的虚拟游戏点数及全球支付服务供应商。由全球领先的玩家生活方式潮流品牌 Razer 支持，为游戏和娱乐行业提供支付服务。通过 Razer Gold 的营销能力和以游戏玩家为中心的生态系统的协同效应，游戏发行商可通过联合品牌推广提升品牌知名度和玩家参与度。
introduction_en: Razer Gold—The largest monetization network for games and entertainment content. With 65,000+ onboarded gaming and entertainment contents, and integrated with major global and local payment partners, gamers leverage razer gold to purchase games, in-game items, earn razer silver rewards, and unlock exclusive game deals.

introduction_zh: 三七互娱（股票代码：002555），是中国优秀的科技文化上市企业，连续多年获评国家文化出口重点企业，并入选为国家文化产业示范基地。全球总部设在广州，并在北京、上海、安徽、海南、湖北、中国香港以及日韩等多个地区设有子公司或办事处等分支机构。公司业务包含游戏、素质教育及人工智能应用，同时在新质生产力、泛文娱及都市消费领域进行拓展，大力布局人工智能、XR、具身智能、生命科技等前沿方向，打造多元生态圈。
introduction_en: 37 Interactive Entertainment (Stock Code: 002555) is a leading publicly traded technology and cultural enterprise in China. It has been recognized as a National Key Cultural Export Enterprise for years and has been designated as a National Cultural Industry Demonstration Base.37 Interactive Entertainment's business spans game development and publishing, quality education, and AI applications. We are also strategically expanding into new quality productive forces, pan-entertainment, and urban consumer sectors, with significant investments in cutting-edge fields such as Artificial Intelligence, Extended Reality (XR), Embodied Intelligence, and Life Sciences, building a diversified ecosystem.

name_zh: 源生聚合信息技术（北京）有限公司
introduction_zh:
Verve连接广告主与开发者，覆盖全平台与各种新兴渠道。目前，Verve已为全球150多个国家的品牌、代理和开发者提供服务。

我们在中国市场提供的产品包括：
1. 面向开发者的移动应用变现及多渠道变现广告交易平台
2. 面向需求方（DSP）的移动应用增长及全渠道增长广告交易平台
3. 面向广告主的平台Dataseat，擅长基于移动端与CTV渠道的应用增长
introduction_en: Verve connects advertisers to publishers in emerging channels. We provide AI-driven tools for effective, responsible ad campaigns. Our digital media solutions optimize underleveraged ad inventory, enhancing outcomes across digital devices.

introduction_zh:
Affinity，广告科技领域的创新先锋。

2006年，Affinity在美国创立。Affinity致力于打造隐私优先的创新广告解决方案，助力开发者和广告主开拓传统搜索及社交媒体以外的全新机遇。作为全球领先的广告科技企业，Affinity拥有600余位专家团队，业务覆盖亚太、欧洲、美国、拉美等地的十余个市场，通过全新触点助力开发者探索更优变现路径，赋能广告主精准触达目标受众。
introduction_en:
Founded in 2006, Affinity has grown into a global adtech leader by identifying untapped opportunities in digital advertising and solving real-world challenges across the purchase funnel. 

Affinity operates 3 ad networks—mCanvas, SitePlug, VEVE—and 3 publisher-focused platforms including Yield Solutions, Opinary, and NucleusLinks. With 600+ employees across India, US, UK, Indonesia, China, Malaysia, and Brazil, we build cross-funnel consumer engagement products for advertisers and publishers. 

Affinity is poised to continue driving transformative solutions in the Adtech industry. Our focus remains on sustainable growth, privacy-conscious innovations, and empowering brands and publishers to succeed in a rapidly evolving digital landscape.

introduction_zh: TransPerfect于1992年在美国成立，至今30逾年持续增长与发展，稳居全球排名第一的语言服务供应商。TransPerfect如今已在全球 100多个城市设有工作室和办事处，在全球各个地区拥有广泛的优质母语资源，7000+名员工，提供超过170种语言的本地化、翻译、配音、QA测试及客服支持。
introduction_en: TransPerfect Games offers video game globalization services to reach gamers all over the world.

name_zh: 贝宝支付（北京）有限公司
introduction_zh: PayPal是全球领先的数字移动支付平台，为全球范围的个人用户和企业用户提供数字和移动支付产品及服务。通过打造创新体验，PayPal让资金流动、销售和购物变得轻松且安全，帮助各种类型及业务规模的从商者更高效地接收来自商家网站、移动设备端、应用程序等的款项支付。PayPal致力在中国长期投资和发展，是第一家获准在中国市场提供在线支付服务的外资支付机构以及首家在中国拥有全资子公司的外资支付公司。
introduction_en:
PayPal is a leading technology platform and digital payments platform that enables digital and mobile payments on behalf of consumers and merchants worldwide. It provides flexible, diversified, secure, and convenient  ways for businesses of all sizes to accept payments from merchant websites, mobile devices, and applications, and at offline retail locations, through a wide range of payment solutions. 
PayPal is committed to long-term investment and growth in China. It is the first licensed foreign platform to enter China’s online third-party payments market and the first foreign payment company with a wholly owned subsidiary in China.

name_zh: 易点天下网络科技股份有限公司
introduction_zh: 易点天下（eclicktech）是一家专注品牌全球化的营销科技公司。过去十余年，我们以技术为驱动，通过自主研发的数字营销平台，持续深耕全球230多个国家与地区，构建起连接超60万媒体的全球增长网络，已助力超过10,000家卓越企业实现全球用户增长与品牌建设。公司于2022年在深交所创业板上市（证券代码：301171）。
introduction_en: eclicktech is a digital marketing technology company focused on global brand development. For over a decade, driven by technology, we have continuously deepened our presence in more than 230 countries and regions worldwide through our self-developed digital marketing platform, building a global growth network connecting over 600,000 media outlets. We have helped more than 10,000 outstanding companies achieve global user growth and brand building. The company was listed on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange's ChiNext board in 2022 (stock code: 301171).

introduction_zh: Novabeyond是一家全球增长营销代理机构，帮助广告主在主流媒体渠道之外发掘新的增长机会。通过整合新兴媒体生态、OEM与CTV渠道、程序化广告能力、直连媒体资源及全球流量网络，为品牌构建覆盖策略、资源与运营的一体化增长体系，持续释放增量增长潜力，实现长期可持续发展。
introduction_en: Novabeyond is a global growth marketing agency focused on helping advertisers scale beyond the limitations of mainstream media traffic. By integrating emerging media ecosystems, OEM and CTV channels, programmatic infrastructure, direct inventory partnerships, and global media resources into a unified growth framework, we help brands diversify acquisition strategies, unlock incremental reach opportunities, and build sustainable global growth systems through strategy, execution, and scalable operational support.

introduction_zh: MovableAD 是全球智能化营销服务平台，整合了 DSP、CTV、媒体以及应用内广告等全球优质流量资源，为广告主提供端到端、数据驱动的营销解决方案。依托专业的运营团队和先进的优化策略，MovableAD 致力于帮助广告主高效获取高价值用户，在全球市场中实现可持续增长，持续提升营销效果。
introduction_en: MovableAD provides end-to-end, data-driven marketing services by integrating premium global traffic sources—including DSPs, CTV, media and in-app inventories. Powered by advanced teams and optimization strategies, we help advertisers acquire high-value users and achieve efficient, cost-effective growth across global markets.

name_zh: PayKKa | 深圳市新国都股份有限公司
introduction_zh: PayKKa（湃卡国际）是上市公司深圳市新国都股份有限公司（股票代码300130）旗下战略级跨境支付品牌，致力为全球商户提供安全高效的一站式数字支付解决方案。主营业务包括B2B外贸收款、B2C跨境电商收款、全球收单和货币换汇及其他金融服务，覆盖全球190+国家和地区，支持20余种主流货币交易且实现最快1秒到账的跨境资金流转。
introduction_en: PayKKa is a strategic cross-border payment brand under Shenzhen XGD Co., Ltd. (stock code: 300130), a listed company. It is committed to providing safe and efficient one-stop digital payment solutions for global merchants. Its core businesses include B2B foreign trade collection, B2C cross-border e-commerce collection, global acquiring, currency exchange, and other financial services. Covering over 190 countries and regions worldwide, PayKKa supports transactions in more than 20 major currencies and enables cross-border fund transfers with a minimum settlement speed of 1 second.

introduction_zh: 凭借超过十年的全球数字营销经验，SmartConnect 通过深入的市场理解与成熟的执行力，助力品牌实现全球化增长。我们专注于OEM流量出海，覆盖小米、OPPO、vivo、传音、荣耀等设备及SHAREit、MOBIUSPACE等出海媒体。作为OEM核心代理商，助力电商、游戏、短视频等品牌全球增长。
introduction_en: With over a decade of global digital marketing experience, SmartConnect empowers brands to grow internationally through deep market understanding and proven execution. We specialize in OEM native traffic for international expansion, covering major device channels such as Xiaomi, OPPO, vivo, Transsion, and HONOR, while also leveraging global in-app media platforms like SHAREit and MOBIUSPACE. As a core agency for OEMs, we empower partners across diverse verticals including e-commerce, gaming, short video, and utilities — helping brands grow smarter and faster on the global stage.

introduction_zh:
中电金信是中国电子控股的二级企业，深耕行业30年，与众多国内头部游戏企业保持长期深度合作，致力于通过AI技术创新解决方案为游戏出海全生态链赋能。
我们拥有7万+精通全球文化的人才网络与50+优势服务语种，能够提供覆盖翻译、配音、测试、数据标注、内容审核、社区运营、海外人才支持及站点搭建等全链路服务。
携手我们，您获得的不仅是高效的技术方案，更是一支懂您的游戏、更懂海外玩家的全球化支持团队。
introduction_en:
GienTech is an expert in intelligent digital transformation strategies and software solutions. With 30 years of industry expertise and deep partnerships with leading gaming firms, we empower the global gaming ecosystem through innovative AI solutions.
We boast a network of 70,000+ global professionals and 50+ key language capabilities. Our end-to-end services include translation, voice-over, testing, data labeling, content moderation, community operations, and overseas site construction.
By partnering with GienTech, you gain more than just efficient technology; you acquire a global support team that truly understands your games and international players.

introduction_en: Ignite Media team was established by a group of enthusiastic geeks in Singapore in 2018. We were born to be international and innovative! We believe that technology could change the world, and make digital marketing more efficient.

introduction_zh: RAMP UP是一家新加坡的国际化广告公司，致力于通过Affiliate Marketing、OEM厂商流量及效果营销解决方案，帮助广告主实现GMV增长与用户增长，业务覆盖全球200多个国家地区。凭借覆盖全球市场的广告主资源、优质流量及专业的运营团队，RAMP UP已与众多头部电商平台、OTA平台及国际品牌建立长期合作关系，持续为合作伙伴创造可持续的商业价值。
introduction_en:
RAMP UP is a Singapore-headquartered global advertising agency, dedicated to driving GMV growth and user acquisition through Affiliate Marketing, OEM traffic solutions, and performance marketing services. Currently, its business spans more than 200 countries and regions worldwide.

With a global network of advertisers, premium traffic resources, and a professional operations team, RAMP UP has established long-term partnerships with leading e-commerce marketplaces, OTAs, and international top brands. By integrating high-quality traffic with performance-driven marketing capabilities, RAMP UP continuously delivers sustainable commercial value to its partners.

name_zh: 克羅伊桑斯行銷解決方案私人有限公司
introduction_zh: Croissance Marketing Solutions Pvt. Ltd. 是一家全球效果行銷與聯盟行銷公司，專注於用戶獲取與業務成長。我們透過全球發布商網絡，為遊戲、金融科技、電子商務及 OTT 等產業提供高品質流量與績效行銷解決方案。我們參與 ChinaJoy，期待與廣告主、發布商、代理商及廣告科技夥伴建立合作，共同拓展全球市場。
introduction_en: Croissance Marketing Solutions Pvt. Ltd. is a global performance marketing and affiliate marketing company specializing in user acquisition and customer growth. We connect advertisers with a strong network of trusted publishers to deliver high-quality traffic across verticals including gaming, fintech, e-commerce, OTT, utilities, and lifestyle. Our expertise spans CPI, CPA, CPL, CPR, and hybrid campaign models, supported by data-driven optimization and transparent reporting. We are attending ChinaJoy to build strategic partnerships with advertisers, publishers, agencies, and ad tech companies while exploring new opportunities in the global gaming and mobile marketing ecosystem.

introduction_zh: 面向AI短漫剧专业创作者，通过数据驱动和智能化工具链重塑内容生产流程，提供从剧本到视频的精品AI剧一站式全链路创作智能体，成功孵化红果千万级爆款。

V5Pay 隶属于新加坡 Quark集团，总部设于新加坡，持有6块支付牌照，是具备全球合规资质的专业互联网支付服务商。公司依托集团全球化布局，在十余个国家和地区设有直营团队，服务覆盖全球70+国家和地区。
为游戏、电商、社交等出海企业提供一站式本地支付解决方案，涵盖收款、付款、结算与风控，助力企业安全高效实现全球资金互联互通。
introduction_en:
V5Pay is an affiliate of Singapore-based Quark Group with its headquarters located in Singapore. Holding six payment licenses, it is a professional internet payment service provider with full global compliance qualifications. Leveraging the Group’s global layout, we have established direct-operated teams in more than ten countries and regions, delivering services across over 70 countries and territories worldwide.
We offer one-stop local payment solutions for overseas-oriented enterprises engaged in gaming, e-commerce, social media and other sectors, covering collection, disbursement, settlement and risk control, helping enterprises achieve secure and efficient global capital interconnection.

name_zh: Opicle Technologies 私人有限公司
introduction_zh: Opicle 是一家全球绩效营销与联盟营销平台，专注于移动获客、应用增长和效果广告。我们连接全球广告主与媒体伙伴，以透明、高效、数据驱动的营销方案，助力品牌实现全球业务增长。
introduction_en:
Opicle – Redefining Digital. Powering Global Performance.

Founded in 2014, Opicle is a global Performance Marketing and Affiliate Marketing company connecting brands, advertisers, agencies, and publishers worldwide. We specialize in Mobile User Acquisition, App Growth, Lead Generation, and Web & Mobile Campaigns, delivering measurable results through CPA, CPL, CPI, CPS, CPE, and Revenue Share models. Operating across 100+ countries, we serve industries including FinTech, E-commerce, Insurance, Travel, Education, Crypto, and iGaming. Backed by 500+ global advertisers, 8,000+ publishers, and 50M+ monthly conversions, Opicle empowers businesses to scale with quality traffic, real-time optimization, and transparent partnerships.

Let's connect and grow together.

introduction_zh:
摩登天空是中国首屈一指的原创音乐唱片公司和备受关注的音乐生活方式运营机构。业务覆盖音乐出版、艺人经纪、现场音乐、演出场地、录音与制作、传媒、视觉与艺术、产品设计、零售与商业空间等众多版块。
Modern Sky Game House旨在将音乐与游戏融合为一种综合娱乐方式，以“玩”为核心线索，串联游戏音乐演出、游戏试玩、游戏竞赛、会客厅对谈、线下互动游戏、Coser巡游打卡等多个版块。
introduction_en:
Modern Sky is China’s leading independent record label for original music, and a highly influential operator of music lifestyle ecosystems. Its business covers a wide range of sectors, including music publishing, artist management, live music, live venue operations, recording and production, media, visual arts, product design, as well as retail and commercial spaces.
Modern Sky Game House is created to integrate music and gaming into an all-inclusive entertainment experience. Centered around the theme of "play", it features a diverse lineup of activities such as game music performances, game demos, gaming tournaments, salon dialogues, offline interactive games, and cosplayer interactions & photo check-ins.

name_zh: 株式会社フォーイット
introduction_zh:
株式会社フォーイット（For it Inc.）是一家于2010年成立的日本网络广告代理公司，总部位于东京涩谷。该公司以运营联盟营销平台（ASP）“afb（Affibee）”为核心业务，并广泛开展网络营销和媒体事业。
目前服务于多家中企出海大手公司，为中国公司的日本出海业务助航。
introduction_en: For it Inc. is a Japanese web advertising agency established in 2010 and headquartered in Shibuya, Tokyo. The company's core business is operating the affiliate service provider (ASP) platform "afb," while also extensively developing digital marketing and media businesses. Currently, it serves multiple major Chinese enterprises expanding abroad, charting the course for Chinese companies entering the Japanese market.Would you like to translate this into any other languages, or do you need to tailor this description for a specific business proposal or presentation?

introduction_zh: Mobikok 是一家专注于全球移动广告与效果营销的 AdTech 公司，连接广告主、流量主及电商合作伙伴，通过程序化广告、联盟营销（CPS/CPA/CPI/CPL）和 AI 驱动的投放优化技术，帮助客户实现用户增长、流量变现与商业价值提升，业务覆盖全球多个国家和地区。
introduction_en: Mobikok is an AdTech company focused on global mobile advertising and performance marketing. It connects advertisers, traffic partners, and e-commerce partners, helping clients grow users, monetize traffic, and boost business value through programmatic ads, affiliate marketing (CPS/CPA/CPI/CPL), and AI-driven optimization technology. Their business spans multiple countries and regions worldwide.

introduction_zh: PhotonPay光子易是下一代全球数字金融及支付基础设施，旨在连接全球数字经济，实现价值的无界流通。 我们通过技术打破金融边界，为全球企业建立稳定、高效、透明的数字化价值网络。PhotonPay光子易建立了涵盖全球账户、全球发卡、全球收单、全球分发、汇兑管理及嵌入式金融的多元化产品矩阵。助力企业在全球市场实现规模化增长。
introduction_en:
PhotonPay is a next-generation global digital financial and payment infrastructure provider, dedicated to connecting the global digital economy and enabling the seamless flow of value across borders.

By leveraging innovative technology, PhotonPay breaks down traditional financial barriers and empowers businesses with a stable, efficient, and transparent digital value network. Our comprehensive product ecosystem includes Global Accounts, Card Issuing, Acquiring, Global Payouts, FX Management, and Embedded Finance solutions.

PhotonPay helps businesses streamline cross-border operations, optimize global financial management, and achieve scalable growth in international markets.

introduction_zh:
WasabiCard 是一个稳定币支付基础设施平台，为企业打造高效合规、可拓展的支付方案。
平台围绕稳定币支付场景，核心产品包括：
・卡片服务（B2B、B2B2C、白标发卡）
・全球支付（USDT 便捷兑法币汇款）
・虚拟信用卡支付方案，适配订阅、广告、高频交易
企业仅需接入单一 API，就能使用全球发卡、跨境支付、自动资金分发，支持薪资发放、佣金结算、广告投放、多地区清算等业务。
introduction_en:
WasabiCard is a stablecoin payment infrastructure platform designed for businesses seeking efficient, compliant, and scalable payment solutions.
Centered around stablecoin-powered payment scenarios, WasabiCard delivers a comprehensive suite of products, including:
- Card Solutions (B2B, B2B2C, and white-label card issuing)
- Global Payout (seamless USDT-to-fiat remittance)
- VCC & Payment Solutions for subscriptions, advertising, and high-frequency transactions
Through a single API integration, businesses can access global card issuing, cross-border payments, and automated fund distribution, enabling use cases such as payroll, affiliate payouts, ad spend, and multi-region settlements.

name_zh: 连连数字科技股份有限公司
introduction_zh: 连连数字科技股份有限公司（“连连数字”）成立于2009年，2024年于中国香港交易所主板挂牌上市（股票代码：2598.HK），是中国领先、全球布局的AI驱动型数字支付服务商，秉持“连通世界，服务全球”的使命，以“AI原生+全球化”为战略，致力于构建值得信赖的全球智能金融新基建，助力中国企业与全球商业实现无界连接。
introduction_en: Lianlian DigiTech Co., Ltd. (“Lianlian DigiTech” or “Lianlian”) was founded in 2009 and listed on the Main Board of the Hong Kong Stock Exchange in 2024 (stock code: 2598.HK). As a leading AI-driven digital payment service provider headquartered in China with a global footprint, Lianlian adheres to its mission of “Connecting the world, Empowering global commerce” and pursues an “AI-Native + Globalization” strategy. The Company is committed to building a trusted global intelligent financial infrastructure, enabling seamless connectivity between Chinese enterprises and global businesses.

introduction_zh:
Nuvei: Nuvei 是驱动全球支付增长的基础设施。一个智能统一的系统，为规模化发展而生。
Visa Direct: 为全球领先的资金流动网络，Visa Direct 致力于连接卡、银行账户及数字钱包，实现本地与跨境支付的高效流转。依托广泛的网络覆盖，Visa Direct 可支持多元化应用场景，包括个人对个人（P2P）及账户对账户（A2A）转账、企业及政府资金发放、商户结算以及退款等。
introduction_en:
Nuvei: Nuvei is the growth infrastructure for every payment, everywhere. One intelligent system built to scale.
Visa Direct: As the largest money movement network, Visa Direct enables domestic and cross-border payments across cards, bank accounts and digital wallets. Visa Direct supports a range of use cases, including person-to-person and account-to-account transfers, business and government payouts, seller settlements and refunds. Visa Direct reaches more than 195 countries and territories and over 18 billion endpoints. In fiscal 2025, Visa Direct processed more than 12.5 billion transactions for more than 650 partners.

introduction_zh:
首尔产业振兴院（SBA）成立于1998年，是首尔市出资设立的全球顶尖公共创业加速器。

其核心宗旨是通过赋能企业创新来激发首尔的经济活力。机构不仅全力扶持文化内容、美妆时尚及研发（R&D）等多元产业，还积极开展初创企业孵化、拓展海外销路等业务，并致力于培养人工智能（AI）等前沿IT产业人才，全方位打造高效的商业生态系统。
introduction_en:
The Seoul Business Agency (SBA) is an institution funded by the Seoul Metropolitan Government, established in 1998 with the purpose of promoting and vitalizing Seoul's economy by contributing to start-up facilitation, corporate growth, and industry nurturing.

Based on its vision to be the world's leading public accelerator driving innovation in Seoul's enterprises and business ecosystem, the SBA supports the growth of various industry sectors, including content, beauty/fashion, and R&D. Concurrently, it carries out diverse support initiatives, such as promoting start-ups and incubating startups, supporting global market entry and overseas sales channel development, and cultivating talent in IT industries like AI.

introduction_zh: CFK是一家涵盖PC及Switch、PlayStation、Xbox等主机的多平台游戏发行商，已在全球推出《食魂徒》等300多款作品。公司不仅负责分销，还拥有专属开发团队，具备直接进行平台移植与IP重制的核心能力。其代表作包括《美少女梦工场2 增强版》及《红魔城蕾米莉亚》等知名原作IP的全新重制游戏。
introduction_en: CFK is a multi-platform game publisher encompassing PC and consoles, including PC, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation, and Xbox. The company has introduced over 300 diverse domestic and international titles across multiple platforms, such as Smilemo, Shikhondo: Blue Soulless, and Nightmare: The Lunatic. Going beyond mere distribution, CFK features an in-house development team capable of porting to various platforms and executing IP remakes. Princess Maker 2 Refine, Wonder Boy Returns Remix, and Koumajou Remilia: Scarlet Symphony are premier examples of famous original IPs successfully remade by the company

introduction_zh: 秉承“易于上手，难于精通”的理念，我们开发兼具成长型角色扮演游戏的魅力、便捷性和策略性的游戏。我们以传统的韩国“鬼怪”主题和高质量的二维艺术为基础，提出了一种独特的世界观，这在日本（我们的核心全球目标市场）获得了很高的吸引力评价。我们已使用我们专有的 BattleFlow 完成了优化，因此您可以随时随地畅玩游戏，不会出现延迟。
introduction_en: Based on the philosophy that "easy to learn, difficult to master," we have developed a game that combines the charm, convenience, and strategy of a growth-oriented role-playing game. Themed after traditional Korean Dokkaebi stories and utilizing high-quality 2D graphics to create a unique worldview, the game is receiving high acclaim and popularity in Japan, a key global market. We have optimized it using our proprietary BattleFlow technology, so you can enjoy the game without lag anytime, anywhere.

introduction_zh:
Guild Studio 是一家游戏开发工作室，目标是成为“黑暗奇幻游戏的大师”。该工作室成立于 2022 年初，最初是一个大学社团，其首个项目《Revelatio》在 Steam 的“新游戏和热门游戏（回合制策略游戏）”榜单中排名第一。
Guild Studio 正在开发《NAMMO》，这是一款东方佛教黑暗奇幻类魂游戏，并荣获 2024 年 GIGDC 大奖（韩国文化部长奖）。
introduction_en:
Guild Studio is a game development studio aiming to become the “Masters of Dark Fantasy.” Founded in early 2022 as a university club, the studio's first project, <Revelatio>, ranked #1 in Steam's New & Trending (Turn-Based Strategy).
Guild Studio is developing <NAMMO>, an Eastern Buddhist Dark Fantasy Soulslike and winner of the 2024 GIGDC Grand Prize (Minister of Culture Award).

<NAMMO> (In Development)
• Selected by KOCCA for the 2025 Multi-Year Game Content Production Support Program
• 2024 GIGDC University Grand Prize (Minister of Culture Award)

<Revelatio> (Released Oct 2024)
• Selected by SBA for the 2024 Game Content Customized Support Program
• Steam Rankings: #1 (Korea) & #2 (Global) in Turn-Based Strategy, #4 in Dark Fantasy

introduction_zh: Actionfit秉持“行动先于思考”的哲学。自2020年首款游戏面世，至2025年已实现累计下载超3千万、营收突破400亿韩元的飞速增长。我们曾与20多家韩国开发商合作并斩获全球佳绩，同时凭借自研成果证实了自身的研发实力。面对日益激烈的国际移动游戏市场，我们愿作为韩国发行商，用韩国游戏赢取更大的全球成功。
introduction_en: ACTIONFIT stands for "Action First," believing swift action trumps overthinking. Since 2020, we have grown rapidly, surpassing 30 million downloads and 40 billion KRW in revenue by 2025. Having partnered with over 20 Korean developers, we have proven our publishing, marketing, and in-house development prowess globally. We aim to compete and achieve greater success worldwide as a proud Korean publisher.

introduction_zh: DEVUNLIMIT 是一家运营AI驱动K-POP舞蹈平台SPARKY的娱乐科技企业。该平台利用智能手机摄像头分析并评定用户的舞步，为全球粉丝提供学习、分享及享受K-POP编舞的互动舞蹈体验。目前，公司正通过移动端应用、线下自助终端（Kiosk）和B2B内容解决方案，积极向亚洲及全球市场拓展。
introduction_en: DEVUNLIMIT is an enter-tech company operating SPARKY, an AI-powered K-POP dance platform. By utilizing smartphone cameras to analyze and score users' movements, it delivers an interactive experience where fans can learn, share, and enjoy K-POP choreography. The company is actively expanding its footprint across Asian and global markets through mobile apps, offline kiosks, and B2B content solutions.

introduction_zh:
《Horizon Walker》是一款回合制角色扮演游戏，拥有独特的世界观和精美的画面。

在满目疮痍的世界尽头，一位孤胆战士守护着最后的堡垒。这款奇幻动作角色扮演游戏完美融合了惊险刺激的动作场面和深邃的世界观。游戏讲述了幸存者们在激烈的战斗中，为了生存而与无尽的敌人周旋的故事。
introduction_en:
Horizon Walker is a turn-based RPG boasting a unique worldview and beautiful visuals.

Across the horizon of a devastated world, a lone warrior stands guard over the last stronghold. This fantasy action RPG perfectly blends thrilling action with a deep worldview. The game depicts the story of survivors struggling to stay alive against endless enemy attacks amidst fierce battles.

introduction_zh: Studio Brakio 是一家独立游戏开发工作室，共有 6 名成员，成立于 2024 年 5 月。我们不断迎接各种挑战，旨在通过高质量的系统确保游戏本身的乐趣，并通过引人入胜的故事和令人难忘的角色提供沉浸式的叙事体验。
introduction_en: Studio Brakio is an indie game development studio with a total of six members, established in May 2024. We are continuously undertaking diverse challenges with the goal of ensuring the fun of gameplay itself through high-quality systems, and providing an immersive narrative through a lingering story and memorable characters.

introduction_zh: Basakansoft是韩国首尔的移动游戏工作室，专注于制作反映现实的剧情向养成模拟游戏，代表作为《韩国考生模拟器》。公司以自主内容技术(Signature Content Tech)、沉浸式叙事(Lived-In Storytelling)和数据驱动增长(Data-Driven Growth)为核心价值，打破传统框架，提供身临其境的创新游戏体验。
introduction_en: Based in Seoul, Basakansoft is a mobile game studio creating reality-based, story-driven nurturing simulation games. Famous for "Korean Student Simulator," the studio breaks conventions with innovative gameplay and immersive narratives. Its growth is driven by three core values: Signature Content Tech for scalable worlds, Lived-In Storytelling for relatable experiences, and Data-Driven Growth for optimization.

introduction_zh: Clegames成立于2013年，是兼具RPG、SLG及放置类等中度游戏开发实力的专业手游厂商。凭借《SoulSeeker》、《Civilization War》及《Zombie Hunter D-Day》等全球运营经验，已累计吸引超3300万用户。目前，公司正以《热血江湖(Ruler of the Land)》IP打造的手游《热血江湖：火龙传》为契机，全力拓展亚洲市场。
introduction_en: Established in 2013, Clegames is a specialized mobile game developer with proven expertise in developing mid-core genres, including RPG, SLG, and idle games. Building on its global service experience with titles like 'Soul Seeker', 'Civilization War', and the 'Zombie Hunter D-Day' series, the company has secured a cumulative user base of over 33 million. Currently, Clegames is driving its expansion into the Asian market with 'Ruler of the Land: Fire Dragon', a mobile RPG based on the popular 'The Ruler of the Land' IP.

MiniGame focuses on providing user traffic management services for global traffic channels, including mobile device manufacturers, branded apps, smart hardware, telecom operators, and e-wallet platforms. It also offers mini-game developers worldwide a one-stop SDK integration and publishing service, enabling global omnichannel distribution.

Its self-operated platform, MiniGame.com, generates over 10 million daily PVs and hosts thousands of high-quality HTML5 mini-games. The platform covers users in more than 200 countries and regions, reaching hundreds of millions of users worldwide, and stands as one of the leading global premium mini-game platforms.
