introduction_zh: Hypertap 作为领先行业的专注深度事件移动效果广告平台，持续为游戏、社交、电商、金融及其他泛娱乐类垂直领域客户提供优质的用户新增和唤醒等全案效果广告推广服务。平台用户覆盖全球 100 多个国家和地区，尤其在欧美、俄罗斯、日韩、东南亚、中东、非洲等多区域有多个成功案例；合作客户产品超过10000个，每日实现超过亿次有效事件，致力为客户实现最优质ROI效果。
introduction_en:
Hypertap is a leading mobile performance advertising platform, driving high-quality user acquisition and re-engagement for gaming, social, e-commerce, utilities, and entertainment apps. Our data-driven campaigns maximize ROI, turning every ad impression into measurable results.

Reaching users in over 100 countries, from Europe and the Americas to Russia, Japan, South Korea, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, and Africa, we have partnered with 10,000+ products, delivering over 20 billion verified events daily.

With Hypertap, your campaigns don’t just run—they perform. Every click, every engagement, every conversion is optimized for success. Trusted by global brands, we turn strategy into growth and investment into impact.

Hypertap: Performance that scales. Results that matter.

name_zh: 北京顶当互动科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 北京顶当互动科技有限公司（TOPDANG）始创于2009年，是国家级高新技术企业、中关村高新企业、专精特新企业。十七年深耕移动流量增长、全域数字营销、智能广告技术赛道，是国内最早深耕iOS应用生态优化、Apple Ads官方授信、快手核心代理、火山大模型Agent合作的头部技术服务商，2025年重磅打造“芯智AI”GEO平台，具备深厚的行业壁垒与成熟的商业化落地经验。
introduction_en:
Founded in 2009, Beijing Topdang Interactive Technology Co., Ltd. (TOPDANG) is a National High-tech Enterprise, Zhongguancun High-tech Enterprise and Specialized, Refined, Distinctive and Innovative Enterprise.

Over the past 17 years, the company has focused on mobile traffic growth, omnichannel digital marketing and intelligent advertising technology. It is a leading technical service provider in China that was among the earliest practitioners in iOS application ecosystem optimization, holding official authorization for Apple Ads, acting as a core agent of Kuaishou, and cooperating with Volcano Engine Large Model Agent. In 2025, the company launched the high-profile Xinzhi AI GEO Platform, with solid industry moat and mature commercialization implementation experience.

introduction_zh: DukPay是专注新兴市场的跨境支付服务商，覆盖中亚、中东、东南亚、拉美及非洲等50余个核心市场，接入超200种本地支付方式。面向电商、游戏、SaaS、AI工具等企业，提供本地收单、全球代付、订阅支付、Virtual Account及定制支付解决方案。凭借对区域合规与支付习惯的深刻洞察，DukPay帮助出海企业降低接入成本，提升转化效率，实现全球业务的安全高效拓展。
introduction_en:
DukPay is a cross-border payment service provider focused on emerging markets, covering more than 50 key markets across Central Asia, the Middle East, Southeast Asia, Latin America, and Africa, with access to over 200 local payment methods.

It serves enterprises in sectors such as e-commerce, gaming, SaaS, and AI tools by providing local payment acceptance, global payout capabilities, subscription payment solutions, Virtual Accounts, and customized payment infrastructure. Leveraging deep expertise in regional compliance requirements and local payment behaviors, DukPay helps cross-border businesses reduce integration costs, improve conversion efficiency, and expand globally with secure and scalable payment operations.

name_zh: 源之宇宙（福建）科技创新有限公司
name_en: Source Universe (Fujian) Technology Innovation Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 源之宇宙（福建）科技创新有限公司2022年成立，总部位于于泉州，深耕数智技术融合文化创新领域。企业自研全球首个以文字生成可交互式程序与可交互式剧情的AI垂类模型工具，宙包AI。它依托多模态大模型贯通吃住行游购娱学全业态，通过宙包MaaS体系，为实景、虚拟及各类XR终端输出定制交互解决方案。覆盖文旅、商业、社交、游戏赛道，文字输入即可快速产出交互内容，打造新一代社交互动业态。
introduction_en:
Origin Universe (Fujian) Technology Innovation Co., Ltd., founded in 2022 and headquartered in Quanzhou, focuses on integrated innovation of digital intelligence technology and culture.
It has independently developed ZhouBao AI, the world’s leading vertical AI model that generates interactive programs and narratives via text prompts. Powered by multimodal large-model technology, ZhouBao AI empowers the full consumer industry chain. Through the ZhouBao MaaS system, it delivers customized interactive solutions for physical scenarios, virtual terminals and all XR devices. Serving cultural tourism, commerce, social networking and gaming sectors, the platform instantly generates complete interactive content to build next-generation social-interactive business ecosystems.

name_zh: 上海旺脉信息科技集团有限公司
name_en: Shanghai Wangmai Information Technology Group Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 上海旺脉信息科技集团有限公司是一家以技术驱动的全链路AI营销技术平台，为客户提供SDK开发者服务、用户运营增长、品效营销服务、AI技术解决方案等一站式服务。自研AI中台灵脉LinkMind为企业实现降本增效、安全合规风控与创意表达能力提升，在数智化转型升级各个环节实现全面增长。旺脉已累计合作伙伴1500+，包括诸多国内外品牌及知名互联网大厂企业，涵盖电商、游戏、文旅、漫剧、3C等众多领域。
introduction_en:
Wangmai Group is a technology-driven full-link AI marketing platform. We deliver one-stop services including SDK developer services, user operation and growth, brand & performance marketing, and AI technical solutions.
Our self-developed AI middle platform, LinkMind, helps enterprises cut costs, improve efficiency, strengthen compliance and risk control, and enhance creative capabilities. It drives comprehensive growth across all stages of digital and intelligent transformation.
Our partners come from a wide range of industries, such as e-commerce, gaming, cultural tourism, comics & dramas, and 3C.

introduction_zh:
Almedia 是一家总部位于德国柏林的全球化广告科技公司，专注于通过数据驱动与技术创新，重塑用户获取与广告转化模式，构建移动增长与变现的未来。

公司旗下旗舰平台 Freecash 通过创新的激励机制与智能推荐体系，连接全球超过 8,000 万用户与品牌及开发者，覆盖游戏、应用及问卷等多元互动场景。凭借卓越的业务增长表现，Almedia 入选《金融时报》FT1000 欧洲增长最快广告企业榜单。
introduction_en:
Berlin-based Almedia is engineering the future of user acquisition with data-driven rewards and recommendations. Its flagship platform, Freecash, has a community of over 70 million users engaging with games, apps, and surveys. 

Recognised by the Financial Times' FT1000 as the fastest-growing advertising company in Europe, Almedia works collaboratively to create custom rewarded campaigns which deliver measurable returns for the world's leading mobile game publishers and brands.

name_zh: ChinaJoy AGS 学院游戏展区
introduction_zh: ChinaJoy AGS学院游戏展区（ChinaJoy Academy Games Show）将亮相BTOB商务洽谈馆核心区域，吸引了来自国内外数十所高校的80个学生团队参展。展区设置学生作品展示、加速赋能、云电脑教育应用、企业与人才交流等功能区，集中展示学生自主开发的各类游戏作品、美术与IP设计作品及AI创新应用等，并开放试玩体验，全面呈现学生在开发、创意、技术等多维度的综合能力。
introduction_en: ChinaJoy Academy Games Show will debut in the core area of the BTOB Hall, drawing participation from 80 student teams representing dozens of universities at home and abroad. The exhibition zone features functional areas dedicated to student works display, acceleration and empowerment programs, cloud PC educational applications, as well as enterprise-talent exchange sessions. It showcases a full spectrum of student independently developed game titles, art and IP design creations, and innovative AI applications, with playable demos available to visitors. The booth comprehensively demonstrates students’ all-round capabilities spanning game development, creative design, technical expertise and more.

introduction_zh: PayShield Technology是一家专注为游戏、电商及数字娱乐行业提供欺诈防护和争议解决的科技公司，创始团队拥有30余年支付行业经验。通过长期与VISA和Mastercard深度合作，致力于为收单机构、支付服务商、电商平台和商户提供全面的风险缓解服务。公司总部位于澳大利亚，在中国香港、美国和瑞士等地设有办公室服务全球客户。
introduction_en: PayShield Technology is specializing in fraud prevention and dispute resolution for the gaming, ecommerce, and digital entertainment industries. Our founding team brings over 30 years of experience in the payments sector. Through long-standing and deep partnerships with VISA and Mastercard, we are committed to delivering comprehensive risk mitigation services to acquirers, payment service providers, ecommerce platforms, and merchants worldwide. Headquartered in Australia, we maintain offices in Hong Kong, the United States, and Switzerland to serve our global clients.

introduction_zh: PartnerBoost是五五科技（专注全球联盟营销超过15年）旗下联盟营销与红人营销一体化管理平台，专注服务品牌出海，对接海外推广媒体（红人、折扣网站、测评推荐媒体等），赋能亚马逊、沃尔玛及独立站卖家站外引流，按销售效果付费（佣金5-15%）。已服务安克、美的、石头、追觅、TCL、ULIKE等2500+中国出海品牌，以可控、可衡量的方式驱动销售增长与品牌成长。
introduction_en: PartnerBoost is an integrated management platform for affiliate marketing and influencer marketing under the umbrella of 55Haitao Group, a company with over 15 years of expertise in global affiliate marketing. Designed to support Chinese brands going global, PartnerBoost helps these brands connect with global publishers, including influencers, deal sites, and product review and recommendation platforms like CNET. It empowers Amazon, Walmart, and DTC sellers to drive off-site traffic, operating on a performance-based model (5–15% sales commission). Having served over 2,500 Chinese brands going global, including Anker, Midea, Roborock, Dreame, TCL, and ULIKE, PartnerBoost drives measurable and controllable sales growth and brand development for sellers.

introduction_zh: UseePay成立于2019年，总部位于香港，并在上海、深圳、新加坡、英国设有分支机构。公司专注为出海企业提供安全高效的全球在线支付与收款解决方案，覆盖独立站收单、外贸收付款、风控管理及货币汇兑等服务，广泛服务于跨境电商、航空旅游、数字娱乐、教育及软件等行业。UseePay严格遵循全球行业监管标准，持有PCI-DSS最高安全认证、香港MSO及美国MSB等支付牌照，保障客户资金安全与合规运营。
introduction_en: UseePay, founded in 2019 and headquartered in Hong Kong, delivers secure and efficient digital payment and collection solutions for global businesses going abroad. With offices in Shanghai, Shenzhen, Singapore, and the UK, the company offers a comprehensive suite of services including direct-to-consumer (DTC) acquiring, cross-border trade payments, risk management, and currency exchange. UseePay serves diverse industries such as e-commerce, travel and hospitality, digital entertainment, education, and software. Fully compliant with international regulatory standards, it holds PCI-DSS Level 1 certification, a Hong Kong MSO license, and a US MSB license, ensuring robust fund security and operational integrity for clients worldwide.

introduction_zh: Sandbox Ads 是一家总部坐落于中东的专业海外效果广告平台，核心业务覆盖亚太、中东、欧美等全球主流市场。我们聚焦数字营销赛道，为全球品牌方、移动广告主与开发者提供一站式360°全链路数字营销解决方案，全方位满足用户精准获客、流量高效变现、创意营销落地等核心需求。
introduction_en:
Sandbox ads is a secure platform to design a perfect mix for all the performance needs. We provide 360 degree digital marketing solutions for brands across Asia pacific, Middle east, US and Europe.
Primary focussed on user acquisitions, monetization and creative solutions for mobile advertisers and publishers around the world. Helping advertisers reach their ideal mobile audience and we help publishers to acquire new users and monetize their mobile app for maximum ROI.

introduction_zh:
以产业园区招商运营、文创项目投资孵化等为主营业务的综合性数字文化产业运营服务商。成功运营多个国家级、省级园区，打造国漫孵化基地、游戏电竞发展中心等专业孵化载体。
运营杭州大运河科创城产业项目，聚焦游戏、动漫、电竞等数字文化产业，打造中国文化智造新高地，诚邀进驻。正举办杭州余杭2026国际数字文化创新应用大赛，游戏、动漫、AI短剧三大赛道，百万奖金千万扶持，诚邀参赛13067821872（微信同号）
ADTiger虎视（HK 01163）是香港上市的全球智能营销引领者，与Google、Meta、Microsoft Advertising、TikTok、Taboola、Teads、Amazon DSP、TTD、Kwai、Bigo Ads、Snapchat、Pinterest、X等平台深度链接，打通海外效果、品牌广告、红人营销、真人拍摄、AIGC创意矩阵、AI技术应用、数字人直播、社媒运营等业务
introduction_en:
ADTiger (HK 01163) is a Hong Kong-listed global leader in intelligent digital marketing.
We maintain official partnerships with leading global ad ecosystems, including Google, Meta, Microsoft Advertising, TikTok, Taboola, Teads, Amazon DSP, The Trade Desk, Kwai, Bigo Ads, Snapchat, Pinterest, and X.
Our full-spectrum service ecosystem covers overseas performance and brand advertising, KOL/KOC influencer marketing, on-location video production, AIGC creative matrix, proprietary AI technology, digital human live streaming, overseas social media operations, and overseas account matrix management.

introduction_zh: Payssion成立于2013年1月15日，致力于为出海企业提供一站式全球本地支付解决方案，通过Payssion一个API可以快速接入全球300多种本地支付。覆盖欧洲、拉美、东南亚、中东、俄罗斯、日韩等100多个国家，包括订阅支付、网银转账、电子钱包、本地信用卡、扫码支付等。2015年5月，Payssion获得雷军顺为资本投资。
introduction_en: Payssion, founded on January 15, 2013, provides cross-border businesses with a one‑stop global local payment aggregation solution. Its single API gives merchants quick access to over 300 local payment methods across 100+ countries, covering Europe, Latin America, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Russia, Japan, and South Korea. Supported options include subscription billing, online bank transfers, e‑wallets, local credit cards, and QR code payments. In May 2015, Payssion secured investment from Lei Jun’s Shunwei Capital.

name_zh: 长沙麦籽互动科技有限公司
introduction_zh: Meta & TikTok 游戏 / APP 出海全域广告服务商，专注手游、移动应用、互动品牌全球买量增长。以“麦籽”喻微小流量深耕生长，坚持效果为先、合规创意、长期共赢，专注为游戏行业客户稳定获取优质付费用户，打造华中地区专业游戏效果广告服务商。团队以95、00后为主，扁平无层级，分为投放优化组、创意素材组两大核心业务线：投放岗深耕流量数据，创意岗专注游戏爆款广告内容产出
introduction_en: Meta & TikTok game/APP global advertising service provider, focusing on mobile games, apps, and interactive brands' worldwide user acquisition growth. We use 'MaiZi' (wheat seed) as a metaphor for cultivating tiny traffic into growth, sticking to performance-first, compliant creativity, and long-term win-win partnerships. We're dedicated to helping gaming clients reliably acquire high-quality paying users, building a professional game performance advertising service in Central China. Our team mainly consists of post-95s and post-00s, with a flat structure, divided into two core business lines: ad optimization, which digs deep into traffic data, and creative production, which focuses on generating hit game ad content.

name_zh: 神策网络科技（北京）有限公司
introduction_zh: 神策数据（Sensors Data），全称神策网络科技（北京）有限公司，是国内专业的数据驱动业务增长解决方案提供商、国家高新技术企业。公司长期深耕大数据分析、营销科技与人工智能应用领域，致力于帮助企业将数据能力转化为持续、可衡量的业务增长能力。
introduction_en: Sensors Data, officially known as Sensors Data Co., Ltd., is a professional data-driven business growth solutions provider in China and a National High-Tech Enterprise. With long-standing expertise in big data analytics, marketing technology, and AI applications, Sensors Data is committed to helping enterprises transform data capabilities into sustainable and measurable business growth.

introduction_zh: The leading multi-source advertising platform with 1.5B+ global audience to reach new users and grow your business.We provide smart user acquisition solutions for media agencies, brands, & affiliates.
introduction_en:
全球领先的多源广告平台，覆盖全球15亿+用户。
为媒体代理商、品牌广告主和联盟伙伴提供智能获客解决方案，助力高效增长

introduction_zh: 虹口区位于上海中心城区北部，地处苏州河与黄浦江交汇处，是海派文化发祥地、先进文化策源地和文化名人聚集地。全区拥有北外滩滨江黄金水岸，可近观陆家嘴全景与浦江落日；保留多伦路、山阴路、今潮8弄等百年历史风貌街区；集聚中共四大纪念馆、左联会址纪念馆等红色地标；1933老场坊、上海邮政博物馆等特色场馆展现城市记忆。虹口近年着力推动“文商旅体展”深度融合，为市民游客提供深度海派文化体验。
introduction_en: Located in the northern part of Shanghai's central urban area, Hongkou District sits at the confluence of Suzhou Creek and the Huangpu River. It is recognized as the birthplace of Shanghai-style culture, a cradle of progressive culture, and a gathering place for cultural luminaries.In recent years, Hongkou has been actively promoting the deep integration of culture, commerce, sports, tourism, and exhibitions, offering both residents and visitors an immersive experience of authentic Shanghai-style culture.

name_zh: 锐科威尔网络科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
✓ ReklamUp 是全球领先的 Google 认证发布商合作伙伴（GCPP），在广告变现表现和运营卓越性方面拥有成熟的成功经验。
✓ ReklamUp 受到全球 500 家顶级发布商的长期信赖，覆盖超过 10,000 款应用，并帮助合作伙伴实现可衡量的业绩提升。
introduction_en:
✓ The leading Google Certified Publishing Partner (GCPP) globally, backed by a proven track record in performance and operational excellence.
✓ Trusted long-term partner of 500 top-tier publishers globally showcasing measurable performance gains over 10.000 apps.

introduction_zh: OPS专注于为应用开发者、IoT设备商及CTV合作伙伴提供广告之外的新增收益方案。通过轻量化接入，在不增加广告位、不展示额外广告、尽量不影响用户体验的前提下，帮助合作伙伴激活现有用户规模价值，拓展新的收益增长空间。方案可与广告、订阅及内购模式并行，适用于具备稳定活跃用户基础的App及智能终端产品。
introduction_en: OPS provides revenue solutions beyond traditional advertising for app developers, IoT device makers, and CTV partners. Through lightweight integration, Moonfox helps partners unlock more value from their existing user base without adding ad slots, showing extra ads, or materially affecting user experience. The solution works alongside current monetization models such as advertising, subscriptions, and in-app purchases, making it suitable for apps, platforms, and smart devices with stable active users. Moonfox enables partners to expand revenue opportunities, improve monetization efficiency, and create sustainable growth from their existing user base. It is designed to support long-term monetization growth.

introduction_zh: Appinflux是一家以程序化广告技术为核心的全球数字营销平台，专注为广告主和开发者提供高效透明的流量获取与变现方案。公司构建了覆盖DSP、ADX和SSP的全栈式程序化生态，实现广告需求与媒体流量的智能匹配。平台支持CPI、CPA、CPL等多种效果结算，覆盖全球多区域市场，助力应用规模化用户增长。同时，平台兼容多种广告形态，灵活适配不同场景，帮助客户在全球移动生态中持续提升投放效率与商业收益。
introduction_en: Appinflux is a programmatic advertising platform enabling efficient, transparent traffic acquisition and monetization for advertisers and developers worldwide. It operates a full-stack ecosystem integrating DSP, ADX, and SSP, intelligently matching ad demand with publisher inventory. Supporting CPI, CPA, and CPL models, Appinflux helps apps scale user acquisition across global markets. It offers open API and seamless integration with leading MMPs like AppsFlyer and Adjust, ensuring full-funnel attribution and automated campaign optimization. The platform supports Display, Native, Video, and Push formats, adapting to diverse scenarios. Committed to transparency and data privacy, Appinflux empowers partners to turn fragmented traffic into sustainable growth.

introduction_zh: 无
introduction_en: Minoads is a premier global marketing platform dedicated to maximizing revenue and enhancing advertising efficiency for businesses worldwide. Operating at the intersection of technology, information, and networking, we leverage cutting-edge data and innovative marketing solutions to optimize ad performance and drive sustainable growth. Whether empowering developers to monetize effectively or helping brands reach their target audiences seamlessly, Minoads is committed to delivering exceptional marketing outcomes in an ever-evolving digital landscape.

name_zh: 顺峰互动（山东）网络有限公司
introduction_zh: 顺峰互动旗下品牌 SooFun，是深耕企业级服务的创新游戏公司。团队成员均来自一线游戏与社交领域，可为企业提供专业高效、可定制的社交互动游戏技术方案及全流程服务。公司以成为客户信赖的技术与创意伙伴为使命，依托游戏化能力助力企业获客、传扬价值、实现增长。
introduction_en: As the brand of Shunfeng Interactive, SooFun is an innovative gaming company focused on enterprise-level services. Staffed with professionals from top-tier gaming and social industries, we provide professional, efficient and customizable technical solutions and full-cycle services for social interactive games. Committed to being clients’ trusted technical and creative partner, SooFun leverages gamification capabilities to help enterprises acquire users, deliver brand value and drive business growth.

name_zh: 香港大牛科技有限公司
name_en: HONG KONG DANIU TECHNOLOGY CO., LIMITED
introduction_zh: 香港大牛科技是 AI 驱动的全球广告资源整合平台，提供广告账号、VCC 支付、撮合平台，自研系统稳定高效，全球布局，高速增长，目标 IPO。
introduction_en: Hong Kong Daniu Technology is an AI-driven global advertising resource integration platform offering advertising accounts, VCC payment solutions, and a matching marketplace. With a stable, high-efficiency proprietary system and a global footprint, the company is experiencing rapid growth and aiming for an IPO.

introduction_zh: 公司成立于2019年，业务以毛绒潮玩周边为核心，已建立起IP定制、产品开发、产供全链、全域营销产研销三位一体的运营团队｡拥有丰富的实战经验，公司自研娃体100+，累计开发系列周边款式3000+、运营品牌累计销量100w+、二次元设计师资源100+、配备7000 ㎡生产基地，500人专业生产团队，月产可达30w件以上，为客户提供全域运营+一站式综合服务。
introduction_en: Founded in 2019, the company focuses on plush trendy toy merchandise and has established an integrated operations team covering IP customization, product development, full supply chain management, and comprehensive marketing. With extensive hands-on experience, the company has independently developed over 100 doll models, launched more than 3,000 series of peripheral products, achieved cumulative sales exceeding 1 million units across its brands, and built a network of over 100 anime designers. Equipped with a 7,000-square-meter production base and a professional manufacturing team of 500 people, it can produce over 300,000 units per month, offering clients end-to-end operational support and one-stop comprehensive services.

introduction_zh: 索尼公司（Sony Corporation）是全球领先的科技与娱乐企业，总部位于东京。自1946年成立以来，索尼始终以创新为核心，业务涵盖电子产品、游戏、影视、音乐及金融等多个领域。其标志性产品包括PlayStation游戏机、BRAVIA电视、Alpha相机以及Walkman高解析度音频播放器等。索尼还拥有索尼影视娱乐（SPE）和索尼音乐集团（SME），为全球观众提供优质娱乐内容。
introduction_en: Sony Corporation, headquartered in Tokyo, is a globally leading technology and entertainment enterprise. Since its establishment in 1946, Sony has always prioritized innovation, with its business spanning multiple domains including electronics, gaming, film and television, music, and finance. Its iconic products include the PlayStation game console, BRAVIA televisions, Alpha cameras, and Walkman high-resolution audio players. Additionally, Sony boasts Sony Pictures Entertainment (SPE) and Sony Music Entertainment (SME), providing premium entertainment content to audiences worldwide.

introduction_zh: 游戏日报是中国国内领先的游戏产业媒体（B2B Media） 我们始终以“成为全球游戏行业最具影响力的价值连接者”为核心定位，链接全球游戏企业、从业者与资源方，构建产业网络。游戏日报粉丝超 470 万，核心用户覆盖90% 以上国内游戏核心中高层从业者，服务腾讯、米哈游、微软、Google 等海内外客户，积极发挥媒体优势链接全球游戏市场，助力中国游戏公司走出去，也积极服务想进入中国游戏市场的海外企业
introduction_en: GameDaily is a leading B2B media outlet for the domestic gaming industry in China. With the core positioning of 'becoming the most influential value connector in the global gaming industry,' we link gaming enterprises, practitioners, and resource parties worldwide to build an industrial network. GameDaily has over 4.7 million followers, with core users covering more than 90% of domestic gaming core mid-to-high-level practitioners. We serve clients both at home and abroad, such as Tencent, miHoYo, Microsoft, and Google, actively leveraging our media advantages to connect the global gaming market, helping Chinese gaming companies go global, and also actively serving overseas enterprises that want to enter the Chinese gaming market.

introduction_zh: Bees Group 总部位于美国休斯顿，致力于为全球客户提供稳定的谷歌、Meta、Kwai、TikTok 等海内外广告账户，以及美国多卡头、带返点的虚拟信用卡服务。我们支持广告付费、AI 订阅、海外消费等多种场景，多卡段覆盖，支付稳定可靠，助力企业实现全场景便捷支付。
introduction_en: Bees Group, headquartered in Houston, USA, provides stable advertising accounts for Google, Meta, Kwai, TikTok, and other domestic and international platforms, as well as US multi‑BIN virtual credit cards with rebates. We support diverse use cases including ad payments, AI subscriptions, and overseas spending. With extensive card coverage and reliable payment processing, we help businesses achieve seamless payments across all scenarios.

introduction_zh: Indixital 是一家全球绩效营销机构，与 100 多家广告商合作，并与 1,000 多家发布商建立了合作关系。我们专注于将发布商直接连接到全球优质offer，无需中间商，提供高额、快速且可靠的佣金结算。受到全球发布商的信赖，Indixital 致力于推动应用程序和网络资产在各大主要市场的流量增长与变现。
introduction_en: indixital is a global performance marketing agency working with 100+ advertisers and partnered with 1,000+ publishers. We specialise in connecting publishers to direct global offers without intermediaries, delivering high, fast, and reliable payouts. Trusted by publishers worldwide, indixital drives traffic growth and monetisation for apps and web properties across every major market.

introduction_zh: 15年以上的 AdTech（广告 Advertising Technology）行业深耕经验。我们提供极具公信力的代理商账户，以及基于您的特定数据训练的独家 AI 反欺诈系统。为您提供最先进的流量保护，无缝接入全球广告平台。市场上绝无仅有的创新解决方案！
introduction_en: 15+ years of AdTech expertise. We provide trusted agency accounts and a unique AI Antifraud system trained on your specific data. Advanced traffic protection and seamless access to global ad platforms with no market analogs!

name_zh: 澎贝数科（深圳）有限公司
introduction_zh: PalmPay 是聚焦新兴市场的全球金融科技平台，专注为出海企业提供安全合规的一站式跨境支付与资金管理解决方案。我们依托覆盖非洲、南亚的本地化支付网络与金融基础设施，提供线上收单、本地收款、虚拟账户、外汇结算及电子钱包等服务，已服务超 5500 万个人用户与 150 万家企业，助力企业实现资金高效归集与合规跨境流转。
introduction_en:
Leveraging its localized financial infrastructure across Africa and South Asia, PalmPay provides a full-stack payment solution including merchant acquiring, local collection, virtual accounts, FX settlement, and digital wallets.
Today, PalmPay serves over 55 million users and 1.5 million businesses, helping global enterprises and digital economy partners move money efficiently, securely, and at scale.

name_zh: VIET LONG GAME PLAY JOINT STOCK COMPANY
introduction_zh: VLG PLAY JSC是一家专注中国游戏出海越南的游戏发行公司。团队拥有中越两地丰富游戏行业经验，提供越南游戏发行、本地化、市场推广、支付渠道、直播CPS等服务。依托自主发行平台 VLPLAY，帮助优质游戏产品快速进入越南市场并实现长期稳定运营，致力成为中国游戏厂商值得信赖的越南发行合作伙伴。
introduction_en: VLG PLAY JSC is a Vietnam-based game publishing company focused on helping Chinese game companies expand into the Vietnamese market. With experienced teams from both China and Vietnam, VLG provides comprehensive services including Vietnam game publishing, localization, marketing promotion, local payment solutions, livestream CPS cooperation and community operation. Through our self-operated platform VLPLAY, we help high-quality games enter Vietnam efficiently and achieve long-term sustainable growth, becoming a trusted publishing partner for Chinese game developers in Vietnam.

introduction_zh: 巴西游戏展（BGS）是美洲规模最大的游戏展会，每年吸引超过30万名观众，汇聚游戏开发商、发行商、品牌、内容创作者以及广大游戏爱好者。
introduction_en: Brasil Game Show (BGS) is the largest gaming event in the Americas, attracting over 300,000 visitors annually and connecting game developers, publishers, brands, content creators, and the gaming community.

introduction_zh: 台北电玩展（Taipei Game Show）自2003年开办至今逾20年，每年超过40万人次进场、汇聚43个国家地区逾2,100位商务参观者到场交流，已成为亚太游戏市场最重要的交流平台，展览包含三大展区：B2B商务区、B2C玩家区及亚太游戏高峰会，「2027台北电玩展」将于1月21日至1月24日在南港展览馆盛大举行，目前开放展区摊位申请和赞助商招募，邀请产业各界共襄盛举。
introduction_en:
As a premier gateway to the Asia-Pacific game market, TAIPEI GAME SHOW has established itself as one of Asia's leading game exhibitions. Since its debut in 2003, the event has become a hub for the global games industry.

The event features three core sections: the Asia Pacific Game Summit (APGS), the B2B Zone, and the B2C Zone, bringing together game developers, publishers, service providers, media, and players from around the world.
In 2026, Taipei Game Show welcomed more than 400,000 visits and over 2,100 industry professionals from 43 countries and regions, further reinforcing its position as one of Asia's most influential game industry events.

Taipei Game Show 2027 will take place from January 21–24, 2027, at TaiNEX 1. Booth and sponsorship applications are now open.

introduction_zh: Payplus成立于2023年，总部设于中国香港，聚焦游戏、短剧、AI等数娱赛道，是面向出海企业，提供收单、代付、风控合规一体化基础设施服务商。平台搭建支付+数据双驱动增长体系，支持API、收银台、SDK快速对接。平台支持多币种结算，提供7*24小时运维服务，持有MSO牌照，PCI DSS权威认证，完备落地KYB/KYC、AML风控筛查、全流程交易监控，全方位保障出海业务支付合规与资金安全。
introduction_en: 无

introduction_zh: Spectrum Digital 是一家效果营销公司，致力于通过智能数字广告解决方案，帮助品牌和企业实现切实且可衡量的增长。我们专注于效果营销、移动营销、品牌推广、原生广告及社交媒体营销活动，旨在精准触达目标受众。我们开展的每一项营销活动均根据业务目标量身定制，以确保实现最佳成效与效率。
introduction_en: At Spectrum Digital, we believe every brand has the potential to make a lasting impact. As a dynamic digital media company, we help businesses amplify their reach through innovative advertising strategies, trusted partnerships. Our mission is to connect brands with opportunities that drive visibility, engagement, and sustainable success, empowering them to thrive in an ever-evolving digital landscape.

name_zh: 熊猫支付科技有限公司
introduction_zh: PandaPay是一家专注于新兴市场的全球聚合支付科技平台，致力于为电商、游戏、社交娱乐及金融科技企业提供本地收单与跨境支付解决方案。通过统一API接口，连接全球300+本地支付方式，覆盖拉丁美洲、中东、中亚、东南亚及非洲等多个市场，帮助企业快速进入新兴海外市场，实现安全、高效、合规的全球资金流转
introduction_en: PandaPay is a global payment technology platform focused on emerging markets, providing localized payment acquiring and cross-border payment solutions for e-commerce, gaming, social entertainment, and fintech businesses. Through a unified API integration, PandaPay connects merchants to over 300 local payment methods worldwide, covering Latin America, the Middle East, Central Asia, Southeast Asia, and Africa. We help businesses expand into emerging markets quickly while enabling secure, efficient, and compliant global payment operations.

introduction_zh: Combos是面向所有人的游戏创作平台——从独立创作者、工作室，到希望拥抱游戏力量的企业。只要描述你的想法，Combos即与你共创：美术、角色、音效与玩法。任何人都可以做出游戏。零代码，不设边界，你只管尽情释放创意，创作快乐。支持游戏概念原型验证、互动内容生产与社区共创。作为Converge AI一体化AI原生生态系统中的游戏创作能力，它与多种智能体产品互联协同，加速企业AI转型。
introduction_en:
Combos by Converge AI is a game creation platform for everyone: solo creators, indie studios, and enterprises ready to embrace the power of play. Describe what you want, and Combos builds it with you: art, characters, sound, and gameplay, all in minutes. No code. No limits. Just games. Unleash Creativity. Create Joy. 

For teams and brands, Combos can support game concept prototyping, interactive content production, audience engagement campaigns, and community co-creation. As the gaming creation capability within Converge AI's connected AI-native ecosystem, Combos is integrated alongside other agent-powered product capabilities. Converge AI helps enterprises accelerate AI transformation and automate workflows through specialized AI agents, shared context, and connected assets.

name_zh: 成都旭星佳程广告有限公司
introduction_zh: STARROAD是一家专注于游戏互动营销的传播公司，常年服务全球排名前十的游戏品牌，作为网易，米哈游，Tik Tok，Steam等国际一线游戏大厂/平台的长期合作伙伴，与顶级客户共创营销解决方案，帮助游戏实现内容营销的IP价值最大化，助力长效品牌资产的积累。
introduction_en: STARROAD is a communication agency specializing in interactive marketing for games, serving the world's top ten game brands year-round. As a long-term partner of internationally leading game companies and platforms such as NetEase, miHoYo, TikTok, and Steam, it collaborates with top-tier clients to create marketing solutions, helping games maximize the IP value of content marketing and facilitating the accumulation of long-term brand equity.

introduction_zh: AniShort AI 短剧协作平台，以 "为 AI 短剧协作而生" 为使命，平台核心优势多画布节点式多人协同工作流，图片视频批量打组一键输出，主体风格全程统一，数字资产可跨画布一键调用，爆款经验可复利沉淀，3D世界+3D导演台固定主体，零排队满血主流热门大模型自由切换，在线审片安心交付，精细化团队管理与智能体全程辅助，为AI 短剧工业化生产首选平台。
introduction_en: AniShort — AI Short-Drama Collaboration Platform，Mission-driven to be "Built for AI short drama collaboration" ，AniShort offers a multi-canvas, node-based workflow for seamless real-time teamwork, with batch grouping and one-click export of images and videos, consistent subject styling throughout the pipeline, one-click cross-canvas digital asset access, and replication of proven viral best practices. A 3D world environment with a 3D director's console ensures stable subject control, while zero-queue full-capacity switching among all major mainstream AI models, online review tools for worry-free delivery, and granular team management with AI agents providing end-to-end assistance make AniShort the go-to platform for industrialized, high-efficiency AI short-drama production at scale.

name_zh: PG传媒解决方案自由区有限责任公司
introduction_zh: Purple Gecko（PG Media Solutions L.L.C-FZ）是一家总部位于迪拜的绩效营销媒体采买公司，直连品牌广告主与优质流量，以Affiliate/CPA模式运营直签Offer。依托自研技术与实时优化，数据透明、结算准时。现诚邀中国优质流量渠道合作，对接独家直签Offer，携手共赢。
introduction_en: Purple Gecko (PG Media Solutions L.L.C-FZ) is a Dubai-based performance media buying house connecting direct brands with high-quality traffic worldwide. We run affiliate and CPA campaigns on our own direct offers — no reselling, no hidden layers — backed by proprietary technology, real-time optimization, and fully transparent performance data. Our team brings deep experience from adtech, global media platforms, and top performance agencies, engineering campaigns to hit CPI, CPA, and ROAS goals across user acquisition, retargeting, and direct response. We are actively expanding our publisher network and welcome quality traffic sources from Chinese publishers: direct access to exclusive offers, reliable tracking, on-time payouts, and dedicated support.

introduction_zh: Animotion Media Group 是一家国际传媒公司，专注于为儿童、青少年及家庭打造高品质教育娱乐内容。旗下品牌包括《螺丝钉》《缇娜托尼》《瑞奇宝宝》《瑞奇小恐龙》《平博士密码》和 Finnick，覆盖动画、电影、音乐、出版、数字内容、授权及现场娱乐。《螺丝钉》已在150多个国家播出，并登陆中国CCTV、腾讯视频、优酷、爱奇艺等平台。
introduction_en: Animotion Media Group is an international media company creating high-quality content for children, young audiences and families. Its portfolio includes global brands such as The Fixies, Tina & Tony, BabyRiki, DinoCity, Beardy Bodo, PinCode, Finnick and others. The company develops animated series, feature films, music, publishing, digital content, consumer products and live entertainment, building long-lasting IPs that combine education and entertainment. Its flagship STEM brand The Fixies has been translated into multiple languages and broadcast in 150+ countries, including China via CCTV, Tencent Video, Youku and iQIYI. Animotion welcomes partnerships with broadcasters, streamers, publishers, educators, music, licensing and live entertainment partners in China.

name_zh: 上海沄骐科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 沄骐科技Miracle Cloud聚焦内容分发平台、云安全和云计算领域，是Fastly中国总代。依靠Fastly的578Tbps全球边缘网络容量，32%更快首字节响应时间，为出海企业提高业务效率和用户体验。其技术团队长期服务于腾讯、网易、快手等海内外知名企业。提供定制化方案、本地化7×24×365多渠道技术支持、专业诚信服务体系；覆盖网络架构咨询、部署优化、专属培训、SLA运维保障等全流程服务。
introduction_en: Miracle Cloud specializes in content delivery platforms, cloud security and cloud computing, it’s the Major Partner of Fastly in China. Leveraging Fastly’s global 578 Tbps edge network capacity and up to 32% faster time to first byte (TTFB) than other CDN, we are empowers Go-to-global enterprises to improve operational performance and helps you deliver the dynamic experiences today’s users demand. Our technical team has provided services to Tencent, NetEase, Kuaishou and etc. Miracle Cloud delivers customized solutions, localized and 24/7/365 multi-channel technical support, professional and integrity-driven service system. We will provide end-to-end services, including network architecture consultation, deployment optimization, exclusive training, SLA maintenance guarantees and etc.

name_zh: 路人互动传媒有限公司
introduction_zh: 路人互动传媒有限公司专注数字广告运营与管理服务，覆盖 Meta、TikTok、Google 等主流广告平台，深耕游戏、应用、电商、短剧及品牌等出海赛道。公司基于自研的 IceBear System 广告管理系统及 Ads Check 浏览器插件，提供多账户统一管理、投放数据追踪与团队协同能力，切实帮助企业提升跨平台广告运营效率、降低多账户运营成本，让全球广告投放更透明、更协同。
introduction_en:
PASSERBY FUN MEDIA LIMITED is a global digital advertising operations and management provider across Meta, TikTok, and Google, serving gaming, apps, e-commerce, short-form drama, and brand advertisers worldwide.

Powered by our proprietary IceBear System and Ads Check browser extension, we provide unified multi-account management, campaign tracking, and seamless team collaboration, helping advertisers improve cross-platform efficiency and transparency while reducing the operational cost of managing multiple ad accounts.

introduction_zh:
AdsTower 是一家AI驱动的全球广告增长与流量变现平台，依托自研DSP技术、全球媒体资源及智能投放算法，为广告主、开发者和品牌提供一站式数字营销解决方案。
平台覆盖100多个国家和地区，整合开发者流量及全球优质媒体资源，支持品牌推广、用户获取、效果营销及流量变现等多元化业务。AdsTower 致力于以数据、技术和AI能力赋能全球增长，帮助合作伙伴实现高效投放、精准获客和持续商业价值提升。
introduction_en: AdsTower is an AI-powered global advertising, user acquisition, and monetization platform dedicated to helping brands,advertisers, and developers achieve sustainable business growth. Powered by its proprietary DSPtechnology,AI-driven optimization engine, and premium global media resources, AdsTower delivers end-to-end solutions for performance marketing, brand promotion,and traffic monetization. The platform reaches over100countries and regions,integrates developer traffic resources,and supports industries including gaming,utilities, e-commerce, finance,and digital applications. By combining intelligent algorithms, transparent delivery, and data-driven insights, AdsTower enables partners to maximize campaign performance, acquire high-value users, and scale efficiently in global markets.

introduction_zh:
FairGuard游戏加固，业界领先的游戏安全服务商。公司自主研发多项独家技术，致力于帮助游戏公司解决外挂和破解问题，为游戏提供深度一体化的加密保护方案。
FairGuard技术团队拥有十余年游戏安全对抗经验，自主研发多项业界独家技术。目前，产品已被FunPlus、三七互娱、游族、心动网络、恺英网络等多家头部游戏公司采用，接入600+款热门游戏。
introduction_en:
FairGuard is a leading game security service provider. Our company has independently developed a variety of proprietary technologies dedicated to helping game companies solve issues related to cheats and piracy, offering in-depth integrated encryption protection solutions for games.

FairGuard technical team has more than ten years of experience in game security confrontation and has independently developed a range of exclusive technologies in the industry. Currently, the product has been adopted by several top game companies such as FunPlus, 37 Interactive Entertainment, YOOZOO GAMES, X.D. Network, and Kingnet Network, integrating into more than 600 popular games.

introduction_zh: Adsplay International 是一家数据驱动的 360 度数字营销领导者，专注于移动客户获取和货币化。我们拥有超过 2,500 个直接客户，是全球最好的移动营销机构，为世界领先品牌提供优质、量身定制的解决方案。让客户在全球范围内高效获取用户提升品牌知名度，以实现更好的投资回报率是我们的使命。
introduction_en: Adsplay International is a data-driven leader in 360-degree digital marketing, specializing in mobile user acquisition and monetization. With a portfolio of over 2,500 direct clients, we are a premier global mobile marketing agency delivering high-quality, tailored solutions to the world's leading brands. Our mission is to enable clients to efficiently acquire users and boost brand awareness on a global scale, ultimately driving superior return on investment.

introduction_zh: Side（前身为PTW）是一家全球领先的游戏开发与服务提供商，30年来，为许多世界知名的开发商和工作室提供技术与创意解决方案。Side从日本起步，如今在全球拥有超过20间工作室，足迹遍布北美、欧洲、南美以及亚洲。其行业领先的服务范围涵盖游戏开发、美术制作、音频制作、游戏测试（QA）、本地化、本地化测试、玩家支持、社群管理以及数据收集。欲了解更多信息，请访问www.side.inc
introduction_en: Side (formerly PTW) is a global video game development and services provider, offering technical and creative solutions to many of the largest developers and studios around the world. Founded in 2009, Side has grown from their Japanese roots to become a global force in the video games industry, with 20+ studios in over a dozen countries across North America, Europe, South America, and Asia. Their industry-leading services include game development, art production, audio production, quality assurance, localization, localization QA, player support, community management, and datasets. For more information, visit www.side.inc.

name_zh: 捷并思（上海）信息技术有限责任公司
introduction_zh: 在 JetBrains，我们致力于通过智能工具帮助开发者提升工作效率，让工具既能简化棘手的任务，又能自动化处理日常工作。比如 Rider，一款颠覆行业的跨平台集成开发环境（IDE）；用于持续集成/持续交付（CI/CD）和部署的 TeamCity 以及用于问题跟踪和项目管理的强大工具YouTrack。与我们在 ChinaJoy 相见吧，共同见证工具与技术如何助您打造卓越的游戏！
introduction_en:
At JetBrains, we have a passion for making developers more productive with our intelligent tools that simplify challenging tasks and automate routine ones. Among our many products you will find Rider, a game-changing cross-platform IDE; TeamCity for CI/CD and deployment; and YouTrack for issue tracking and project management.
Come to our booth to learn about JetBrains tools and technologies that can help you create cutting-edge games, and check out the offers JetBrains provides for startups, students and teachers, and the developer community.

introduction_zh: Digirovers全球移动营销服务商。依托自研Wondrous DSP平台及16亿画像DMP，深耕多渠道程序化广告与效果获客，助力全球消费科技及数字品牌高效出海，最大化LTV。
introduction_en: Digirovers is a leading global tech-marketing and performance agency specialized in high-growth user acquisition (UA) and ROI-driven marketing for mobile-first brands. Operating out of key hubs in India and Singapore, Digirovers bridges the gap between ambitious digital enterprises and global audiences. The company's growth ecosystem is anchored by Wondrous, its proprietary in-house Demand-Side Platform (DSP), which integrates seamlessly with an advanced Data Management Platform (DMP) leveraging 1.6 billion connected audience profiles. By combining Wondrous's programmatic capabilities with deep cross-channel networks, Digirovers delivers data-driven creativity, advanced targeting, and localized campaigns that maximize customer lifetime value (LTV) across Tier 1, 2, and 3 global markets.

name_zh: 北京小旭音乐文化有限责任公司
introduction_zh: 小旭音乐由卢小旭 2006 年创立，总部北京，在广州、成都设分部，是国内知名游戏音频与 AI 音视频创意品牌。深耕游戏音乐、音效、配音全案制作，代表作含《古剑奇谭》《诛仙》《QQ 斗地主》《仙剑奇侠传七》等上千部作品。近年布局 AI 音视频，旗下 “小旭 AI-Studio” 打造爆款内容，获官媒转发，兼具行业口碑与创新影响力。
introduction_en:
Founded by Lu Xiaoxu in 2006, Xiaoxu Music is headquartered in Beijing with branches in Guangzhou and Chengdu. It is a well-known domestic brand specializing in game audio and AI audio-video creation.
It focuses on full-scale production of game music, sound effects and dubbing, having created thousands of classic works including GuJian QiTan, ZhuXian and Chinese Paladin 7. In recent years, it has expanded into AI audio and video fields. Its self-developed AI creation platform has produced numerous popular works, earning widespread recognition and positive influence across the industry.

name_zh: 东莞市精锋智能玻璃有限公司
name_en: Dongguan JimFuk Smart Glass Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 东莞市精锋智能玻璃有限公司成立于2012年，是一家集研发、生产、销售于一体的OEM企业。拥有14年行业经验，专注于高端定制玻璃鼠标垫，产品技术领先全球，远销欧美、东南亚等市场。公司具备切割、蚀刻、磨边、抛光、钢化、UV印刷等完整生产工艺链，自主蚀刻线支持灵活参数调节。严格执行ISO9001:2015质量管理体系，真诚服务每一位客户。期待与您合作共赢！
introduction_en: Dongguan JimFuk Smart Glass Co., Ltd., established in 2012, is an OEM enterprise integrating R&D, production, and sales. With 14 years of experience, we focus on high-end custom glass mouse pads, with leading technology exported to Europe, the Americas, and Southeast Asia. We have a complete production chain: cutting, etching, edging, polishing, tempering, and UV printing, plus our own etching line for flexible adjustments. Strictly ISO9001:2015 certified. Precision processing, sincere service. Looking forward to win-win cooperation!

name_zh: 广州光盒动力文化传播有限公司
introduction_zh: 光盒动力是国内AI短剧工业化创作与全球发行机构，TikTok官方短剧服务商。公司自研AIGC平台燃梦谷DreamonFun，依托标准化SOP，月产AI短剧超万分钟，累计出品逾千部。总部设立于广州，于美国、中国香港设有分支，提供欧美、日本、中东等地本土承制、全球发行及达人营销服务。曾获TikTok年度优秀承制商及国际短剧节最佳悬疑叙事奖，并通过广告、电商、IP衍生等多元模式持续放大短剧价值。
introduction_en: LightHubPower is a China-based AI short-drama production and global distribution company and an official TikTok short-drama service provider. It developed the AIGC platform DreamonFun, powered by standardized SOPs, producing over 10,000 minutes of AI short dramas per month and over 1,000 titles in total. Headquartered in Guangzhou with branches in the U.S. and Hong Kong, it provides localized production, global distribution, and influencer marketing services across Europe, the U.S., Japan, and the Middle East. The company has received the TikTok Annual Outstanding Producer award and Best Suspense Narrative Award, and expands value through advertising, e-commerce, and IP derivatives.

name_zh: 睿思飞（上海）信息科技有限责任公司
introduction_zh: Riskified 作为全球智能风控与营收增长的战略伙伴，以前沿 AI 重构数字信任生态。赋能游戏与数字娱乐产业突破欺诈边界，实现安全与体验的卓越平衡。通过毫秒级智能决策与全额赔付保障，助力企业释放全球营收潜力，驱动高质量增长。在元宇宙与数字消费新浪潮中，Riskified 以可信技术基石，护航每一次创新交易，共筑繁荣数字未来。
introduction_en: Riskified is a global AI-powered fraud prevention and revenue optimization platform for gaming and digital entertainment. Using advanced machine learning, we approve more legitimate transactions while blocking fraud—with financial guarantees on every approved order. At ChinaJoy, Riskified helps publishers scale cross-border, protect players, and drive growth. Trusted by industry leaders, we transform risk into a strategic advantage, enabling secure, seamless digital commerce worldwide.

name_zh: 昊通语言文化传播（北京）有限公司
introduction_zh: Kallostrans，是专注于口译、笔译、本地化的专业翻译服务公司。作为专业的一站式语言服务供应商，Kallostrans提供多语种、多领域、全流程的翻译本地化服务。 以“翻译+服务”为载体，帮助海外公司走进来、本土公司走出去，对接服务全世界。
introduction_en: Kallostrans is a professional translation company focusing on interpretation, translation and localization. As a professional one-stop language service provider, Kallostrans delivers full-process translation and localization services in multiple languages across various fields. With the "Translation + Service" model, we help overseas enterprises expand into China and assist local companies to go global, serving clients all over the world.

introduction_zh: Click Orbits是一家全球效果营销机构，专注于移动游戏、移动应用及网页营销。我们通过效果广告、达人营销、创意优化及数据驱动策略，帮助开发者和发行商提升用户增长、优化ROAS并拓展全球市场。期待与全球开发者、发行商、广告平台及技术伙伴合作。
introduction_en: Click Orbits is a global performance marketing agency specializing in mobile apps, games, and web campaigns. We help developers, publishers, and digital businesses accelerate user acquisition, maximize ROAS, and achieve sustainable growth through performance advertising, influencer marketing, creative optimization, and data-driven marketing solutions. We welcome collaboration opportunities with publishers, ad platforms, and technology partners worldwide.

introduction_zh: TBM Groups 是一家领先的效果营销和联盟营销解决方案公司，致力于通过创新、数据驱动的数字营销策略帮助企业获取高质量客户。我们提供覆盖全球市场的可扩展营销服务，专注于移动应用推广、用户增长、潜在客户开发及品牌获客。凭借丰富的全球流量资源、专业的优化能力和透明的合作模式，我们为金融科技、电商、游戏、电信、旅游等多个行业提供高效的营销解决方案，助力客户实现业务增长并最大化投资回报率（ROI）
introduction_en: TBM Groups is a global performance marketing company specializing in user acquisition, affiliate marketing, and digital growth solutions. We help brands scale through data-driven campaigns across mobile, web, and connected platforms, delivering measurable results on CPA, CPL, CPI, CPC, and CPM models. With a strong global publisher network and expertise across multiple industries, we connect businesses with high-quality users worldwide.

name_zh: 嘉兴超维信息技术有限公司
introduction_zh: 嘉兴超维信息技术有限公司，提供超写实数字人角色资产制作的全流程技术设备及解决方案。公司成立于2016年，是国家高新技术企业，专精特新中心型企业。公司研发了人像3D单反相机阵列、LightStage球形光场重光照及PBR材质扫描设备、 4D动态捕捉设备、物件3D建模设备，平面PBR质扫描仪，实现了对人体（全身、人脸、皮肤材质及表情捕捉）、物件领域3D建模技术和设备的全覆盖。

name_zh: 深圳市其域创新科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 深圳市其域创新科技有限公司（XGRIDS）致力于构建空间智能平台。围绕“感知—重建—理解—创造”的技术路径，打造空间智能时代的底层技术引擎，形成覆盖多模态空间感知、自动化三维重建、智能化编辑应用的软硬件产品体系，高效生成结构精准、物理一致、视觉真实的三维空间数据，广泛服务具身智能、模拟仿真、智慧城市、影视制作、游戏文旅、VR/AR等领域。
introduction_en: XGRIDS is building a spatial intelligence platform — bridging the physical and digital worlds to provide the foundational infrastructure for AI to operate in real-world environments. The company converts advanced spatial intelligence research into production-ready products — using spatial perception, 3D reconstruction, and intelligent processing to turn physical environments into spatial data that AI systems can interpret, reason about, and act on.

introduction_zh: 成都角研社科技有限公司旗下品牌——IP角研社，专注于ACG内容IP品牌和商业文化领域，面向企业提供行业资讯、IP合作对接和企业招商活动三方面的服务。公司成立于2023年10月，总部位于成都，致力于成为链接ACG内容IP产业上下游的桥梁，截止目前在国内外12个城市成功举办超30场”IP+“合作对接会及行业论坛。

introduction_en: DreamTech is deeply engaged in the fields of 3D and 4D AI technology, dedicated to enhancing the experience of AIGC creators and consumers worldwide through innovative products and services. The company’s vision is to leverage advanced AI technologies to create spatial-temporal intelligence experiences that seamlessly connect with the real world and enable real-time interaction, ultimately advancing toward artificial general intelligence (AGI) by simulating the complexity and diversity of the real world.

name_zh: 黑龙江省华厦亿达信息科技有限公司
name_en: Heilongjiang Huaxia Yida Information Technology Co., Ltd.
introduction_zh: 黑龙江省华厦亿达信息科技 2014 年成立，深耕行业 12年，布局全国五大分公司。主营四大板块：海外游戏全球发行，多款游戏流水破 6000 万，提供全案发行配套；短剧、漫剧海内外双渠道发行，原创定制各类剧本；一站式品牌营销宣传；专业游戏美术原创定制，涵盖 AI 原画、KV、UI、视频剪辑、AI短剧/漫剧制作等，拥有千余合作案例。面向渠道、公会、品牌方开放合作，提供本地化、稳定结算等全链路服务。
introduction_en: Heilongjiang Huaxia Yida Information Technology Co., Ltd., established in 2014, boasts 12 years of industry experience and five national branches. We run four core businesses: global overseas game publishing with titles hitting over 60 million revenue and full publishing support; cross-border short drama & comic drama distribution plus original script customization; one-stop brand marketing; original game art design including AI concept art, KV, UI and video editing with 1,000+ projects. We cooperate with channels, creator groups and brands, offering full-link services such as localized operation and stable settlement.

introduction_zh: ClickDealer 自 2012 年起专注于 CPL 与 CPS 精准营销领域。十余年砥砺前行，我们在联盟营销行业中持续进化，规模与影响力已今非昔比。如今，我们携手全球知名品牌，专注运营独家优质Offer，在六大洲设立六大办公室，业务布局全球，赢得了国际市场对效果营销专业能力的高度认可。我们的目标始终如一：借助前沿广告技术与策略，在按行动付费模式下，持续实现卓越营销成效。
introduction_en:
ClickDealer started in 2012 with a few marketers specializing in different verticals who pooled their knowledge and resources to find better ways to run CPA campaigns. When we could not find the right tool for the job, we built it ourselves, and when we found someone with a vision and passion for performance marketing, we invited them to join.

Over a decade later, we are still optimizing, but on a much grander scale. Global campaigns with household brands, global presence across 6 offices, and global recognition in the performance marketing industry. Our goal remains the same: achieving peak performance in cost-per-action campaigns by utilizing the latest advancements in advertising technology and strategy.

introduction_zh: Advivify 是一家领先的全球数字广告平台，专注于为广告主和媒体合作伙伴提供数据驱动的效果营销解决方案。我们提供联盟营销、移动广告、展示广告、视频广告、原生广告及程序化广告服务，依托先进的 RTB 技术和全球优质流量资源，帮助客户提升用户增长、优化广告投放效果并提高投资回报率，同时帮助媒体实现收益最大化，致力于建立长期、透明、互利共赢的合作伙伴关系。
introduction_en: Advivify is a leading global digital advertising platform delivering data-driven performance marketing solutions for advertisers and publishers. As a privately owned international Performance, Display, Video, and Native network, we help premium brands optimize user acquisition and maximize ROI through Affiliate, Mobile, Reward, and Programmatic solutions. Our advanced RTB technology and strong partnerships with leading exchanges enable high-performing campaigns across multiple ad formats and devices. We empower publishers to maximize revenue with competitive eCPMs, diverse advertiser demand, and expert optimization, while building long-term partnerships based on trust, transparency, and performance.

name_zh: 北京海璇文化有限公司
introduction_zh: 桔子本地化成立于2015年，总部坐落于北京。凭借过硬的专业服务实力，公司稳步推进全球化布局，先后在天津、中国香港、泰国曼谷及越南胡志明市设立专属服务中心，构建起覆盖多区域、适配多语种的一体化本地化服务网络，为全球业务开展筑牢根基。自成立以来，公司已为200余家全球知名互联网企业、游戏研发与发行商、内容出版机构，提供多语言、全场景的本地化综合支持，成功交付超600个多个项目，为企业保驾护航。
introduction_en:
Founded in 2015 and headquartered in Beijing, Orange Localization boasts strong professional service expertise and steadily expands its global footprint. It has set up dedicated service centers in Tianjin, Hong Kong SAR of China, Bangkok (Thailand) and Ho Chi Minh City (Vietnam), building an integrated multi‑regional and multilingual localization service network to lay a solid foundation for global business development.
Since its establishment, the company has delivered comprehensive multilingual and full‑scenario localization support for over 200 world‑renowned internet enterprises, game developers, publishers and content publishers. With more than 600 successful projects completed, it provides reliable support for clients’ global expansion and overseas operations.

introduction_zh:
巨界互娱(上海)网络科技有限公司是一家新成立有朝气、有活力的公司，致力于为全球用户提供优质、趣味内容的新模式游戏、购物的公司。自创立之初，公司就坚定不移的在研发精品游戏及购物APP的道路上踏实前行，旨在为“全球用户带来极致的游戏、购物新体验”，同战略合作伙伴一起不断扩展全球版图。欢迎有梦想、有激情、
有想法的伙伴加入我们，我们将为您提供自由、宽广的发展空间!
introduction_en:
Jujie Huyu (Shanghai) Network Technology Co., Ltd. is a newly established and vibrant enterprise. We are dedicated to developing innovative games and shopping platforms with high-quality and entertaining content for global users.
Since the founding, we have remained firmly committed to the R&D of high-quality games and shopping mobile applications. Our goal is to deliver an ultimate brand-new experience in gaming and online shopping to users all over the world. Together with our strategic partners, we continuously expand our global business territory.

name_zh: 睿光信息科技(香港)有限公司
introduction_zh: Recon Technology Hong Kong Limited 是领先的国际云服务代理与 AI 技术解决方案提供商，专注助力中资企业出海。我们深度对接阿里云、腾讯云、AWS、华为云、谷歌云、微软云等全球头部云厂商，为游戏、直播、语聊、金融、制造、政府等行业提供安全合规的云服务代理、多币种代充值及全栈技术支持。作为阿里云国际旗舰级总代，连续五年全球前三，服务客户超 200 家，交付成功率98%
introduction_en: Recon Technology Hong Kong Limited is a leading international cloud service agency and AI solutions provider, helping Chinese enterprises expand globally. We partner with Alibaba Cloud, Tencent Cloud, AWS, Huawei Cloud, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure. As an Alibaba Cloud International Flagship Reseller for five years and a global top-three partner, we offer world-class infrastructure, preferential pricing, and local support. Our services include secure multi-currency recharging, cloud migration, hybrid architecture, cost optimization, and 7×24 managed IT services powered by RPA, AI and BI. Trusted by 200+ clients with a 98% project delivery rate, we also invite partners to join our reseller network.

introduction_en: Blue Network Technology is a premier service provider specializing in overseas ad media traffic operations. Driven by our core values of "Precise Traffic, High Conversion, and Long-Term Growth," we deliver one-stop global advertising solutions tailored for brands looking to expand overseas and capitalize on global traffic opportunities.

introduction_zh: 月退制成立于2015年，是一家以创意为核心的全链路游戏发行服务商。与全球各头部游戏厂商均有稳定的合作，如：腾讯、网易、拳头、蓝洞等。月退制作通过坚持优质的交付获得了业内广泛好评。业务范围包含账号及生态运营、内容制作、平面设计、海外业务、公会与MCN及线上线下营销等。在11年的游戏业服务中，坚持0回扣，希望最终成为玩家最向往的游戏产业公司。

We maintain stable partnerships with leading global game developers, including Tencent, NetEase, Riot Games, Krafton, etc. Our commitment to high-quality production has earned us widespread acclaim within the industry.  Our services include social media account and ecosystem management, content creation, graphic design, international cooperations, guild & MCN, and online & offline marketing. With 11 years in the gaming industry, we have maintained a ‘zero-kickback’ rule and aspire to become the gaming company that players most look up to.

name_zh: 北京吾爱吾乐文化传播有限公司
name_en: MUSIC IN EYES CULTURE COMMUNICATION Co.,Ltd.
introduction_zh: 公司主营杜比全景声节目、高清立体声、5.1 电影音效及影视作曲制作，为杜比合作伙伴，具备全景声家庭版制作资质。业务覆盖影视前期录音，后期对白、动效、作曲、音编至终混全流程音频制作，所有配乐均可保障版权。公司作品屡获国内外奖项，业内知名度较高。内设作曲部、音编部、配音部，集结音乐总监、声音导演、录音、作曲、拟音、混音、配音等专业人员，团队稳定，可按项目需求灵活调整制作配置，制作水准广受行业认可。
introduction_en: Founded in 2011, the company specializes in Dolby Atmos, stereo, 5.1 film audio, and scoring. A Dolby partner with Atmos home edition certification. Covers full audio post-production from location recording to dialogue, Foley, scoring, sound design, and final mix. All music copyright-cleared. Award-winning works domestically and internationally. Highly reputable. Houses composing, sound design, and dubbing departments, with music directors, sound directors, engineers, composers, Foley artists, mixers, and voice actors. Stable team, flexible project-based configuration.

introduction_zh: 橘子传媒(OrangeMedia)是一家专注于全球移动互联网广告投放与品牌出海营销的尖端解决方案提供商
introduction_en: OrangeMedia is a leading provider of cutting-edge solutions focused on global mobile internet ad placement and brand expansion into international markets.

introduction_zh:
我们是一家总部位于东京的日本游戏公司，专注于女性向恋爱游戏的自主研发，产品已发行至日本、中国、东南亚、中东及欧美市场。
同时，我们为游戏、动漫、漫画等泛娱乐领域提供日本及亚洲市场拓展服务，涵盖本地化、配音制作、市场推广、IP授权（引进/输出）等海外业务。公司拥有以亚洲为中心的多国母语团队，可根据不同市场需求提供专业、高效的一站式解决方案，欢迎莅临我们的展位，期待与您交流合作！
introduction_en:
We are a Japan-based game company headquartered in Tokyo.

We develop our own games with a focus on romance games for women and publish them across Japan, China, Southeast Asia, the Middle East, Europe, and North America.

In addition to game development, we support companies in expanding into the Japanese and Asian markets across various entertainment fields, including anime and manga.

Our services cover every aspect of global business development, including localization, voice recording, promotion, and licensing (inbound and outbound). With a multilingual team of native professionals from across Asia, we provide one-stop solutions tailored to each target market.

Feel free to visit our booth—we look forward to meeting you!

introduction_zh: 株式会社译坊于2010年10月28日成立，是一家以游戏本地化翻译及语音收录，商务领域的口译笔译为主的企业。自公司创立以来，译坊不仅努力于自身的发展与成长，而且关注整个行业的提高与进步。在翻译人员流动大、水平参差、良莠不齐的情况下，译坊以诚信的合作态度成功集结到一批顶尖水准的优秀译员，秉着用心翻译，以字传心的企业理念，已为近百部游戏实现了完美的本地化翻译。
introduction_en:
Yakubo Co., Ltd. was established on October 28, 2010. The company specializes in game localization—including translation and voice recording—as well as interpretation and translation services in the business sector.
Since its founding, Yakubo has not only dedicated itself to its own growth and development but has also contributed to the overall improvement and progress of the industry. Guided by the corporate philosophy of “We carefully convey the thoughts and feelings that dwell in words.” Yakubo has delivered high-quality localization for nearly one hundred games. Guided by the corporate philosophy of “We carefully convey the thoughts and feelings that dwell in words.” Yakubo has delivered high-quality localization for nearly one hundred games.

name_zh: 成都海妖科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
AirSound AI 是基于大模型的智能语音体，支持连接企业知识库与业务系统，提供自然连贯的多轮对话与实时意图理解。
核心优势：打破传统外呼限制，不仅能通话，更能自动完成预约、线索筛选、工单创建、CRM更新及人工转接，真正智能推动业务执行。
应用场景：全面覆盖营销触达、销售跟进、服务回访、投诉处理等全链路场景，助企业打造全天候、可优化的智能客户沟通体系。
introduction_en:
AirSound AI is an LLM-powered voice agent that delivers natural, multi-turn conversations with real-time intent recognition, fully integrating with your knowledge base and business systems.

Core Value: Beyond traditional automated calling—it doesn't just talk, it drives action by automating scheduling, lead screening, ticketing, CRM updates, and human handoffs.

Applications: Spans marketing, sales follow-ups, customer retention, and complaint handling, helping enterprises build a 24/7, measurable, and evolving communication system.

introduction_zh: 玲央奈软件专注于中日游戏的研发支持、出海引进、本地化与市场营销。近一年参与10款游戏项目，积累了丰富实务经验。面向计划进入日本市场的中国游戏企业，尤其是中小团队，公司可提供兼具品质与成本优势的本地化、推广及咨询服务，并覆盖内容企划、行业交流会策划与游戏开发。曾负责正规授权军事题材主机游戏首次赴日业务，蜡笔小新IP游戏授权与出海业务，目前亦在研发本地化题材PC独立游戏《疯狂本地化》。欢迎咨询合作。
introduction_en: Leona Software specializes in development support, overseas publishing and introduction, localization, and marketing for video games between Greater China and Japan. Having contributed to 10 game projects over the past year, we offer extensive hands-on experience. For Chinese game companies entering Japan—especially small and mid-sized teams—we provide cost-effective, high-quality localization, promotion, and consulting services, as well as content planning, industry event coordination, and game development support. We have led the first Japan-market launch of an officially licensed military-themed console title, famous anime IP game and are currently developing Crazy Localization, a PC indie narrative adventure centered on the game localization industry. We welcome partnership inquiries.

introduction_zh:
"寻汇SUNRATE是行业领先的全球支付与财资管理平台，公司成立于2016年，凭借其先进的基础设施、全球支付网络及一站式解决方案，助力企业在190+国家及地区实现本地化运营与全球扩张。

寻汇SUNRATE在多个关键市场设有办公室，包括新加坡、吉隆坡、雅加达、中国香港、上海及伦敦。公司与花旗银行、渣打银行、中国银行等顶级金融机构保持战略合作，同时也是万事达卡、Visa以及银联国际的主会员机构。"
introduction_en:
SUNRATE is a leading global payment and treasury management platform for businesses worldwide. Founded in 2016, SUNRATE has enabled companies to operate and scale both locally and globally in 190+ countries and regions with its cutting-edge infrastructure, global network, and unified solutions.

SUNRATE operates through offices across key markets, including Singapore, Kuala Lumpur, Jakarta, Hong Kong, Shanghai, and London. The company partners with the top global financial institutions, such as Citibank, Standard Chartered, Barclays, J.P. Morgan. SUNRATE is also the principal member of Mastercard and Visa.

introduction_zh: UgameDeal是专为数娱出海提供三方支付收单和代付解决方案的供应商，一站式接入支付网络覆盖海外主流市场，直连200+本地支付方式。一键代付服务，资金瞬时通达，批量付款、实时到账、安全高效。适配弱联网游戏场景，让每一笔订单都稳稳到账。
introduction_en: UgameDeal is a provider of third-party payment acquiring and payout solutions tailored for digital entertainment going global. Our unified API connects to over 200 local payment methods across major overseas markets. With one-click mass disbursement, funds reach recipients instantly—batch processing, real-time settlement, and secure efficiency. Optimized for weak-network gaming scenarios, every transaction is settled reliably.

name_zh: 北京数字悦动科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 数字悦动是一家由国有资本战略领投的智能营销服务商，致力于为广告主与媒体提供基于数据和算法的全链路商业解决方案。公司依托自主研发的程序化广告平台与AI技术，汇聚海量优质预算，帮助合作伙伴实现流量的高效变现与商业价值最大化。
京畿道内容振兴院（GCA）是为推动京畿道文化产业发展而设立的公共机构，致力于支持出版、网络漫画、动画、音乐、影像、电影、游戏等京畿道内容的创作、流通及海外拓展。在ChinaJoy BTOB展馆，京畿道内容振兴院（GCA）将设立"京畿道展馆"，携手京畿道游戏企业，共同展示丰富多样的优质韩国游戏内容。诚挚邀请对韩国游戏感兴趣的各位莅临京畿道展馆，期待与您相见。
introduction_en: Gyeonggi Content Agency (GCA) is a public institution established by Gyeonggi Province to promote its cultural industries. GCA supports the production, distribution, and global expansion of content from Gyeonggi Province across a wide range of sectors, including publishing, webtoons, animation, music, video, film, and games. At the ChinaJoy BTOB Hall, GCA will host the Gyeonggi Province Pavilion together with game companies based in Gyeonggi Province to showcase a diverse range of high-quality Korean games. If you are interested in Korean games, we look forward to welcoming you at the Gyeonggi Province Pavilion.

introduction_zh:
Ironmace 是一家怀抱"开发前所未有的游戏，为全球玩家带来全新体验"这一目标，由各领域专业人士于2021年携手创立的游戏开发公司。
我们始终怀着对玩家的尊重之心，汇聚于大韩民国的这群充满热情的创作者们，正在开启游戏的全新文艺复兴。秉承"玩家至上"（Gamer First）的理念，我们致力于打造能够弥合文化差异的作品，并将不断成长为连接东西方的全球游戏品牌。
introduction_en:
IRONMACE Co., Ltd. is a game developer founded in 2021 by experts in each field with the goal of "developing games that have never existed in the world and providing new experiences to gamers around the world."
With respect for gamers, passionate creators gathered in Korea are opening a new renaissance of the game, and we will grow into a global game franchise connecting the East and the West by creating works that are faithful to Gamer First philosophy and resolving cultural gaps through games.

introduction_zh: SuperStormStudio是由韩国网络游戏第一代开发者创立的游戏开发工作室。核心成员自2000年起在allm开发动作游戏，并与Nexon、Tencent等全球伙伴合作。基于20年以上动作游戏经验，我们致力于打造面向全球玩家的全新动作团队竞技游戏，并挑战全球电竞市场。StormStriker正是这一愿景下开发的5v5动作团队竞技游戏。
introduction_en: SuperStormStudio is a development studio founded by first-generation developers from South Korea's online gaming industry. Since 2000, our core members have developed action games at allm that attracted the attention of many online gamers, while collaborating with major partners such as Nexon and Tencent. Built on more than 20 years of action game development experience, SuperStormStudio aims to create a new action team battle game that players around the world can enjoy and to challenge the global eSports market. StormStriker is the 5v5 action team battle game developed with this vision.

introduction_zh: 京畿内容振兴院（Gyeonggi Content Agency，简称 GCA）是韩国京畿道专门负责推动文化内容产业发展的公共机构。GCA致力于支持游戏、网络漫画、动画、AI、XR、角色IP及数字内容等多个创意产业领域的发展，并通过企业培育、国际市场推广、投资对接及国际合作等多元化支持，助力韩国内容企业拓展海外市场，提升全球竞争力。
introduction_en: The Gyeonggi Content Agency (GCA) is a public organization dedicated to fostering the growth of the content industry in Gyeonggi Province, Korea. GCA supports companies across a wide range of creative sectors, including games, webtoons, animation, AI, XR, character IP, and digital content. Through business development, global marketing, investment support, and international partnerships, GCA helps Korean content companies expand into overseas markets and strengthen their global competitiveness.

introduction_zh: Studio W.BABA是一家专注于动画与角色IP的内容企业，业务涵盖策划、制作、发行、授权、衍生品及品牌合作。旗下拥有在中国已实现授权与商业化成果的3D动画IP《B-Family》，以及累计播放量超90亿的热门漫画IP《太阳的灵药》。公司希望通过ChinaJoy拓展中国市场，寻找授权、零售、联合制作及投资合作伙伴。
introduction_en:
Studio W.BABA is an animation and character IP company engaged in content planning, production, distribution, licensing, merchandising, and brand 
collaboration. Its key IPs include B-Family, a non-verbal short-form 3D animated character IP with proven licensing, merchandising, and investment achievements 
in China, and Elixir of the Sun, a premium romance fantasy IP based on a hit webtoon with strong marketability across Asia, including over 9 billion cumulative views on China’s Kuaikan. Through ChinaJoy, Studio W.BABA aims to expand its IP business in China by discovering licensing, merchandise, retail, digital platform, co-production, and investment partners.

introduction_zh: RIMA Entertainment是一家融合AI与机器人技术的韩国媒体科技企业，专注于智能媒体与沉浸式内容开发。旗下《BandMaster》结合AI机器人乐器技术，打造创新音乐互动体验。公司已达成超800万美元全球IP合作，并积极拓展AI/XR合作与投资业务。
introduction_en:
RIMA Entertainment is an AI-driven media company that integrates artificial intelligence and robotics with culture and entertainment. The company develops smart media and immersive content solutions based on its proprietary physical AI robotics technology. Its flagship content, BandMaster, is a real-time collaborative rhythm action game synchronized with AI robotic instruments, featuring 1024-level piano control and 127-level drum striking power to deliver a unique live-performance experience. 
RIMA is expanding into virtual artists, AI companion platforms, and music IP businesses. The company has secured over USD 8 million in global IP deals and is actively pursuing AI/XR partnerships and investments worldwide.

introduction_zh: Birdletter是一家专注于高品质休闲游戏开发的韩国移动游戏公司，以角色驱动的原创IP开发为核心竞争力。公司凭借出色的视觉表现和富有趣味性的游戏体验，持续打造深受全球玩家喜爱的作品，并不断提升在国际市场的竞争力。
introduction_en:
Birdletter Inc., a casual game development studio where characters come to life
Birdletter is a top-tier mobile game studio specializing in high-quality casual games. We focus on character-driven game development, creating original IPs with xceptional visual quality that resonate with players around the world. By delivering games that are both fun and polished, we continue to strengthen our competitive edge in the global market.

introduction_zh: NVEX是一家专注于艺术与音乐教育的韩国AI教育科技企业，旗下品牌“MEW”结合自主研发的教育AI Agent和音乐AI伙伴“VOCCO”，打造线上线下融合的沉浸式教育解决方案。旗舰产品MEW DRUM将电子鼓与节奏游戏相结合，已广泛应用于韩国学校、公共机构及大型活动。公司正进一步拓展钢琴、吉他、K-POP及舞蹈领域，并致力于构建全球AI艺术教育生态体系。
introduction_en: NVEX Inc., founded in 2022, is an AI ed-tech company specializing in arts and music education. Through its AI music education brand, MEW, the company develops blended edutainment solutions powered by its proprietary educational AI Agent and music companion character, VOCCO. Its flagship product, MEW DRUM, combines electronic drums with rhythm-game-style feedback to deliver immersive learning experiences. Since its launch in 2025, it has been adopted by schools, public institutions, and major festivals across Korea. Building on the success of MEW PIANO and MEW DRUM, NVEX is expanding into guitar, vocal, K-POP, and dance education, aiming to build a global AI-powered arts education ecosystem. Its technology has been recognized at CES 2025 and GITEX 2024.

introduction_zh: Ailive是一家专注于游戏、XR和虚拟人领域的韩国AI内容科技企业。旗下平台Genaimo利用Agentic AI技术，实现高品质3D角色动画的智能生成，大幅提升制作效率并降低创作门槛。公司同时开发原创游戏IP，持续验证AI驱动内容生产的商业化应用，致力于构建全球下一代AI创意基础设施。
introduction_en: Ailive is an AI content technology company transforming content creation for gaming, XR, and virtual humans through Agentic AI. Its flagship platform, Genaimo, enables creators and studios to generate high-quality 3D character animations with AI, significantly improving production efficiency and lowering technical barriers. Beyond AI tools, Ailive is validating its technology through the development of two original game IPs powered by its proprietary Agentic AI. By making content creation faster, more accessible, and scalable, Ailive is building the next generation of AI-powered creative infrastructure for the global content industry.

introduction_zh: Newcore Games成立于2020年，是一家位于韩国京畿道城南市的独立游戏开发公司。公司的代表作《The Devil Within：SAGAT》是以韩国传统神话为背景，在Steam和PS5全球发行，累计销量约10万份，并荣获韩国游戏大奖、GYAAR大奖及Epic MegaGrants。新作《7 Trials》融合韩国冥界神话与阈限恐怖元素，支持4人联机合作，预计于2026年11月正式上线。
introduction_en:
Newcore Games is a Korean indie game studio founded in 2020, based in Seongnam, Gyeonggi-do.
Our debut title The Devil Within: SATGAT, a Korean folklore-inspired action game released globally on Steam and PS5, achieved approximately 100,000 cumulative sales, earning the Minister of Culture Award at Korea Game Awards, the Bandai Namco GYAAR Indie Game Contest Award, and Epic MegaGrants recognition.
Our upcoming title 7 Trials is a top-down hack-n-slash action roguelite that fuses Korean afterlife mythology with liminal horror aesthetics, featuring up to 4-player online co-op. Selected for KOCCA's Multi-Year Game Development Support Program(Console), the game is targeting its initial launch in November 2026.

name_zh: 智冠科技股份有限公司
introduction_zh: 智冠科技深耕数字内容产业超过四十年，为两岸首家上市柜游戏公司。除了是中国台湾省最大的游戏整合服务商，更逐步扩展至游戏自制研发、游戏代理营运、游戏行销通路及数字内容点数服务平台，并出版游戏相关丛书和杂志，形成完整的产业链。面对多元的网络科技挑战，智冠逐步拓展至数位游戏、网络广告行销和金融科技三大核心事业群，提供全方位在地营销资源，深获国际游戏大厂肯定，为进入华人游戏市场的首选合作伙伴
introduction_en: Soft-World has been a prominent game company in the Chinese market for nearly 40 years and is the first publicly listed game company in Greater China. Initially focusing on distributing and selling computer games, it has expanded into game development, game distribution, marketing, digital contemt services, and publishing game-related books and magazines, creating a comprehensive industry chain. In response to diverse challenges in internet technology. Soft-World has expanded into three core business areas: digital gaming, online advertising, and fintech. It integrates resources and experience to maintain a strong presense in Taiwan, Hong Kong, Macau, and International business。

introduction_zh: 快鸟先飞(BIG BEAK)是专注于全球营销的一站式解决方案供应商。作为Kwai for Business官方授权一级广告代理商和TikTok for Business官方授权一级广告代理商，我们以拉美、东南亚等高增长市场为战略支点，为寻求全球增长的企业客户提供账户开户优化，流量精准代投，创意素材定制，用户长效增长等全维度营销解决方案。
introduction_en:
BIG BEAK is a one-stop solution provider specializing in global marketing services.
As an officially authorized Tier 1 advertising agency for both Kwai for Business and TikTok for Business, we strategically anchor our operations in high-growth markets including Latin America and Southeast Asia. We deliver full-spectrum marketing solutions to enterprise clients pursuing global expansion, covering account opening and optimization, targeted traffic campaign management, custom creative asset production, and sustainable long-term user growth.

name_zh: 巨溪商务信息咨询（上海）有限公司
introduction_zh: Worldline 是全球领先的支付与交易服务提供商，致力于为企业构建无边界的数字支付生态。我们通过覆盖全球的收单、跨境结算、本地化支付渠道和安全合规解决方案，帮助商户在全球市场快速扩张、提升转化率和营收。Worldline 的目标是成为全球游戏发行商和全球电商等跨境业务的支付伙伴，帮助企业无缝连接全球买家，提升全球收入与增长潜力，同时降低复杂性与运营成本。
introduction_en: Worldline is a global leader in payments and transactional services, dedicated to building boundary-free digital payment ecosystems for merchants operating at scale across the world. By connecting merchants to a global network of acquiring banks, cross-border settlement rails, localized payment channels, and robust security and compliance solutions, Worldline enables brands to expand rapidly into new markets, elevate conversion, and grow revenue with less complexity.

introduction_zh: 猎豹出海（纽交所上市企业猎豹移动旗下），Meta/TikTok/Google 等14大平台官方代理及WhatsApp BSP官方商业解决方案提供商，13 年海外广告经验，累计 $80 亿广告消耗，服务 8 万 + 出海客户，管理 100 万 + 广告账户，覆盖 220 + 海外国家和地区，为出海企业提供广告营销+AI工具（龙虾|素材制作|智能投放|WhatsApp增长运营）+云和大模型全链路服务。
introduction_en:
Cheetah Global is the international growth division of Cheetah Mobile, providing end-to-end advertising, AI, and cloud solutions for businesses expanding worldwide. 
Backed by official partnerships with 14 leading media platforms—including Meta, TikTok, and Google—and as a certified WhatsApp Business Solution Provider (BSP), we bring over 13 years of global advertising expertise. To date, we have managed more than US$8 billion in ad spend, served 80,000+ businesses, operated over 1 million advertising accounts, and supported campaigns across 220+ countries and regions. 
Through our integrated ecosystem of advertising services, EasyClaw AI solutions, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise AI services—including LLM API and token solutions—we help businesses accelerate global growth.

name_zh: 深圳吉优网络科技有限公司
introduction_zh:
Geeyoo(吉优)深耕行业十多年，服务超几千款产品，以专业团队和成熟平台为全球30+国家游戏厂商提供一站式本地化解决方案。

Rooted deeply in the gaming industry and leveraging the resources and expertise of Game7, the company focuses on game data analysis and data-driven operations. Centered on its self-developed Fineboost platform, the core business provides full-lifecycle data solutions covering user acquisition, ad monetization, user behavior analytics, and game components for game developers, publishers, and operators worldwide.

introduction_zh: VBERAI （上海胥图⽹络科技）是⼀家专注于 AI 原⽣游戏创作平台与智能⽣产⼒基础设施的平台。VBERAI 构建了⾯向设计师、开发者、游戏团队、企业与创作者的新⼀代游戏 AI 创作平台——AI Studio，通过统⼀的智能⼯作空间，将⼤型语⾔模型、图像⽣成模型、视频模型以及各类专业 AI 引擎连接在⼀起，让复杂的创意⽣产流程实现智能化、⾃动化和规模化。
introduction_en: VBERAI (Shanghai Xutu Network Technology) is a platform dedicated to AI-native game creation platforms and intelligent productivity infrastructure. VBERAI has developed a new-generation game AI creation platform—AI Studio—targeted at designers, developers, game teams, enterprises, and creators. By integrating large language models, image generation models, video models, and various professional AI engines into a unified intelligent workspace, it enables complex creative production processes to become intelligent, automated, and scalable.

introduction_zh: Monetapay成立于2019年，拥有MSO, MSB和印尼支付牌照，核心团队来自百度、京东等一线互联网大厂，拥有丰富的互联网支付行业经验。当前在印尼、泰国和菲律宾地区进行深耕运营，并在更多国家进行布局中；凭借领先的技术实力、完善的风控体系和本地化运营能力，整体业务呈现强劲增长态势，平台日均交易规模已超过3000万美元。
introduction_en: MonetaPay was established in 2019 and holds MSO, MSB, and Indonesian payment licenses. Its core team comprises seasoned professionals from leading internet giants such as Baidu and JD.com, bringing extensive expertise in the internet payments industry. The company currently operates in-depth in Indonesia, Thailand and Philippines, with ongoing expansion into additional markets. Leveraging its cutting-edge technological capabilities, robust risk control framework, and localized operational expertise, MonetaPay has achieved sustained and vigorous growth, with daily transaction volumes exceeding USD 30 million.

introduction_zh: 圓幣科技是一家立足中國香港、面向全球的金融科技集團，通過旗下多個持牌實體為企業提供創新的數字金融服務。集團致力於建設連接傳統金融（Web2）與 Web3 的新一代金融基礎設施。  作為中國香港金融管理局（HKMA）首批穩定幣發行人沙盒的入選企業，圓幣科技始終堅持合規與創新並重。目前，集團累計融資額已超過 9000 萬美元。了解更多：https://rd.group/zh-Hant/
introduction_en: RD Technologies is a global financial technology group that provides innovative digital financial services to enterprises through its regulated subsidiaries. The group is dedicated to building the next generation of financial infrastructure bridging traditional finance (Web2) and Web3. As an early participant admitted into the Hong Kong Monetary Authority (HKMA) Stablecoins Issuer Sandbox, RD Technologies maintains a steadfast commitment to balancing rigorous compliance with pioneering innovation. To date, the group has secured over $90 million USD in cumulative funding. Learn more: https://rd.group

name_zh: 上海汉威信恒展览有限公司
introduction_zh: 中国国际数码互动娱乐展览会（简称ChinaJoy)，是由国家新闻出版署和上海市人民政府共同指导，中国音像与数字出版协会和上海汉威信恒展览有限公司主办，上海市新闻出版局和浦东新区人民政府协办的综合性国际数宇娱乐产业盛会。
introduction_en: China International Digital Interactive Entertainment Expo (referred to as ChinaJoy) is a comprehensive international digital entertainment industry event jointly guided by the State Press and Publication Administration and Shanghai Municipal People's Government, hosted by China Audiovisual and Digital Publishing Association and Shanghai Hanwei Xinheng Exhibition Company Limited, and co-sponsored by Shanghai Municipal Bureau of Press and Publication and the People's Government of Pudong New Area.

name_zh: 广州兄弟玩网络科技有限公司
introduction_zh: 2018年成立于广州，集游戏创新研发、直播运营买量、游戏联运发行于一体的综合型游戏公司，凭借对传奇品类的深度深耕与全链路业务布局，在短短数年间打造出多款月流水破亿、累计流水超十亿的爆款产品。专注 996 传奇、996 传世手游赛道，打造了专业一体化研运团队。我们拥有长线研发与全渠道发行的完整闭环能力，深耕传奇品类，专注产品商业化落地与运营推广。
introduction_en: Founded in Guangzhou in 2018, we are a comprehensive gaming company that combines game innovation and development, live broadcast operation and marketing, and game interconnection and distribution. Through our deep engagement with the legendary genre and our comprehensive business strategy, we have created several popular products with monthly revenue of over 100 million yuan and cumulative revenue exceeding 1 billion yuan within just a few years. We specialize in the 996 Legend and 996 Legendary Mobile Games segments and have established a professional, integrated research and operation team. We possess a complete closed-loop capability for long-term research and development, as well as full-channel distribution, and have focused on the commercialization and operation of our products.

name_en: Cheung Kong Graduate School of Business
introduction_zh: 长江商学院成立于2002年11月21日，是教育部批准设立的拥有独立法人资格的非营利性中外合作办学机构，是国务院学位委员会批准的“工商管理硕士授予单位”（含EMBA和MBA），为国际管理教育协会(AACSB)和欧洲管理发展基金会(EFMD)成员，并获得AACSB和EQUIS认证。学院总部位于北京，现设有工商管理硕士项目；高级工商管理硕士项目；企业家学者项目；高层管理教育项目及全球独角兽项目。
introduction_en: CKGSB is China’s first privately-funded and research-driven business school. With our MBA, Executive MBA and Executive Education programs, we provide top business education for established business leaders and disruptive entrepreneurs shaping a better future in China and beyond. We are also the preferred institution for academics returning to China from leading global business schools.
